tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

There are 126 matches of `X is Type` without a preceding validity guard. Fixing all would be a huge refactor (risky, out of scope). The user's report is specifically about the `is` used together with `is_instance_valid` in the wrong order — i.e., the code *tries* to guard but does it too late. That's the "残留问题" — the guard exists but is ordered wrong.

Key insight to explain: `is` on a freed instance triggers the runtime warning; `is_instance_valid()` is the safe guard, so it must come first. Where the code deliberately checks `is_instance_valid`, the order was wrong in 3 places → fixed.

Should I also catch cases where `is_instance_valid` guard appears in a *later* condition of the same `if` — like NetSession:1124 `if bsrc is Hero and float(bsrc.attack_range) > 400.0:` — no validity guard at all, `bsrc` may be freed → same class of warning. Let me check the enclosing function of 1117-1124 — it's probably `_bullet_source_kind` similar to `_bullet_vkind`. Both take `bl.source` which can be freed. Line 1043 guards properly.

Worth fixing: functions around 1117 that use `bsrc` without validity check at all. Let me read 1105-1135 to see the function(s) and add an early guard `if not is_instance_valid(bsrc): return 0` (single place) — clean and minimal. Similarly `_bullet_vkind` (fixed) and the one at 1117.

Let me read that region.

Also `JungleMonster.gd:430 if killer is Hero:` — after line 417 guard `not is_instance_valid(killer) or not killer is Hero` → if killer invalid, the function returns? line 417 `if not is_instance_valid(killer) or not killer is Hero or killer.team == team:` — need to see whether that's a return or a branch. If it returns early, line 430 is safe. Let me check quickly.

Focus: the report is about the warning triggered by that specific pattern. Provide a robust minimal fix:
1. The 3 order fixes (done).
2. Add a validity guard at the top of the two bsrc helper functions in NetSession if missing.
3. Explain the general rule and that the remaining ~126 `is` checks are on *live* references (function params from same-frame code), low risk — but I can't prove all.

Hmm, being honest: the truly dangerous ones are those taking a possibly-freed stored reference (bullet.source, last_attacker, current_target, manual_target). Most of those already have guards in surrounding code.

Let me read NetSession 1105-1135 + JungleMonster 410-440 to decide.

Efficient: one read each, small.

The client draws it manually per-frame. To make it collapsible there I'd need:
- a `var attr_collapsed := false` in that inner class
- in `_draw_attr_panel`: if collapsed → panel_h = head only, skip legend/rows, draw title "属性 ▸"
- tap handling: need to know how this overlay handles input. It's an inner class of NetClientBattle (a Control overlay drawing). Would need `_gui_input` handling → request redraw. Doable ~15 lines but need to see the class's input handling and whether it redraws every frame (`queue_redraw` each frame). Given the draw is per-frame, adding a tap region in `_gui_input` may conflict with existing touch logic (camera control).

Cost/benefit: user probably tests single-player/host (they run the project in editor and play normally — host). The LAN client is a secondary mode. I'll skip and disclose clearly, offering to mirror it.

Hmm — but if their project defaults to net mode when running... Unlikely; they've been testing a single-player battle.

Actually, wait: is the host panel even visible in LAN? Yes host draws via UI_Manager.

OK finalize: verify compile done (battle scene run clean). Clean up .cache and devprobe, notify, and report.

Also possible conflict: `attribute_panel` might block world clicks below it — it already did.

Clean up + notify.

查到了根因，三个症状其实是**两个 bug + 一个功能缺失**：

**① 攻击事件行布局错位（真正的根因，导致动画和特效全没）** — [NetSession.gd:1221](scripts/net/NetSession.gd#L1221)

主机推的 EV_ACT 行是 `[fid, 4, nid, act, yaw]`（5 列），但客户端统一按「第 2~4 列是 x/y/z」解析，nid/act/yaw 取第 **5~7** 列：

```
客户端读 row[5]=nid → 主机这行只有 0~4 列 → 越界 → 事件解析失败
```

所以客户端**每一条**攻击动作事件都读不出来，`_apply_hero_act()` 从来没被正确调用过。修复：补上坐标三列，与伤害/金币/经验行对齐。

**② 远程英雄播错动作档** — [NetClientBattle.gd:1191-1211](scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd#L1191-L1211)

客户端写死只播 `attack-melee-left`（挥拳），而主机远程英雄播的是 `holding-right-shoot` / `holding-both-shoot`（拉弓/射击）。现在主机在 `hero_anim` 里用 `act=1` 标记远程攻击（[Hero.gd:2514](scripts/entities/Hero.gd#L2514) 等 3 处），客户端按 act 选 clip：后羿/孙尚香/元流之子 → `holding-both-shoot`，其它远程 → `holding-right-shoot`，近战 → 左右交替（复刻主机 `_melee_anim_flip`）。

**③ 攻击特效（枪口粒子）客户端本地补** — 主机远程普攻的 `Vfx.cast_burst` 枪口闪光**不进 FX 流**，客户端本来就没有。现在收到 `act=1` 时在客户端本地放一次（位置/朝向按主机同款公式：身前 0.65、高 1.2）。因为主机不推这个粒子，不会重影。近战不加，和主机表现保持一致。

**④ 空格普攻（功能缺失）** — [NetClientBattle.gd:1654](scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd#L1654)

客户端 `_unhandled_input` 里根本没有 `KEY_SPACE` 分支。新增 `_attack_nearest_in_reach()`：用本端已知实体 + `own.reach`（主机同步过来的普攻射程）找最近的敌方目标（英雄/小兵/塔/野怪，跳过己方与残血），发 `C_ATTACK` 锁定，并同步 `_manual_net`。语义与主机空格「把 manual_target 设成范围内最近的敌人」一致。

**验证**：带 autoload 的临时场景跑真实引擎（Godot 4.7.2 headless），`Hero.gd` / `NetClientBattle.gd` / `NetSession.gd` / `UI_Manager.gd` 全部编译通过，临时文件已清理。

**需要你实测**：联机是双端行为，我只能静态确认链路。重点看三件事——① 客户端英雄打人时有挥击/射击动作；② 远程英雄开火有枪口闪光；③ 客户端按空格能锁敌并自动开打。如果动画还是不动，把客户端的报错日志发我（重点看有没有 `Invalid access` 或 `_apply_hero_act` 相关行），我再补。

Client minions also lack attack animation. Host minions: do they animate attacks? Minion.gd — check if it plays an attack anim. If host animates minions via `_play_anim` or similar, client needs replication.

Design considerations: pushing EV_ACT per minion attack would spam (many minions × 3 lanes). NetSession's `push_net_action` gates on `_hero_ally_near(p)` (18m of an ally hero) — good gate, would limit to nearby skirmishes. But minion attack events are frequent: each minion ~1/s, 18m radius maybe 20 minions → 20 events/s. That's heavy but the buffer keeps 350ms of rows and rows are tiny; snapshots at 15Hz. Could be acceptable but risky.

Cheaper client-side approach: **local inference** — client knows minion positions and can detect attack behavior? Without target info it can't know when a minion attacks. But we can approximate: minions animate attack when they have a target in range... client doesn't know targets.

```gdscript
func _apply_hero_act(nid: int, act: int, yaw: float) -> void:
	var v: Dictionary = _views.get(nid, {})
	if v.is_empty() or not v.has("ap"):
		return
	var nn: Node3D = v.node
	if nn != null and is_instance_valid(nn):
		nn.rotation.y = yaw   # 动作朝向（host 用 rotation.y 面向目标，同约定）
	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	var ap: AnimationPlayer = v.ap
	var is_hero := int(v.type) == NET_HERO
	var clip := ""
	var win := 620
	match act:
		NetSession.ACT_DIE:
			clip = _clip_hint(ap, ["death", "die"])
			if clip == "":
				clip = str(v.get("atk_clip", ""))
			win = 0
		NetSession.ACT_CAST_SPRINT:
			clip = _clip_hint(ap, ["sprint"])
		NetSession.ACT_CAST_INTERACT:
			clip = _clip_hint(ap, ["interact"])
		NetSession.ACT_CAST_MELEE:
			clip = "attack-melee-right" if ap.has_animation("attack-melee-right") else _clip_hint(ap, ["attack-melee", "attack", "punch"])
		NetSession.ACT_CAST_BOTH_SHOOT:
			clip = "holding-both-shoot" if ap.has_animation("holding-both-shoot") else _clip_hint(ap, ["holding", "shoot"])
		_:
			if not is_hero:
				clip = str(v.get("atk_clip", ""))
			elif act == NetSession.ACT_ATTACK_SHOOT:
				clip = "holding-both-shoot" if str(v.get("name", "")) in ["后羿", "孙尚香", "元流之子"] else "holding-right-shoot"
				if not ap.has_animation(clip):
					clip = str(v.get("atk_clip", ""))
			else:
				v.melee_flip = not bool(v.get("melee_flip", false))
				clip = "attack-melee-left" if bool(v.melee_flip) else "attack-melee-right"
				if not ap.has_animation(clip):
					clip = str(v.get("atk_clip", ""))
	if clip == "" or not ap.has_animation(clip):
		return
	ap.play(clip)
	v.anim = "attack"
	v.att_clip = clip
	v.att_play = now
	if act == NetSession.ACT_DIE:
		# 死亡：按 clip 长度留一段宽限，等主机销毁节点后再释放 view（否则会"啪"地消失）
		var ln := ap.get_animation(clip).length
		v.dying_until = now + int(ln * 1000.0) + 250
		v.att_until = 0
	elif win > 0:
		v.att_until = now + win
	# 攻击特效：host 远程普攻的枪口粒子（Hero._perform_attack 里 Vfx.cast_burst）不进 FX 流，
	# 客户端本地补一次；只对英雄远程普攻加，其余保持与 host 一致。
	if is_hero and act == NetSession.ACT_ATTACK_SHOOT and nn != null and is_instance_valid(nn):
		var fwd2 := Vector3(sin(yaw), 0.0, cos(yaw))
		Vfx.cast_burst(str(v.get("name", "")),
			nn.global_position + Vector3.UP * 1.2 + fwd2 * 0.65, fwd2, 0.5)
```

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

我把主机侧所有 `_play_anim()` 调用点和客户端动画驱动做了逐项对表，**结论：动画并没有全部正常——除小兵攻击外，还有 3 类缺口，其中 1 个是我自己刚埋的**。

**对表结果（主机动作 → 客户端）**

| 动作 | 主机 | 之前客户端 | 现在 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 英雄 idle/walk | `_play_anim` 驱动 | 按位移本地推导 ✅ | ✅ |
| 英雄普攻近战/远程 | `attack-melee-left/right`、`holding-*-shoot` | 已修（上一轮） | ✅ |
| 英雄**技能施法** | `_cast_anim_name()` → sprint / interact-right / attack-melee-right / holding-*-shoot | **完全没推** ❌ | ✅ 新增 |
| 英雄/小兵/野怪**死亡** | `_play_anim("die")` → 播完 clip 才 `queue_free` | **直接消失** ❌ | ✅ 新增（含 1s 宽限） |
| 小兵 idle/walk/攻击 | ✅ | 上一轮已修 | ✅ |
| **野怪 idle/walk/攻击** | ✅ 有（`JungleMonster._play_anim` 映射 idle/walk/`eat`） | **完全没挂** ❌（我上一轮判断错了） | ✅ 新增 |
| 塔 | 纯程序网格，无动画 | — | 一致 |
| 回城 | 主机本身**没有**回城动作（只切 `is_recalling`） | 一致 | 一致 |

**这次的改动**

1. **野怪动画**（推翻我上一轮"野怪主机没动画"的判断——那句话是错的，`JungleMonster.gd` 里 idle/walk/attack→`eat` 全都有）：客户端重新给 `NET_JUNGLE` 挂 AnimationPlayer，并在 `JungleMonster._play_anim` 里加攻击推送。[JungleMonster.gd:116](scripts/entities/JungleMonster.gd#L116)
2. **施法动作**：新增 8 档 `ACT_*` 常量（[NetSession.gd:172](scripts/net/NetSession.gd#L172)），主机在 `_cast_feedback` 里把实际播的 clip 映射成动作档推送，客户端逐档复刻（sprint / interact-right / attack-melee-right / holding-both-shoot / holding-right-shoot）。[Hero.gd:3193](scripts/entities/Hero.gd#L3193)
3. **死亡动作**：`GameEntity.die()` 推 `ACT_DIE`（主机是"播完死亡动画再 queue_free"）；客户端播 death/die clip，并**延后释放 view** 到 clip 播完 +250ms 才销毁——否则单位会"啪"一下消失。同理 `_tick_hero_anims` 在死亡窗口内不再切 idle/walk。[GameEntity.gd:1220](scripts/entities/GameEntity.gd#L1220)、[NetClientBattle.gd:585](scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd#L585)
4. **修掉重复推送**：上一轮我在 `_attack_anim()` 外又加了 3 处 `hero_anim`，这轮把推送统一收进 `_attack_anim()` 内部（远程/近战各一次），3 处重复调用全部删除——否则每次普攻会推两遍动作。
5. 野怪攻击 clip 的关键字匹配补了 `eat`（主机对普通野怪就是播 `eat`）。

**验证**：`GameEntity` / `Minion` / `JungleMonster` / `Hero` / `NetClientBattle` / `NetSession` 六个脚本在带 autoload 的真实引擎里全部编译通过；临时文件清理完毕。

**实测重点（客户端侧）**
- 英雄放技能时有抬手/拉弓动作（原来只会原地站着发光）
- 小兵、野怪死亡时先倒地再消失（原来直接消失）
- 野怪会待机/移动/攻击（原来石头一样杵着）
- 每次普攻只播一遍动作（不会因为双推送而抖动）

如果某个英雄技能动作不对，大概率是 `_cast_anim_name()` 返回的 clip 在该模型里不存在，客户端会回退到关键字匹配；把英雄名报我我加映射。

## Primary Request and Intent
- Project-wide efficiency rule (Chinese, permanent): "我的时间和预算不是很足，请你在这个项目尽可能快速完成我的任务并节省token用量，把这一条作为这个项目的原则" — recorded in `CLAUDE.md` → `## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)`.
- Standing preference: "以后每次完成任务给我发个windows通知" — after each completed task run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`.
- Earlier completed work: map visual realism package "A+B+C+F+G 全套" (procedural ground texture, environment/lighting, decoration scatter, river water shader, camera polish); joystick `move_vector` error root-caused and fixed.
- Completed: "你知道标准的王者峡谷地形吗？把它和我的对比一下，给出你的分析报告" → report at `docs/map-comparison-report.md`; then "修改吧" → applied 3 recommended fixes (mirror jungle bug, bush randomization, jungle micro-terrain + river-bank walls).
- Completed: `_bullet_vkind` freed-instance warning → `is` / `is_instance_valid` ordering fixed in 3 places.
- Completed: "请把玩家英雄信息面板设置为可折叠" → left-bottom `attribute_panel` now collapsible via clickable "属性 ▾" header.
- **Current request (in progress)**: "客户端似乎不能播放攻击动画，也没有攻击特效，甚至不能通过按空格来普通攻击" — LAN client: no attack animation, no attack VFX, spacebar normal attack does nothing.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 (project claims 4.5; user's editor is ≥4.6 — avoid `class_name` colliding with native classes; prefer `preload`).
- GDScript: autoloads (`Config`, `ItemDatabase`, `SkillDatabase`, `GameManager`, `UiManager`, `CollisionSystem`, `Vfx` = `res://scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd`, `NetSession`, `TouchController`, `SfxManager`); `MultiMesh`, `ShaderMaterial`, `ProceduralSkyMaterial`, `AnimationPlayer` clip replay.
- LAN architecture: host-authoritative sim; client `NetClientBattle` renders snapshot-driven views. Command enum on `NetSession`: `C_MOVE=0`, `C_ATTACK=1 [1,target_net_id]`, `C_CAST=2`, `C_UPGRADE=3`, `C_RECALL=4`, `C_CANCEL_RECALL=5`, `C_BUY=6`, `C_DRIVE=7`, `C_ATTACK_AUTO=8 [8,1=hold]`, `C_PRIORITY=9`, `C_SUMMONER=10`, `C_RECOVER=11`, `C_ACTIVE=12`, `C_SELL=13`, `C_INSPECT=14`, `C_ROSTER=15`, `C_YUANLIU_PICK=16`.
- Event kinds (`NetSession` + `NetClientBattle`): `EV_DMG=1`, `EV_GOLD=2`, `EV_EXP=3`, `EV_ACT=4 [fid,4,nid,act,yaw]`; both FX and events buffers keep ~350 ms, dedup by `fid`.
- Snapshot segments (client consts): `SNAP_BULLETS=7`, `SNAP_BULLET_EXT=0.066`; bullets carry `[iid,x,y,z,team,bsz,kind,vkind]`, `kind>=1000` = bespoke visual.
- Map facts: 120×120, bases (-58,58)/(58,-58), mid lane `x+z=0`, river `x−z=0` (perpendicular), epic pits (24,26)暴君 / (-24,-26)主宰, 20 turrets, ~95 bush points.
- Authoring: PowerShell `pwsh`; Godot binary must be copied from `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe` (that path is a directory); copies go to `.cache\godot47.exe` and must be deleted after use.
- Verification idiom: `--headless --path . res://scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 300` (compiles autoloads incl. `UiManager`); `--script res://devprobe/x.gd` cannot compile scripts referencing autoloads (`Identifier not found: NetSession`), and headless does not compile GLSL.

## Files and Code
- `CLAUDE.md` — working principles + mandatory notification rule.
- `docs/map-comparison-report.md` — NEW (this session): 王者峡谷 vs project comparison, P0/P1/P2 issue list, ASCII map.
- `scripts/core/MapVisuals.gd` (`class_name MapVisuals extends RefCounted`) — visual layer; this session: river axis corrected to `x−z` (shader `float d = abs(wp.x - wp.z) * 0.70710678;`, layout `absf(x - z)`, `_open_ground` river mask); added `uniform float bump_amount` + vertex displacement in `_GROUND_CODE` masked to jungle (lane/river/highground stay flat, `edge_m` fades outside ±56–70); `ground_material(bump: float = 0.0)` sets `bump_amount`; river-bank walls repositioned to `x−z=±15` with `Basis(Vector3.UP, -PI*0.25)`.
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` — L311-314 wild plane `subdivide_width/depth = 100` + `MapVisuals.ground_material(0.28)`; L939 `_spawn_jungle_group("pig", {... "magic_resist": 90}, Vector3(6,0,-26), 2)` and L948 `"lizard" ... Vector3(41,0,-5)` (mirror bug fix); `_create_turrets()` at L755 (10 per team), `_create_jungle()` at L910, `epic_pit_centers = [Vector3(24,0,26), Vector3(-24,0,-26)]` L951, `JUNGLE_FIRST_SPAWN=30.0`, `SPATIAL_FIRST_SPAWN=60.0`; KEY_SPACE normal-attack handler at L3112-3128 (`hero.set_manual_target(nearest_enemy)` within `attack_range * 0.01`).
- `scripts/entities/Bush.gd` — `_ready()` rewritten: deterministic per-mirror-symmetric hash `h = int(round(absf(position.x)*10.0))*131 + int(round(absf(position.z)*10.0))*17`, `RandomNumberGenerator.seed = h`, scale `randf_range(4.2, 6.6)` × Y `0.9–1.15`, random Y rotation, ±0.45 offset; collision/region logic unchanged.
- `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` — collapsible attribute panel: new vars `attr_header`, `attr_legend`, `attr_collapsed`, `attr_panel_h_full`, `attr_header_h` (~L214); `_create_attribute_panel()` L2782+ with `head_h := 26.0 * rs`, header Label "属性  ▾", `_connect_tap_to_action(attr_header, Callable(self,"toggle_attribute_panel"))`; new `toggle_attribute_panel()` L2842 (bottom-anchored `position.y = vp_h - 385.0 - h`, hides legend/rows, flips arrow); `_update_attribute_panel` now `lab.visible = not attr_collapsed`. `ATTRIBUTE_ROWS` (18 rows), `ATTR_ROWS_PER_COL = 9` at L193-214.
- `scripts/ui/ResultsPanel.gd:103` — `if is_instance_valid(entity) and entity is Hero:` (fixed order).
- `scripts/entities/Bullet.gd:427` — `if counts_as_aa and not aa_proc_done and is_instance_valid(source) and source is Hero and source.health > 0.0:` (fixed order).
- `scripts/net/NetSession.gd` — `_bullet_vkind()` L1131-1136 now `if is_instance_valid(bsrc) and bsrc is Hero:`; `_bullet_kind()` L1111 correctly guarded at L1115; `push_net_action()` L1212, `hero_anim(h, act)` L1225 emits `EV_ACT` only `if mode == Mode.HOST`; `_hero_ally_near(p)` L1231 requires a living `TEAM_PLAYER` hero within 18 m; own-state pack includes `"reach": h.attack_range * 0.01` (L616); host command handling L720-780 (`C_ATTACK` resolves target via `_entity_by_net`, sets `manual_target`).
- `scripts/entities/Hero.gd` — `_perform_attack(target)` L2042; ranged bullet branch L2402/L2500-2514 ends with `_attack_anim()`, `Vfx.cast_burst(...)` (only `attack_range > 400`), `NetSession.hero_anim(self, 0)`; `hero_anim` only at L2514, L2579 (马超 dash), L2637; `_attack_anim()` L3166 plays `"holding-both-shoot"` (后羿/孙尚香/元流之子) else `"holding-right-shoot"` when ranged, else alternating `"attack-melee-left"/"attack-melee-right"`; `_play_anim()` sites: L1510 walk, L3168/3171, L3182 cast, L4194 idle.
- `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd` — `_unhandled_input()` L1585-1641 handles KEY_R/1/2/3/4/5/6/TAB/C/T/ESCAPE but **no KEY_SPACE**; `_apply_hero_act(nid, act, yaw)` L1163 always plays `"attack-melee-left"` and sets `v.att_until = now + 600`; `_tick_hero_anims()` L1181; view creation sets `view["ap"]` via `_find_ap(node)` L1330-1339; `_manual_net` L203; `_send C_ATTACK` at L1698, L2249; `_apply_bullets()` L605, `_make_bullet_visual(kind)` L668; drawn replica of attribute panel `_draw_attr_panel(s)` L3150 (~18 rows, not collapsible).
- `scripts/net/NetRosterPanel.gd` — C/T roster views incl. attr table (uses `UiManager.ATTRIBUTE_ROWS`).

## Errors and Fixes
- `Invalid access to property or key 'move_vector' on a base object of type 'VirtualJoystick'` — root cause `Parse Error: Class "VirtualJoystick" hides a native class` (Godot 4.6+ native class); fixed by removing `class_name` from `scripts/mobile/VirtualJoystick.gd` and using `preload("res://scripts/mobile/VirtualJoystick.gd").new()` at `TouchController.gd:715` and `NetTouchPad.gd:93`; verified with Godot 4.7.2 headless.
- `Left operand of 'is' is a previously freed instance` — cause: `is` evaluated before `is_instance_valid()`; fixed ordering in `NetSession.gd:1133`, `Bullet.gd:427`, `ResultsPanel.gd:103`; remaining ~126 unguarded `X is Type` sites judged low-risk (only fail if attacker freed mid-flight).
- `--script` probes report `Identifier not found: NetSession` / `ItemDatabase` — artifact of missing autoloads in `--script` mode, not real errors; use `res://scenes/battle.tscn` run instead.
- Earlier (still relevant): `load_workspace_dependencies` fails `EPERM ... python.exe`; WinRT toast fails `no package identity (0x80073D54)` → WPF popup is the reliable notification channel.

## Pending Jobs
- **LAN client attack fixes (current task)**: (a) no spacebar normal attack, (b) attack animation missing/wrong clip, (c) no attack VFX client-side.
- Optionally mirror the collapsible attribute panel into `NetClientBattle._draw_attr_panel()` (client replica still always expanded) — offered, not requested explicitly.
- Optionally add a unified "dead-source" guard (`_vsrc()`) for ~100 ungarded `if source is Hero` sites in `Bullet.gd`/`GameEntity.gd` — offered, awaiting user decision.

## Current Work
- Investigating the three client-side attack symptoms; established root-cause candidates:
  1. `NetClientBattle._unhandled_input()` has **no KEY_SPACE branch** → space does nothing (host logic is `BattleManager.gd:3112-3128`, sets nearest enemy in range as `manual_target`); client has `_own.get("reach")`, `_views` positions and `_manual_net`, so nearest-enemy selection can be mirrored and sent as `C_ATTACK`.
  2. `_apply_hero_act()` always plays `"attack-melee-left"`, while host ranged heroes use `"holding-right-shoot"`/`"holding-both-shoot"` (`Hero._attack_anim()` L3166) — act code carries no melee/ranged distinction; `NetSession.hero_anim(self, 0)` always passes `act = 0`.
  3. Ordinary-attack VFX (host muzzle `Vfx.cast_burst` L2513, hit sparks) are not replicated as FX rows; client only shows bullets, and `Vfx` autoload is available client-side so a local muzzle spark on `EV_ACT` is viable.
- No edits made yet for this task; `.cache\godot47.exe` and `devprobe\` already cleaned from previous task.

## Next Step
- Implement the three fixes: add KEY_SPACE → nearest-enemy `C_ATTACK` in `NetClientBattle._unhandled_input()`; pass `act = 1 if attack_range > 400 else 0` from `Hero._perform_attack` sites into `NetSession.hero_anim()` and play the matching clip in `_apply_hero_act()`; spawn a local `Vfx.cast_burst`/hit spark on `EV_ACT` client-side; then compile-verify via headless `res://scenes/battle.tscn`, delete `.cache`/`devprobe`, and fire `scripts\dev\notify.ps1`.

## Critical Context
- User plays the **host/single-player** mainly; LAN client is secondary but is exactly what the current complaint targets — client-side replica code (drawn HUD, `_draw_attr_panel`) diverges from host and is a recurring source of gaps.
- `Hero._perform_attack` melee path appears to never call `_attack_anim()`/`hero_anim()` (only 3 `_attack_anim()` sites: L2509 ranged, L2578 马超 dash, L2636 special) — so melee attack animation may be missing on host too; adding it must avoid double-play for ranged (which already calls it at L2509).
- Repository has no git and no test suite; verification = headless Godot runs only; GLSL/shader correctness cannot be validated headless (must be eyeballed by user after F5).
- Project root contains stale build artifacts (`HonorKing.pck/.exe/.apk`, `android/build/...` with 9/1 `.gdc` vs 9/3 sources) — running the exported exe/APK can reproduce old behavior; re-export needed after source fixes.
- File sandbox is `danger-full-access`, approvals disabled — never pass `sandbox_permissions`.

- Implement the three fixes: add KEY_SPACE → nearest-enemy `C_ATTACK` in `NetClientBattle._unhandled_input()`; pass `act = 1 if attack_range > 400 else 0` from `Hero._perform_attack` sites into `NetSession.hero_anim()` and play the matching clip in `_apply_hero_act()`; spawn a local `Vfx.cast_burst`/hit spark on `EV_ACT` client-side; then compile-verify via headless `res://scenes/battle.tscn`, delete `.cache`/`devprobe`, and fire `scripts\dev\notify.ps1`.

- `Hero._perform_attack` melee path appears to never call `_attack_anim()`/`hero_anim()` (only 3 `_attack_anim()` sites: L2509 ranged, L2578 马超 dash, L2636 special) — so melee attack animation may be missing on host too; adding it must avoid double-play for ranged (which already calls it at L2509).
- Repository has no git and no test suite; verification = headless Godot runs only; GLSL/shader correctness cannot be validated headless (must be eyeballed by user after F5).
- Project root contains stale build artifacts (`HonorKing.pck/.exe/.apk`, `android/build/...` with 9/1 `.gdc` vs 9/3 sources) — running the exported exe/APK can reproduce old behavior; re-export needed after source fixes.
- File sandbox is `danger-full-access`, approvals disabled — never pass `sandbox_permissions`.

  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

func _add_base_blend(f: float) -> void:
	var stone := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	stone.albedo_color = Color(0.19, 0.18, 0.17)
	stone.roughness = 0.95
	var stone2 := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	stone2.albedo_color = Color(0.14, 0.135, 0.13)
	stone2.roughness = 1.0
	# 外圈过渡台（低矮、颜色更深，视觉上"长"进地里）
	var s1 := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var c1 := CylinderMesh.new()
	c1.top_radius = 3.6 * f; c1.bottom_radius = 4.0 * f; c1.height = 0.16 * f; c1.radial_segments = 32
	s1.mesh = c1
	s1.position.y = 0.06 * f
	s1.material_override = stone2
	add_child(s1)
	# 内圈石台（承接模型底部）

	var c2 := CylinderMesh.new()
	c2.top_radius = 2.6 * f; c2.bottom_radius = 2.9 * f; c2.height = 0.34 * f; c2.radial_segments = 32
	s2.mesh = c2
	s2.position.y = 0.16 * f
	s2.material_override = stone
	add_child(s2)
	# 接地暗影（径向渐隐，压住硬边 + 假 AO）
	var sh := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var pm := PlaneMesh.new(); pm.size = Vector2(9.0 * f, 9.0 * f)
	sh.mesh = pm
	sh.position.y = 0.015
	var mat := ShaderMaterial.new()
	var shd := Shader.new()
	shd.code = """shader_type spatial;
render_mode unshaded, blend_mix, depth_draw_never, cull_disabled;
uniform float radius_scale = 0.5;
varying vec3 lp;
void vertex() { lp = VERTEX; }
void fragment() {
	float r = clamp(length(lp.xz) / radius_scale, 0.0, 1.0);
	ALBEDO = vec3(0.02, 0.02, 0.025);
	ALPHA = pow(1.0 - r, 2.2) * 0.55;
}"""
	mat.shader = shd
	mat.set_shader_parameter("radius_scale", 4.5 * f)
	sh.material_override = mat
	add_child(sh)
```

static var _blend_shader: Shader = null
```
and build once, duplicate material per tower (material_override = mat where mat is duplicated to set radius per type). Duplicating ShaderMaterial shares the Shader ✓ good.

content.text: popup shown: HonorKing · 防御塔激光+落地融合 | 激光瞬伤攻击 + 石台/接地暗影

防御塔改完了：攻击变成激光，底座也和地面融合了。

**一、落地融合**（[Turret.gd:82](scripts/entities/Turret.gd#L82)）

塔原来只有一个 GLB 模型 + 碰撞球直接摆在地上，模型底面和地形平面是硬切边，所以显得突兀。现在加了三层“融合结构”：

1. **外圈过渡台**：低矮圆台（半径 3.4/2.9，高 0.14），深色石头材质，像被地面埋了一圈
2. **内圈石台**：半径 2.4/2.1、高 0.30，承接模型底部，让塔“站在台上”而不是“插在地上”
3. **接地暗影**：9×9 的平面，自定义着色器做径向渐隐（`pow(1-r, 2.2)`，中心 0.6 透明度），模拟 AO 压住地面硬边

关键优化：**材质和着色器全塔共用一份**（`static var`），只按塔型缩放节点（水晶 2.5×、高地 2.0×、外塔 1.5×），所以 20 座塔只编译一次 shader。

**二、激光攻击**（[Turret.gd:174](scripts/entities/Turret.gd#L174)）

- 删掉 `Bullet` 发射，改**瞬时结算**：`take_damage(actual_damage, self, false, 0, pen)`（穿透语义和原子弹一致：打英雄无视护甲）

func _tower_collapse(v: Dictionary) -> void:
	var node: Node3D = v.node
	var pivot := Node3D.new()
	node.add_child(pivot)
	for c in node.get_children():

两项任务都已完成。先说个关键发现：**攻城车模型根本没有骨骼动画**——我实际去查了 GLB 里的 clip 列表：

```
cannon-mobile.glb  clips=NONE        ← 攻城车：没有任何 AnimationPlayer
soldier/archer/orc clips=[attack-melee-left, walk, idle, die, ...]  ← 其他兵种有
Turret.glb         clips=NONE        ← 塔：同样没有
```

所以这两项任务都必须采用**程序化动画**，无法通过播放骨骼 clip 来实现。

**一、防御塔摧毁动画**

- **主机**：`_play_destruction()`（[Turret.gd:158](scripts/entities/Turret.gd#L158)）——把所有可视子节点收进临时 pivot，塌陷 1.15s：Z 轴倾 0.40rad + X 轴倾 -0.24rad + 下沉 1.35×（水晶/高地更深）+ 压扁到 55%，同时甩出 **9 块碎石**（随机尺寸/初速/旋转，落回地面 0.12 高度后自毁）、一圈尘土扩散环、一团爆点火花。
- **时长控制**：给 `GameEntity` 加了 `death_delay_override`，塔设 1.55s，等倒塌播完才 `queue_free`（原来固定 1s 就删，动画会被切掉）。
- **客户端**：`Turret.play_collapse()` 是 **static 函数**，两端共用同一份实现，表现完全一致。触发方式不用新增 RPC——主机在 `dying_visual` 期间**继续广播 hp=0 的塔**（[NetSession.gd:1019](scripts/net/NetSession.gd#L1019)），客户端收到 hp≤0 就在本地播放同一套坍塌 + 同样的尘环/火花，`dying_until` 留 1.65s 宽限，等主机删节点后再释放。

**二、攻城车攻击动画**

- **主机**：`_siege_recoil()`（[Minion.gd:71](scripts/entities/Minion.gd#L71)）——模型沿本地 -Z 后坐 0.45、0.07s 急速后退 + 0.24s 回弹（`TRANS_BACK` 会有轻微过冲，像火炮），同时炮口炸一团橙黄辉光。原来攻城车开炮是完全没表现的（`_play_anim("attack-melee-left")` 找不到 clip，静默返回）。
- **客户端**：EV_ACT 事件已在推（上一轮加的），现在 `_apply_hero_act` 遇到**没有 AnimationPlayer 的模型**时，会改走 `_proc_recoil()`，做同样的后坐 + 炮口辉光。这条路径以后任何新的无骨骼模型也自动生效。

**验证**：编译检查 + 实机 headless 跑真实调用——塔倒塌（`play_collapse` 正常 reparent 并起 tween）、攻城车 `visual` 非空且后坐可执行，无报错。

**可调项**：
- 倒塌幅度/时长：`play_collapse` 里 4 个 `tween_property`（倾角 0.40、下沉 1.35、压扁 0.85/0.55、时长 1.15~1.25）
- 碎石数量/大小：`for i in range(9)` 和 `bm.size` 的随机区间
- 攻城车后坐量：`_siege_recoil` 里 `base.z - 0.45`；觉得不够猛就加大到 0.6~0.7

一个提示：塔倒塌和单位死亡都依赖"主机延迟删除节点"来留出动画时间，如果你觉得塔炸得太久（1.55s），改 `Turret.die` 里的 `death_delay_override` 和客户端 `+1650` 两处即可。

- **主机**：`_play_destruction()`（[Turret.gd:158](scripts/entities/Turret.gd#L158)）——把所有可视子节点收进临时 pivot，塌陷 1.15s：Z 轴倾 0.40rad + X 轴倾 -0.24rad + 下沉 1.35×（水晶/高地更深）+ 压扁到 55%，同时甩出 **9 块碎石**（随机尺寸/初速/旋转，落回地面 0.12 高度后自毁）、一圈尘土扩散环、一团爆点火花。
- **时长控制**：给 `GameEntity` 加了 `death_delay_override`，塔设 1.55s，等倒塌播完才 `queue_free`（原来固定 1s 就删，动画会被切掉）。
- **客户端**：`Turret.play_collapse()` 是 **static 函数**，两端共用同一份实现，表现完全一致。触发方式不用新增 RPC——主机在 `dying_visual` 期间**继续广播 hp=0 的塔**（[NetSession.gd:1019](scripts/net/NetSession.gd#L1019)），客户端收到 hp≤0 就在本地播放同一套坍塌 + 同样的尘环/火花，`dying_until` 留 1.65s 宽限，等主机删节点后再释放。

**二、攻城车攻击动画**

- **主机**：`_siege_recoil()`（[Minion.gd:71](scripts/entities/Minion.gd#L71)）——模型沿本地 -Z 后坐 0.45、0.07s 急速后退 + 0.24s 回弹（`TRANS_BACK` 会有轻微过冲，像火炮），同时炮口炸一团橙黄辉光。原来攻城车开炮是完全没表现的（`_play_anim("attack-melee-left")` 找不到 clip，静默返回）。
- **客户端**：EV_ACT 事件已在推（上一轮加的），现在 `_apply_hero_act` 遇到**没有 AnimationPlayer 的模型**时，会改走 `_proc_recoil()`，做同样的后坐 + 炮口辉光。这条路径以后任何新的无骨骼模型也自动生效。

**验证**：编译检查 + 实机 headless 跑真实调用——塔倒塌（`play_collapse` 正常 reparent 并起 tween）、攻城车 `visual` 非空且后坐可执行，无报错。

**可调项**：
- 倒塌幅度/时长：`play_collapse` 里 4 个 `tween_property`（倾角 0.40、下沉 1.35、压扁 0.85/0.55、时长 1.15~1.25）
- 碎石数量/大小：`for i in range(9)` 和 `bm.size` 的随机区间
- 攻城车后坐量：`_siege_recoil` 里 `base.z - 0.45`；觉得不够猛就加大到 0.6~0.7

一个提示：塔倒塌和单位死亡都依赖"主机延迟删除节点"来留出动画时间，如果你觉得塔炸得太久（1.55s），改 `Turret.die` 里的 `death_delay_override` 和客户端 `+1650` 两处即可。

修好了，这是我上一轮改激光时引入的**执行顺序问题**。

**原因**：我把「伤害结算」放在了「取目标坐标」之前：

```gdscript
current_target.take_damage(...)          # 这一击可能直接击杀目标
var to := current_target.global_position # ← 目标已被释放，变成 null
```

塔的激光是**瞬伤**（以前子弹飞行到目标才结算，取坐标时目标必然还活着）。一旦这一发打死小兵/英雄，`current_target` 立刻变成 null，后面取坐标就会报 `Invalid access to property or key 'global_position' on a base object of type 'Nil'`。

**修复**（[Turret.gd:289](scripts/entities/Turret.gd#L289)）：先把引用和坐标都取出来，再结算伤害。

```gdscript
var tgt := current_target
var from := ...
var to := tgt.global_position + Vector3.UP * 1.0
tgt.take_damage(...)   # 结算后即使 tgt 变了也不影响后面的光束
```

**同时修掉了小兵里同类的隐患**（[Minion.gd:123](scripts/entities/Minion.gd#L123)）：原来先 `take_damage` 再用 `current_target.global_position` 算朝向，击杀目标时会踩同一个坑。现在把朝向计算提到结算之前——这是从子弹时就已经存在的隐患，只是塔瞬伤让它更容易复现。

**验证**：两个脚本编译通过，临时文件已清理。

补充一句原理：这里之所以必须取坐标而不能靠 `is_instance_valid` 兜底，是因为 GDScript 里已释放对象的变量读属性会直接报错；只要保证「先取数据、后结算伤害」的顺序，这个问题就不会再出现。以后我加任何瞬伤类攻击都会遵守这个顺序。

修改防御塔攻击：一根很细的光束从塔顶连向目标，然后一个伤害发光能量球沿着这条线移动，到达目标处即造成伤害

New tower attack design:
- A thin beam from tower top to target (continuous line/guide).
- An energy orb (glowing projectile) travels along that line.
- Damage on arrival.

防御塔攻击改成“细光束 + 能量球”了，伤害也恢复为**到达目标时结算**。

**攻击表现**（[Turret.gd:289](scripts/entities/Turret.gd#L289)）

1. **极细光束**：从塔顶（水晶更高一点）到目标胸口画一道宽 `0.055` 的光束，持续时间和能量球飞行时间一致——它是“弹道指引线”，不是持续激光。
2. **能量球沿光束飞行**：不再是瞬伤，改用 `Bullet` 作为伤害载体，速度按 `距离 / 飞行时间` 反算，所以弹体正好在 `fly_t` 秒内飞到目标。飞行时间 `clamp(距离/26, 0.22, 0.85)` 秒——近距离约 0.25s，远距离最慢 0.85s。
3. **到达才结算伤害**：`Bullet` 命中目标时才 `take_damage`，穿透语义（打英雄无视护甲）通过 `pen_percent` 原样保留，伤害数字/命中火花也沿用既有弹体路径，所以主机的伤害反馈是自动的。
4. **能量球外观**：主机端原来用的是 `weapon-ammo-bullet.glb`（一颗实心弹丸，不发光）。现在塔的弹体跳过模型，改用**自发光球体**（金色 `1.0, 0.93, 0.72`，`emission_energy_multiplier = 2.2`，3× 缩放），彻底像一颗能量球（[Bullet.gd:80](scripts/entities/Bullet.gd#L80)）。

**联机同步**
- 光束走新增的 `push_tower_laser(from, to, team, fly_t)` RPC（沿用 18m 可见性判断），客户端画同一道细光束，并在 `fly_t` 后补命中火花。
- 能量球本体走**普通弹体快照**，不需要额外协议：`_bullet_kind()` 里塔的弹体档位从 `1` 改成新的 `5`（[NetSession.gd:1132](scripts/net/NetSession.gd#L1132)），客户端为 `kind=5` 新增发光球视觉（核心 + 外层光晕），飞行轨迹和主机天然同步（客户端本来就做两帧采样外推）。

**顺便说明**：上一轮那个 `current_target` 空引用报错，这轮改动里**自然消失了**——因为不再在开火时直接结算伤害，目标只会死在能量球到达那一刻。

**验证**：Turret / Bullet / NetSession / NetClientBattle 编译通过；实机实测塔开火弹体的视觉分支正确（能量球模型为空走了回退球体、3× 缩放、自发光），`Vfx.beam` 调用无报错。

**可调项**：
- 光束粗细：`Vfx.beam(..., 0.055, fly_t)` 的 `0.055`
- 球速：`dst / 26.0` 里的 `26`（越大越快，伤害越早）
- 球大小/颜色：`Bullet.gd` 里 `mat.albedo_color` 和目标球 `radius`（默认 base radius × 3 缩放）

static func create_sphere(radius: float, color: Color, emissive: bool = false, alpha: float = 1.0) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mi = MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.mesh = SphereMesh.new()
	mi.mesh.radius = radius
	mi.mesh.height = radius * 2.0
	var mat = StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = color
	if alpha < 1.0:
		mat.albedo_color.a = alpha
		mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	if emissive:
		mat.emission_enabled = true
		mat.emission = color
	mi.material_override = mat
	return mi

# 创建圆柱体（默认垂直放置，适合方向指示器）

MeshFactory.create_sphere: `emissive` sets emission but no `shading_mode = UNSHADED` and no blend mode additive. For a bright orb, better to build materials explicitly.

	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "EnergyOrb"
	var core := create_sphere(radius, Color(1.0, 1.0, 0.95), false)
	var cmat := StandardMaterial3D.new()

		gm.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD

		g.material_override = gm

## 一、能量球更亮

原来的球在材质里开了 `emission`，但它是 `SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED` —— **unshaded 材质根本不参与光照/自发光计算，emission 完全无效**，等于只是画了一个纯色球。现在改成**三层叠加**（新增 `MeshFactory.create_energy_orb()`，主机/客户端共用）：

- 核心层：纯白偏金 `(1,1,0.94)` unshaded（最亮的一层）
- 中层：1.9× 半径，**加色混合** `(1,0.88,0.55, 0.55)`
- 外层：3.1× 半径，加色 `(1,0.88,0.55, 0.25)`，且不写深度

加色混合是唯一能让“亮的程度”超过 1.0 的办法，视觉上会有明显的辉光溢出效果。实测三层都正常生成。

## 二、塔倒塌时间加长

| 项 | 原 | 现 |
|---|---|---|
| 倾斜/下沉/压扁 | 1.15s / 1.25s | **1.9s / 2.05s** |
| 节点延迟删除 | 1.55s | **2.25s** |
| 客户端宽限 | 1.65s | **2.4s** |

碎石飞行时间同步拉长到 0.9~1.45s，不会出现“塔还没塌完石头先落地”的割裂感。

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Project-wide efficiency rule (Chinese, permanent): "我的时间和预算不是很足，请你在这个项目尽可能快速完成我的任务并节省token用量，把这一条作为这个项目的原则" — recorded in `CLAUDE.md` → `## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)`.
- Standing preference: "以后每次完成任务给我发个windows通知" — after each completed task run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`.
- Completed earlier: map realism pack (texture/lighting/scatter/river/camera); joystick `move_vector` crash; 王者峡谷 comparison report (`docs/map-comparison-report.md`) + 3 fixes; `_bullet_vkind` freed-instance fixes; collapsible attribute panel.
- Completed: LAN client attack bugs — "客户端似乎不能播放攻击动画，也没有攻击特效，甚至不能通过按空格来普通攻击" → EV_ACT row layout fix, ranged clip selection, muzzle VFX, KEY_SPACE attack.
- Completed: "客户端小兵攻击也缺乏动画" → minion AP attach + host push.
- Completed: "你再检查其他的动画是不是都没有问题" → audit; added jungle attack/idle/walk, skill-cast act codes, death anims, removed duplicate `hero_anim` pushes.
- Completed: "感觉现在防御塔和地面的融合感不是很好…而且其子弹发射感觉也怪怪的，改为用激光攻击" → stone plinth + radial AO shadow shader, laser (instant damage) attack.
- Completed (latest): "请添加防御塔被摧毁的动画，并添加攻城车攻击的动画" → procedural tower collapse + siege recoil, both host and client.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 headless binary (project claims 4.5); editor ≥4.6, so avoid `class_name` collisions with native classes.
- LAN architecture: host-authoritative sim; client `NetClientBattle` renders snapshot-driven views; RPCs live on the `NetSession` autoload and re-emit via signals.
- Command enum: `C_MOVE=0`, `C_ATTACK=1`, `C_CAST=2`, `C_UPGRADE=3`, `C_RECALL=4`, `C_CANCEL_RECALL=5`, `C_BUY=6`, `C_DRIVE=7`, `C_ATTACK_AUTO=8`, `C_PRIORITY=9`, `C_SUMMONER=10`, `C_RECOVER=11`, `C_ACTIVE=12`, `C_SELL=13`, `C_INSPECT=14`, `C_ROSTER=15`, `C_YUANLIU_PICK=16`.
- Event kinds: `EV_DMG=1`, `EV_GOLD=2`, `EV_EXP=3`, `EV_ACT=4`; row layout `[fid,kind,x,y,z,...]` must match client index consts (`EV_ROW_X=2`, `EV_ACT_NID=5`, `EV_ACT_ACT=6`, `EV_ACT_YAW=7`).
- `ACT_*` act codes (NetSession): `ACT_ATTACK_MELEE=0`, `ACT_ATTACK_SHOOT=1`, `ACT_CAST_SPRINT=2`, `ACT_CAST_INTERACT=3`, `ACT_CAST_MELEE=4`, `ACT_CAST_BOTH_SHOOT=5`, `ACT_CAST_SHOOT=6`, `ACT_DIE=7`.
- Snapshot segments: `SNAP_BULLETS=7`, `SNAP_BULLET_EXT=0.066`, `SNAP_FX`, `SNAP_EVENTS`, `SNAP_SCORE`, `SNAP_RESPAWN`; turret row = `[nid,2,team,x,z,hp,maxhp,name,under_attack,lyf,ring_state]` (hp at index 5).
- Visibility gates: `push_net_fx`/`push_net_action`/`push_tower_laser` drop events when no living `TEAM_PLAYER` entity within 18 m.
- Verified GLB clip inventories: `soldier/archer/character-orc` = `attack-melee-left/right, holding-*-shoot, idle, walk, die, sprint, interact-*`; `DragonBaby` = `CharacterArmature|Punch/Flying_Idle/Death/...`; **`cannon-mobile.glb` clips=NONE**, **`Turret.glb` clips=NONE** → those need procedural animation.
- Map facts: 120×120, bases (-58,58)/(58,-58), mid lane `x+z=0`, river `x−z=0`, epic pits (24,26)/(-24,-26), 20 turrets, ~95 bush points.
- Verification idiom: temp scene + probe script run via `--headless --path . res://<dir>/check.tscn --quit-after N` (autoloads present, so `NetSession`/`Vfx` resolve); `--script` mode cannot compile scripts referencing autoloads; headless does not compile GLSL.

## Files and Code
- `CLAUDE.md` — working principles + mandatory notification rule.
- `scripts/entities/Hero.gd` — `_attack_anim()` (L3169) now pushes `NetSession.hero_anim(self, ACT_ATTACK_SHOOT|ACT_ATTACK_MELEE)` internally; the three duplicate `NetSession.hero_anim(self, 1 if attack_range > 400 else 0)` lines removed; `_cast_feedback()` (L3182) maps `_cast_anim_name()` result → `ACT_CAST_*` and pushes it.
- `scripts/entities/GameEntity.gd` — `var death_delay_override: float = 0.0` (near L22, used instead of clip length in `die()`); `die()` L1219-1220 `_play_anim("die")` + `NetSession.net_action(self, NetSession.ACT_DIE)`.
- `scripts/entities/Minion.gd` — `var visual: Node3D` set in `_create_visual()`; `_play_anim()` pushes `NetSession.net_action(self, 0)` when `anim_name == "attack-melee-left"` on all paths (L56-61); new `_siege_recoil()` (L71) tweens `visual.position.z` to `base.z-0.45` over 0.07s then back over 0.24s (`TRANS_BACK`) + `Vfx.cast_glow(... Color(1.0,0.72,0.35), 0.5, 0.18)`; called from attack branch after `_play_anim("attack-melee-left")` when `display_name == "siege"`.
- `scripts/entities/JungleMonster.gd` — `_play_anim()` L113-116 pushes `NetSession.net_action(self, 0)` for `"attack-melee-left"`; maps dragon variants to `CharacterArmature|*`, animals attack→`"eat"`.
- `scripts/entities/Turret.gd` — `class_name Turret extends GameEntity`; `var dying_visual: bool = false`; `_create_visual()` computes `f` (crystal 2.5/high 2.0/else 1.5), adds model, calls `_add_base_blend(f)`; static `_stone_a/_stone_b/_blend_mat` + `static func _ensure_mats()` (radial-fade AO shader `ALPHA = pow(1.0 - r, 2.2) * 0.6`, `r = length(lp.xz)/4.5`); `_add_base_blend()` builds outer plinth (r 2.9/3.4 h 0.14), inner plinth (r 2.1/2.4 h 0.30), 9×9 shadow plane (`SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF`, y 0.02); `static func play_collapse(root, sf, fx_parent)` reparents visible children into `CollapsePivot` then tweens rotation z 0.40/x -0.24, `position:y -= 1.35*sf`, scale (0.85,0.55,0.85) over ~1.15-1.25s + 9 debris boxes with `global_position`/`rotation` tweens then `queue_free`; `_play_destruction()` sets `dying_visual`, `sf = 1.0 if display_name in ["outer","inner"] else 1.6`, calls `play_collapse(self, sf, get_parent())` + `Vfx.shockwave(... 3.2*sf ...)` + `Vfx.hit_spark(...)`; `die()` sets `death_delay_override = 1.55` and calls `_play_destruction()` before `super.die(killer)`; attack branch now laser: `current_target.take_damage(actual_damage, self, false, 0, 1.0 if ignore else 0.0)` + `Vfx.beam(from, to, Vfx.team_color(team), 0.5 if crystal else 0.32, clampf(1.0/attack_speed, 0.18, 0.40))` + `Vfx.hit_spark` + `NetSession.push_tower_laser(from, to, team)` + `SfxManager.try_tower_sfx("shot", ...)`.
- `scripts/net/NetSession.gd` — `signal net_tower_laser(from, to, team)`; `push_tower_laser()` / `_rpc_tower_laser()` (near FX push, gated by `_fx_ally_near`); `ACT_*` consts beside `EV_ACT`; `push_net_action()` pushes `[0, EV_ACT, p.x, p.y, p.z, nid, act, yaw]`; `net_action(ent, act)` generic beside `hero_anim`; turret snapshot loop now `if e.health <= 0 and not e.get("dying_visual"): continue` (dying towers still broadcast).
- `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd` — `NetSession.net_tower_laser.connect(_on_tower_laser)` (~L290) + `_on_tower_laser()` spawning `Vfx.beam`/`Vfx.hit_spark`; `_proc_recoil(v, yaw)` (siege/procedural: tween `v.model` position z, muzzle `Vfx.cast_glow`); `_apply_hero_act()` handles `ACT_DIE` (grace `dying_until`), cast codes, melee alternation (`v.melee_flip`), ranged, plus `if not v.has("ap"): if act == NetSession.ACT_ATTACK_MELEE: _proc_recoil(...)`; `_tick_hero_anims()` skips `dying_until` windows, uses cached `idle_clip/walk_clip/atk_clip`; `_setup_anim_loops()` keyword-loops any clip containing idle/walk/run; `_clip_hint(ap, hints)` helper; view creation `var model_ref: Node3D = null` set for `NET_TURRET`/`NET_MINION`, `view["model"] = model_ref` after the view dict, AP attach for `NET_HERO | NET_MINION | NET_JUNGLE`; turret branch in `_apply_snap` triggers `Turret.play_collapse(v.node, sf2, parent)` + shockwave/spark + `v.dying_until = now + 1650` when `v.hp <= 0`; view release loop respects `dying_until`; `KEY_SPACE` → `_attack_nearest_in_reach()` sending `C_ATTACK`.

## Errors and Fixes
- `Invalid access to property or key 'move_vector' on a base object of type 'VirtualJoystick'` — `class_name` hid a native class; fixed by preload-based instantiation.
- `Left operand of 'is' is a previously freed instance` — reordered to `is_instance_valid(x) and x is Hero` in 3 sites.
- `Parse Error: Identifier "view" not declared in the current scope` (NetClientBattle) — my `view["model"] = tm` edits landed inside `_make_view` before the `var view := {...}` declaration; fixed with a local `model_ref` set in the `match typ` block and assigned to `view["model"]` after the dict literal.
- `Error: cannot edit ... file changed since it was read` repeatedly — parallel edits in one message conflict with the FS version guard; resolved by re-reading and issuing edits **one per message**.
- `Error: cannot write ... file no longer exists — re-read the file, then retry` after deleting a probed dir — worked around by using a fresh probe directory name each time (`devcheck2`, `devcheck3`, `devcheck4`).
- Accidental `pass_PLACEHOLDER` / stray `view["static"] = true` lines introduced by mis-scoped edits — both immediately reverted with follow-up edits.
- Earlier: WinRT toast fails `no package identity (0x80073D54)` → WPF popup is the reliable notify channel; `load_workspace_dependencies` fails EPERM on python.exe.

## Pending Jobs
- (none) — all explicitly requested items delivered.

## Current Work
- Delivered tower destruction animation (host `_play_destruction`/static `play_collapse` + client replication via hp=0 turret rows and `dying_until`) and siege-cart attack animation (procedural recoil on host `Minion._siege_recoil` and client `_proc_recoil` via `EV_ACT`).
- Verified: 5 scripts compile in autoload context; runtime probe instantiated turrets (`play_collapse` ok, children=2 after reparent) and siege minion (`visual=true`, `_siege_recoil()` no errors); temp dirs `.cache`, `devcheck3`, `devcheck4` deleted; Windows notification fired.

## Next Step
- (none)

## Critical Context
- User plays host/single-player mainly but repeatedly tests LAN client; client replica code diverges from host and is a recurring gap source — always mirror host animation/VFX changes in `NetClientBattle`.
- Turret and siege-cart GLBs have no AnimationPlayer, so all their animation must be procedural/tween-based; `_clip_hint` keyword matching is the fallback for any model whose clip names differ from the hero schema.
- Death visuals rely on host delaying `queue_free` (`death_delay_override`, `dying_visual` broadcast); tuning `Turret.die`'s `1.55` requires updating the client's `+1650` grace in tandem.
- Notifications must use `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`; user reads results in Chinese, wants terse change lists + verification notes + tunable parameters.
- File sandbox is `danger-full-access`, approvals disabled — never pass `sandbox_permissions`; verify absolute paths before deletes.
- Repo has no git and no test suite; GLSL/shaders cannot be validated headless — flag visual items for user F5 eyeballing; stale build artifacts (`HonorKing.pck/.exe/.apk`) must be re-exported to see new behavior in exported builds.

# CLAUDE.md

- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。

- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.
