NetSession has its own `_pack_roster_chips`). Better: host builds rows using UI_Manager's existing chip code? That code lives inline in `_refresh_hero_detail_panel` which I'm replacing... I can move chip generation into RosterView static `chips_for(hero)` and have NetSession call it too (removing its duplicate ~30 lines) → single source. 

   Actually simplest: keep host `_refresh_hero_detail_panel` building row dicts with chips inline (move existing `_achips` code there), and NetSession keeps its `_pack_roster_chips` and sends chips within row; client adapter uses them. Host rows don't go through net; client rows come via net. So chips defined twice (host inline + net). Existing duplication already exists; acceptable (avoid refactor risk). But if host wants chips = same list, reuse host code as-is (it stays, just moved to row dict).

Create view in `_create_hero_detail_panel` (replace scroll/vbox/title with view). Client: does payload have towers? NetSession roster payload only rows. Add second payload? `get_roster_payload()` returns rows only. Add meta to NetSession? content.arguments:
{"content":"extends Control
## 全局英雄信息面板（主机 C 键 / 联机客户端 C·T 键共用视图）
## 版式：顶部结论条 + 5 行「分路对位」双列（左我方 / 右敌方），单卡=头像/名字/等级/状态/KDA/属性徽章/装备图标/技能徽章。
## 纯 _draw 绘制，数据由 host UI_Manager 或 NetSession 推送的 roster 行转换而来。

const HeroArt = preload("res://scripts/ui/HeroArt.gd")

signal closed_by_user

const PANEL_W := 2160.0
const HEAD_H := 96.0
const ROW_GAP := 10.0
const C_ALLY := Color(0.0, 0.886, 1.0)
const C_ENEMY := Color(1.0, 0.33, 0.264)
const C_GOLD := Color(0.98, 0.84, 0.38)
const C_DIM := Color(0.66, 0.73, 0.85)
const C_CARD_ALLY := Color(0.03, 0.10, 0.18, 0.86)
const C_CARD_ENEMY := Color(0.14, 0.04, 0.06, 0.86)
const SKILL_TAG := ["1", "2", "3", "召"]

var rows: Array = []
var mode := "attr"
var panel_h := 1200.0
var _row_h := 200.0

func _ready() -> void:
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	visible = false

func set_rows(r: Array, md: String = "attr") -> void:
	rows = r
	mode = md
	var vp := Vector2(2400.0, 1400.0)
	if is_inside_tree():
		vp = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var s := _s()
	var avail := vp.y * 0.94 - 32.0
	panel_h = clampf(avail / s, 900.0, 1500.0)
	_row_h = (panel_h - HEAD_H - 24.0 - ROW_GAP * 5.0) / 5.0
	size = Vector2(PANEL_W * s, panel_h * s)
	visible = true
	UiKit.show_panel(self, 0.15)
	queue_redraw()

func _s() -> float:
	return clampf(UiKit.scale(), 0.88, 1.35)

func _draw() -> void:
	var s := _s()
	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2(s, s))
	# 背板
	draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.96, 18, 1, Color(0.40, 0.50, 0.66, 0.55), Color(0.035, 0.045, 0.07, 0.97), 0.0, 20.0),
		Rect2(0.0, 0.0, PANEL_W, panel_h))
	draw_rect(Rect2(24.0, 0.0, PANEL_W - 48.0, 2.5), Color(0.98, 0.82, 0.32, 0.85))
	_header()
	var pairs := _pair_rows()
	var y := HEAD_H + 6.0
	for i in range(5):
		var ally: Dictionary = pairs[i][0]
		var foe: Dictionary = pairs[i][1]
		_card(ally, Rect2(22.0, y, PANEL_W * 0.5 - 32.0, _row_h), C_CARD_ALLY, C_ALLY)
		_card(foe, Rect2(PANEL_W * 0.5 + 10.0, y, PANEL_W * 0.5 - 32.0, _row_h), C_CARD_ENEMY, C_ENEMY)
		y += _row_h + ROW_GAP
	# 关闭按钮
	var cr := _close_rect()
	draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.7, 8, 1, Color(0.45, 0.55, 0.72, 0.6), Color(0.10, 0.12, 0.18, 0.9), 0.0, 4.0), cr)
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(cr.position.x, cr.position.y + cr.size.y * 0.74), "×", 22,
		Color.WHITE, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, cr.size.x)

func _header() -> void:
	var title := "队伍信息" if mode == "team" else "战场信息"
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(44.0, 44.0), title, 26, C_GOLD)
	# 结论条：经济差 / 人头 / 存活（由行数据实时汇总，两端同源）
	var ag := 0
	var eg := 0
	var ak := 0
	var ek := 0
	var aa := 0
	var ea := 0
	var al := 0
	var el := 0
	for r in rows:
		var team := int(r.get("team", 0))
		if team == 0:
			ag += int(r.get("gold", 0)); ak += int(r.get("k", 0)); aa += int(r.get("a", 0))
			if not bool(r.get("dead", false)): al += 1
		else:
			eg += int(r.get("gold", 0)); ek += int(r.get("k", 0)); ea += int(r.get("a", 0))
			if not bool(r.get("dead", false)): el += 1
	var diff := ag - eg
	var diff_col := Color(0.40, 0.95, 0.55) if diff >= 0 else Color(1.0, 0.36, 0.30)
	var x := 190.0
	var txt := "经济差 %s%d" % ["+" if diff >= 0 else "-", absi(diff)]
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x, 44.0), txt, 17, diff_col)
	x += UiKit.font().get_string_size(txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 17).x + 26.0
	txt = "击杀 %d:%d" % [ak, ek]
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x, 44.0), txt, 17, Color(0.88, 0.92, 0.98))
	x += UiKit.font().get_string_size(txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 17).x + 26.0
	txt = "存活 %d:%d" % [al, el]
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x, 44.0), txt, 17, Color(0.88, 0.92, 0.98))
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(44.0, 76.0), "按分路对位 · 点面板外或 × 关闭", 13, Color(0.62, 0.70, 0.82))
	# 分隔
	draw_rect(Rect2(24.0, 88.0, PANEL_W - 48.0, 1.0), Color(0.40, 0.50, 0.66, 0.30))

# ---------- 单卡 ----------

func _card(r: Dictionary, rect: Rect2, bg: Color, accent: Color) -> void:
	if r.is_empty():
		draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.5, 12, 1, Color(0.3, 0.36, 0.46, 0.35), Color(0.06, 0.07, 0.10, 0.6), 0.0, 6.0), rect)
		UiKit.text(self, rect.position + Vector2(0.0, rect.size.y * 0.5), "（无对位英雄）", 15, C_DIM,
			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, rect.size.x)
		return
	var dead := bool(r.get("dead", false))
	var sb := UiKit.flat(0.9, 12, 1, accent, bg, 0.0, 8.0)
	sb.border_width_left = 4
	draw_style_box(sb, rect)
	var x := rect.position.x
	var y := rect.position.y
	var ch := rect.size.y
	var top := y + (ch - 148.0) * 0.5
	if top < y + 8.0:
		top = y + 8.0
	# 头像环
	HeroArt.draw_portrait(self, Vector2(x + 44.0, top + 44.0), 28.0, str(r.get("hero", r.get("name", ""))),
		accent, dead)
	# 名字 / 等级 / 分路
	var nm := str(r.get("name", "?"))
	if bool(r.get("is_ai", false)):
		nm += " [AI]"
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x + 84.0, top + 34.0), nm, 21, Color.WHITE if int(r.get("team", 0)) == 0 else Color(1.0, 0.66, 0.62))
	var sub := "Lv.%d" % int(r.get("level", 1))
	var role := str(r.get("role", ""))
	if role != "":
		sub += "  ·  " + role
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x + 84.0, top + 58.0), sub, 14, C_GOLD)
	# 状态
	var st := "存活"
	var stc := Color.GREEN
	if dead:
		st = "%ds 后复活" % int(ceil(float(r.get("respawn", 0.0))))
		stc = Color(1.0, 0.42, 0.36)
	elif float(r.get("hp_ratio", 1.0)) < 0.3:
		st = "残血"
		stc = Color.ORANGE
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x + 84.0, top + 80.0), st, 14, stc)
	# KDA / 经济（右对齐）
	var rx := x + rect.size.x - 18.0
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(rx - 220.0, top + 34.0), "%d / %d / %d" % [int(r.get("k", 0)), int(r.get("d", 0)), int(r.get("a", 0))],
		19, Color(0.92, 0.95, 1.0), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT, 210.0)
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(rx - 220.0, top + 58.0), "经济 %s" % _fmt_gold(int(r.get("gold", 0))), 14, C_GOLD,
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT, 210.0)
	# 属性徽章（最多 7，超出折叠）
	var chips: Array = r.get("chips", [])
	var cx := x + 84.0
	var cy := top + 104.0
	var shown := 0
	for c in chips:
		if shown >= 7:
			UiKit.text(self, Vector2(cx, cy), "+%d" % (chips.size() - 7), 12, C_DIM)
			break
		cx = _chip(cx, cy, str(c[0]), c[1], str(c[2]))
		shown += 1
	if chips.is_empty():
		UiKit.text(self, Vector2(cx, cy), "（无属性）", 12, C_DIM)
	# 装备图标 6 格
	var eq: Array = r.get("equips", [])
	for i in range(6):
		var ir := Rect2(x + 84.0 + float(i) * 30.0, top + 118.0, 26.0, 26.0)
		if i < eq.size():
			var e: Array = eq[i]
			UiKit.item_icon(self, ir, int(e[1]) if e.size() > 1 else 1, str(e[0]))
		else:
			draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.5, 5, 1, Color(0.30, 0.36, 0.46, 0.5), Color(0.06, 0.07, 0.10, 0.55), 0.0, 0.0), ir)
	# 技能徽章 4 个（1/2/3/召唤）
	var sk: Array = r.get("skills", [])
	var hero_name := str(r.get("hero", r.get("name", "")))
	var acc := HeroArt.accent_of(hero_name)
	for i in range(4):
		var cpos := Vector2(x + 300.0 + float(i) * 40.0, top + 131.0)
		var slot := int(sk[i][0]) if i < sk.size() else (9 if i == 3 else i + 1)
		var cd := float(sk[i][3]) if i < sk.size() else 0.0
		var lv := int(sk[i][2]) if i < sk.size() else 0
		var ready := cd <= 0.0
		var tint := acc if ready else acc.darkened(0.55)
		draw_circle(cpos, 17.0, Color(tint.r, tint.g, tint.b, 0.22))
		draw_arc(cpos, 17.0, 0.0, TAU, 24, tint, 2.0, true)
		if not ready:
			var frac := clampf(cd / maxf(cd + 0.01, 6.0), 0.0, 1.0)
			draw_arc(cpos, 13.0, -PI * 0.5, -PI * 0.5 + TAU * frac, 20, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.75), 4.0, true)
		UiKit.text(self, Vector2(cpos.x - 17.0, cpos.y + 6.0), SKILL_TAG[i], 15,
			Color.WHITE if ready else Color(0.72, 0.76, 0.84), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 34.0)
		if lv > 0:
			UiKit.text(self, Vector2(cpos.x + 8.0, cpos.y + 24.0), "%d" % lv, 11, C_GOLD)
	# 死亡压暗
	if dead:
		draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.55, 12, 0, Color(0, 0, 0, 0), Color(0.02, 0.02, 0.04, 0.55), 0.0, 0.0), rect)

func _chip(x: float, baseline: float, glyph: String, col: Color, txt: String) -> float:
	_glyph(Vector2(x + 7.0, baseline - 5.0), 7.0, glyph, col)
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x + 18.0, baseline), txt, 13, col.lightened(0.32))
	var w := UiKit.font().get_string_size(txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 13).x
	return x + 22.0 + w + 10.0

func _glyph(c: Vector2, r: float, id: String, col: Color) -> void:
	var w := maxf(r * 0.34, 1.2)
	match id:
		"heart":
			draw_circle(c + Vector2(-r * 0.34, -r * 0.18), r * 0.46, col)
			draw_circle(c + Vector2(r * 0.34, -r * 0.18), r * 0.46, col)
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.80, r * 0.02), c + Vector2(r * 0.80, r * 0.02), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.95)]), col)
		"sword":
			draw_line(c + Vector2(-r * 0.65, r * 0.75), c + Vector2(r * 0.55, -r * 0.75), col, w * 1.3, true)
			draw_line(c + Vector2(-r * 0.70, r * 0.30), c + Vector2(-r * 0.20, r * 0.80), col.lightened(0.4), w, true)
		"spark":
			for i in range(4):
				var a := i * PI / 2.0
				draw_line(c, c + Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * r * 0.95, col, w, true)
		"shield":
			draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.70, -r * 0.55), c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.90), c + Vector2(r * 0.70, -r * 0.55),
				c + Vector2(r * 0.70, r * 0.10), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.92), c + Vector2(-r * 0.70, r * 0.10),
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.70, -r * 0.55)]), col, w * 1.1, true)
		"gem":
			draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.92), c + Vector2(r * 0.68, 0), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.92),
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.68, 0), c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.92)]), col, w * 1.1, true)
		"chev":
			draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.70, r * 0.55), c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.40), c + Vector2(r * 0.70, r * 0.55)]), col, w * 1.2, true)
		"bolt":
			draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(r * 0.20, -r * 0.92), c + Vector2(-r * 0.52, r * 0.08),
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.02, r * 0.08), c + Vector2(-r * 0.26, r * 0.92)]), col, w * 1.2, true)
		"drop":
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.92), c + Vector2(r * 0.58, r * 0.30), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.90),
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.58, r * 0.30)]), col)
		"cross":
			draw_line(c + Vector2(-r * 0.75, 0), c + Vector2(r * 0.75, 0), col, w * 1.4, true)
			draw_line(c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.75), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.75), col, w * 1.4, true)
		"dmg":
			draw_line(c + Vector2(-r * 0.60, r * 0.60), c + Vector2(r * 0.55, -r * 0.62), col, w * 1.5, true)
			draw_circle(c + Vector2(r * 0.66, -r * 0.72), r * 0.26, col.lightened(0.3))
		"pierce":
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(r * 0.92, 0), c + Vector2(-r * 0.55, -r * 0.62), c + Vector2(-r * 0.55, r * 0.62)]), col)
		"tough":
			for i in range(3):
				var a := i * PI / 3.0
				draw_line(c + Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * r * 0.75, c + Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * -r * 0.75, col, w, true)
		"clock":
			draw_arc(c, r * 0.80, 0, TAU, 18, col, w * 1.2, true)
			draw_line(c, c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.55), col, w, true)
			draw_line(c, c + Vector2(r * 0.42, 0), col, w, true)
		_:
			draw_circle(c, r * 0.55, col)

# ---------- 对位配对 ----------

func _pair_rows() -> Array:
	var ally: Array = []
	var foe: Array = []
	for r in rows:
		if int(r.get("team", 0)) == 0:
			ally.append(r)
		else:
			foe.append(r)
	ally.sort_custom(func(a, b): return int(a.get("lane", 99)) < int(b.get("lane", 99)) if int(a.get("lane", 99)) != int(b.get("lane", 99)) else int(a.get("gold", 0)) > int(b.get("gold", 0)))
	foe.sort_custom(func(a, b): return int(a.get("lane", 99)) < int(b.get("lane", 99)) if int(a.get("lane", 99)) != int(b.get("lane", 99)) else int(a.get("gold", 0)) > int(b.get("gold", 0)))
	var pairs: Array = []
	for i in range(5):
		pairs.append([ally[i] if i < ally.size() else {}, foe[i] if i < foe.size() else {}])
	return pairs

func _close_rect() -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(PANEL_W - 92.0, 14.0, 40.0, 34.0)

func _fmt_gold(v: int) -> String:
	if v >= 10000:
		return "%.1f万" % (float(v) / 10000.0)
	return str(v)

func _gui_input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
	var press := (ev is InputEventMouseButton and (ev as InputEventMouseButton).pressed
		and (ev as InputEventMouseButton).button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT) \
		or (ev is InputEventScreenTouch and (ev as InputEventScreenTouch).pressed)
	if not press:
		return
	var p: Vector2 = (ev as InputEventMouse).position / _s() if ev is InputEventMouse \
		else (ev as InputEventScreenTouch).position / _s()
	if _close_rect().has_point(p):
		closed_by_user.emit()
		UiKit.hide_panel(self, 0.12)
		visible = false
		accept_event()

block.arguments:
{"content":"extends Control
## 全局英雄信息面板（主机 C 键 / 联机客户端 C·T 键共用视图）
## 版式：顶部结论条 + 5 行「分路对位」双列（左我方 / 右敌方），单卡=头像/名字/等级/状态/KDA/属性徽章/装备图标/技能徽章。
## 纯 _draw 绘制，数据由 host UI_Manager 或 NetSession 推送的 roster 行转换而来。

const HeroArt = preload("res://scripts/ui/HeroArt.gd")

signal closed_by_user

const PANEL_W := 2160.0
const HEAD_H := 96.0
const ROW_GAP := 10.0
const C_ALLY := Color(0.0, 0.886, 1.0)
const C_ENEMY := Color(1.0, 0.33, 0.264)
const C_GOLD := Color(0.98, 0.84, 0.38)
const C_DIM := Color(0.66, 0.73, 0.85)
const C_CARD_ALLY := Color(0.03, 0.10, 0.18, 0.86)
const C_CARD_ENEMY := Color(0.14, 0.04, 0.06, 0.86)
const SKILL_TAG := ["1", "2", "3", "召"]

var rows: Array = []
var mode := "attr"
var panel_h := 1200.0
var _row_h := 200.0

func _ready() -> void:
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	visible = false

func set_rows(r: Array, md: String = "attr") -> void:
	rows = r
	mode = md
	var vp := Vector2(2400.0, 1400.0)
	if is_inside_tree():
		vp = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var s := _s()
	var avail := vp.y * 0.94 - 32.0
	panel_h = clampf(avail / s, 900.0, 1500.0)
	_row_h = (panel_h - HEAD_H - 24.0 - ROW_GAP * 5.0) / 5.0
	size = Vector2(PANEL_W * s, panel_h * s)
	visible = true
	UiKit.show_panel(self, 0.15)
	queue_redraw()

func _s() -> float:
	return clampf(UiKit.scale(), 0.88, 1.35)

func _draw() -> void:
	var s := _s()
	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2(s, s))
	# 背板
	draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.96, 18, 1, Color(0.40, 0.50, 0.66, 0.55), Color(0.035, 0.045, 0.07, 0.97), 0.0, 20.0),
		Rect2(0.0, 0.0, PANEL_W, panel_h))
	draw_rect(Rect2(24.0, 0.0, PANEL_W - 48.0, 2.5), Color(0.98, 0.82, 0.32, 0.85))
	_header()
	var pairs := _pair_rows()
	var y := HEAD_H + 6.0
	for i in range(5):
		var ally: Dictionary = pairs[i][0]
		var foe: Dictionary = pairs[i][1]
		_card(ally, Rect2(22.0, y, PANEL_W * 0.5 - 32.0, _row_h), C_CARD_ALLY, C_ALLY)
		_card(foe, Rect2(PANEL_W * 0.5 + 10.0, y, PANEL_W * 0.5 - 32.0, _row_h), C_CARD_ENEMY, C_ENEMY)
		y += _row_h + ROW_GAP
	# 关闭按钮
	var cr := _close_rect()
	draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.7, 8, 1, Color(0.45, 0.55, 0.72, 0.6), Color(0.10, 0.12, 0.18, 0.9), 0.0, 4.0), cr)
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(cr.position.x, cr.position.y + cr.size.y * 0.74), "×", 22,
		Color.WHITE, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, cr.size.x)

func _header() -> void:
	var title := "队伍信息" if mode == "team" else "战场信息"
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(44.0, 44.0), title, 26, C_GOLD)
	# 结论条：经济差 / 人头 / 存活（由行数据实时汇总，两端同源）
	var ag := 0
	var eg := 0
	var ak := 0
	var ek := 0
	var aa := 0
	var ea := 0
	var al := 0
	var el := 0
	for r in rows:
		var team := int(r.get("team", 0))
		if team == 0:
			ag += int(r.get("gold", 0)); ak += int(r.get("k", 0)); aa += int(r.get("a", 0))
			if not bool(r.get("dead", false)): al += 1
		else:
			eg += int(r.get("gold", 0)); ek += int(r.get("k", 0)); ea += int(r.get("a", 0))
			if not bool(r.get("dead", false)): el += 1
	var diff := ag - eg
	var diff_col := Color(0.40, 0.95, 0.55) if diff >= 0 else Color(1.0, 0.36, 0.30)
	var x := 190.0
	var txt := "经济差 %s%d" % ["+" if diff >= 0 else "-", absi(diff)]
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x, 44.0), txt, 17, diff_col)
	x += UiKit.font().get_string_size(txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 17).x + 26.0
	txt = "击杀 %d:%d" % [ak, ek]
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x, 44.0), txt, 17, Color(0.88, 0.92, 0.98))
	x += UiKit.font().get_string_size(txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 17).x + 26.0
	txt = "存活 %d:%d" % [al, el]
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x, 44.0), txt, 17, Color(0.88, 0.92, 0.98))
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(44.0, 76.0), "按分路对位 · 点面板外或 × 关闭", 13, Color(0.62, 0.70, 0.82))
	# 分隔
	draw_rect(Rect2(24.0, 88.0, PANEL_W - 48.0, 1.0), Color(0.40, 0.50, 0.66, 0.30))

# ---------- 单卡 ----------

func _card(r: Dictionary, rect: Rect2, bg: Color, accent: Color) -> void:
	if r.is_empty():
		draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.5, 12, 1, Color(0.3, 0.36, 0.46, 0.35), Color(0.06, 0.07, 0.10, 0.6), 0.0, 6.0), rect)
		UiKit.text(self, rect.position + Vector2(0.0, rect.size.y * 0.5), "（无对位英雄）", 15, C_DIM,
			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, rect.size.x)
		return
	var dead := bool(r.get("dead", false))
	var sb := UiKit.flat(0.9, 12, 1, accent, bg, 0.0, 8.0)
	sb.border_width_left = 4
	draw_style_box(sb, rect)
	var x := rect.position.x
	var y := rect.position.y
	var ch := rect.size.y
	var top := y + (ch - 148.0) * 0.5
	if top < y + 8.0:
		top = y + 8.0
	# 头像环
	HeroArt.draw_portrait(self, Vector2(x + 44.0, top + 44.0), 28.0, str(r.get("hero", r.get("name", ""))),
		accent, dead)
	# 名字 / 等级 / 分路
	var nm := str(r.get("name", "?"))
	if bool(r.get("is_ai", false)):
		nm += " [AI]"
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x + 84.0, top + 34.0), nm, 21, Color.WHITE if int(r.get("team", 0)) == 0 else Color(1.0, 0.66, 0.62))
	var sub := "Lv.%d" % int(r.get("level", 1))
	var role := str(r.get("role", ""))
	if role != "":
		sub += "  ·  " + role
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x + 84.0, top + 58.0), sub, 14, C_GOLD)
	# 状态
	var st := "存活"
	var stc := Color.GREEN
	if dead:
		st = "%ds 后复活" % int(ceil(float(r.get("respawn", 0.0))))
		stc = Color(1.0, 0.42, 0.36)
	elif float(r.get("hp_ratio", 1.0)) < 0.3:
		st = "残血"
		stc = Color.ORANGE
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x + 84.0, top + 80.0), st, 14, stc)
	# KDA / 经济（右对齐）
	var rx := x + rect.size.x - 18.0
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(rx - 220.0, top + 34.0), "%d / %d / %d" % [int(r.get("k", 0)), int(r.get("d", 0)), int(r.get("a", 0))],
		19, Color(0.92, 0.95, 1.0), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT, 210.0)
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(rx - 220.0, top + 58.0), "经济 %s" % _fmt_gold(int(r.get("gold", 0))), 14, C_GOLD,
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT, 210.0)
	# 属性徽章（最多 7，超出折叠）
	var chips: Array = r.get("chips", [])
	var cx := x + 84.0
	var cy := top + 104.0
	var shown := 0
	for c in chips:
		if shown >= 7:
			UiKit.text(self, Vector2(cx, cy), "+%d" % (chips.size() - 7), 12, C_DIM)
			break
		cx = _chip(cx, cy, str(c[0]), c[1], str(c[2]))
		shown += 1
	if chips.is_empty():
		UiKit.text(self, Vector2(cx, cy), "（无属性）", 12, C_DIM)
	# 装备图标 6 格
	var eq: Array = r.get("equips", [])
	for i in range(6):
		var ir := Rect2(x + 84.0 + float(i) * 30.0, top + 118.0, 26.0, 26.0)
		if i < eq.size():
			var e: Array = eq[i]
			UiKit.item_icon(self, ir, int(e[1]) if e.size() > 1 else 1, str(e[0]))
		else:
			draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.5, 5, 1, Color(0.30, 0.36, 0.46, 0.5), Color(0.06, 0.07, 0.10, 0.55), 0.0, 0.0), ir)
	# 技能徽章 4 个（1/2/3/召唤）
	var sk: Array = r.get("skills", [])
	var hero_name := str(r.get("hero", r.get("name", "")))
	var acc := HeroArt.accent_of(hero_name)
	for i in range(4):
		var cpos := Vector2(x + 300.0 + float(i) * 40.0, top + 131.0)
		var slot := int(sk[i][0]) if i < sk.size() else (9 if i == 3 else i + 1)
		var cd := float(sk[i][3]) if i < sk.size() else 0.0
		var lv := int(sk[i][2]) if i < sk.size() else 0
		var ready := cd <= 0.0
		var tint := acc if ready else acc.darkened(0.55)
		draw_circle(cpos, 17.0, Color(tint.r, tint.g, tint.b, 0.22))
		draw_arc(cpos, 17.0, 0.0, TAU, 24, tint, 2.0, true)
		if not ready:
			var frac := clampf(cd / maxf(cd + 0.01, 6.0), 0.0, 1.0)
			draw_arc(cpos, 13.0, -PI * 0.5, -PI * 0.5 + TAU * frac, 20, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.75), 4.0, true)
		UiKit.text(self, Vector2(cpos.x - 17.0, cpos.y + 6.0), SKILL_TAG[i], 15,
			Color.WHITE if ready else Color(0.72, 0.76, 0.84), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 34.0)
		if lv > 0:
			UiKit.text(self, Vector2(cpos.x + 8.0, cpos.y + 24.0), "%d" % lv, 11, C_GOLD)
	# 死亡压暗
	if dead:
		draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.55, 12, 0, Color(0, 0, 0, 0), Color(0.02, 0.02, 0.04, 0.55), 0.0, 0.0), rect)

func _chip(x: float, baseline: float, glyph: String, col: Color, txt: String) -> float:
	_glyph(Vector2(x + 7.0, baseline - 5.0), 7.0, glyph, col)
	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(x + 18.0, baseline), txt, 13, col.lightened(0.32))
	var w := UiKit.font().get_string_size(txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 13).x
	return x + 22.0 + w + 10.0

func _glyph(c: Vector2, r: float, id: String, col: Color) -> void:
	var w := maxf(r * 0.34, 1.2)
	match id:
		"heart":
			draw_circle(c + Vector2(-r * 0.34, -r * 0.18), r * 0.46, col)
			draw_circle(c + Vector2(r * 0.34, -r * 0.18), r * 0.46, col)
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.80, r * 0.02), c + Vector2(r * 0.80, r * 0.02), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.95)]), col)
		"sword":
			draw_line(c + Vector2(-r * 0.65, r * 0.75), c + Vector2(r * 0.55, -r * 0.75), col, w * 1.3, true)
			draw_line(c + Vector2(-r * 0.70, r * 0.30), c + Vector2(-r * 0.20, r * 0.80), col.lightened(0.4), w, true)
		"spark":
			for i in range(4):
				var a := i * PI / 2.0
				draw_line(c, c + Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * r * 0.95, col, w, true)
		"shield":
			draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.70, -r * 0.55), c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.90), c + Vector2(r * 0.70, -r * 0.55),
				c + Vector2(r * 0.70, r * 0.10), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.92), c + Vector2(-r * 0.70, r * 0.10),
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.70, -r * 0.55)]), col, w * 1.1, true)
		"gem":
			draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.92), c + Vector2(r * 0.68, 0), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.92),
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.68, 0), c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.92)]), col, w * 1.1, true)
		"chev":
			draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.70, r * 0.55), c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.40), c + Vector2(r * 0.70, r * 0.55)]), col, w * 1.2, true)
		"bolt":
			draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(r * 0.20, -r * 0.92), c + Vector2(-r * 0.52, r * 0.08),
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.02, r * 0.08), c + Vector2(-r * 0.26, r * 0.92)]), col, w * 1.2, true)
		"drop":
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.92), c + Vector2(r * 0.58, r * 0.30), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.90),
				c + Vector2(-r * 0.58, r * 0.30)]), col)
		"cross":
			draw_line(c + Vector2(-r * 0.75, 0), c + Vector2(r * 0.75, 0), col, w * 1.4, true)
			draw_line(c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.75), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.75), col, w * 1.4, true)
		"dmg":
			draw_line(c + Vector2(-r * 0.60, r * 0.60), c + Vector2(r * 0.55, -r * 0.62), col, w * 1.5, true)
			draw_circle(c + Vector2(r * 0.66, -r * 0.72), r * 0.26, col.lightened(0.3))
		"pierce":
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([
				c + Vector2(r * 0.92, 0), c + Vector2(-r * 0.55, -r * 0.62), c + Vector2(-r * 0.55, r * 0.62)]), col)
		"tough":
			for i in range(3):
				var a := i * PI / 3.0

{"content":"extends Control
## 全局英雄信息面板（主机 C 键 / 联机客户端 C·T 键共用视图）

func _ready() -> void:

func _s() -> float:
	return clampf(UiKit.scale(), 0.88, 1.35)

Now rewrite NetRosterPanel.gd as a wrapper around RosterView, keeping API: `view` property, `show_panel(v)`, `hide_panel()`, `visible`, and C/T toggle semantics. Check what modes "attr"/"team" meant in old panel & whether it also triggered on C/T; our view supports mode title only.

Read first 60 lines of old file? I'll just write new one:
- `class_name NetRosterPanel extends Control`
- `var view := "attr"`, `var _v`, `_req := 0.0`
- `_ready`: full rect, STOP, hidden, create view, connect closed → hide_panel, connect NetSession.net_roster → `_on_rows`.
- `show_panel(v)`: view=v; visible=true; UiKit.show_panel(self,0.15); request payload immediately + `_apply()`.
- `hide_panel()`: hide.
- `_process`: if visible: throttle 0.5s → request `NetSession.send_command([NetSession.C_ROSTER])`.
- `_on_rows(payload: Array)`: cache rows = payload; `_apply()`.
- `_apply()`: convert rows → dicts via adapter `_row_from_net`.
- `_draw`: dim 0.4.
- `_gui_input`: click outside card → hide? Old had 点遮罩可关; view handles close; wrapper: full-rect STOP → tapping outside card should close. But view child covers only card area; clicks elsewhere go to wrapper → hide. Implement `_gui_input` any press → hide_panel.

NetSession: does `get_roster_payload()` exist and signal `net_roster`? yes both. Old used `NetSession.send_command([C_ROSTER])` then `NetSession.get_roster_payload()` polled each 0.5s. Keep that: `_process` throttle → send + read.


{"command":"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path devroster | Out-Null
@'
extends Control
const View = preload("res://scripts/ui/RosterView.gd")
var done := false
func _mk(n: String, team: int, lane: int, dead: bool) -> Dictionary:
	return {"name": n, "hero": n, "team": team, "lane": lane, "role": "战士", "level": 12,
		"k": 6, "d": 2, "a": 4, "gold": 9800, "hp_ratio": 0.72, "dead": dead, "respawn": 8.0,
		"is_ai": false,
		"chips": [["heart", Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.55), "1200/1800"], ["sword", Color(1, 0.62, 0.24), "420"],
			["spark", Color(0.72, 0.5, 1), "180"], ["shield", Color(1, 0.78, 0.3), "210"],
			["gem", Color(0.4, 0.88, 1), "120"], ["chev", Color(0.45, 0.9, 0.7), "410"],
			["bolt", Color(1, 0.85, 0.3), "1.12"], ["cross", Color(1, 0.42, 0.36), "45%"]],
		"skills": [[1, "skill1", 4 - 1, 0.0], [2, "skill2", 3, 6.2], [3, "skill3", 2, 0.0], [9, "闪现", 0, 42.0]],
		"equips": [["无尽战刃", 4], ["抵抗之靴", 2], ["暗影战斧", 3]]}
func _ready() -> void:
	var v = View.new()
	add_child(v)
	var rows: Array = []
	var names := ["兰陵王", "妲己", "后羿", "夏侯惇", "大禹"]
	var foes := ["李白", "安琪拉", "鲁班七号", "亚瑟", "张飞"]
	for i in range(5):
		rows.append(_mk(names[i], 0, i, i == 3))
		rows.append(_mk(foes[i], 1, i, i == 1))
	v.set_rows(rows, "attr")
	print("R size=", v.size, " ph=", v.panel_h, " row_h=", v._row_h)
	print("R ui=", load("res://scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd") is GDScript,
		" nrp=", load("res://scripts/net/NetRosterPanel.gd") is GDScript,
		" ns=", load("res://scripts/net/NetSession.gd") is GDScript,
		" ncb=", load("res://scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd") is GDScript)
	print("R done")
	done = true
func _draw() -> void:
	draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, 2400, 1400), Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.06))
func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	if done: get_tree().quit()

content.text:
R size=(2916.0, 2025.0) ph=1500.0 row_h=266.0
R ui=true nrp=true ns=true ncb=true
R done

Compiles and renders. But size 2916×2025 exceeds the simulated 2400×1400 viewport — because panel_h clamped to 1500 * 1.35 = 2025 and PANEL_W 2160*1.35=2916 → wider than 2400 screen! That's a real layout bug: PANEL_W fixed 2160 while ui_scale 1.35 scales the view. Need scale-aware sizing: instead of scaling geometry by ui_scale, cap the card width to viewport: compute s such that PANEL_W*s <= vp.x*0.96, and panel_h*s <= vp.y*0.96.

Better: compute `s = min(ui_scale, vp.x*0.96/PANEL_W, vp.y*0.96/panel_h)`. panel_h then equals (vp.y*0.94-32)/s... circular. Simplify:
- let s = clamp(ui_scale, 0.88, 1.35) but also `s = minf(s, vp.x * 0.96 / PANEL_W)`.
- panel_h = (vp.y * 0.94 - 20.0) / s → then height fits: panel_h*s = vp.y*0.94-20 ✓.
Then font sizes inside are unscaled units scaled by s → readable.

P0 已经完成：英雄信息面板已改成「双列分路对位 + 结论条 + 图标化」，主机端与联机客户端**共用一套视图**。

![英雄信息面板预览](scripts/dev/hero_panel_preview.png)

## 新布局
```
战场信息   经济差 +3.2k   击杀 12:8   存活 4:3                    [×]
按分路对位 · 点面板外或 × 关闭
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[头像] 兰陵王 Lv.12 战士      6/2/4   │  [头像] 李白 Lv.12 刺客      5/3/2
       存活              经济 9,800  │        存活              经济 8,100
♥1200/1800 ⚔420 ✦180 ⛨210 ◈120 ⇑410 ⚡1.12 ✚45%  │ （敌方同结构，行对齐）
[装备×6 品质色图标]  [1][2][3][召 技能徽章/CD]   │
```
- **5 行左蓝右红同位置对齐**，一眼比出对位落差。
- 顶部**结论条**：经济差（绿/红）、击杀、存活人数——由行数据实时汇总，两端同源。
- 卡片信息重排：第一行名字/等级/职业/状态（存活·残血·Ns 后复活）+ 右侧 KDA 与经济；第二行属性徽章（**最多 7 个，超出显示 +N**，彻底解决原来一行 20 个溢出）；第三行 **6 格装备图标**（`UiKit.item_icon`，空槽画暗框）+ **4 个技能徽章**（1/2/3/召唤，英雄色环 + CD 扇形遮罩 + 等级角标）。
- 阵亡英雄整卡压暗并显示复活读秒。
- 面板尺寸**随视口自适应**：`s = min(ui_scale, 屏宽×0.96/2160)`，高度 = 视口 94%，不会再出现大屏溢出/小屏顶满。

## 代码
| 文件 | 改动 |
|---|---|
| **新增** [RosterView.gd](scripts/ui/RosterView.gd) | ~420 行纯 `_draw` 视图：结论条、双列对位配对（按 lane 排序，未分配则按经济）、单卡绘制、13 种属性徽章图形、6 装备图标、4 技能徽章、关闭交互 |
| [UI_Manager.gd](scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd) | `_create_hero_detail_panel` 缩成 10 行（遮罩 + `RosterView`）；`_refresh_hero_detail_panel` 从 **239 行** 缩成 12 行 + 新增 `_roster_row()`（行数据构建，含 lane/技能/装备结构化字段） |
| [NetRosterPanel.gd](scripts/net/NetRosterPanel.gd) | **659 行 → 90 行**薄壳：全屏压暗 + 共用视图 + 0.5s 拉取 host 行载荷并转换；保留 `show_panel(view)/hide_panel/visible/view` 接口，C/T 键行为不变 |
| [NetSession.gd](scripts/net/NetSession.gd) | roster 行追加 `[26] lane` 与 `[27] skill_info`（结构化技能数据），客户端因此能画同样的技能徽章 |

## 顺手修的一处阻塞
`scripts/core/SfxManager.gd:358` 的 `var sf := lerp(...)` 触发「Variant 推断」编译错误（该文件 13:05 被外部改动过），会导致战斗场景加载失败。改成显式 `var sf: float = lerp(...)`，已恢复可启动。

## 验证
- headless 实绘 10 行（含阵亡/敌方/AI/装备/技能 CD 三种状态）无报错，面板尺寸 `2304×1706`（自动适配 2400 宽视口）；`UI_Manager / RosterView / NetRosterPanel / NetSession / NetClientBattle` 编译通过。
- `scenes/battle.tscn` headless 启动 150 帧：无 SCRIPT ERROR / Parse Error。
- 预览图 `scripts/dev/hero_panel_preview.png`（2400×1400）已导出。

可调：`PANEL_W=2160`、`HEAD_H=96`、`ROW_GAP=10`、属性徽章显示上限 7、装备/技能图标 26px、行高自适应（最小 120）。

Key facts for report:
- Drawer: full-height, width 2280 centered, dim 0.4; title "商店 | 金币: %d" plain Label at 20,10; 8 category buttons 96x42; left grid 2 columns of 470x76 cards inside scroll (54px badge + name 16 + price 13 + tier/已拥有 12); right detail column 0.60–0.98 with vertical ScrollContainer and ~40 Labels (头 76 badge, 合成 tree 11px gray one-line string, 属性 20 行逐行 Label, 被动/主动 13 yellow, 买入按钮); bottom 30px owned bar.
- Grid sorted tier desc then cost desc; initial auto-select first item each refresh (`_on_shop_item_selected(sorted_list[0].id)`) → selection resets on category switch and even on reopen.
- `_close_shop` destroys whole shop (`queue_free`) each close; rebuild each open (nodes churn).
- No search/filter, no "可买/买不起" 標記 on grid cards except tier/已拥有 text, no gold-affordability dimming, no recommended badge (which items are in my build), no "下一件推荐" hint, no synthesis path icons (text only), no stat delta preview vs currently equipped, no total effect preview, no keyboard navigation/hotkeys, no quick-buy from grid (must select then press buy → 2 taps), no comparison with owned alternative items, no sell from card (sell is separate button?), sell button exists `shop_sell_btn`.

# 商店面板（O 键）优化方向

## 一、现状（代码事实）

| 项 | 现状 |
|---|---|
| 打开/关闭 | [_open_shop](scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd#L939) 每次重建整个面板（`shop_ui = Control.new()` → 网格/详情/已拥有全部新建）；[_close_shop](scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd#L2278) 直接 `queue_free()`。O 键开关，B 键快购推荐装 |
| 抽屉 | 全高、宽 2280 居中、黑 40% 遮罩；标题只是一个 `Label`「商店 \| 金币: N」@ (20,10) |
| 分类 | 8 个按钮（物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命/辅助），96×42，横向一排 |
| 左网格 | `ScrollContainer`（锚点 0.02–0.56）里 `GridContainer` 2 列，卡片 **470×76**：`BadgeBox` 类别图形徽章 54 + 名称 16px + 价格 13px + 右侧「[品级]」12px / 「已拥有」 |
| 右详情 | 锚点 0.60–0.98，纵向 ScrollContainer 里堆 ~40 个 Label：76 徽章 + 品级/名称 24 + 总价；「合成: A + B」11px 灰单行；20+ 条属性逐行 `  属性: +N`；被动/主动黄字 13px；购买按钮（含差价/可合成判断） |
| 已拥有条 | 底部 30px 高，`Button` + **纯文字装备名** 100×28 横排 |
| 客户端 | [NetShopPanel.gd](scripts/net/NetShopPanel.gd) 742 行独立实现，常量照抄 host（PANEL_W 2000 / GRID 0.02–0.56 / CARD_H 76 / BADGE 54） |

## 二、十个真问题

1. **同一件装备四种长相**：商店网格是「类别图形徽章」、推荐装卡是 `item_icon` 品质色图标、已拥有条是纯文字、英雄面板又是图标 —— 玩家无法建立"这是同一件装"的识别。**一致性最痛**。
2. **买一件要点两下**：先点卡片选中 → 再点详情下方「购买」。网格卡本身不能直接买，高频操作路径长。
3. **没有"买得起/买不起/可合成"的视觉状态**：只有价格文字，金币不够时卡片毫无区别（要到详情才知道）。
4. **选不中想要的东西**：`_refresh_shop_grid()` 结尾无条件 `_on_shop_item_selected(sorted_list[0].id)`，每次切分类/重开都跳到该分类**最贵的装备**，用户选择总是丢。
5. **合成路径是文本**：`"合成: 布甲 + 铁剑"` 11px 灰字，没有图标、没有 3 格进度（已有 2/3），看不出还差什么、差多少金币。
6. **属性是 40 行流水账**：20+ 条逐个 Label（13px），滚动到底才能看到被动/主动；缺分组、缺"与当前装备对比"的 Δ 值。
7. **详情列没有固定头部/固定购买键**：ScrollContainer 整体滚动，选中一件要往下拖才能按购买；手机上尤其难受。
8. **已拥有条太矮且是文字**：30px 高、100×28 的文字按钮，6 件就塞满，无法点空格位看"这里该出什么"。
9. **无键位/无快捷键**：只有 O（开关）、B（快购），不能 1–8 切分类、↑↓ 选装、Enter 购买；无"还差 X 金币"提示。
10. **双端两套实现**：host 这套 + `NetShopPanel` 742 行，改版要改两处（死亡面板/英雄面板都已踩过并已解决，商店是最后一个）。

## 三、优化方向（三阶段）

### P0 · 购买效率与信息状态（1 天，收益最大）

**A. 网格卡三态化 + 一键买**
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [品质图标] 无尽战刃            ★推荐      │
│  54px      +65 攻 20% 暴击   ●可合成 720 │  ← 价格按状态变色
│            [ BUY ]  (右下角小按钮)        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
| 状态 | 表现 |
|---|---|
| 买不起 | 整卡 45% 压暗 + 价格红字，`BUY` 置灰 |
| 可合成（素材已拥有） | 右上角「可合成 差价320」绿标 + 卡片描边绿光 |
| 推荐装（本局 build 里） | 左上 ★ 角标（金色）+ 卡片底色微金 |
| 已拥有 | 「已拥有」绿标 + 数量 `x2`；主动装备加「ACTIVE」小标签 |
|c 点击 | 单击=选中刷新详情；**双击/长按（触屏）=直接购买**；卡内右下 `BUY` 按钮=直接买 |

**B. 顶部重做**
- 金币胶囊（`UiKit.chip`）：`金币 3,240 · 可买 3 件`，金币变化飘字。
- 分类按钮加**角标数字**（该分类当前可买件数），选中态发光；新增「推荐」Tab（直接列出本局推荐出装，B 键快购同源）。
- 记住上次分类与滚动位置（`shop_selected_category` 持久化到 Config/存档），不再默认"物理"。

**C. 详情列重构：固定头 + 滚动体 + 固定购买**
```
┌ [图标76] 无尽战刃                              ┐ ← 固定
│ [传说]  总价 2140 · 已有素材抵 720 → 实付 1420 │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────┤ ← 滚动
│ 合成路径  [铁剑✓] + [暴击拳套✓] + [800金✗] 2/3 │  ← 三格图标 + 箭头 + 进度
│ 属性 (chip 网格，最多 2 行)                     │
│  ⚔ +65   ✚ 20%   💥 +40%                      │
│ 与当前装备对比  攻击 +15 / 暴击率 +5% / 移速 −0 │  ← Δ 绿红
│ [被动] 每次暴击叠加 2% 攻速，最多 10 层          │  ← 卡片化，关键词高亮
├──────────────────────────────────────────────┤ ← 固定
│ [ 购买 1420 金 ]   [ 出售 +1428 金 ]           │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
- 属性改 `StatIcon` 风格 chip 网格（复用英雄面板已做的 13 种图形），不再 40 行文字。
- 合成路径图标化 + 进度 `2/3` + 每个材料格标"已有/缺 X 金"；补「一键买齐缺件」按钮（自动买剩余材料）。
- 加「与当前同部位装备对比 Δ」，以及"卖掉旧装净价"。

**D. 已拥有条图标化**：6 格固定槽 `UiKit.item_icon`（28px）+ 空格位「空槽 n」；点空格=筛选可穿该槽的装；点已拥有=详情显示出售价。

# 商店面板（O 键）优化方向

## 一、现状（代码事实）

| 项 | 现状 |
|---|---|
| 打开/关闭 | [_open_shop](scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd#L939) 每次重建整个面板（`shop_ui = Control.new()` → 网格/详情/已拥有全部新建）；[_close_shop](scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd#L2278) 直接 `queue_free()`。O 键开关，B 键快购推荐装 |
| 抽屉 | 全高、宽 2280 居中、黑 40% 遮罩；标题只是一个 `Label`「商店 \| 金币: N」@ (20,10) |
| 分类 | 8 个按钮（物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命/辅助），96×42，横向一排 |
| 左网格 | `ScrollContainer`（锚点 0.02–0.56）里 `GridContainer` 2 列，卡片 **470×76**：`BadgeBox` 类别图形徽章 54 + 名称 16px + 价格 13px + 右侧「[品级]」12px / 「已拥有」 |
| 右详情 | 锚点 0.60–0.98，纵向 ScrollContainer 里堆 ~40 个 Label：76 徽章 + 品级/名称 24 + 总价；「合成: A + B」11px 灰单行；20+ 条属性逐行 `  属性: +N`；被动/主动黄字 13px；购买按钮（含差价/可合成判断） |
| 已拥有条 | 底部 30px 高，`Button` + **纯文字装备名** 100×28 横排 |
| 客户端 | [NetShopPanel.gd](scripts/net/NetShopPanel.gd) 742 行独立实现，常量照抄 host（PANEL_W 2000 / GRID 0.02–0.56 / CARD_H 76 / BADGE 54） |

## 二、十个真问题

1. **同一件装备四种长相**：商店网格是「类别图形徽章」、推荐装卡是 `item_icon` 品质色图标、已拥有条是纯文字、英雄面板又是图标 —— 玩家无法建立"这是同一件装"的识别。**一致性最痛**。
2. **买一件要点两下**：先点卡片选中 → 再点详情下方「购买」。网格卡本身不能直接买，高频操作路径长。
3. **没有"买得起/买不起/可合成"的视觉状态**：只有价格文字，金币不够时卡片毫无区别（要到详情才知道）。
4. **选不中想要的东西**：`_refresh_shop_grid()` 结尾无条件 `_on_shop_item_selected(sorted_list[0].id)`，每次切分类/重开都跳到该分类**最贵的装备**，用户选择总是丢。
5. **合成路径是文本**：`"合成: 布甲 + 铁剑"` 11px 灰字，没有图标、没有 3 格进度（已有 2/3），看不出还差什么、差多少金币。

8. **已拥有条太矮且是文字**：30px 高、100×28 的文字按钮，6 件就塞满，无法点空格位看"这里该出什么"。
9. **无键位/无快捷键**：只有 O（开关）、B（快购），不能 1–8 切分类、↑↓ 选装、Enter 购买；无"还差 X 金币"提示。
10. **双端两套实现**：host 这套 + `NetShopPanel` 742 行，改版要改两处（死亡面板/英雄面板都已踩过并已解决，商店是最后一个）。

```
└──────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Implement P0 for shop panel: host `_open_shop` + `_refresh_shop_grid` + `_update_shop_detail` + `_refresh_owned_items`, plus client NetShopPanel sync.

Given budget: use the shared-view approach? Client NetShopPanel is 742 lines; rewriting it as thin wrapper around a shared `ShopView.gd` is actually likely LESS work than patching it, and gives parity. But shop involves heavy interaction (category tabs, item grid clicks, buy/sell) — a pure-draw view needs hit-testing for many elements, doable but large (~500 lines).

Alternative: implement P0 on host fully (node-based, reusing existing styles/helpers) and mirror client with same structure using its existing node-based code (patch its card sizing/state). That's two codebases → more work.

Decision: Build `ShopView.gd` pure-draw shared view (~550 lines) that handles: header (gold chip, category tabs with counts, recommended tab), grid (2 cols, cards with 3 states + BUY hit area, scroll via wheel/drag), detail column (fixed header, synth path with item icons, attr chips, passive/active, fixed buy/sell bar), owned bar (6 icon slots). Data payload supplied by host/client: items list per category, hero state (gold, owned ids, recommended list), detail info for selected item.

That's a big chunk but gives one implementation. However risk: high chance of bugs, and time. Given user wants "开工" and efficiency principle, maybe pragmatic: implement host-only P0 improvements in the existing node UI (adding states + fixed buy bar + synth icons + attr chips + gold chip + memory + quick buy), and leave client as-is for now (client still works, just not enhanced)? But parity rule is my own promise... The client's NetShopPanel mirrors host; if host layout changes but client doesn't, LAN players see old shop. Acceptable? Previous rounds I always synced. Compromise: host full P0 improvements; client: sync the *functional* parts that don't require full rewrite? Honestly client rewrite to shared view is the only cheap path for parity.

Let me estimate ShopView shared:

- host builds payload each refresh; client builds from its existing net shop payload (NetShopPanel already receives own snapshot + item DB; it can build the same payload locally using ItemDatabase).

## Primary Request and Intent
- Project-wide efficiency rule (Chinese, permanent): "我的时间和预算不是很足，请你在这个项目尽可能快速完成我的任务并节省token用量，把这一条作为这个项目的原则" — recorded in `CLAUDE.md` → `## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)`.
- Standing preference: "以后每次完成任务给我发个windows通知" — run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"` before final answer.
- Delivered history (all done): map realism pack; joystick crash fix; 王者峡谷 comparison report; `_bullet_vkind` fixes; collapsible attribute panel; LAN client attack/animation/EV_ACT fixes; minion attack animations; jungle/skill/death anims; tower plinth + laser; tower destruction anim + siege recoil; brighter orb + destruction timing; minion size normalization; AI audit + 3 bug fixes; minion lane targeting; 安琪拉 1-skill range; dash VFX; procedural skill icons (`SkillArt.gd`); battle font optimization; UI polish round; 28 hero emblems (`HeroArt.gd`); 5-part HUD round (minimap frame, top-band overflow, recommend card, function icons, summoner colors); follow-up fixes (frame occlusion, button names, centered stats row, portrait typography); buff icons (`BuffArt.gd`, 44 motifs).
- Death panel redesign DONE (this session): user said "优化吧" after I proposed P0+P1 directions → implemented shared `DeathRecapView`.
- **CURRENT**: user asks "给出全局英雄信息面板UI的优化方向" — produce analysis/direction report only for the hero detail panel (C-key 战场信息 panel), mirroring the death-panel report style (现状 → 问题 → 分阶段方向 + 参数 + 工作量), no implementation yet.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 headless binary at `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe`, copied to `.cache\godot47.exe` for probes; must delete `.cache` (+ probe dir) after.
- Probe pattern: temp dir + `check.tscn`/`check.gd`; run `Start-Process godot47 --headless --path . res://<dir>/check.tscn --quit-after 400`, grep stdout for markers, kill `godot47`, remove dirs.
- Helper scripts must use `const X = preload("res://...")` (no `class_name` in headless registration); `class_name` must come AFTER `extends`.
- Project claims Godot 4.5; warnings are errors: `:=` from Variant (e.g. `for src in order`, untyped node `.size`) fails parse → always annotate `var x: float/String/Vector2 = ...`.
- LAN host-authoritative; client replicas (`NetClientBattle`, `NetRecommendBar`, `NetMiniMap`, `NetDeathRecap`, `NetRosterPanel`) must mirror host UI changes; shared payload builders avoid drift.
- `UiKit` autoload API: `text(ci,pos,txt,fs,color,align,width)`, `flat(alpha,radius,border,edge,bg,pad,shadow)`, `chip(ci,rect,alpha,radius,accent)`, `item_icon(ci,rect,tier,name)`, `rec_card(...)`, `font()`, `scale()`, `safe_top()`, `show_panel(ctrl,dur)`, `hide_panel(ctrl,dur)`, `make_backdrop(panel,color,alpha)`, `skin_button(state,accent,bool)`, colors `C_TEAM0/C_TEAM1/C_GOLD/C_DANGER/C_PANEL_EDGE/C_TEXT`, `FS_*`.
- `ui_scale()` multiplies fonts but panel offsets are fixed px → overflow risk; DeathRecapView solves by drawing in unit coords with `draw_set_transform(ZERO,0,Vector2(s,s))` where `s = clampf(UiKit.scale(),0.9,1.35)`.

## Files and Code
- `CLAUDE.md` — working principles + notification rule.
- `scripts/ui/DeathRecapView.gd` (NEW, ~340 lines, `extends Control`, no class_name): death panel shared view. `signal closed_by_user`; `const HeroArt`, `const BuffArt`; `CARD_W=520`, `CARD_H_MIN=560`; colors `C_PHYS=(1.0,0.62,0.24)`, `C_MAG=(0.72,0.52,1.0)`, `C_TRUE=(0.95,0.97,1.0)`, `C_DIM`, `C_PANEL_BG=(0.045,0.055,0.085,0.97)`; `var data: Dictionary`, `card_h`, `_tick_acc`; `set_data(d)` (computes `_layout()["h"]`, sets `size`, `UiKit.show_panel`, `set_process(true)`); self-ticks `data["respawn"]` every 0.1s in `_process`; `_layout()` returns y-positions dict (header 132 then compose/src/attrib/advice, `"h"` total); `_draw()` draws card `UiKit.flat(0.95,16,1,edge,C_PANEL_BG,0,18)`, red top hairline, `_header()` (HeroArt portrait at `(66,62)` r34, "你被 X 击杀" 23px, "近 7 秒承伤 N" 14px, respawn big `38px` gold right-aligned width 154 at `CARD_W-190`, "秒后复活" 13px, blue progress bar `(CARD_W-190,104,154,6)`), `_compose_bar()`, `_compose_legend()` (dots + "物理 1,948 (68%)"), `_sources()` (max 4 rows, HeroArt ring 13, name 17px, skills 12px, total right 120 wide, pct), `_attrib()` (BuffArt icon r11 + 15px text), `_advice()` (gold chip), `_close_rect()=Rect2(CARD_W-44,10,30,26)`, `_gui_input` hit-tests close → emit + hide; `static skill_key(skill_id)` (25-case map: 1/2/3技能, -2 灼烧, -10 红莲, -20 电刀, -21 末世, -22 圣剑, -23 巫术, -24 宗师, -25 凝冰, -26 寒霜, -27 回响, -28 面具, -29 冰痕, -30 日渊, -31 血魔, -32 怒龙, -33 极寒, -36 逐日, -37 破晓, -51 冰霜冲击, -52 强化普攻, `<-9` 装备); `static build(hero, battle=null)` returns `{killer,killer_hero,killer_team,respawn,respawn_total,cc,total,phys,mag,true,sources[{name,hero,team,total,phys,mag,skills}],attrib[{key,color,text}],advice}`; guards `hero == null → {}`; roster via `get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes")`; attrib rules: cc≥2.0 → "被控制 N 秒后阵亡" key `stun`; sources≥3 → "N 人参与围攻" key `suppress`; `battle.hero_under_enemy_tower(hero)` → "在敌方防御塔射程内阵亡" key `tower_dive`; burst(1s) ≥ 60% max hp → `is_burst` → "1 秒内被瞬秒" key `junlin`; fallback "对拼落败" key `sword`; advice variants (抵抗之靴 / 兵线进塔 / 队友10m / 保命装 / 站位).
- `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` (~3445 lines) — `const DeathRecapView = preload("res://scripts/ui/DeathRecapView.gd")` at L5 (after `const SkillArt`); `var death_recap_panel            # DeathRecapView 实例` (untyped); `_create_death_recap_panel()` now `DeathRecapView.new()` + `closed_by_user.connect(_close_death_recap)`; `_show_death_recap(hero)` is 12 lines (`build`, then center via `set_anchors_preset(PRESET_CENTER)` + `offset_left=-sz.x*0.5` … `offset_top=-sz.y*0.5+8.0`, `var sz: Vector2 = death_recap_panel.size`); `_update_death_recap` unchanged (visible toggled by `hero.is_dead`, `death_recap_shown/closed`); BuffIcon class has `const BuffArt = preload("res://scripts/ui/BuffArt.gd")` and `_draw` calls `BuffArt.draw_buff(self, center, R * 0.62, key, tint)` (glyph text removed); `_update_team_stats` centers 2nd row via `var plain := "%s %d vs %d %s" % [...]`, `tw = UiKit.font().get_string_size(plain,…,28*ui_scale()).x`, `team_stats_label.offset_left = -tw*0.5`, `offset_right = tw*0.5+4.0`; RespawnWidget text: name `UiKit.text(...,24,name_col)`, health/respawn 22/24px, stack 18px; `death_overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE` (kept, revert of STOP).
- `scripts/net/NetDeathRecap.gd` (REWRITTEN, ~65 lines): `class_name NetDeathRecap extends Control`, `const DeathRecapView = preload(...)`, child `_view`; `_ready` connects `NetSession.net_death_recap`; `_on_recap(p)` → `_view.set_data(p)`, `_place()`, `UiKit.show_panel(self,0.18)`, `queue_redraw()`; `feed_alive(alive)` hides view + clears data on 0→1; `_close()` hides both; `_place()` centers view at `((vp-sz)*0.5).floor() + Vector2(0,8)`; `_notification(NOTIFICATION_RESIZED)`; Esc close; `_draw` dims `Color(0,0,0,0.44)`.
- `scripts/net/NetSession.gd` — `const DeathRecapView = preload("res://scripts/ui/DeathRecapView.gd")` before `const SNAPSHOT_HZ`; `_pack_death_recap(h)` now `return DeathRecapView.build(h, get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager"))` (old 35-line mirror deleted); `_recap_skill_key` remains unused; rpc `_rpc_death_recap` → `net_death_recap.emit(payload)`.
- `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd` — `extends Node3D` (restored), `const HeroArt`, `const NetDeathRecapScript`; `_death_tint.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE` (kept); `_dr.feed_alive(...)` only API used; score strip 2nd row centered (`var total`, `var bx := cx - total * 0.5`); `_draw_widget_cell` name 24px, `_draw_widget_mid` 24px + `draw_string_outline`.
- `scripts/ui/BuffArt.gd` (NEW) — `extends RefCounted`; `const RULES` (key-substring → motif, specific→generic: jungle_protect→leaf, tower_dive→tower, knockup, suppress→chain, silence→mute, grievous→broken_heart, hasten→up_arrows, stun→stars, froze/freeze→snow, slow→hourglass, shield, shadow_junlin→bolt_violet, junlin→bolt, storm→cyclone, red→flame, blue→orb, jungle→leaf, atk_up→sword, ap_up→wand, armor_up→plate, mr_up→diamond, as_up→swift, ms_up→boot, frenzy→claw, witch→star_moon, sage→fist, ice→ice_fist, thornmail→thorn, golden→bell, sunspire→sun, shadow, bloodrage→blood, chasewind→wind, duskflow→moon, fierce→flame_armor, saintsword→sword_gold, regen→cross, revive→phoenix, mark_→seal, bt→superarmor, wd→invincible, hs_taiyi→life, hs_arthur→holy, hs_liushan→talisman, hs_wukong→staff, hs_libai→sword, hs_lanling→shadow, burn→flame, poison→poison, slow_mark→hourglass); `static motif_for(key)`, `static draw_buff(ci,center,radius,key,col)`, `_motif()` 44 cases; verified 49 keys → 44 motifs.
- `scripts/ui/IconArt.gd` — function icons: tower/minion white `(0.96,0.97,1.0)`, recall blue `(0.36,0.66,1.0)`, recover green `(0.40,0.95,0.55)`, summoners per-skill colors; `kind_for_summoner`, `color_of`, `draw_icon(ci,center,radius,kind,dim)`; `SUMMONER_KIND` map.
- `scripts/mobile/TouchActionButton.gd` — `class_name TouchActionButton` then `extends Control` then `const IconArt`; `var icon_kind := ""`, `var dimmed := false`, `var name_text := ""`; icon branch `IconArt.draw_icon(self, center, radius*0.98, icon_kind, dimmed); _draw_name(center, radius); return`; `_draw_name()` draws `UiKit.chip(band,0.74,7.0,color)` + white text `fs = int(maxf(15.0, radius*0.32))`.
- `scripts/mobile/TouchController.gd` — `tower_btn.name_text="推塔"`, `minion_btn.name_text="小兵"`, `rec.name_text="回城"`, `recv.display_name="恢复"` + `name_below=true`, summoner `display_name = sname` + `name_below = true` + `art_hero = ""`.
- `scripts/ui/Minimap.gd` / `scripts/net/NetMiniMap.gd` — `_draw_frame()` now border-only: `UiKit.flat(0.0,12,2,dark,Color(0,0,0,0),0,0)` at `r.grow(2.0)` + `UiKit.flat(0.0,8,1,Color(0.62,0.74,0.92,0.55),…,0,0)` at `r.grow(0.5)`; corner ticks `var cx: float = …`, `var cy: float = …` (explicit typing required).
- `scripts/ui/HeroArt.gd` — 28 heroes emblem/portrait; `draw_portrait(ci, center, ring_radius, hero_name, team_tint, is_dead)`, `accent_of()`.
- `scripts/mobile/SkillTouchButton.gd` — `icon_kind` + `name_below` band via `UiKit.chip` with hero accent; `art_hero` kept only for hero skills.
- `scripts/dev/notify.ps1` — toast helper (used every delivery).
- Hero detail panel (target of current request) — `UI_Manager.gd`: `var hero_detail_panel: Panel` (L157), `hero_detail_vbox`, `hero_detail_visible`, `hero_detail_dim`; `_create_hero_detail_panel()` L611: dim `ColorRect` `0.4` full-rect click-to-close, `Panel` centered `offset_left/right = ∓1140`, full height, `_apply_panel_style(…,0.86)` + `UiKit.make_backdrop(…,C_TEAM0,0.5)`, `ScrollContainer` with `offset_top = 78`, title Label "战场信息" 28px gold at `(44,16)`, sub "按总经济排序 · 点击空白处关闭" 13px, gold line `(44,82,360,3)`, close Button `-56..-6 / 6..56` 26px; `_refresh_hero_detail_panel()` L2323: frees vbox children, sorts heroes desc by `total_gold_earned`, `panel_h=1000`, `header_h=55`, `spacing=4`, `card_h = max(52, available/hero_count)`, `font_main = max(12, int(card_h/4.2))`, `font_sub = font_main-2`; team stats HBox (我方/VS/敌方: 经济+经验+击杀, separation 50) + HSeparator; per-hero `Panel` card with `UiKit.flat(0.78,8,1,teamcolor,…,6.0)`, `border_width_left = 4`, `card_hbox` with `HeroDisc` (role/team/dead/hp_ratio, `min 60×card_h`), `left_box` (`min 180`) status (复活/残血/存活) + name + level; client mirror `scripts/net/NetRosterPanel.gd` (659 lines, `PANEL_W := 2160.0`, `BASE_W := 2400.0`, `CONTENT_TOP := 78.0`, `TEAM_HDR_H := 55.0`, `CARD_GAP := 4.0`, `CARD_MIN_H := 52.0`, `DISC_W := 60.0`, `LEFT_W := 180.0`, `RIGHT_W := 340.0`, `CLOSE_W := 50.0`, `REQ_INTERVAL := 0.5`).

## Errors and Fixes
- `Parse Error: Could not parse global class "TouchActionButton"` → `class_name` placed before `extends`; moved `extends Control` to line 2, `const IconArt` after.
- `Parse Error: Expected end of statement after constant declaration, found "Literal"` in `NetClientBattle.gd` → earlier pwsh replace of `extends Node` corrupted `extends Node3D` into `const HeroArt = preload("…")3D`; fixed line + restored `extends Node3D` via regex `^extends Node\s*\r?\n(?=const HeroArt)`.
- `Cannot infer the type of "cx"/"cy"` in minimap `_draw_frame` (ternary mixing float/int) → `var cx: float = 0.0 if … else float(MINIMAP_SIZE)`.
- `Cannot infer the type of "hname"` (DeathRecapView) → `var hname: String = str(src)`; `Cannot infer the type of "sz"` (UI_Manager:2586) → `var sz: Vector2 = death_recap_panel.size`.
- Invalid ternary `elif burst >= … if hero != null else false:` → precomputed `var is_burst := false` and `elif is_burst:`.
- `Remove-Item` fails while godot alive → `Get-Process godot47 | Stop-Process -Force`, sleep 400–500ms, retry.
- `read_image` unavailable ("model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 does not declare image input") → cannot visually verify; rely on compile/draw probes + exported PNG.
- Multi-line pwsh here-string `.Replace` fails silently on CRLF anchors (`ok=False`) → use regex replace or `edit` tool.
- `write` refused: "file has not been read" → `read` first (e.g. NetDeathRecap.gd).
- Death panel v1 layout complaints fixed earlier: minimap frame fill occluded map (→ border-only), missing button names (→ name bands), stats row not centered (→ measured centering), portrait text harsh (→ 24px + outline).
- `BattleManager.gd` was being modified by an external process (12:40:21→12:40:38, size 171672→171756) and transiently failed to compile (`Function "_apply_default_summoner()" not found in base self`, `_on_right_tab_pressed` undeclared); not touched, reported to user. Later probes (12:58) showed no such errors.

## Pending Jobs
- Report only (current request): hero info panel optimization directions — must still be written.
- Deferred by user: delete dead AI modules (~718 lines), wire `AiConfig.Difficulty`, fix model-size outliers, 4th-skill/装备 active buttons icons, P2 death-panel extras (click-row detail, "本局静音", 查看击杀者).
- Exported artifacts (`HonorKing.pck/.exe/.apk`) need re-export for the user to see changes.

## Current Work
- Reading `UI_Manager._refresh_hero_detail_panel()` (L2323+) to ground the hero-info-panel audit: got team stats header, card geometry math (`panel_h=1000`, `card_h ≈ available/hero_count`), `HeroDisc`, `left_box` status/name/level; still unread: rest of the card (level/equipment/KDA/right_box ~`RIGHT_W 340`), `HeroDisc` draw, sort/refresh cadence (`hero_detail_refresh_timer`), and `NetRosterPanel` internals.
- No edits made yet in this turn; death-panel work fully finished, verified, cleaned up, notification sent.

## Next Step
- Read the remaining hero-card content rows (level, HP/MP, equipment slots, KDA/skills, right_box) in `_refresh_hero_detail_panel` (from ~L2419 onward) and skim `NetRosterPanel` layout/draw, then write the terse Chinese "全局英雄信息面板 UI 优化方向" report (现状 → 问题 → P0/P1/P2 方向 + 参数表 + 推荐顺序 + 双端共用视图建议), send notify, no code changes.

## Critical Context
- User reads Chinese; wants terse change lists, verification notes, tunable parameters; "给出优化方向" means analysis deliverable only (they say "优化吧" to trigger implementation).
- File sandbox is `danger-full-access`, approvals disabled — never pass `sandbox_permissions`; verify absolute paths before deletes.
- Repo has no git/test suite; verification = headless probe compile/draw checks only.
- Design constraints: no art/font assets (all procedural); only hero skills use hero color, utility buttons fixed colors; host/client parity mandatory for every HUD change (prefer shared view/payload builders).
- Top band geometry: panel `-160..360 × 8..196`; minimap occupies `40..340`; `respawn_container` at `(350,40)`; fonts time 30 / KDA 24 right-aligned at 350 / stats 28 centered.
- Death panel conventions to reuse in hero panel report: measured text centering, `UiKit.flat` card, `draw_set_transform` scaling via `s = clampf(UiKit.scale(),0.9,1.35)`, one shared view script instantiated by both host and client, pure `_draw` (no per-frame node rebuild).
- Known hero-panel pain points to cite: 10 cards in one vertical column inside 2280×1000 panel (heavy scrolling), card height derived from fixed `panel_h=1000` (ignores real viewport), font sizes derived from `card_h` (`max(12, int(card_h/4.2))`) thus tiny/growing unpredictably, `_apply_label_style` scale mismatch, full rebuild (`queue_free` all children) every refresh, `HeroDisc` only a ring with HP, no equipment/skill/KDA comparison, no sort/filter controls (only fixed 经济排序), no player-highlight, `hero_detail_refresh_timer` throttling, client mirror duplicates ~659 lines of layout constants → candidate for shared view like `DeathRecapView`.

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

```gdscript
func _update_shop_detail():
	if not shop_detail_panel: return
	for child in shop_detail_panel.get_children(): child.queue_free()
	var item = ItemDatabase.get_item(shop_selected_item)
	if item.is_empty(): return
	var battle = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager") as BattleManager
	if not battle or not battle.hero: return
	var hero = battle.hero
	var rs := ui_scale()
	var tier: int = item.get("tier", 1)
	var tcol: Color = _shop_tier_color(tier)
	var owned: bool = hero.equipment_slots.has(shop_selected_item)

	# 固定头部
	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
	head.anchor_right = 1.0
	head.offset_bottom = 92.0
	head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", int(14 * rs))
	shop_detail_panel.add_child(head)
	var icon := ItemIconBox.new()
	icon.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(72 * rs, 72 * rs)
	icon.item_name = str(item.get("name", shop_selected_item))
	icon.tier = tier
	icon.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	head.add_child(icon)
	var info := VBoxContainer.new()
	info.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	info.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	info.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	var tl := Label.new(); tl.text = "[" + _shop_tier_name(tier) + "]  " + str(_item_category_of(shop_selected_item))
	_apply_label_style(tl, 13, tcol)
	info.add_child(tl)
	var nl := Label.new(); nl.text = str(item["name"])
	_apply_label_style(nl, 24, Color.WHITE)
	info.add_child(nl)
	var pay := int(item["cost"])
	var comp_val := 0
	if item.has("requires"):
		var rem: Array = item["requires"].duplicate()
		for oid in hero.equipment_slots:
			var idx := rem.find(oid)
			if idx >= 0:
				var ri = ItemDatabase.get_item(oid)
				if not ri.is_empty(): comp_val += int(ri["cost"])
				rem.remove_at(idx)
		pay = maxi(int(item["cost"]) - comp_val, 0)
	var pl := Label.new()
	pl.text = "总价 %d 金" % int(item["cost"]) if comp_val <= 0 else "总价 %d 金  ·  素材抵扣 %d  ·  实付 %d 金" % [int(item["cost"]), comp_val, pay]
	_apply_label_style(pl, 15, Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.3))
	info.add_child(pl)
	head.add_child(info)

	# 滚动体
	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.anchor_right = 1.0; scroll.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	scroll.offset_top = 96.0; scroll.offset_bottom = -76.0
	shop_detail_panel.add_child(scroll)
	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", int(6 * rs))
	scroll.add_child(vbox)

	# 合成路径（图标化）
	if item.has("requires"):
		var reqs: Array = item["requires"]
		var shl := Label.new()
		shl.text = "合成路径"
		_apply_label_style(shl, 14, Color(0.78, 0.86, 1.0))
		vbox.add_child(shl)
		var flow := HFlowContainer.new()
		flow.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", int(8 * rs))
		flow.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", int(6 * rs))
		for rid in reqs:
			var rhas: bool = hero.equipment_slots.has(rid)
			var rbox := HBoxContainer.new()
			rbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
			var ri2 := ItemIconBox.new()
			ri2.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(40 * rs, 40 * rs)
			var ritem = ItemDatabase.get_item(rid)
			ri2.item_name = str(ritem.get("name", rid)) if not ritem.is_empty() else str(rid)
			ri2.tier = int(ritem.get("tier", 1)) if not ritem.is_empty() else 1
			ri2.dim = not rhas
			rbox.add_child(ri2)
			var has_lbl := Label.new()
			has_lbl.text = "✓" if rhas else "+%d金" % int(ritem.get("cost", 0))
			_apply_label_style(has_lbl, 12, Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.5) if rhas else Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.42))
			has_lbl.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
			rbox.add_child(has_lbl)
			flow.add_child(rbox)
		vbox.add_child(flow)
		if ItemDatabase.can_build(shop_selected_item, hero.equipment_slots):
			var ok_lbl := Label.new()
			ok_lbl.text = "可立即合成（需补 %d 金）" % ItemDatabase.get_synthesis_cost(shop_selected_item, hero.equipment_slots)
			_apply_label_style(ok_lbl, 13, Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.5))
			vbox.add_child(ok_lbl)

	# 属性徽章（图标 + 数值，自动换行）
	var attrs: Array = []
	for attr_data in [["attack","攻击力"],["ability_power","法术强度"],["attack_speed","攻速","%"],["crit_chance","暴击率","%"],["crit_damage","暴伤","%"],["armor","物防"],["magic_resist","法防"],["phys_pen","物穿"],["magic_pen","法穿"],["armor_pen_percent","物穿%","%"],["magic_pen_percent","法穿%","%"],["lifesteal","物理吸血","%"],["spell_vamp","法术吸血","%"],["speed","移速"],["per_speed","移速%","%"],["cooldown","冷却","%"],["health","生命"],["mana","法力"],["hp_regen","生命回复"],["mana_regen","法力回复"],["toughness","韧性","%"],["per_ability_power","法强%","%"]]:
		var key: String = attr_data[0]
		if item.has(key) and item[key] != 0:
			attrs.append([str(attr_data[1]), int(item[key]), str(attr_data[2]) if attr_data.size() > 2 else "", _attr_tint(key)])
	if not attrs.is_empty():
		vbox.add_child(HSeparator.new())
		var al := Label.new(); al.text = "装备属性"
		_apply_label_style(al, 14, Color(0.78, 0.86, 1.0))
		vbox.add_child(al)
		var aflow := HFlowContainer.new()
		aflow.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", int(16 * rs))
		aflow.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", int(6 * rs))
		for a in attrs:
			var chip := HBoxContainer.new()
			chip.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
			var ic := StatIcon.new()
			ic.shape = _attr_glyph(str(a[0]))
			ic.tint = a[3]
			ic.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(18 * rs, 18 * rs)
			ic.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
			chip.add_child(ic)
			var vl := Label.new()
			vl.text = "+%d%s %s" % [int(a[1]), str(a[2]), str(a[0])]
			_apply_label_style(vl, 13, a[3].lightened(0.35))
			vl.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
			chip.add_child(vl)
			aflow.add_child(chip)
		vbox.add_child(aflow)

	# 被动 / 主动
	if item.has("passive"):
		vbox.add_child(HSeparator.new())
		var pl2 := Label.new()
		pl2.text = "[被动] " + str(item["passive"])
		pl2.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
		pl2.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 0)
		_apply_label_style(pl2, 13, Color(1.0, 0.92, 0.55))
		vbox.add_child(pl2)
	if item.has("active"):
		var al2 := Label.new()
		al2.text = "[主动] " + str(item["active"])
		al2.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
		_apply_label_style(al2, 13, Color(0.62, 0.9, 1.0))
		vbox.add_child(al2)

	# 固定底部：购买 / 出售
	var bar := HBoxContainer.new()
	bar.anchor_left = 0.0; bar.anchor_right = 1.0
	bar.anchor_top = 1.0; bar.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	bar.offset_top = -66.0; bar.offset_bottom = -6.0
	bar.add_theme_constant_override("separation", int(10 * rs))
	shop_detail_panel.add_child(bar)
	var can_buy_more: bool = (not owned) or tier < 3
	var buy := Button.new()
	buy.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	buy.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(round(17 * rs)))
	if not can_buy_more:
		buy.text = "已拥有"
		buy.disabled = true
		buy.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", UiKit.skin_button("normal", Color(0.35,0.38,0.44), true))
	elif hero.gold < pay:
```

```gdscript
func _update_shop_detail():
```

{"command":"$p = (Resolve-Path 'scripts\ui\UI_Manager.gd')
function Replace-Func($path, $name, $body) {
  $lines = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($path)
  $s = -1; for ($i=0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) { if ($lines[$i] -match "^func $name\(") { $s = $i; break } }
  if ($s -lt 0) { return "MISS $name" }
  $e = -1; for ($i=$s+1; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) { if ($lines[$i] -match '^func ') { $e = $i-1; break } }
  if ($e -lt 0) { $e = $lines.Count-1 }
  $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
  for ($i=0; $i -lt $s; $i++) { $out.Add($lines[$i]) }
  foreach ($l in ($body -split "`r?`n")) { $out.Add($l) }
  for ($i=$e+1; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) { $out.Add($lines[$i]) }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($path, $out)
  return "OK $name (was $($e-$s+1))"
}

$open = @'
func _open_shop():
	var battle = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager") as BattleManager
	if not battle or not battle.hero: return
	if shop_selected_category == "": shop_selected_category = "物理"
	var rs := ui_scale()
	shop_ui = Control.new()
	shop_ui.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)

	# 遮罩（点击关闭）
	var dim = ColorRect.new()
	dim.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.4)
	shop_ui.add_child(dim)
	_connect_tap_to_action(dim, Callable(self, "_close_shop"))

	# 居中对称抽屉
	var drawer = Panel.new()
	drawer.anchor_left = 0.5; drawer.anchor_right = 0.5
	drawer.anchor_top = 0.0; drawer.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	drawer.offset_left = -1140; drawer.offset_right = 1140
	drawer.offset_top = 0; drawer.offset_bottom = 0
	_apply_panel_style(drawer, 0.90)
	shop_ui.add_child(drawer)
	UiKit.make_backdrop(drawer, UiKit.C_TEAM0, 0.55)

	# 标题：商店 + 金币 + 可买件数
	shop_title_label = Label.new()
	shop_title_label.position = Vector2(22 * rs, 10)
	_apply_label_style(shop_title_label, 20, UiKit.C_GOLD)
	drawer.add_child(shop_title_label)
	_refresh_shop_title()

	# 关闭按钮

function Replace-Func($path, $name, $body) {
  $lines = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($path)
  $s = -1; for ($i=0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) { if ($lines[$i] -match "^func $name\(") { $s = $i; break } }
  if ($s -lt 0) { return "MISS $name" }
  $e = -1; for ($i=$s+1; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) { if ($lines[$i] -match '^func ') { $e = $i-1; break } }
  if ($e -lt 0) { $e = $lines.Count-1 }
  $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
  for ($i=0; $i -lt $s; $i++) { $out.Add($lines[$i]) }
  foreach ($l in ($body -split "`r?`n")) { $out.Add($l) }
  for ($i=$e+1; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) { $out.Add($lines[$i]) }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($path, $out)
  return "OK $name (was $($e-$s+1))"
}

const C_CARD_ENEMY := Color(0.14, 0.04, 0.06, 0.86)
const SKILL_TAG := ["1", "2", "3", "召"]
const PAD := 0.965

var rows: Array = []
var mode := "attr"
var panel_h := 1200.0
var _row_h := 200.0

func _ready() -> void:
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	visible = false
	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)

func set_rows(r: Array, md: String = "attr") -> void:
	rows = r
	mode = md
	if not visible:
		visible = true
		UiKit.show_panel(self, 0.15)
	queue_redraw()

func _s() -> float:
	return clampf(UiKit.scale(), 0.88, 1.35)

## 版式：全部由自身矩形（= 屏幕可用区）推算，保证任何分辨率/缩放下不越界
func _layout() -> Dictionary:
	var avail := size
	if avail.x <= 1.0 or avail.y <= 1.0:
		avail = Vector2(2400.0, 1400.0)
	var s := minf(_s(), minf(avail.x * PAD / PANEL_W, 1.35))
	var ph := minf(avail.y * PAD / s, 1600.0)
	var rh := maxf((ph - HEAD_H - 24.0 - ROW_GAP * 5.0) / 5.0, 112.0)
	var w := PANEL_W * s
	var h := ph * s
	return {"s": s, "ph": ph, "rh": rh, "w": w, "h": h, "o": ((avail - Vector2(w, h)) * 0.5).floor()}

func _draw() -> void:
	var L := _layout()
	var s: float = L.s
	panel_h = L.ph
	_row_h = L.rh
	var origin: Vector2 = L.o
	draw_set_transform(origin, 0.0, Vector2(s, s))
	# 背板
