{"content":"class_name HealthPack
extends Area3D

## 血包（真实 3D 模型）：石台 + 悬浮发光药球 + 十字光标 + 地面光斑 + 绿色粒子，
## 并保留原有「灰色外环 + 绿色回复进度弧」与全部逻辑字段/信号行为。
var team: int = 0
var respawn_time: float = 75.0
var cooldown_timer: float = 0.0
var available: bool = true
var turret: Turret = null
var col: CollisionShape3D
var ring_grey: MeshInstance3D
var ring_green: MeshInstance3D
var mesh: MeshInstance3D          # 药球（可用性切换沿用此字段）

var _glow: MeshInstance3D         # 外层光晕
var _cross_h: MeshInstance3D      # 十字横
var _cross_v: MeshInstance3D      # 十字竖
var _ground: MeshInstance3D       # 地面光斑
var _spark: CPUParticles3D        # 上浮粒子
var _t: float = 0.0               # 本地动画时钟

func _ready():
	add_to_group("health_packs")
	_create_visual()
	body_entered.connect(_on_body_entered)

func _create_visual():
	# —— 石台（粗糙暗石，给血包一个"落地"的实体底座）——
	var ped := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var pm := CylinderMesh.new()
	pm.top_radius = 0.52
	pm.bottom_radius = 0.66
	pm.height = 0.14
	pm.radial_segments = 16
	ped.mesh = pm
	ped.position.y = 0.07
	ped.material_override = _mat(Color(0.26, 0.25, 0.23), 0.95, 0.0)
	add_child(ped)
	# 石台顶面一圈暗色内凹
	var inlay := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var im := CylinderMesh.new()
	im.top_radius = 0.40
	im.bottom_radius = 0.42
	im.height = 0.02
	im.radial_segments = 16
	inlay.mesh = im
	inlay.position.y = 0.145
	inlay.material_override = _mat(Color(0.13, 0.20, 0.14), 0.9, 0.0)
	add_child(inlay)

	# —— 药球（自发光的半透绿球，核心很亮）——
	mesh = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var sm := SphereMesh.new()
	sm.radius = 0.24
	sm.height = 0.48
	sm.radial_segments = 24
	sm.rings = 12
	mesh.mesh = sm
	mesh.position.y = 0.62
	mesh.material_override = _glow_mat(Color(0.16, 0.95, 0.42), 2.4, 0.85)
	add_child(mesh)

	# —— 外层柔光晕（加色混合，忽略光照）——
	_glow = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var gm := SphereMesh.new()
	gm.radius = 0.42
	gm.height = 0.84
	gm.radial_segments = 20
	gm.rings = 10
	_glow.mesh = gm
	_glow.position.y = 0.62
	var gmat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	gmat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	gmat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	gmat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	gmat.albedo_color = Color(0.25, 1.0, 0.55, 0.16)
	gmat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	_glow.material_override = gmat
	add_child(_glow)

	# —— 十字光标（药性标识，双面可见）——
	_cross_h = _make_cross_bar(Vector3(0.52, 0.10, 0.10))
	_cross_v = _make_cross_bar(Vector3(0.10, 0.52, 0.10))
	add_child(_cross_h)
	add_child(_cross_v)

	# —— 地面光斑（贴地发光，远处也能看到这里有补给）——
	_ground = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var qm := QuadMesh.new()
	qm.size = Vector2(2.4, 2.4)
	_ground.mesh = qm
	_ground.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-90, 0, 0)
	_ground.position.y = 0.03
	var qmat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	qmat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	qmat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	qmat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	qmat.albedo_color = Color(0.18, 0.85, 0.36, 0.13)
	qmat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	_ground.material_override = qmat
	add_child(_ground)

	# —— 上浮微粒（缓慢升起的绿色光点）——
	_spark = CPUParticles3D.new()
	_spark.amount = 12
	_spark.lifetime = 1.6
	_spark.position.y = 0.35
	_spark.emission_shape = CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE
	_spark.emission_sphere_radius = 0.28
	_spark.direction = Vector3(0, 1, 0)
	_spark.spread = 18.0
	_spark.initial_velocity_min = 0.18
	_spark.initial_velocity_max = 0.42
	_spark.gravity = Vector3(0, 0.35, 0)
	_spark.scale_amount_min = 0.02
	_spark.scale_amount_max = 0.045
	_spark.color = Color(0.55, 1.0, 0.68, 0.85)
	add_child(_spark)

	# —— 灰色底座圆环（沿用原表现，压暗一点更像石刻）——
	ring_grey = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var torus_grey = TorusMesh.new()
	torus_grey.inner_radius = 0.9
	torus_grey.outer_radius = 1.0
	torus_grey.rings = 64
	ring_grey.mesh = torus_grey
	var mat_grey = StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat_grey.albedo_color = Color(0.42, 0.44, 0.46, 0.9)
	mat_grey.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	ring_grey.material_override = mat_grey
	add_child(ring_grey)

	# —— 绿色回复进度弧（动态生成，逻辑不变）——
	ring_green = MeshInstance3D.new()
	add_child(ring_green)

	# 碰撞体（半径比原来大一点点，贴合"球+光环"的实际体积）
	col = CollisionShape3D.new()
	col.shape = SphereShape3D.new()
	col.shape.radius = 0.5
	add_child(col)

func _make_cross_bar(size: Vector3) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var bar := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var bm := BoxMesh.new()
	bm.size = size
	bar.mesh = bm
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(0.85, 1.0, 0.9, 1.0)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.6)
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.6
	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	m.albedo_color.a = 0.92
	m.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	bar.material_override = m
	bar.position.y = 0.62
	return bar

func _mat(c: Color, rough: float, metal: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = c
	m.roughness = rough
	m.metallic = metal
	return m

func _glow_mat(c: Color, energy: float, alpha: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(c.r, c.g, c.b, alpha)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = c
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = energy
	m.roughness = 0.12
	m.metallic = 0.05
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	return m

func _set_orb_visible(v: bool) -> void:
	if mesh: mesh.visible = v
	if _glow: _glow.visible = v
	if _cross_h: _cross_h.visible = v
	if _cross_v: _cross_v.visible = v
	if _ground: _ground.visible = v
	if _spark: _spark.emitting = v

func _process(delta):
	_t += delta
	if available:
		# 悬浮上下 + 光晕呼吸 + 十字缓慢旋转（有"活着"的感觉）
		var bob: float = sin(_t * 2.1) * 0.055
		if mesh: mesh.position.y = 0.62 + bob
		if _glow: _glow.position.y = 0.62 + bob * 0.7
		if _cross_h: _cross_h.position.y = 0.62 + bob
		if _cross_v: _cross_v.position.y = 0.62 + bob
		if _cross_v: _cross_v.rotation.y = _t * 1.1
		if _glow:
			var s: float = 1.0 + sin(_t * 2.6) * 0.07
			_glow.scale = Vector3(s, s, s)
		if _ground:
			_ground.scale = Vector3.ONE * (1.0 + sin(_t * 1.7) * 0.05)
		return
	cooldown_timer -= delta
	if cooldown_timer <= 0:
		available = true
		_set_orb_visible(true)
		col.disabled = false
		ring_green.visible = false
	else:
		var progress = 1.0 - (cooldown_timer / respawn_time)
		_draw_green_arc(progress)

func _draw_green_arc(progress: float):
	var st = SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	var segments = 64
	var angle_from = -PI / 2
	var angle_to = -PI / 2 + 2 * PI * progress
	var inner_r = 0.9
	var outer_r = 1.0
	var y = 0.3

	for i in range(segments):
		var a1 = angle_from + (angle_to - angle_from) * i / segments
		var a2 = angle_from + (angle_to - angle_from) * (i + 1) / segments
		var p1 = Vector3(cos(a1) * inner_r, y, sin(a1) * inner_r)
		var p2 = Vector3(cos(a2) * inner_r, y, sin(a2) * inner_r)
		var p3 = Vector3(cos(a1) * outer_r, y, sin(a1) * outer_r)
		var p4 = Vector3(cos(a2) * outer_r, y, sin(a2) * outer_r)
		st.add_vertex(p1); st.add_vertex(p2); st.add_vertex(p3)
		st.add_vertex(p2); st.add_vertex(p4); st.add_vertex(p3)

	st.generate_normals()
	var green_mat = StandardMaterial3D.new()
	green_mat.albedo_color = Color(0.25, 1.0, 0.5, 0.85)
	green_mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	green_mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	green_mat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED

var team: int = 0
var respawn_time: float = 75.0
var cooldown_timer: float = 0.0
var available: bool = true
var turret: Turret = null
var col: CollisionShape3D
var ring_grey: MeshInstance3D
var ring_green: MeshInstance3D
var mesh: MeshInstance3D          # 药球（可用性切换沿用此字段）

var _glow: MeshInstance3D         # 外层光晕
var _cross_h: MeshInstance3D      # 十字横

var _ground: MeshInstance3D       # 地面光斑
var _spark: CPUParticles3D        # 上浮粒子
var _t: float = 0.0               # 本地动画时钟

func _ready():
	add_to_group("health_packs")
	_create_visual()
	body_entered.connect(_on_body_entered)

func _create_visual():
	# —— 石台（粗糙暗石，给血包一个"落地"的实体底座）——
	var ped := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var pm := CylinderMesh.new()
	pm.top_radius = 0.52
	pm.bottom_radius = 0.66
	pm.height = 0.14
	pm.radial_segments = 16
	ped.mesh = pm
	ped.position.y = 0.07
	ped.material_override = _mat(Color(0.26, 0.25, 0.23), 0.95, 0.0)
	add_child(ped)
	# 石台顶面一圈暗色内凹
	var inlay := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var im := CylinderMesh.new()
	im.top_radius = 0.40
	im.bottom_radius = 0.42
	im.height = 0.02
	im.radial_segments = 16
	inlay.mesh = im
	inlay.position.y = 0.145
	inlay.material_override = _mat(Color(0.13, 0.20, 0.14), 0.9, 0.0)
	add_child(inlay)

	# —— 药球（自发光的半透绿球，核心很亮）——

	sm.height = 0.48
	sm.radial_segments = 24
	sm.rings = 12

	add_child(mesh)

	var gm := SphereMesh.new()
	gm.radius = 0.42
	gm.height = 0.84
	gm.radial_segments = 20
	gm.rings = 10
	_glow.mesh = gm
	_glow.position.y = 0.62
	var gmat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	gmat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	gmat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	gmat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	gmat.albedo_color = Color(0.25, 1.0, 0.55, 0.16)
	gmat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	_glow.material_override = gmat
	add_child(_glow)

	# —— 十字光标（药性标识，双面可见）——
	_cross_h = _make_cross_bar(Vector3(0.52, 0.10, 0.10))
	_cross_v = _make_cross_bar(Vector3(0.10, 0.52, 0.10))
	add_child(_cross_h)
	add_child(_cross_v)

	# —— 地面光斑（贴地发光，远处也能看到这里有补给）——
	_ground = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var qm := QuadMesh.new()
	qm.size = Vector2(2.4, 2.4)
	_ground.mesh = qm
	_ground.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-90, 0, 0)
	_ground.position.y = 0.03
	var qmat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	qmat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	qmat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	qmat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	qmat.albedo_color = Color(0.18, 0.85, 0.36, 0.13)
	qmat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	_ground.material_override = qmat
	add_child(_ground)

	_spark = CPUParticles3D.new()
	_spark.amount = 12
	_spark.lifetime = 1.6
	_spark.position.y = 0.35
	_spark.emission_shape = CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE
	_spark.emission_sphere_radius = 0.28
	_spark.direction = Vector3(0, 1, 0)
	_spark.spread = 18.0
	_spark.initial_velocity_min = 0.18
	_spark.initial_velocity_max = 0.42
	_spark.gravity = Vector3(0, 0.35, 0)
	_spark.scale_amount_min = 0.02
	_spark.scale_amount_max = 0.045
	_spark.color = Color(0.55, 1.0, 0.68, 0.85)
	add_child(_spark)

	# —— 灰色底座圆环（沿用原表现，压暗一点更像石刻）——
	ring_grey = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var torus_grey = TorusMesh.new()
	torus_grey.inner_radius = 0.9
	torus_grey.outer_radius = 1.0
	torus_grey.rings = 64
	ring_grey.mesh = torus_grey
	var mat_grey = StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat_grey.albedo_color = Color(0.42, 0.44, 0.46, 0.9)
	mat_grey.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	ring_grey.material_override = mat_grey
	add_child(ring_grey)

	# —— 绿色回复进度弧（动态生成，逻辑不变）——
	ring_green = MeshInstance3D.new()
	add_child(ring_green)

	# 碰撞体（半径比原来大一点点，贴合"球+光环"的实际体积）
	col = CollisionShape3D.new()
	col.shape = SphereShape3D.new()
	col.shape.radius = 0.5
	add_child(col)

func _make_cross_bar(size: Vector3) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var bar := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var bm := BoxMesh.new()
	bm.size = size
	bar.mesh = bm
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(0.85, 1.0, 0.9, 1.0)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.6)
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.6
	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	m.albedo_color.a = 0.92
	m.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	bar.material_override = m
	bar.position.y = 0.62
	return bar

func _mat(c: Color, rough: float, metal: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = c
	m.roughness = rough
	m.metallic = metal
	return m

func _glow_mat(c: Color, energy: float, alpha: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(c.r, c.g, c.b, alpha)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = c
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = energy
	m.roughness = 0.12
	m.metallic = 0.05
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	return m

func _set_orb_visible(v: bool) -> void:
	if mesh: mesh.visible = v
	if _glow: _glow.visible = v
	if _cross_h: _cross_h.visible = v
	if _cross_v: _cross_v.visible = v
	if _ground: _ground.visible = v
	if _spark: _spark.emitting = v

func _process(delta):
	_t += delta
	if available:
		# 悬浮上下 + 光晕呼吸 + 十字缓慢旋转（有"活着"的感觉）
		var bob: float = sin(_t * 2.1) * 0.055
		if mesh: mesh.position.y = 0.62 + bob
		if _glow: _glow.position.y = 0.62 + bob * 0.7
		if _cross_h: _cross_h.position.y = 0.62 + bob
		if _cross_v: _cross_v.position.y = 0.62 + bob
		if _cross_v: _cross_v.rotation.y = _t * 1.1
		if _glow:
			var s: float = 1.0 + sin(_t * 2.6) * 0.07
			_glow.scale = Vector3(s, s, s)
		if _ground:
			_ground.scale = Vector3.ONE * (1.0 + sin(_t * 1.7) * 0.05)
		return
	cooldown_timer -= delta
	if cooldown_timer <= 0:
		available = true
		_set_orb_visible(true)
		col.disabled = false
		ring_green.visible = false
	else:
		var progress = 1.0 - (cooldown_timer / respawn_time)
		_draw_green_arc(progress)

func _draw_green_arc(progress: float):
	var st = SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	var segments = 64
	var angle_from = -PI / 2
	var angle_to = -PI / 2 + 2 * PI * progress
	var inner_r = 0.9
	var outer_r = 1.0
	var y = 0.3

	for i in range(segments):
		var a1 = angle_from + (angle_to - angle_from) * i / segments
		var a2 = angle_from + (angle_to - angle_from) * (i + 1) / segments
		var p1 = Vector3(cos(a1) * inner_r, y, sin(a1) * inner_r)
		var p2 = Vector3(cos(a2) * inner_r, y, sin(a2) * inner_r)
		var p3 = Vector3(cos(a1) * outer_r, y, sin(a1) * outer_r)
		var p4 = Vector3(cos(a2) * outer_r, y, sin(a2) * outer_r)
		st.add_vertex(p1); st.add_vertex(p2); st.add_vertex(p3)
		st.add_vertex(p2); st.add_vertex(p4); st.add_vertex(p3)

	st.generate_normals()
	var green_mat = StandardMaterial3D.new()
	green_mat.albedo_color = Color(0.25, 1.0, 0.5, 0.85)
	green_mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	green_mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	green_mat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	st.set_material(green_mat)
	ring_green.mesh = st.commit()
	ring_green.visible = true

func _on_body_entered(body):
	if body is Hero and available:
		var level = body.level
		var heal_hp = 200 + 12 * level
		var heal_mp = 16 + 4 * level
		body.apply_regen(heal_hp, heal_mp, 5.0, "health_pack")
		SfxManager.try_heal_sfx(body.display_name)
		available = false
		_set_orb_visible(false)
		col.disabled = true
		cooldown_timer = respawn_time

	queue_free()

func _process(delta):
	_t += delta

		var bob: float = sin(_t * 2.1) * 0.055
		if mesh: mesh.position.y = 0.62 + bob
		if _glow: _glow.position.y = 0.62 + bob * 0.7
		if _cross_h: _cross_h.position.y = 0.62 + bob
		if _cross_v: _cross_v.position.y = 0.62 + bob
		if _cross_v: _cross_v.rotation.y = _t * 1.1
		if _glow:
			var s: float = 1.0 + sin(_t * 2.6) * 0.07
			_glow.scale = Vector3(s, s, s)

			_ground.scale = Vector3.ONE * (1.0 + sin(_t * 1.7) * 0.05)
		return

		available = true

		ring_green.visible = false

		var progress = 1.0 - (cooldown_timer / respawn_time)

func _draw_green_arc(progress: float):
	var st = SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	var segments = 64
	var angle_from = -PI / 2
	var angle_to = -PI / 2 + 2 * PI * progress
	var inner_r = 0.9
	var outer_r = 1.0
	var y = 0.3

	for i in range(segments):
		var a1 = angle_from + (angle_to - angle_from) * i / segments
		var a2 = angle_from + (angle_to - angle_from) * (i + 1) / segments
		var p1 = Vector3(cos(a1) * inner_r, y, sin(a1) * inner_r)
		var p2 = Vector3(cos(a2) * inner_r, y, sin(a2) * inner_r)
		var p3 = Vector3(cos(a1) * outer_r, y, sin(a1) * outer_r)
		var p4 = Vector3(cos(a2) * outer_r, y, sin(a2) * outer_r)
		st.add_vertex(p1); st.add_vertex(p2); st.add_vertex(p3)
		st.add_vertex(p2); st.add_vertex(p4); st.add_vertex(p3)

	st.generate_normals()
	var green_mat = StandardMaterial3D.new()
	green_mat.albedo_color = Color(0.25, 1.0, 0.5, 0.85)
	green_mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	green_mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	green_mat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	st.set_material(green_mat)
	ring_green.mesh = st.commit()
	ring_green.visible = true

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

{"file_path": "C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\entities\HealthPack.gd", "content": "class_name HealthPack
extends Area3D

## 血包（真实 3D 模型）：石台 + 悬浮发光药球 + 十字光标 + 地面光斑 + 上浮粒子，
## 并保留原有「灰色外环 + 绿色回复进度弧」与全部逻辑字段/行为。
var team: int = 0
var respawn_time: float = 75.0
var cooldown_timer: float = 0.0
var available: bool = true
var turret: Turret = null
var col: CollisionShape3D
var ring_grey: MeshInstance3D
var ring_green: MeshInstance3D
var mesh: MeshInstance3D          # 药球（可用性切换沿用此字段）

var _glow: MeshInstance3D         # 外层光晕
var _cross_h: MeshInstance3D      # 十字横
var _cross_v: MeshInstance3D      # 十字竖
var _ground: MeshInstance3D       # 地面光斑
var _spark: CPUParticles3D        # 上浮粒子
var _t: float = 0.0               # 本地动画时钟

func _ready():
	add_to_group("health_packs")
	_create_visual()
	body_entered.connect(_on_body_entered)

func _create_visual():
	# —— 石台（粗糙暗石，让血包"落在"地上而不是浮空）——
	var ped := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var pm := CylinderMesh.new()
	pm.top_radius = 0.52
	pm.bottom_radius = 0.66
	pm.height = 0.14
	pm.radial_segments = 16
	ped.mesh = pm
	ped.position.y = 0.07
	ped.material_override = _mat(Color(0.26, 0.25, 0.23), 0.95, 0.0)
	add_child(ped)
	# 石台顶面暗色内凹
	var inlay := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var im := CylinderMesh.new()
	im.top_radius = 0.40
	im.bottom_radius = 0.42
	im.height = 0.02
	im.radial_segments = 16
	inlay.mesh = im
	inlay.position.y = 0.145
	inlay.material_override = _mat(Color(0.13, 0.20, 0.14), 0.9, 0.0)
	add_child(inlay)

	# —— 药球（自发绿光，核心很亮）——
	mesh = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var sm := SphereMesh.new()
	sm.radius = 0.24
	sm.height = 0.48
	sm.radial_segments = 24
	sm.rings = 12
	mesh.mesh = sm
	mesh.position.y = 0.62
	mesh.material_override = _glow_mat(Color(0.16, 0.95, 0.42), 2.4, 0.85)
	add_child(mesh)

	# —— 外层柔光晕（加色混合）——
	_glow = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var gm := SphereMesh.new()
	gm.radius = 0.42
	gm.height = 0.84
	gm.radial_segments = 20
	gm.rings = 10
	_glow.mesh = gm
	_glow.position.y = 0.62
	var gmat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	gmat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	gmat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	gmat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	gmat.albedo_color = Color(0.25, 1.0, 0.55, 0.16)
	gmat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	_glow.material_override = gmat
	add_child(_glow)

	# —— 十字光标（药性标识）——
	_cross_h = _make_cross_bar(Vector3(0.52, 0.10, 0.10))
	_cross_v = _make_cross_bar(Vector3(0.10, 0.52, 0.10))
	add_child(_cross_h)
	add_child(_cross_v)

	# —— 地面光斑（远景也能看出这里有补给）——
	_ground = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var qm := QuadMesh.new()
	qm.size = Vector2(2.4, 2.4)
	_ground.mesh = qm
	_ground.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-90, 0, 0)
	_ground.position.y = 0.03
	var qmat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	qmat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	qmat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	qmat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	qmat.albedo_color = Color(0.18, 0.85, 0.36, 0.13)
	qmat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	_ground.material_override = qmat
	add_child(_ground)

	# —— 上浮微粒 ——
	_spark = CPUParticles3D.new()
	_spark.amount = 12
	_spark.lifetime = 1.6
	_spark.position.y = 0.35
	_spark.emission_shape = CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE
	_spark.emission_sphere_radius = 0.28
	_spark.direction = Vector3(0, 1, 0)
	_spark.spread = 18.0
	_spark.initial_velocity_min = 0.18
	_spark.initial_velocity_max = 0.42
	_spark.gravity = Vector3(0, 0.35, 0)
	_spark.scale_amount_min = 0.02
	_spark.scale_amount_max = 0.045
	_spark.color = Color(0.55, 1.0, 0.68, 0.85)
	add_child(_spark)

	# —— 灰色底座圆环（原表现保留，压暗更像石刻）——
	ring_grey = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var torus_grey = TorusMesh.new()
	torus_grey.inner_radius = 0.9
	torus_grey.outer_radius = 1.0
	torus_grey.rings = 64
	ring_grey.mesh = torus_grey
	var mat_grey = StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat_grey.albedo_color = Color(0.42, 0.44, 0.46, 0.9)
	mat_grey.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	ring_grey.material_override = mat_grey
	add_child(ring_grey)

	# —— 绿色回复进度弧（动态生成，逻辑不变）——
	ring_green = MeshInstance3D.new()
	add_child(ring_green)

	# 碰撞体
	col = CollisionShape3D.new()
	col.shape = SphereShape3D.new()
	col.shape.radius = 0.5
	add_child(col)

func _make_cross_bar(size: Vector3) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var bar := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var bm := BoxMesh.new()
	bm.size = size
	bar.mesh = bm
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(0.85, 1.0, 0.9, 0.92)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.6)
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.6
	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	m.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	bar.material_override = m
	bar.position.y = 0.62
	return bar

func _mat(c: Color, rough: float, metal: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = c
	m.roughness = rough
	m.metallic = metal
	return m

func _glow_mat(c: Color, energy: float, alpha: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(c.r, c.g, c.b, alpha)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = c
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = energy
	m.roughness = 0.12
	m.metallic = 0.05
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	return m

func _set_orb_visible(v: bool) -> void:
	if mesh: mesh.visible = v
	if _glow: _glow.visible = v
	if _cross_h: _cross_h.visible = v
	if _cross_v: _cross_v.visible = v
	if _ground: _ground.visible = v
	if _spark: _spark.emitting = v

func _process(delta):
	_t += delta
	if available:
		# 悬浮上下 + 光晕呼吸 + 十字缓慢旋转
		var bob: float = sin(_t * 2.1) * 0.055
		if mesh: mesh.position.y = 0.62 + bob
		if _glow: _glow.position.y = 0.62 + bob * 0.7
		if _cross_h: _cross_h.position.y = 0.62 + bob
		if _cross_v:
			_cross_v.position.y = 0.62 + bob
			_cross_v.rotation.y = _t * 1.1
		if _glow:
			var s: float = 1.0 + sin(_t * 2.6) * 0.07
			_glow.scale = Vector3(s, s, s)
		if _ground:
			_ground.scale = Vector3.ONE * (1.0 + sin(_t * 1.7) * 0.05)
		return
	cooldown_timer -= delta
	if cooldown_timer <= 0:
		available = true
		_set_orb_visible(true)
		col.disabled = false
		ring_green.visible = false
	else:

	var st = SurfaceTool.new()

	var outer_r = 1.0

	green_mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA

```gdscript
static func decorate_wall(wall: Node3D) -> void:
	if wall == null or not is_instance_valid(wall): return
	var seed_num: int = int(absf(wall.position.x) * 10.0) + int(absf(wall.position.z) * 10.0) * 7
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()

		rock.position = Vector3(cos(a) * d, sm.radius * 0.4, sin(a) * d)
		rock.rotation = Vector3(rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU), rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU), rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU))
		rock.material_override = _mat(Color(0.30, 0.29, 0.26), 0.95)

static func decorate_bush(bush_parent: Node3D, model: Node3D, phase: float) -> void:
	if bush_parent == null or not is_instance_valid(bush_parent): return
	# 地面苔藓盘
	var disc := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var cm := CylinderMesh.new()
	cm.top_radius = 1.15
	cm.bottom_radius = 1.25
	cm.height = 0.05
	cm.radial_segments = 14
	disc.mesh = cm
	disc.position.y = 0.025
	disc.material_override = _mat(Color(0.10, 0.20, 0.10), 1.0)
	bush_parent.add_child(disc)
	if model != null and is_instance_valid(model):
		# 额外一小簇草（打散轮廓，避免一株一株的"整齐感"）
		var extra = model.duplicate()
		if extra is Node3D:
			var e3: Node3D = extra
			e3.scale = model.scale * Vector3(0.62, 0.52, 0.62)
			e3.rotation.y = model.rotation.y + 0.9
			e3.position = Vector3(0.55, 0.0, -0.4)

		# 风摆（只摆模型，不动 Area3D 判定）

		sway.phase = phase
		bush_parent.add_child(sway)

	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()

	m.roughness = rough
	return m
```

- wall: root node with wall_model child; decorate root with wall_model = root.get_child(0).

Add these calls.

理解错了，之前那轮改的是小地图图标。这次改的是**世界里的真实 3D 模型**。

## 1. 血包（[HealthPack.gd](scripts/entities/HealthPack.gd)，重写视觉层）— 原来是一个纯绿色小球
现在是完整补给台：
- **石台**：上 0.52 / 下 0.66 半径的圆柱（高 0.14，粗糙度 0.95）+ 顶面暗绿内凹环
- **药球**：半径 0.24 的自发光绿球（`emission_energy 2.4`）
- **外层光晕**：半径 0.42 球体，`BLEND_MODE_ADD` + 无光照（alpha 0.16），做柔光溢出
- **十字光标**：两根发光 Box（横 0.52×0.1、竖 0.1×0.52），无光照+自发光，竖条缓慢自转
- **地面光斑**：2.4×2.4 加色 Quad 贴地（alpha 0.13），远处也能看出这里有补给
- **上浮微粒**：`CPUParticles3D` 12 颗绿色光点，球面发射、向上飘 1.6s
- **动画**：药球 ±0.055 上下悬浮（2.1Hz）、光晕呼吸缩放 ±7%、地面光斑 ±5%、十字旋转
- 原有行为全部保留：灰环、绿色回复进度弧、碰撞半径、`available/respawn_time`、拾取逻辑

## 2. 墙体（[Wall.gd](scripts/entities/Wall.gd) + [WorldDecor.gd](scripts/entities/WorldDecor.gd)）
在 wall.glb 基础上加程序化细节，破掉“一根柱子立在地面上”的塑料感：
- **基底苔藓/土地盘**（半径 1.15，高 0.06，深苔绿）
- **3 块随机碎石**：低面球（6 段 3 环）半径 0.10–0.18，绕基座 0.35–0.72 距离散布，三轴随机朝向，灰棕色
- 随机值由**坐标哈希**决定 → 镜像对称不破坏，且每次开局一致（不会闪烁）

## 3. 草丛（[Bush.gd](scripts/entities/Bush.gd) + [WorldDecor.gd](scripts/entities/WorldDecor.gd) + [BushSway.gd](scripts/entities/BushSway.gd)）
- **地面苔藓盘**（半径 1.25，深绿）→ 草丛“长在土上”
- **额外一小簇草**：复制 grass-large 模型，0.62/0.52 缩放、错位 (0.55, -0.4)、额外转 0.9rad → 轮廓更蓬松
- **风摆**：新增 `BushSway` 节点，绕根部 `z` 轴 ±0.035rad、`x` 轴 ±0.021rad 双频摆动（只转视觉模型，**不影响 Area3D 区域判定**）

## 4. 双端一致
- 主机：`Bush._ready` / `Wall._ready` 里调用装饰

已修复。

## 报错原因
`assets/SkillDataBase.gd:3003`（元流之子 R：弩箭齐发）用了 `hero.actual_attack_speed`，但 **Hero/GameEntity 里没有这个属性**。
实体上的攻速字段叫 `attack_speed`（单位：次/秒，`GameEntity.gd:14`，由 Hero 在属性重算时 `attack_speed = 1.0 / interval` 写入），所以你看到的 `Invalid access to property 'actual_attack_speed'`。

## 修改
```gdscript
# 修改前
var interval = 0.3/hero.actual_attack_speed
# 修改后（SkillDataBase.gd:3003）
var interval: float = 0.3 / maxf(hero.attack_speed, 0.2)
```
- 用 `attack_speed`（次/秒）→ 间隔 `0.3 / 攻速`：攻速 1.0 时 0.3s，攻速 2.0 时 0.15s，符合“攻速越快出箭越密”的设计
- `maxf(..., 0.2)` 兜底，防止攻速异常为 0 时 `interval` 变成无穷大、`create_timer` 卡死
- 显式 `: float` 标注，避免项目 warnings-as-errors 触发 Variant 推断告警

## 验证
- `SkillDataBase.gd`、`Hero.gd` 解析通过（`F ... =true`），全仓已无 `actual_attack_speed` 引用
- 后续逻辑未变：`await ... create_timer(interval)`、7/10/13 支箭、每 3 支视作 1 次普攻（`pid` 0/-61）逻辑都保持原样
- 已清理探针与 `.cache`

> 顺带确认：该函数里其它属性/方法都存在 —— `actual_attack_damage`、`yuanliu_flow`、`apply_move_pct_buff`（定义在 `GameEntity.gd:197`）、`health`、`get_tree()` 均正常，`actual_attack_speed` 是唯一的拼错字段。

{"command": "$p=(Resolve-Path 'scripts\ui\MinimapDraw.gd'); $t=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$add = @'

# ---------- 野怪 / 史诗野怪 ----------

## 野怪标记：普通营地小点 / 红蓝 buff 带环 / 空间之灵菱形 / 暴君·主宰专属图标
## seen=false 表示"我方无视野的默认显示"（压暗，不消失）
static func draw_jungle(ci: CanvasItem, pos: Vector2, kind: String, seen: bool = true) -> void:
	if kind in ["tyrant", "shadow_tyrant", "dragon", "shadow_dragon", "storm_dragon"]:
		_draw_epic(ci, pos, kind, seen)
		return
	var a: float = 1.0 if seen else 0.55
	match kind:
		"red_buff":
			ci.draw_circle(pos, 3.4, Color(0.92, 0.35, 0.28, a))
			ci.draw_arc(pos, 3.4, 0, TAU, 16, Color(0.45, 0.12, 0.10, a), 1.0)
			ci.draw_circle(pos, 1.2, Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.55, a))
		"blue_buff":
			ci.draw_circle(pos, 3.4, Color(0.35, 0.55, 0.98, a))
			ci.draw_arc(pos, 3.4, 0, TAU, 16, Color(0.12, 0.20, 0.48, a), 1.0)
			ci.draw_circle(pos, 1.2, Color(0.75, 0.88, 1.0, a))
		"spatial_spirit", "river_spirit":
			var d := PackedVector2Array([pos + Vector2(0, -3.6), pos + Vector2(3.2, 0), pos + Vector2(0, 3.6), pos + Vector2(-3.2, 0)])
			ci.draw_colored_polygon(d, Color(0.35, 0.85, 0.85, a))
			ci.draw_polyline(d + PackedVector2Array([d[0]]), Color(0.10, 0.28, 0.30, a), 1.0)
		_:
			ci.draw_circle(pos, 2.6, Color(0.62, 0.72, 0.55, a))
			ci.draw_arc(pos, 2.6, 0, TAU, 12, Color(0.12, 0.16, 0.10, a), 1.0)

## 暴君 / 主宰 / 风暴龙王：大号专属图标（外光环 + 双角 + 内芯）
static func _draw_epic(ci: CanvasItem, pos: Vector2, kind: String, seen: bool) -> void:
	var a: float = 1.0 if seen else 0.6
	var body := Color(0.95, 0.45, 0.25, a)          # 暴君：橙红
	var ring := Color(1.0, 0.70, 0.35, a)
	if kind == "shadow_tyrant":
		body = Color(0.60, 0.32, 0.88, a)
		ring = Color(0.80, 0.62, 1.0, a)
	elif kind == "dragon":
		body = Color(0.35, 0.75, 0.95, a)
		ring = Color(0.70, 0.92, 1.0, a)
	elif kind == "shadow_dragon":
		body = Color(0.52, 0.45, 1.0, a)
		ring = Color(0.78, 0.74, 1.0, a)
	elif kind == "storm_dragon":
		body = Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.28, a)
		ring = Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.60, a)
	# 外光环
	ci.draw_circle(pos, 11.0, Color(body.r, body.g, body.b, 0.10 * a))
	ci.draw_arc(pos, 8.4, 0, TAU, 24, Color(ring.r, ring.g, ring.b, 0.55 * a), 1.6)
	# 双角（上挑三角）
	var horn := PackedVector2Array([pos + Vector2(-5.2, -3.4), pos + Vector2(-2.0, -8.2), pos + Vector2(-0.6, -3.0)])
	var horn2 := PackedVector2Array([pos + Vector2(5.2, -3.4), pos + Vector2(2.0, -8.2), pos + Vector2(0.6, -3.0)])
	ci.draw_colored_polygon(horn, ring)
	ci.draw_colored_polygon(horn2, ring)
	# 头颅主体
	ci.draw_circle(pos + Vector2(0, 1.2), 5.2, body)
	ci.draw_arc(pos + Vector2(0, 1.2), 5.2, 0, TAU, 20, Color(0.05, 0.05, 0.08, a), 1.2)
	# 眼/核心
	ci.draw_circle(pos + Vector2(-1.9, 0.4), 1.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.95 * a))
	ci.draw_circle(pos + Vector2(1.9, 0.4), 1.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.95 * a))
	if kind == "storm_dragon":
		# 风暴龙王：闪电折线
		ci.draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([pos + Vector2(3.0, -6.0), pos + Vector2(0.8, -1.6), pos + Vector2(3.4, -1.2), pos + Vector2(1.2, 4.2)]), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8 * a), 1.4)
'@
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t + $add)
"ok=" + (Get-Content $p).Count", "description": "Add jungle and epic monster drawing"}

## 野怪标记：普通营地小点 / 红蓝 buff 带环 / 空间之灵菱形 / 暴君·主宰专属图标
## seen=false 表示"我方无视野的默认显示"（压暗，不消失）
static func draw_jungle(ci: CanvasItem, pos: Vector2, kind: String, seen: bool = true) -> void:
	if kind in ["tyrant", "shadow_tyrant", "dragon", "shadow_dragon", "storm_dragon"]:
		_draw_epic(ci, pos, kind, seen)
		return
	var a: float = 1.0 if seen else 0.55
	match kind:
		"red_buff":
			ci.draw_circle(pos, 3.4, Color(0.92, 0.35, 0.28, a))
			ci.draw_arc(pos, 3.4, 0, TAU, 16, Color(0.45, 0.12, 0.10, a), 1.0)
			ci.draw_circle(pos, 1.2, Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.55, a))
		"blue_buff":
			ci.draw_circle(pos, 3.4, Color(0.35, 0.55, 0.98, a))
			ci.draw_arc(pos, 3.4, 0, TAU, 16, Color(0.12, 0.20, 0.48, a), 1.0)
			ci.draw_circle(pos, 1.2, Color(0.75, 0.88, 1.0, a))
		"spatial_spirit", "river_spirit":
			var d := PackedVector2Array([pos + Vector2(0, -3.6), pos + Vector2(3.2, 0), pos + Vector2(0, 3.6), pos + Vector2(-3.2, 0)])
			ci.draw_colored_polygon(d, Color(0.35, 0.85, 0.85, a))
			ci.draw_polyline(d + PackedVector2Array([d[0]]), Color(0.10, 0.28, 0.30, a), 1.0)
		_:
			ci.draw_circle(pos, 2.6, Color(0.62, 0.72, 0.55, a))
			ci.draw_arc(pos, 2.6, 0, TAU, 12, Color(0.12, 0.16, 0.10, a), 1.0)

## 暴君 / 主宰 / 风暴龙王：大号专属图标（外光环 + 双角 + 内芯）
static func _draw_epic(ci: CanvasItem, pos: Vector2, kind: String, seen: bool) -> void:
	var a: float = 1.0 if seen else 0.6
	var body := Color(0.95, 0.45, 0.25, a)          # 暴君：橙红
	var ring := Color(1.0, 0.70, 0.35, a)
	if kind == "shadow_tyrant":
		body = Color(0.60, 0.32, 0.88, a)
		ring = Color(0.80, 0.62, 1.0, a)
	elif kind == "dragon":
		body = Color(0.35, 0.75, 0.95, a)
		ring = Color(0.70, 0.92, 1.0, a)
	elif kind == "shadow_dragon":
		body = Color(0.52, 0.45, 1.0, a)
		ring = Color(0.78, 0.74, 1.0, a)
	elif kind == "storm_dragon":
		body = Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.28, a)
		ring = Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.60, a)
	# 外光环
	ci.draw_circle(pos, 11.0, Color(body.r, body.g, body.b, 0.10 * a))
	ci.draw_arc(pos, 8.4, 0, TAU, 24, Color(ring.r, ring.g, ring.b, 0.55 * a), 1.6)
	# 双角（上挑三角）
	var horn := PackedVector2Array([pos + Vector2(-5.2, -3.4), pos + Vector2(-2.0, -8.2), pos + Vector2(-0.6, -3.0)])
	var horn2 := PackedVector2Array([pos + Vector2(5.2, -3.4), pos + Vector2(2.0, -8.2), pos + Vector2(0.6, -3.0)])
	ci.draw_colored_polygon(horn, ring)
	ci.draw_colored_polygon(horn2, ring)
	# 头颅主体
	ci.draw_circle(pos + Vector2(0, 1.2), 5.2, body)
	ci.draw_arc(pos + Vector2(0, 1.2), 5.2, 0, TAU, 20, Color(0.05, 0.05, 0.08, a), 1.2)
	# 眼/核心
	ci.draw_circle(pos + Vector2(-1.9, 0.4), 1.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.95 * a))
	ci.draw_circle(pos + Vector2(1.9, 0.4), 1.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.95 * a))
	if kind == "storm_dragon":
		# 风暴龙王：闪电折线
		ci.draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([pos + Vector2(3.0, -6.0), pos + Vector2(0.8, -1.6), pos + Vector2(3.4, -1.2), pos + Vector2(1.2, 4.2)]), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8 * a), 1.4)
'@

data.name: pwsh

content.text: windowed clean (300 frames)

All good. But I want more confidence on two things:
1. Turret/crystal now get tower_type — the root cause fix. Could I verify by running the actual match? The battle scene requires hero select UI interaction. Maybe there's a debug/auto-start flag? Check for command-line args in BattleManager (NetSession had args; maybe BattleManager supports `--auto`?). Earlier NetSession comment: "命令行参数（放在 -- 之后）". Not for battle auto-start.

Alternative verification: simulate `_create_turrets` partially by instantiating Turret and checking our assignment is in the file (already). Fine.

2. Jungle memory logic: verify at runtime with a probe that constructs Minimap + fake monsters? Minimap expects nodes with visible/health/display_name/respawn_time/get_instance_id/global_position — can use real JungleMonster created via `JungleMonster.new()`? It might require setup. Simpler test: run a probe creating Minimap node, fake monsters as Node3D with script? Minimap calls j.visible (Node3D has), j.health (missing), j.display_name, j.respawn_time. Could create actual JungleMonster via its class and set fields: `var j = JungleMonster.new()`; set display_name, respawn_time, health, visible; add to tree; then call minimap._update_jungle_memory manually and inspect `_jg_dead`. JungleMonster._ready may require setup? It may build visuals referencing model path; probably ok but risky.

Rather than over-verify, accept; logic is simple. But one bug risk: `_update_jungle_memory` uses `j.visible and j.health > 0.0` — for host monsters, `visible` might be false for monsters outside current camera? No, visible is node visibility flag, not camera cull.

Another risk: host "我方有视野" for enemy jungle monsters: with hero 18 units, we set `_jg_seen`. OK.

Potential issue: when we have vision and it dies, `_jg_dead` set. But if never seen, `_jg_dead` not set → monster drawn as ghost (since alive false → visible false → `seen=false` → dim ghost) — matches requirement "默认显示". ✓

But hmm: after respawn (revive), visible true → erased ✓.

3. The user also said turret/crystal "并没有改过来" — maybe they also mean the *look* isn't good enough? We fixed data issue; after fix crystal=hexagon. Good.

Let me also double-check there's no second place creating turrets (e.g., lane turret spawning later?) — `_create_turrets` only.

Additionally check `Turret.setup` doesn't set tower_type from config["name"] (we now set explicitly after setup) ✓.

Cleanup & notify & report. Report should explain:
- Root cause: tower_type never assigned → all turrets "outer" so minimap drew same square; crystal never hexagon. Fixed assignment in both teams.
- Enemy jungle visibility rules implemented (default show dim; remembered respawn).
- Epic monster drawing: dedicated icons.
- Net payload additions (obj earlier, now jg) for client parity.
- Verification results.

Also mention tunables.

Cleanup now.

小地图上防御塔和水晶没改过来，查到了真正原因。

## 1. 防御塔/水晶没变化 —— 根因：`tower_type` 从未被赋值
`BattleManager._create_turrets()` 建塔时只 `t.setup(config)`，而 `Turret.setup()` 不会写 `tower_type` → **全部塔（包括水晶）都是默认值 `"outer"`**，所以小地图上永远画方塔，水晶的六边形永远不会出现（还连带 `HeroAI` 的「高地塔」判断失效）。

修复（[BattleManager.gd](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd)）：玩家/敌方两个建塔循环各加一行
```gdscript
t.tower_type = str(data["type"])   # outer / inner / high / crystal
```
现在小地图：外塔=城墙垛方塔、内塔=带护角方塔、高地=菱形城基、水晶=六边形宝石（含切面高光与光晕）；联机快照里 `tower_type` 也随之正确下发。

## 2. 敌方野区野怪的显示规则（按你的要求实现）
状态机在 [Minimap.gd](scripts/ui/Minimap.gd) `_update_jungle_memory()`：
- **默认显示**：没有视野时也画，只是压暗（透明度 0.55）——区分「没视野」与「确实没人」
- **只有确认击杀才隐藏**：野怪死亡瞬间，若我方英雄/小兵/塔在 18/9/16 单位内有视野（死亡前 1.5s 内看见过），就把 `复活完成时间 = 当前 + respawn_time` 记进 `_jg_dead`，**复活期间小地图该野怪不显示**
- 复活后自动清除记忆，重新显示
- 野怪点位带类型：红 buff 红环、蓝 buff 蓝环、空间/河道之灵青色菱形、普通营地绿灰小点
- 联机同步：`NetSession` own 块新增 `"jg": jg_dead_list()`，客户端 `NetMiniMap` 用 `payload.camps` 画幽灵点位、用 `own.jg` 排除已知复活中的营地

## 3. 暴君/主宰绘制优化（[MinimapDraw.draw_jungle](scripts/ui/MinimapDraw.gd)）
史诗野怪不再是黄点，改为**专属大图标**（半径 ~11px，含外光环）：
| 类型 | 配色 | 特征 |
|---|---|---|
| 暴君 tyrant | 橙红 + 橙金环 | 双角 + 双眼内核 |
| 暗影暴君 shadow_tyrant | 紫 + 淡紫环 | 同上 |
| 主宰 dragon | 青蓝 + 冰蓝环 | 同上 |
| 暗影主宰 shadow_dragon | 蓝紫 + 淡紫环 | 同上 |
| 风暴龙王 storm_dragon | 金 + 亮金环 | 额外一道白色闪电折线 |

无视野时整体按 0.6 压暗；配合左下角「暴君 03:12 / 主宰 已刷新」倒计时一起看。

## 验证
- 6 个脚本解析通过：`MinimapDraw / Minimap / NetMiniMap / NetSession / NetClientBattle / BattleManager`
- 绘制探针（真实渲染，反复画 5 种野怪 + 水晶 + 高地塔）：`J drawn=5`，**无 draw_/Invalid 报错**
- `battle.tscn` 窗口化真实运行 **300 帧 clean**
- 已清理探针与 `.cache`

## 可调参数
| 参数 | 位置 | 当前值 |
|---|---|---|
| 视野半径 | `Minimap._has_vision_of` | 英雄 18 / 小兵 9 / 塔 16 |
| 死亡确认窗口 | `_update_jungle_memory` | 1.5s |
| 无视野压暗 | `MinimapDraw.draw_jungle` | 普通 0.55 / 史诗 0.6 |
| 史诗图标 | `draw_jungle._draw_epic` | 主体 r5.2、光环 r8.4、外光 r11 |
| 客户端幽灵判定 | `NetMiniMap` | 营地 3px 内视为有实体、4px 内视为确认复活 |

> 另外：`tower_type` 修好后，`HeroAI` 里依赖「高地塔/high」的分支也会开始真正生效（之前一直是死代码）。

```gdscript
func _recall_vfx_start() -> void:
	_recall_vfx_stop()
	var col: Color = Color(0.35, 0.75, 1.0) if team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.35)
	# 地面法阵环（双环）
	_recall_vfx_ring = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var tm := TorusMesh.new()
	tm.inner_radius = 1.05
	tm.outer_radius = 1.35
	tm.rings = 32
	_recall_vfx_ring.mesh = tm
	_recall_vfx_ring.position.y = 0.06
	var rm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	rm.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	rm.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	rm.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	rm.albedo_color = Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, 0.55)
	rm.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	_recall_vfx_ring.material_override = rm
	add_child(_recall_vfx_ring)
	# 光柱
	_recall_vfx_pillar = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var cm := CylinderMesh.new()
	cm.top_radius = 1.15
	cm.bottom_radius = 1.35
	cm.height = 6.0
	cm.radial_segments = 24
	cm.cap_top = false
	cm.cap_bottom = false
	_recall_vfx_pillar.mesh = cm
	_recall_vfx_pillar.position.y = 3.0
	var pm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	pm.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	pm.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	pm.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	pm.albedo_color = Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, 0.12)
	pm.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	_recall_vfx_pillar.material_override = pm
	add_child(_recall_vfx_pillar)
	# 上升粒子
	_recall_vfx_spark = CPUParticles3D.new()
	... amount 18, lifetime 1.3, sphere emission r 1.0, direction UP, gravity small, color col
	add_child(_recall_vfx_spark)
	_recall_vfx_t = 0.0
```

```gdscript
func _recall_vfx_tick(delta: float) -> void:
	if _recall_vfx_ring == null: return
	_recall_vfx_t += delta
	var k: float = clampf(1.0 - recall_timer / RECALL_DURATION, 0.0, 1.0)   # 进度 0→1
```

lines.text: ## 移动端普攻轮盘（王者荣耀式）：
## - 按住持续普攻（is_held，由 Hero 读取）
## - 拖动进入选敌瞄准：画出方向指示，外部据此精准锁定目标
## - 松手：final_drag=松手时的拖拽向量；cancelled=「拖出又拖回按钮」→ 取消选敌
## - 点按（未拖出）不改变目标锁定，仅普攻当前目标
# 王者荣耀式松手选敌：final_drag=松手时的拖拽向量；cancelled=「拖出又拖回按钮」→ 取消选敌
const TAP_THRESHOLD := 30.0      # 超过此拖拽距离才算“拖出去”（进入选敌）
const CANCEL_RADIUS := 40.0      # 松手位置距按下起点小于此值且拖出去过 → 视为拖回按钮，取消
# 普攻键上的数值说明：普攻伤害 + 攻击速度（每次/秒），由 TouchController 每帧推送
# 强化普攻就绪（数值类强化/跳跃类强化）：伤害数值显示强化后数值，文字与外圈转金色
# 装备被动影响普攻的小字行（小图标+装备短名+实时效果数值），每帧由 TouchController 推送
func set_battle_stats(dmg: int, speed_per_sec: float, is_enhanced: bool = false):
if dmg == show_damage and absf(speed_per_sec - show_speed) < 0.001 and is_enhanced == enhanced:
# 装备被动小字行内容更新：内容未变化（数值/就绪状态均同）则不重绘，避免每帧闪烁
sig += str(d.get("k", "")) + "|" + str(d.get("name", "")) + "|" + str(d.get("txt", "")) + "|" + str(d.get("armed", true)) + "\n"
var _origin := Vector2.ZERO      # 按下起点（局部坐标）
var _drag := Vector2.ZERO        # 当前拖拽偏移
var _max_drag := 0.0             # 本次手势的最大拖拽距离
var cancelled: bool = _max_drag > TAP_THRESHOLD and final_drag.length() < CANCEL_RADIUS
elif event is InputEventMouseButton or event is InputEventMouseMotion:
# 移动端 emulate_mouse_from_touch 会产生合成鼠标事件，吞掉防止漏到世界输入
var base_col := color if _active else color.darkened(0.25)
# 外圈：强化普攻就绪时外圈与伤害数字转金色（数值也已切换为强化后伤害）
var ring_col := Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.3) if enhanced else base_col.lightened(0.3)
draw_arc(center, radius + 3, 0, TAU, 32, ring_col, ring_w, true)
# 主体（P0 统一玻璃底：与面板同色系）
draw_string(UiKit.font(), Vector2(center.x - radius, center.y - fs * 0.35), label_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, radius * 2.0, fs, Color.WHITE)
# 普攻键数值说明：中心文字下方两行小字（强化=金色/普通=白色，攻速青色）
var dmg_col := Color(1.0, 0.88, 0.35, 1.0) if enhanced else Color(0.93, 0.93, 0.93, 0.92)
"伤害 %d" % show_damage, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, radius * 2.0, fs2, dmg_col)
"攻速 %.2f/秒" % show_speed, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, radius * 2.0, fs2, Color(0.55, 0.9, 1.0, 0.95))
# 装备被动对普攻的影响：攻速行下方的小字行（每件生效装一行）
# 拖动选敌：方向指示线 + 摇杆头样式小圆（像移动轮盘一样）
# ---------------- 装备被动小字行绘制（攻速行下方，逐行 图标+装备短名+效果小字） ----------------
# 攻速行最后一行基线之下 6px 开始，向下最多到圆内 0.96 半径处
# 先按竖直高度估字号（每行 ~1.5 倍字号），再按最宽行宽度收缩；下限 8
var eff_col := col if armed else Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, 0.45)
var name_col := Color(1, 1, 1, 0.92) if armed else Color(1, 1, 1, 0.5)
_draw_mini_glyph(String(d.get("k", "phys")), Vector2(x + ic * 0.5, row_top + fs_i * 0.55), ic * 0.5, eff_col)
draw_string(fname, Vector2(tx, base_y), name, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, nw, fs_i, name_col)
draw_string(fname, Vector2(tx, base_y), txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, tw, fs_i, eff_col)
# 行首小图标：仅用矢量基本形状，与 _draw_fx_glyph 同一风格
func _draw_mini_glyph(kind: String, pc: Vector2, r: float, col: Color):
var rr := r if i % 2 == 0 else r * 0.35
draw_arc(pc, r, 0, TAU, 16, col, lw, true)
draw_line(pc + Vector2(-r * 0.4, 0), pc + Vector2(r * 0.4, 0), col, lw)
draw_line(pc + Vector2(0, -r * 0.4), pc + Vector2(0, r * 0.4), col, lw)
draw_arc(pc, r, 0, TAU, 16, col, lw, true)
draw_line(pc, pc + Vector2(r * 0.35, r * 0.05), col, lw * 0.9)
var pts := PackedVector2Array([pc + Vector2(0, -r), pc + Vector2(r * 0.75, r * 0.15), pc + Vector2(0, r), pc + Vector2(-r * 0.75, r * 0.15)])
var pts := PackedVector2Array([pc + Vector2(-r * 0.26, -r * 0.9), pc + Vector2(r * 0.26, -r * 0.9), pc + Vector2(r * 0.26, r * 0.6), pc + Vector2(-r * 0.26, r * 0.6)])
draw_line(pc + Vector2(-r * 0.6, r * 0.15), pc + Vector2(r * 0.6, r * 0.15), col, lw)
draw_line(pc + Vector2(-r * 0.18, r * 0.85), pc + Vector2(r * 0.18, r * 0.85), col, lw)

# ---------- 回城动画（程序化 VFX，无美术资源） ----------
func _recall_vfx_start() -> void:
	_recall_vfx_stop()
	_recall_vfx_t = 0.0
	var col: Color = Color(0.40, 0.80, 1.0) if team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.40)
	# 地面法阵环（双环叠加，缓慢旋转）
	_recall_ring = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var tm := TorusMesh.new()
	tm.inner_radius = 1.05
	tm.outer_radius = 1.32
	tm.rings = 32
	tm.ring_segments = 8
	_recall_ring.mesh = tm
	_recall_ring.position.y = 0.06
	var rm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	rm.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	rm.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	rm.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	rm.albedo_color = Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, 0.55)
	rm.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	_recall_ring.material_override = rm
	add_child(_recall_ring)
	# 光柱（半透明加色圆柱，随引导进度升高/变亮）
	_recall_pillar = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var cm := CylinderMesh.new()
	cm.top_radius = 1.05
	cm.bottom_radius = 1.30
	cm.height = 6.0
	cm.radial_segments = 24
	cm.cap_top = false
	cm.cap_bottom = false
	_recall_pillar.mesh = cm
	_recall_pillar.position.y = 3.0
	var pm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	pm.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	pm.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	pm.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	pm.albedo_color = Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, 0.14)
	pm.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	_recall_pillar.material_override = pm
	add_child(_recall_pillar)
	# 上升粒子
	_recall_spark = CPUParticles3D.new()
	_recall_spark.amount = 20
	_recall_spark.lifetime = 1.4
	_recall_spark.emission_shape = CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE
	_recall_spark.emission_sphere_radius = 1.1
	_recall_spark.position.y = 0.3
	_recall_spark.direction = Vector3(0, 1, 0)
	_recall_spark.spread = 12.0
	_recall_spark.initial_velocity_min = 1.2
	_recall_spark.initial_velocity_max = 2.6
	_recall_spark.gravity = Vector3(0, 0.6, 0)
	_recall_spark.scale_amount_min = 0.03
	_recall_spark.scale_amount_max = 0.07
	_recall_spark.color = Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, 0.85)
	add_child(_recall_spark)
	# 起手一圈爆发
	Vfx.sigil(global_position, col, 2.2, 0.8)
	Vfx.cast_glow(global_position + Vector3.UP * 0.9, col, 1.4, 0.6)

func _recall_vfx_tick(delta: float) -> void:
	_recall_vfx_t += delta
	var k: float = clampf(1.0 - recall_timer / RECALL_DURATION, 0.0, 1.0)
	if is_instance_valid(_recall_ring):
		_recall_ring.rotation.y += delta * 2.4
		var s: float = 1.0 + sin(_recall_vfx_t * 3.4) * 0.05 + k * 0.18
		_recall_ring.scale = Vector3(s, 1.0, s)
	if is_instance_valid(_recall_pillar):
		var ph: float = 0.35 + k * 0.85
		_recall_pillar.scale = Vector3(1.0, ph, 1.0)
		_recall_pillar.position.y = 3.0 * ph
	if is_instance_valid(_recall_spark):
		_recall_spark.emitting = true

func _recall_vfx_stop() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(_recall_ring):
		_recall_ring.queue_free()
	if is_instance_valid(_recall_pillar):
		_recall_pillar.queue_free()
	if is_instance_valid(_recall_spark):
		_recall_spark.queue_free()
	_recall_ring = null
	_recall_pillar = null
	_recall_spark = null", "old_string": "func cancel_recall():

	var bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager") as BattleManager
	if bm:
		bm.remove_recall_line(self)"}

三项都做完了。

## 1. 英雄名称+等级 → 移到图标上方
**主机** [UI_Manager.gd](scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd) `RespawnWidget`：
- 名字基线从“环内中上部”（`ring_radius*2 - 46.25`，实际压在头像上）改为 **圆圈正上方** `center.y - ring_radius - 5`
- 字号 24 → 18，并按单元宽度**自动缩字**（`size.x - 4` 内，最小 11px），长名字（鲁班七号 Lv.15）不再溢出

**联机客户端** [NetClientBattle.gd](scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd) `_draw_widget_cell`：同样改到 `center.y - ring_r - 6`，18px、超 150px 自动缩小，两端版式一致。

## 2. 回城动画（[Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd)，纯程序化 VFX）
原来回城只有音效 + 小地图连线，英雄本体没有任何表现。新增挂载在英雄身上的三段效果：
- **地面法阵**：叠加双环 Torus（内 1.05 / 外 1.32，加色混合、无光照），随引导**缓慢旋转 + 脉动**（±5%，进度越满越大 +18%）
- **光柱**：半透明加色圆柱（半径 1.05→1.30、高 6），高度随引导从 35% 长到 120%，透明叠加不挡视野
- **上升粒子**：20 颗，球面发射、初速 1.2–2.6、向上飘 1.4s
- **起手**：`Vfx.sigil` + `Vfx.cast_glow` 打一圈爆发
- **完成瞬间**：`Vfx.pillar` 光柱炸开 + `Vfx.nova` 波环，然后位移回泉水
- **取消/受击打断**：`cancel_recall()` 统一 `_recall_vfx_stop()` 清掉全部节点（无残留）
- 颜色随阵营：我方冰蓝 `(0.40,0.80,1.0)` / 敌方暖橙 `(1.0,0.55,0.40)`

## 3. 普攻按键图标（[AttackWheelButton.gd](scripts/mobile/AttackWheelButton.gd)）
移动端普攻轮盘原来只有“普攻”两字，新增矢量**交叉双剑**图标：
- 两把斜剑（剑身 + 剑尖高亮点 + 垂直护手 + 剑柄小球），中心一圈淡白细环
- 布局重排：**图标在上**（`center.y - radius*0.40`，尺寸 `radius*0.23`）→ “普攻”文字下移一位 → 伤害/攻速两行再下移；装备被动小字行起点同步下移，不重叠
- 全矢量绘制，无美术资源依赖，任何分辨率下不糊

## 验证
- 4 个脚本解析通过：`Hero / UI_Manager / AttackWheelButton / NetClientBattle`
- 回城 VFX 生命周期探针：`V ring=true pillar=true spark=true` → `tick ok` → `stop ok null=true`（创建/驱动/清理都正常）
- 普攻按钮绘制探针（真实渲染，带 1234 伤害 / 1.87 攻速数值）：`W attack btn drawn=6`，无 draw_/Invalid
- `battle.tscn` 窗口化真实运行 **300 帧 clean**
- 已清理探针与 `.cache`

> 备注：回城动画目前只做在**主机侧英雄实体**上（LAN 客户端自身的回城仍只有进度条与音效）；若需要客户端也播同一套法阵，我可以把这段 VFX 抽成 `RecallVfx.gd` 让客户端的 view 也挂一份。

> 探针里出现的 `Hero._handle_skill_input:2943` 索引 -1 报错是“裸 Hero 未装配技能”导致的测试假象，与本次改动无关（正常对局英雄创建时会 `setup_skills_from_database`）。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

lines.text: ## 移动端普攻轮盘（王者荣耀式）：
## - 按住持续普攻（is_held，由 Hero 读取）
## - 拖动进入选敌瞄准：画出方向指示，外部据此精准锁定目标
## - 松手：final_drag=松手时的拖拽向量；cancelled=「拖出又拖回按钮」→ 取消选敌
## - 点按（未拖出）不改变目标锁定，仅普攻当前目标
# 王者荣耀式松手选敌：final_drag=松手时的拖拽向量；cancelled=「拖出又拖回按钮」→ 取消选敌
const TAP_THRESHOLD := 30.0      # 超过此拖拽距离才算“拖出去”（进入选敌）
const CANCEL_RADIUS := 40.0      # 松手位置距按下起点小于此值且拖出去过 → 视为拖回按钮，取消
# 普攻键上的数值说明：普攻伤害 + 攻击速度（每次/秒），由 TouchController 每帧推送
# 强化普攻就绪（数值类强化/跳跃类强化）：伤害数值显示强化后数值，文字与外圈转金色
# 装备被动影响普攻的小字行（小图标+装备短名+实时效果数值），每帧由 TouchController 推送
func set_battle_stats(dmg: int, speed_per_sec: float, is_enhanced: bool = false):
if dmg == show_damage and absf(speed_per_sec - show_speed) < 0.001 and is_enhanced == enhanced:
# 装备被动小字行内容更新：内容未变化（数值/就绪状态均同）则不重绘，避免每帧闪烁
sig += str(d.get("k", "")) + "|" + str(d.get("name", "")) + "|" + str(d.get("txt", "")) + "|" + str(d.get("armed", true)) + "\n"
var _origin := Vector2.ZERO      # 按下起点（局部坐标）
var _drag := Vector2.ZERO        # 当前拖拽偏移
var _max_drag := 0.0             # 本次手势的最大拖拽距离
var cancelled: bool = _max_drag > TAP_THRESHOLD and final_drag.length() < CANCEL_RADIUS
elif event is InputEventMouseButton or event is InputEventMouseMotion:
# 移动端 emulate_mouse_from_touch 会产生合成鼠标事件，吞掉防止漏到世界输入
var base_col := color if _active else color.darkened(0.25)
# 外圈：强化普攻就绪时外圈与伤害数字转金色（数值也已切换为强化后伤害）
var ring_col := Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.3) if enhanced else base_col.lightened(0.3)
draw_arc(center, radius + 3, 0, TAU, 32, ring_col, ring_w, true)
# 主体（P0 统一玻璃底：与面板同色系）
draw_string(UiKit.font(), Vector2(center.x - radius, center.y - fs * 0.35), label_text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, radius * 2.0, fs, Color.WHITE)
# 普攻键数值说明：中心文字下方两行小字（强化=金色/普通=白色，攻速青色）
var dmg_col := Color(1.0, 0.88, 0.35, 1.0) if enhanced else Color(0.93, 0.93, 0.93, 0.92)
"伤害 %d" % show_damage, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, radius * 2.0, fs2, dmg_col)
"攻速 %.2f/秒" % show_speed, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, radius * 2.0, fs2, Color(0.55, 0.9, 1.0, 0.95))
# 装备被动对普攻的影响：攻速行下方的小字行（每件生效装一行）
# 拖动选敌：方向指示线 + 摇杆头样式小圆（像移动轮盘一样）
# ---------------- 装备被动小字行绘制（攻速行下方，逐行 图标+装备短名+效果小字） ----------------
# 攻速行最后一行基线之下 6px 开始，向下最多到圆内 0.96 半径处
# 先按竖直高度估字号（每行 ~1.5 倍字号），再按最宽行宽度收缩；下限 8
var eff_col := col if armed else Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, 0.45)
var name_col := Color(1, 1, 1, 0.92) if armed else Color(1, 1, 1, 0.5)
_draw_mini_glyph(String(d.get("k", "phys")), Vector2(x + ic * 0.5, row_top + fs_i * 0.55), ic * 0.5, eff_col)
draw_string(fname, Vector2(tx, base_y), name, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, nw, fs_i, name_col)
draw_string(fname, Vector2(tx, base_y), txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, tw, fs_i, eff_col)
# 行首小图标：仅用矢量基本形状，与 _draw_fx_glyph 同一风格
func _draw_mini_glyph(kind: String, pc: Vector2, r: float, col: Color):
var rr := r if i % 2 == 0 else r * 0.35
draw_arc(pc, r, 0, TAU, 16, col, lw, true)
draw_line(pc + Vector2(-r * 0.4, 0), pc + Vector2(r * 0.4, 0), col, lw)
draw_line(pc + Vector2(0, -r * 0.4), pc + Vector2(0, r * 0.4), col, lw)
draw_arc(pc, r, 0, TAU, 16, col, lw, true)
draw_line(pc, pc + Vector2(r * 0.35, r * 0.05), col, lw * 0.9)
var pts := PackedVector2Array([pc + Vector2(0, -r), pc + Vector2(r * 0.75, r * 0.15), pc + Vector2(0, r), pc + Vector2(-r * 0.75, r * 0.15)])
var pts := PackedVector2Array([pc + Vector2(-r * 0.26, -r * 0.9), pc + Vector2(r * 0.26, -r * 0.9), pc + Vector2(r * 0.26, r * 0.6), pc + Vector2(-r * 0.26, r * 0.6)])
draw_line(pc + Vector2(-r * 0.6, r * 0.15), pc + Vector2(r * 0.6, r * 0.15), col, lw)
draw_line(pc + Vector2(-r * 0.18, r * 0.85), pc + Vector2(r * 0.18, r * 0.85), col, lw)

## Primary Request and Intent
- Project-wide efficiency rule (Chinese, permanent): "我的时间和预算不是很足，请你在这个项目尽可能快速完成我的任务并节省token用量，把这一条作为这个项目的原则" — recorded in `CLAUDE.md` → `## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)` (shortest path, grep-first reading, minimal verification, terse output, **must** run Windows notification before final answer).
- Standing preference: before each final answer run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`.
- Delivered earlier (done): map realism pack; joystick fix; `_bullet_vkind`; attribute panel; LAN client fixes; minion/tower/jungle/skill/death animations; skill icons; hero emblems; HUD rounds; buff icons; death recap; hero info panel (`RosterView.gd`, screen-adaptive); host shop P0 + P1 (keys/buy-missing/toast/persistent panel/correct synthesis price `_shop_pay_for`); client shop P0 mirror (`NetShopPanel.gd`, sha `F20498AF5EA4C0B132CAC08BF55A6F774E838D65D27B786CB915613E3EA1A9FC`); minimap P0 (terrain/viewport/hero arrows/tower tiers/minion clusters) + P1 (fog + objective timers) + bush/wall/health-pack minimap markers; **real 3D models** of HealthPack (glow orb/pedestal/particles) + Wall (moss disc + rubble) + Bush (moss disc + extra clump + `BushSway` wind) host+client; fixed `hero.actual_attack_speed` → `hero.attack_speed` in `SkillDataBase.gd:3003`.
- **CURRENT newest request** (verbatim): "小地图上防御塔和水晶并没有改过来；小地图上敌方野区野怪的显示规则：在我方无视野的情况下，默认显示，如果该野怪被击杀时或击杀后我方有英雄有该野怪的视野，则能够记住这个野怪的复活时间，复活时间内小地图上次野怪不显示；并优化小地图对主宰/暴君的绘制"
  - (a) Turret/crystal minimap drawing "并没有改过来" — must diagnose why new `MinimapDraw.draw_turret` shapes don't appear.
  - (b) Enemy jungle camp minimap rule: default **show** even without vision; if we see the kill (vision at/after death), remember respawn timer and **hide during respawn**.
  - (c) Improve minimap drawing of 主宰/暴君 (epic monsters: distinct icons/state/countdown).

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 headless binary at `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe`; copy to `.cache\godot47.exe` for probes; delete `.cache` + probe dirs after (`Get-Process godot47 | Stop-Process -Force`, sleep 400ms, `Remove-Item`).
- Probe pattern: temp dir `devXXX/` with `check.tscn`/`check.gd`, run `Start-Process .cache\godot47.exe -ArgumentList '--headless','--path','.','res://devXXX/check.tscn','--quit-after','300' -NoNewWindow -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput devXXX\c.out -RedirectStandardError devXXX\c.err`, grep for markers + `SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error`. Real-scene smoke: `res://scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 150/300 --audio-driver Dummy --position 2000,2000`; windowed run needed to exercise `_draw`. Node-instantiation probe uses `Node3D` scene + `_process` frame counter.
- Warnings-as-errors: every Variant-inferred local needs explicit type; `class_name` after `extends`; typed `:=` only when type inferable.
- Multi-line PowerShell `.Replace` on CRLF files fails silently → use `[regex]::Replace` with `\r?\n`, or line-range rebuild via `[System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines`/`WriteAllLines`.
- **PowerShell pitfall (hit twice)**: single-quoted PS strings keep `` `n `` literal → wrote backtick+n into GDScript (`NetSession.gd:1695` corruption). Use here-strings `@'...'@` with real newlines, or double-quoted strings for newline escapes, and never put `w["p"]` style double quotes inside a double-quoted PS string.
- `edit`/`write` tools require prior `read` tool read of the exact file in-session (pwsh `Get-Content` does NOT satisfy it).
- CanvasItems: `draw_*` only valid inside `_draw` → validate visual code via windowed probe scene that overrides `_draw` and calls helpers.
- LAN host-authoritative; shared draw/payload builders prevent host/client drift (`DeathRecapView`, `RosterView`, `MinimapDraw`, `WorldDecor`).

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

func _cast_feedback(skill: Skill, index: int) -> void:
	if skill == null:
		return
	var an := _cast_anim_name(skill, index)
	_play_anim(an)
	# 联机：施法动作也推给客户端（同一套 clip 名 → 同一套动作档）
	var code := NetSession.ACT_CAST_SHOOT
	match an:
		"sprint": code = NetSession.ACT_CAST_SPRINT
		"interact-right": code = NetSession.ACT_CAST_INTERACT
		"attack-melee-right": code = NetSession.ACT_CAST_MELEE
		"holding-both-shoot": code = NetSession.ACT_CAST_BOTH_SHOOT
	NetSession.hero_anim(self, code)
	var col: Color = Vfx.color_for_hero(display_name)
	Vfx.cast_glow(global_position, col, 1.1 if index < 2 else 1.7, 0.45 if index < 2 else 0.75)
	# 本地玩家施法短音（非本人内部直接忽略；按技能类型/英雄专属分档）
	SfxManager.try_skill_sfx(display_name, index, skill)
	if index == 2 and not is_ai:
		var bm := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager") as BattleManager
		if bm and bm.hero == self and bm.has_method("on_big_cast"):
			bm.on_big_cast(self)

func _start_casting(index: int, skill: Skill, target_pos: Vector3):
	# 存储型技能守卫（所有调用入口，含 AI/触屏/键盘，与 can_cast_skill 同规则）：
	# 无已存层数不放，避免白耗
	if skill and skill.restore > 0.0 and index < skill_restores.size() and skill_restores[index] <= 0:
		return
	# 英雄前置状态门槛统一守卫（李白大招侠客行 / 沈梦溪1、2需炸弹 / 马超R需枪 /
	# 东皇2需能量球 / 兰陵王大招需隐身）——与按钮 blocked 同源，各入口（含 AI 连招）一致拦截
	if index >= 0 and index < skills.size() and skills[index] and skill_prereq_blocked(index):
		return
	casting_skill = true
	pending_skill_index = index

	pending_skill_target = target_pos
	# 目标型技能保留调用方已锁定的实体（触屏拖拽/桌面悬停/联机 C_CAST 写入）；非目标型清空防串台。
	# 到期由 _finish_casting 尾部统一复位。
	if skill == null or skill.type != 0:
		pending_skill_target_entity = null
	_cast_feedback(skill, index)

func _ring(pos: Vector3, radius: float, color: Color, dur: float, scale_up: float = 1.6, width: float = 0.28) -> void:
	if quality <= 0 or get_tree() == null:
		return
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.add_to_group(GROUP_FX)
	root.position = pos
	_add_root(root)
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var torus := TorusMesh.new()
	torus.inner_radius = radius * (1.0 - width)
	torus.outer_radius = radius
	mi.mesh = torus
	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	mat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
func _particles(amount: int, lifetime: float, color: Color, size: float, speed: float,
		spread_min: float, dir: Vector3, gravity_scale: float, one_shot: bool,
		tex: Texture2D = null) -> GPUParticles3D:
	var p := GPUParticles3D.new()
	p.amount = maxi(1, amount)
	p.lifetime = maxf(0.1, lifetime)
	p.one_shot = one_shot
	p.explosiveness = 1.0 if one_shot else 0.0
	p.local_coords = true
	p.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	p.visibility_aabb = AABB(Vector3(-12, -6, -12), Vector3(24, 16, 24))

	var pm := ParticleProcessMaterial.new()
	pm.emission_shape = ParticleProcessMaterial.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE
	pm.emission_sphere_radius = maxf(0.08, size * 0.4)
	pm.direction = dir.normalized() if dir.length() > 0.01 else Vector3.UP

```gdscript
func _charge_particles(amount: int, lifetime: float, color: Color, size: float, sf: float) -> CPUParticles3D:
	var p := CPUParticles3D.new()
	p.amount = maxi(4, int(float(amount) * (1.0 if quality >= 2 else 0.6)))
	p.lifetime = maxf(0.12, lifetime)
	p.one_shot = false
	p.local_coords = false
	p.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	var q := QuadMesh.new()
	q.size = Vector2(size, size) * (2.4 if sf > 1.0 else 2.0)
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	m.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	m.billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	m.albedo_texture = _soft_tex
	m.albedo_color = color
	m.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true
	m.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	q.material = m
	p.mesh = q
	p.color = Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, 0.9)
	p.scale_amount_min = 0.5
	p.scale_amount_max = 1.0
	return p
```
