## 加色发光材质（前摇特效专用，免去每处重复写 StandardMaterial3D）
func _add_mat(color: Color, alpha: float, emission: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	m.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	m.albedo_color = Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, alpha)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = color
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = emission
	m.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	return m

## 前摇粒子（软光斑 billboard 四边形 + 加色混合）
func _charge_particles(amount: int, lifetime: float, color: Color, size: float, sf: float) -> CPUParticles3D:
	var p := CPUParticles3D.new()
	p.amount = maxi(6, int(float(amount) * (1.0 if quality >= 2 else 0.6)))
	p.lifetime = maxf(0.12, lifetime)
	p.one_shot = false
	p.local_coords = false
	p.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	p.emitting = false
	var q := QuadMesh.new()
	q.size = Vector2(size, size) * (2.7 if sf > 1.0 else 2.2)
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	m.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	m.billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	m.albedo_texture = _soft_tex
	m.albedo_color = color
	m.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true
	m.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	q.material = m
	p.mesh = q
	p.color = Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, 0.9)
	p.color_ramp = null
	p.scale_amount_min = 0.55
	p.scale_amount_max = 1.0
	return p

## 前摇的元素差异点缀：火=上升火星/冰=冰晶碎片/雷=侧向电弧/圣=竖直光带/
## 刃=交叉刃光/暗=暗雾/水=水珠/其余=扩散气环
func _element_flourish(el_name: String, col: Color, col2: Color, base: Vector3,
		facing: Vector3, sf: float, dur: float, root: Node3D) -> void:
	match el_name:
		"fire":
			_burst(col, col2, base + Vector3.UP * 0.5, 12, dur * 0.95, 0.55 * sf, 4.2, Vector3.UP, 24.0, 3.0)
		"ice":
			for i in range(5):
				var sh := MeshInstance3D.new()
				var qm := QuadMesh.new()
				qm.size = Vector2(0.16, 0.46) * sf
				sh.mesh = qm
				sh.material_override = _add_mat(col2, 0.75, 2.0)
				var ang: float = TAU * float(i) / 5.0
				sh.position = Vector3(cos(ang) * 1.15 * sf, 0.55, sin(ang) * 1.15 * sf)
				sh.rotation = Vector3(0.6, ang, 0.35)
				sh.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
				root.add_child(sh)
				var tw := root.create_tween()
				tw.set_parallel(true)
				tw.tween_property(sh, "position:y", 2.1 * sf, dur * 0.95).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
				tw.tween_property(sh, "rotation:y", sh.rotation.y + 3.0, dur * 0.95)
		"lightning":
			for i in range(2):
				var a := TAU * float(i) / 2.0 + 0.4
				var from := base + Vector3(cos(a) * 1.5 * sf, 0.25, sin(a) * 1.5 * sf)
				beam(from, base + Vector3.UP * 1.15, col2, 0.055, dur * 0.45)
		"holy":
			var band := MeshInstance3D.new()
			var cyl := CylinderMesh.new()
			cyl.top_radius = 0.30 * sf
			cyl.bottom_radius = 0.55 * sf
			cyl.height = 3.6
			cyl.radial_segments = 12
			cyl.cap_top = false
			cyl.cap_bottom = false
			band.mesh = cyl
			band.position = Vector3(0, 1.8, 0)
			band.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
			band.material_override = _add_mat(col2, 0.22, 1.6)
			root.add_child(band)
		"blade":
			for i in range(2):
				var bl := MeshInstance3D.new()
				var box := BoxMesh.new()
				box.size = Vector3(0.05, 1.5, 0.05) * sf
				bl.mesh = box
				bl.material_override = _add_mat(col2, 0.7, 2.4)
				bl.position = Vector3(0, 1.0, 0)
				bl.rotation = Vector3(0.0, 0.6 + PI * float(i) * 0.5, 0.5 if i == 0 else -0.5)
				bl.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
				root.add_child(bl)
				var tw2 := root.create_tween()
				tw2.set_parallel(true)
				tw2.tween_property(bl, "rotation:y", bl.rotation.y + TAU * 0.8, dur)
				tw2.tween_property(bl, "position:y", 1.9, dur * 0.9)
		"shadow":
			var mist := _charge_particles(14, dur * 1.2, col, 0.34, sf)
			mist.emission_sphere_radius = 1.25 * sf
			mist.direction = Vector3.UP
			mist.spread = 55.0
			mist.initial_velocity_min = 0.5
			mist.initial_velocity_max = 1.3
			mist.gravity = Vector3(0, 0.6, 0)
			mist.position = Vector3(0, 0.45, 0)
			root.add_child(mist)
			mist.emitting = true
		"water":
			_burst(col, col2, base + Vector3.UP * 0.4, 10, dur * 0.9, 0.5 * sf, 3.4, Vector3.UP, 30.0, 1.6)
		_:
			_delayed_ring(base, 2.2 * sf, col, 0.04, dur * 0.85)
"}

## 加色发光材质（前摇特效专用，免去每处重复写 StandardMaterial3D）
func _add_mat(color: Color, alpha: float, emission: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	m.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	m.albedo_color = Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, alpha)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = color
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = emission
	m.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	return m

## 前摇粒子（软光斑 billboard 四边形 + 加色混合）
func _charge_particles(amount: int, lifetime: float, color: Color, size: float, sf: float) -> CPUParticles3D:
	var p := CPUParticles3D.new()
	p.amount = maxi(6, int(float(amount) * (1.0 if quality >= 2 else 0.6)))
	p.lifetime = maxf(0.12, lifetime)
	p.one_shot = false
	p.local_coords = false
	p.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	p.emitting = false
	var q := QuadMesh.new()
	q.size = Vector2(size, size) * (2.7 if sf > 1.0 else 2.2)
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	m.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	m.billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	m.albedo_texture = _soft_tex
	m.albedo_color = color
	m.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true
	m.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	q.material = m
	p.mesh = q
	p.color = Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, 0.9)
	p.color_ramp = null
	p.scale_amount_min = 0.55
	p.scale_amount_max = 1.0
	return p

popup shown: HonorKing · 技能前摇动画 | 前摇从单个圈升级为三旋法阵+内吸能量+手中聚能球+元素点缀；落点预警改为充能法阵

前摇从「一个圈」升级成了一套分层蓄力表现。

## 根因
施法前摇唯一的表现是 [Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd) `_cast_feedback()` 里的一行 `Vfx.cast_glow()` —— 内部只是 `_ring()` 一圈 + 8 颗小火花，所以所有英雄、所有技能看起来都是同一个圈。

## 改动
### 1. 新增 `Vfx.cast_charge()`（[VfxFactory.gd](scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd)），替代单圈
分 10 层叠加，时长 0.42s（大招 0.60s，整体 ×1.35）：
| 层 | 表现 |
|---|---|
| 地面软光斑 | 着色器法阵，`pulse_speed 8` 随蓄力呼吸 |
| 三圈法阵 | 半径 1.62/1.16/0.72，**正-反-正** 差速旋转 |
| 内吸粒子 | 环形发射 + **负径向加速度(-4~-8)** → 能量从四周汇向脚下 |
| 上升光尘 | 16 颗球面发射、向上飘 |
| 手中聚能球 | 从 0.35 倍长到 1.45 倍并上浮（读作"攒劲") |
| 中段旋环 | 微倾斜 0.32rad 反向旋转，表现能量上涌 |
| 元素点缀 | 见下 |
| 朝向能量线 | 地面一道指向施法方向的锥形光束（0.7s 内淡出） |
| 临时点光 | 元素色 OmniLight，蓄力期照亮脚下 |
| 收尾 | 全部材质同步渐隐后整体释放，无残留 |

### 2. 元素差异（不再是同一个圈换色）
- **火**：12 颗上升火星（带重力） / **冰**：5 片冰晶碎片旋转上浮
- **雷**：两侧 zigzag 电弧打进聚能球 / **圣**：竖直半透明光带
- **刃**：两道交叉刃光旋转上升 / **暗**：大颗暗雾向心汇聚
- **水**：水花上溅 / **风·大地·奥术**：中空扩散气环

### 3. 新增 `Vfx.telegraph()` —— 落点预警「充能法阵」
原来区域/大招落点只有一个 `sigil()` 圆盘，现改为：软光斑 + 内外**反向双环**（r 与 0.66r）+ **向心汇聚粒子** + 竖直微光柱 + 点光，末段（`dur*0.85`）炸开两圈波纹。已接入 `play_spell` 的 `zone` 与 `target_zone` 两个分支。

### 4. 调用点
`Hero._cast_feedback()` 用 `Vfx.cast_charge(display_name, global_position, fdir, pending_skill_target, index)` 替换原 `cast_glow`，朝向取自 `rotation.y`；指数 ≥2 自动放大加长。

## 验证
- `Vfx.cast_charge` / `telegraph` 实机渲染探针：`D fx6=5`、`D emitting=3`（法阵/粒子/光球都建出来了）、`D fx100=0`（0.6s 内全部释放，无泄漏）
- 5 种元素（火/冰/刃/暗/圣）+ 大招档位同帧创建，**无 SCRIPT ERROR**
- `battle.tscn` 窗口化真实运行 300 帧 clean
- 已清理探针与 `.cache`

## 可调参数（都在 `cast_charge` 顶部）
| 参数 | 当前值 |
|---|---|
| 普通/大招时长 | `dur = 0.42 / 0.60` |
| 大招放大 | `sf = 1.0 / 1.35` |
| 法阵三环半径 | `[1.62, 1.16, 0.72] * sf` |
| 内吸强度 | `radial_accel -8.0 ~ -4.0` |
| 聚能球终态 | `scale 1.45*sf`，高度 `1.15 → 1.32` |

> 说明：这套前摇做在主机侧英雄上；LAN 客户端远端英雄施法目前仍只有动作 clip 同步，若需要可见同款法阵，我可以把 `cast_charge` 接到客户端的施法事件里（同一套 Vfx 参数，成本很低）。

popup shown: HonorKing · 血条数字/移动模式/商店修复 | 英雄图标去掉血量数字；默认改前后左右移动；修复商店选中高亮不刷新、买卖后状态过期、未拥有可出售

三件事都处理完了，商店确实找出了 4 个 bug。

## 1. 去掉英雄图标里的血量数字
- 主机 [UI_Manager.gd](scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd) `RespawnWidget`：删掉头像中央的 `str(int(hero.health))` 文本，保留外圈血量弧 + 阵亡复活倒计时。
- 联机 [NetClientBattle.gd](scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd)：`_draw_widget_cell` 活体分支同样删掉血量数字，阵亡倒计时保留（两端版式仍一致）。

## 2. 默认移动模式改为「前后左右」
[TouchController.gd](scripts/mobile/TouchController.gd) `var move_mode := MOVE_MODE_TURN` → `MOVE_MODE_DIR`。现在开局 W/S/A/D 直接按屏幕方向走（W=远离镜头），HUD 标签显示「WASD移动：前后左右模式」，点一下切换按钮仍可切回转向模式。

## 3. 商店面板 —— 查到 4 个 bug 并修好

To make fonts bigger and fill panel: multiply by ~1.25. Risk: overflow within card width. Card width = PANEL_W*0.5 - 32 = 1080-32 = 1048; name at x+84 with 21px — plenty of space. Chips row: 7 chips at 13px; and equipment icons at x+84 + 6*30 = 264 width; skills at x+300.

Content vertical: `top + 148` block; rows: name 34, sub 58, status 80, chips 104, equips 118..144, skills 131+34 → bottom ~165 > 148? Actually skill circles at top+131 radius 17 → bottom 148 ✓.

If I scale fonts 1.25: name 26, sub 17.5, status 17.5, KDA 24, gold 17.5, chips 15, skill 18, lv 14 — vertical positions same, so text may crowd but 148px tall area is fine (fonts up to 26 → baselines spaced 24px apart at 34/58/80 → name top at 34-26=8 ✓, sub 58-17.5=40 ✓ gap fine).

Chips: each chip width = glyph + text width + gap; bigger font widens chips; 7 chips may overflow card width (1048). Chip text like "+120 攻击" at 15px ≈ 80px + glyph 20 → 100px ×7 = 700 < 900 ✓.

Also `_row_h` computed as maxf((ph - HEAD_H - 24 - 5*GAP)/5, 112) — panel_h = 1200 → row_h ≈ (1200-96-24-50)/5 = 206. Cards 206 tall; content 148 → some empty space already. Bigger fonts help "更满".

Additionally user says "让整个画面更满" — also could reduce empty space: increase `_card` content spread: keep.

Implementation: add `const FONT_BOOST := 1.22` and wrap text sizes: simplest is to define helper `_f(fs: int) -> int: return int(round(float(fs) * FONT_BOOST))` then replace each literal font size arg with `_f(21)` etc. That's ~20 edits — do with regex carefully? Risky because numbers appear in other contexts (positions like 84.0, 34.0). Only `UiKit.text(self, ..., N, ...)` where N is an int literal — pattern: `, 21, Color` etc.

Safer approach: since all text goes through `UiKit.text(self, ...)`, I can add a local wrapper `_txt(pos, txt, fs, col, align:=..., w:=-1.0)` and change call sites... still many edits.

Alternative cheapest: scale inside UiKit? No, global impact.

Pragmatic approach: regex replace specific known font-size literals within RosterView text calls:
patterns: `, 26, C_GOLD)`, `, 17, diff_col)`, `, 17, Color(...)`, `, 13, Color(0.62...`, `, 21, Color.WHITE if`, `, 14, C_GOLD)`, `, 14, stc)`, `, 19, Color(0.92`, `, 12, C_DIM)`, `, 15, C_DIM`, `, 15,\n Color.WHITE if ready`, `, 11, C_GOLD`.

Simplest: define `_f()` and do a targeted replace of `, 26, C_GOLD)` → `, _f(26), C_GOLD)` etc. Only in this file, and use `[regex]::Replace` with patterns anchored to `, (\d{2}), ` preceded by `UiKit.text(...`? Multi-line complex.

## 小地图绘制库（host / LAN client 共用）：地形底图 + 塔/英雄/小兵/野怪/迷雾/目标计时。
## 全部为 CanvasItem 立即绘制，调用方在 _draw() 内使用。

static var FONT: Font = ThemeDB.fallback_font

const RIVER_HALF := 9.0

# ---------------- 地形 ----------------
static func world_color(wx: float, wz: float, map_size: float = 120.0) -> Color:
	var half := map_size * 0.5
	# 河道：x = z 对角线（宽 ±9）
	var river_d := absf(wx - wz) / sqrt(2.0)
	var base := Color(0.075, 0.135, 0.095)   # 野区深绿
	var n := sin(wx * 0.21 + wz * 0.13) * 0.5 + cos(wx * 0.09 - wz * 0.17) * 0.5
	base = base.lightened(0.03 * (n + 1.0) * 0.5)
	# 兵线：中路 x = -z，发育路 z≈+half-6，对抗路 x≈-half+6
	var mid_d := absf(wx + wz) / sqrt(2.0)
	var lane_col := Color(0.235, 0.215, 0.155)
	if mid_d < 6.5:
		base = base.lerp(lane_col, clampf(1.0 - mid_d / 6.5, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.9)
	var bot_d := absf(wz - (half - 4.0))
	if bot_d < 7.0 and absf(wx) < half - 2.0:
		base = base.lerp(lane_col, clampf(1.0 - bot_d / 7.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.9)
	var left_d := absf(wx + half - 4.0)
	if left_d < 7.0 and absf(wz) < half - 2.0:
		base = base.lerp(lane_col, clampf(1.0 - left_d / 7.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.9)
	# 河道覆盖
	if river_d < RIVER_HALF:
		var k := 1.0 - river_d / RIVER_HALF
		var water := Color(0.10, 0.33, 0.42).lerp(Color(0.16, 0.52, 0.60), k)
		base = base.lerp(water, 0.55 + 0.45 * k)
	# 泉水/基地：暖色
	for c in [Vector2(-half + 7.0, half - 7.0), Vector2(half - 7.0, -half + 7.0)]:
		var d: float = Vector2(wx, wz).distance_to(c)
		if d < 16.0:
			base = base.lerp(Color(0.42, 0.34, 0.16), clampf(1.0 - d / 16.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.6)
	return base

static func terrain_texture(px: int, map_size: float, grid: int = 120) -> ImageTexture:
	var img := Image.create(grid, grid, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
	for gy in range(grid):
		var wz: float = (float(gy) + 0.5) / float(grid) * map_size - map_size * 0.5
		for gx in range(grid):
			var wx: float = (float(gx) + 0.5) / float(grid) * map_size - map_size * 0.5
			# 边界暗化（贴墙区域读起来更深，避免糊成一片）
			var edge: float = maxf(absf(wx), absf(wz)) / (map_size * 0.5)
			var c := world_color(wx, wz, map_size)
			if edge > 0.82:
				c = c.darkened((edge - 0.82) / 0.18 * 0.45)
			img.set_pixel(gx, gy, c)
	img.resize(px, px, Image.INTERPOLATE_BILINEAR)
	var tex := ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
	return tex

  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

## 1. 小地图野怪提亮
| 项 | 改前 | 改后 |
|---|---|---|
| 普通营地 | 3px 深绿点 | 2.8px 亮绿芯 `(0.82,0.95,0.64)` + 深色描边 + 白芯 + 柔光底 |
| 红/蓝 buff | 半径 3.4 偏暗 | 3.6px 高饱和 + 亮色外环 + 高光芯 + 外圈柔光 |
| 空间之灵 | 深青 | 亮青菱形 + 柔光 |
| 暴君/主宰 | 光环 11、头颅 5.2 | 光环 12.8、头颅 5.8、外环更亮（5 种变体各自配色） |
| 无视野（默认显示） | alpha 0.55 左右 | alpha 0.86–0.88，**基本不掉亮度** |
| 迷雾压暗 | alpha 0.30 | 0.26（地形仍可读，图标不再被压黑） |

实测：野怪图标区域平均亮度 **0.30 → 0.54**。

## 2. 防御塔：四种轮廓彻底分开
原来外塔/内塔都是同一个方块（只差护角），现在：
- **外塔** = 方形塔身 + 顶部城垛缺口 + 1.3px 白描边 + 中心白点（明确读作"塔"）
- **内塔** = **八边形**塔基 + 内层八边芯 + 白描边（不再是正方形）
- **高地塔** = 菱形（保留）
- **水晶** = 六边形宝石 + 血量外环（保留，尺寸 15）

自动化像素探针（SubViewport 透明渲染后数像素）确认四种形状**填充像素数各不相同**：`outer 144 / inner 124 / high 130 / crystal 389`，且无脚本错误。

## 3. 英雄面板字体放大（RosterView）
整体字号上调一档，同一套版式不变、内容更满：
| 元素 | 原 → 新 |
|---|---|
| 标题 | 26 → 32 |
| 结论条（经济差/击杀/存活） | 17 → 21 |
| 副标题提示 | 13 → 17 |
| 英雄名 / KDA | 21 → 27 / 19 → 24 |
| 等级·分路 / 状态 / 经济 | 14 → 18 |
| 属性 chip 文本 | 13 → 17（图标 7 → 8.5，间距同步加大） |
| 技能标签 / 技能等级 | 15 → 18 / 11 → 14 |
| 头像环 | 28 → 32 |

按卡片可用宽度（1080×0.5−32≈1048）估算：7 个属性 chip 放大后约 875px，仍在安全范围内；纵向各行基线（34/58/80/104/118）与 148px 内容高度仍不重叠。

**验证**：真实 `battle.tscn` 窗口化跑 380 帧 + 打开英雄面板、小地图每帧绘制、地形贴图 256×256 生成，**0 条 SCRIPT ERROR / Parse Error**；探针目录 `.cache`、`devfx2` 已清理。

> 说明：重写后的 `MinimapDraw.gd` 为 22KB，接口与配色逻辑与原版一致（地形底图由 120 网格采样后双线性放大，兵线/河道/基地暖光布局沿用原规则）。如果你觉得新地形底色和之前观感有差异，告诉我具体想调整的方向，我再逐项对齐。

1: class_name Wall
2: extends StaticBody3D
3: 
4: const WorldDecor = preload("res://scripts/entities/WorldDecor.gd")
5: 
6: func _ready():
7: 	# 加载墙体模型
8: 	var model = load("res://model/wall/wall.glb")
9: 	if model:
10: 		var instance = model.instantiate()
11: 		instance.scale = Vector3(1.0, 1.3, 1.0)
12: 		instance.rotation.y = deg_to_rad(90.0)
13: 		add_child(instance)
14: 	# 真实感细节：基底苔藓盘 + 随机碎石（纯几何，不依赖贴图）
15: 	WorldDecor.decorate_wall(self)
16: 
17: 	# 碰撞形状
18: 	var col = CollisionShape3D.new()
19: 	col.shape = BoxShape3D.new()
20: 	col.shape.size = Vector3(0.4, 3, 0.4)

159: const _GROUND_CODE := """
160: shader_type spatial;
161: render_mode diffuse_burley, specular_schlick_ggx, cull_back;
162: 
163: uniform sampler2D layout_tex : filter_linear, repeat_disable;
164: uniform sampler2D detail_tex : filter_linear, repeat_enable;
165: uniform sampler2D normal_tex : filter_linear, repeat_enable, hint_normal;
166: uniform vec4 tint : source_color = vec4(1.0);
167: uniform vec4 emission_color : source_color = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
168: uniform float emission_strength = 0.0;
169: uniform float detail_scale = 14.0;
170: uniform float map_half = 60.0;
171: uniform float normal_strength = 0.35;
172: uniform float ground_roughness = 0.95;
173: uniform float bump_amount = 0.0;
174: 
175: varying vec3 wp;
176: 
177: void vertex() {
178: 	wp = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;
179: 	// 野区微地形起伏（只动野区，分路/河道/高地保持平）；纯视觉，实体仍踩 y=0
180: 	if (bump_amount > 0.001) {
181: 		float lane_d = min(min(abs(abs(wp.x) - 55.0), abs(abs(wp.z) - 55.0)), abs(wp.x + wp.z) * 0.7071068);
182: 		float lane_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(7.0, 13.0, lane_d);
183: 		float river_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(10.0, 15.0, abs(wp.x - wp.z) * 0.7071068);
184: 		float hg_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(30.0, 38.0, min(length(wp.xz + vec2(60.0, -60.0)), length(wp.xz - vec2(60.0, -60.0))));
185: 		float edge_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(56.0, 70.0, max(abs(wp.x), abs(wp.z)));
186: 		float jungle_m = clamp(1.0 - lane_m - river_m - hg_m, 0.0, 1.0) * edge_m;
187: 		float n = sin(wp.x * 0.34) * cos(wp.z * 0.29) * 0.65 + sin(wp.x * 0.81 + 1.7) * cos(wp.z * 0.67 - 0.9) * 0.35;

NetClientBattle replacements missed due to CRLF. Use regex replacements with `\r?\n` and tabs.

Patterns:
1. `(?m)^\t\t# 与主机同一套草丛细节.*\r?\n(?:\t\t[^\r\n]*\r?\n){4}` → hmm count lines: comment, var bush_model, if..., bush_model = ..., var bh..., WorldDecor.decorate_bush → 6 lines. Replace with comment line.
2. wall: comment + WorldDecor.decorate_wall lines.
3. Remove preload const line.

Use [regex]::Replace with singleline careful. Let's do:

$t = [regex]::Replace($t, '(?m)^\t\t# 与主机同一套草丛细节[^\r\n]*\r?\n(?:\t\t[^\r\n]*\r?\n){5}', "`t`t# 程序化灌木已自带苔藓盘/草叶/风摆（与主机同源），不再叠加旧装饰`n")

Check counts: after comment line: var bush_model (1), if (2), bush_model = ... (3), var bh (4), WorldDecor.decorate_bush (5) → exactly 5 following lines ✓.

Wall: comment + 1 line → `^\t\t# 与主机同一套墙体细节[^\r\n]*\r?\n\t\tWorldDecor\.decorate_wall\(root\)\r?\n`.

Const: `(?m)^const WorldDecor = preload\([^\r\n]*\r?\n`.

Then also check other uses of WorldDecor in that file (maybe none after).

W grass_surfaces=1 aabb=(0.621075, 1.096007, 0.627576)
W wall_surfaces=1 aabb=(2.147961, 3.066253, 2.2032)
W fountain=true children=9
W bushes=112
W bush_children=2
W walls=520
=== shader/script errors ===

Mostly working but missing prints for bush_aabb / wall_aabb — because `bush_children=2` then `get_child(0)` may be a Node3D (DecorMesh root) not MeshInstance3D. Right: `Bush.gd` adds `DecorMesh.bush_visual()` which returns a Node3D containing MeshInstance3D → so bush child 0 is Node3D. Fix probe to descend. Also `bush_children=2` = visual root + CollisionShape3D ✓.

Also wall mesh AABB 2.15×3.07×2.20 — that's wide because rubble at base radius up to ~1.05 + boulders. Wall collision is 0.4 wide; visual 2.1 wide is too wide — river walls in MultiMesh spacing 7 units along diagonal, so 2.1 width is okay-ish but individual in-lane walls would look chunky. Old glb at scale 1.3: unknown width. Let's slim it: reduce base rubble distance (0.52-0.98 → 0.35-0.66), layer offsets, and boulder horizontal radius: layers 0.62/0.55/0.47/0.40/0.30 → reduce to 0.46/0.42/0.36/0.30/0.24 → width ~1.3-1.4. Height 3.0 still (top layer y 2.62 + ry 0.24 → ~2.9, plus scale jitter 1.22 → 3.07 ✓ matches collision height 3.0).

Bush: check aabb after fix. bushes=112 (BattleManager creates ~95? payload says 112). walls=520? That's a lot — BattleManager creates walls; 520 * ~2000 tris = heavy! Let me compute wall tri count: 5 layers × ~2 rocks × sphere(8×5) tris = 8*5*2=80 tris/rock → 12 rocks ≈ 960 + 6 rubble (80 each=480) + disc (14*2*... cylinder ≈ 28 tris) ≈ 1470 tris per wall ×520 = 764k tris. Too heavy. Plus bushes 112 × (16 blobs*7*4*2=56 tris → 896 + 18 blades*~6 + disc) ≈ 1000 tris → 112k. Walls are the problem.

Reduce wall poly: use sphere radial 6 rings 3 → 6*3*2=36 tris/rock. Rocks: layers counts 3+2+2+2+1=10 → 360 + rubble 6*36=216 + disc 28 ≈ 600 tris/wall → 312k total. Still a lot but acceptable? Hmm 520 walls seem excessive; maybe group "walls" includes lane walls etc. Could also reduce rubble to 4.

Alternative: use MultiMesh for host walls? BattleManager creates individual Wall nodes (needed for collision). We can't batch easily... Actually we could switch the visual to a shared small mesh and rely on instancing — 600 tris each is fine for GPU (312k tris), simpler.

Let me check the actual mesh tri counts programmatically later; simplest optimization: radial 6, rings 3 for wall rocks; bush blobs radial 6 rings 3 (36 tris) ×16 = 576.

Wait, characters (~270KB GLB) have thousands of tris; 300-400k total is normal for a MOBA scene. Fine. But also fog/shadow cast: wall cast_shadow ON ×520 → shadow map cost. Old GLB also cast shadows. Keep.

## 1. 新的程序化模型（[DecorMesh.gd](scripts/entities/DecorMesh.gd)，新增）
运行时用 `SurfaceTool` 拼 ArrayMesh + 自定义 shader，主机与联机客户端**同一套代码**，无贴图、无外部资源：

| 模型 | 构成 | 面数 | 尺寸 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 石墙 | 7 块错缝低模巨石（5 层）+ 4 块基底碎石 + 苔藓土盘 | 584 tri | ≈1.1 宽 × 3.06 高（与 0.4×3×0.4 碰撞盒高度一致） |
| 灌木丛 | 12 个蓬松叶团 + 18 根三棱草叶（向外倾斜）+ 苔藓盘 | 1080 tri | ≈2.05 宽 × 1.58 高（贴合 2×2 区域） |
| 环境草簇 | 9 根草叶，MultiMesh 里 360 簇 | 180 tri | 1.1 高（原 grass-large 的 360 簇已改用它） |

着色器（视觉真实感来源，全部程序化噪声）：
- **石头**：世界坐标三频噪声分色（浅岩/深岩/颗粒），近地面朝上表面长苔藓，底部渐变泥土色，粗糙度随苔藓下降。
- **叶片**：噪声深浅三层绿 + 顶部亮叶尖 + `BACKLIGHT` 透光，GPU 顶点风摆（按世界坐标取相位，不会整片同步抖）。

content.arguments:
{"command":"$nl = "`n"
$p = (Resolve-Path 'scripts\core\BattleManager.gd'); $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
# 1) 城墙生成调用
$t = $t.Replace("	# ---- 墙体与草丛生成 ----`n`t_generate_lane_edge_walls()`n`t_generate_high_ground_walls()", "	# ---- 墙体与草丛生成 ----`n`t_generate_lane_edge_walls()`n`t_generate_high_ground_walls()`n`t_generate_outer_walls()")
# 2) _add_wall 支持强制放置（外周城墙要在高地过滤之外也能立起来）
$oldSig = "func _add_wall(pos: Vector3, facing: Vector3 = Vector3.ZERO):`n`tif _is_inside_high_ground(pos):`n`t`treturn"
$newSig = "func _add_wall(pos: Vector3, facing: Vector3 = Vector3.ZERO, force: bool = false):`n`tif not force and _is_inside_high_ground(pos):`n`t`treturn"
if ($t.Contains($oldSig)) { $t = $t.Replace($oldSig, $newSig); 'addwall ok' } else { 'addwall MISS' }
# 3) 龙坑围墙 270° → 180°（半圈，开口朝最近分路）
$oldPit = "`twhile angle < 360.0:`n`t`tvar rel := fmod(angle - mouth + 360.0, 360.0)`n`t`tif rel > 45.0 and rel < 315.0:"
$newPit = "`twhile angle < 360.0:`n`t`tvar rel := fmod(angle - mouth + 360.0, 360.0)`n`t`t# 180° 半圈围墙（背向最近分路的一面），开口 180°，进坑与被勾出都更顺`n`t`tif rel > 90.0 and rel < 270.0:"
if ($t.Contains($oldPit)) { $t = $t.Replace($oldPit, $newPit); 'pit ok' } else { 'pit MISS' }
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t)
"calls=" + $t.Contains("_generate_outer_walls()")","description":"Wire outer walls call and 180 degree pit walls"}

NetSession.gd L1719: " walls=", payload.get("walls", []).size(), " camps=", payload.get("camps", []).size())
Minimap.gd L437: for w in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("walls"):

Payload builds walls from group "walls" → outer walls automatically included ✓ (client gets them).

Also Minimap draws walls from group (host) and payload (client) ✓ — 520 walls currently; adding ring adds ~ (4 edges × 2*(63-37)/2 ≈ 26 per edge) ≈ 104 + 18 corners ≈ 122 more walls → 642. Each 584 tris → 375k tris. Hmm heavy. Consider client too (each client creates 642 nodes with own mesh instance; mesh generated per wall — 584 tris × 642 = big memory but each mesh built separately! That's 642 ArrayMesh resources ~ each ~584*3 verts → 642*1752 verts ≈ 1.1M vertices in RAM, plus GPU. That is a lot but was already 520. Fine-ish.

Optimization: cache wall mesh variants (e.g., 8 prebuilt meshes by seed%8) and reuse MeshInstance3D with shared mesh + per-instance rotation/scale variation. That cuts memory hugely and build time. Implement in DecorMesh: `wall_visual(seed)` → choose `_wall_cache[seed % 8]`; build lazily 8 variants. Bush similar (seed % 10). Since walls differ only in rotation/scale slightly, 8 variants is visually enough.

Let me implement caching:
```gdscript
static var _wall_cache: Array = []
static func wall_visual(seed_val) -> Node3D:
	var slot: int = absi(seed_val) % 8
	if _wall_cache.size() <= slot: ... build lazily
```
Simpler: `static func _wall_mesh_variant(idx: int) -> ArrayMesh` with static var array.

Also random rotation y per instance for variety: add `root.rotation.y = float(seed_val % 360) * PI/180` — but walls' facing is set by parent (`wall.rotation.y`), so root rotation would break facing alignment. Keep root no rotation, vary via scale (x/z scale 0.92-1.08) — but scale changes height too... fine to vary only x/z: `mi.scale = Vector3(sx, 1.0, sz)` slight.

Given time budget, this optimization is worth ~20 lines. Let's do it.

Then add `_generate_outer_walls` function and verify with probe: count walls, count pit walls, ensure parse, ensure no wall blocks spawn baseline: check distance of each new wall to hero spawn (-58,58) > 10? Outer walls near base are force-placed; check min distance from spawn to any wall and ensure > 3.0 (collision radius ~0.2 + hero 0.4). Forced walls at |x|=63,z∈[37..63] → distance from (-58,58): e.g. wall (-63,58) distance 5.0 ✓; wall (-63,48) distance 11; corner arc (-63,63) → 7.07 ✓. OK > 3.

But also forced outer walls at (-63, -63..-37) etc are in jungle ✓.

Wait: forced walls may be placed on top of lane paths at corners? Corner regions are jungle. Fine.

Also check pit walls: radius 8.5 around pit centers (24,26) & (-24,-26); 180° arc on side away from lane. Verify count = 36.

Let me write the function + caching + run probe.

## 1. 地图外周整圈城墙
原来只有 `_generate_lane_edge_walls()`，四条边只铺了 `|t| ≤ 37` 的中段，**四个角全是缺口**。新增 [BattleManager.gd](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd) `_generate_outer_walls()`：

- 沿 `|x|=63` / `|z|=63` 补满 `|t| > 37` 的所有段（步长 2，朝内），与已有中段无缝衔接 → 一圈闭合
- **野区两个外角 `(-63,-63)` / `(63,-63)`→`(63,63)` 圆弧倒角**：半径 8.5 与两条边线相切、每角 10 段，直角变成圆弧城墙转角
- **泉水处自动让开**：新增 `_add_outer_wall()`，距蓝/红泉水中心 < 7m 的落点直接跳过（喷泉池半径 5.25，实测最近城墙距泉水 **7.07m**，不会插进池子）
- `_add_wall()` 增加 `force` 参数：外周城墙需要绕过"高地内不立墙"的过滤，同时仍保留草丛避让

实测（自动探针统计）：城墙总数 **520 → 592**，外周最大空隙 **1.0m**（除两个基地角，见下）。

- **CURRENT newest request** (verbatim): "请不要用我给的墙体、草丛模型，你自己生产一版更逼真的墙体、草丛；优化泉水的视觉效果"

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 headless/windowed; **real binary path** `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe` (the `.exe` path is a DIRECTORY containing the real exe + `*_console.exe`); copy to `.cache\godot47.exe`, delete `.cache` + probe dirs afterwards.
- Probe pattern: temp dir `devXXX/` with `.tscn` + `.gd`; headless `Start-Process .cache\godot47.exe -ArgumentList '--headless','--path','.','res://devXXX/chk.tscn','--quit-after','300' -NoNewWindow -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput devXXX\c.out -RedirectStandardError devXXX\c.err`; windowed adds `--audio-driver','Dummy','--position','2000,2000'`; real-scene smoke `res://scenes/battle.tscn` windowed ~380 frames.
- Scripts parse-check via `load(p) is GDScript` inside probe `_ready()`.
- Warnings-as-errors: every Variant-inferred local needs explicit type.
- `MinimapDraw.gd` has **no `class_name`** → probe/other files must `preload("res://scripts/ui/MinimapDraw.gd")` (inner classes cannot see outer `const`, so use local `var md = preload(...)` inside inner-class methods).
- CanvasItem `draw_*` only in `_draw`. SubViewport (`transparent_bg = true`) + `get_texture().get_image()` + pixel counting is the working way to verify procedural visuals numerically (model cannot see images — `read_image` unsupported).

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

用户时间与预算有限，**每个任务都必须为省时间/省 token 服务**：

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a reminder in the current session that delivers prompt when it becomes due. Supply exactly one timing parameter: after_seconds, at, every_seconds, daily, weekly, or cron. Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

prompt.description: Reminder content to present when the target becomes due.

title.description: Concise task name in the user's language, at most 120 characters. Name only the core action and subject; keep essential target identifiers such as PR numbers and branch names. Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

every_seconds.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60, aligned to the creation time; changing it with schedule_update re-aligns it to the save time.

daily.description: Every day at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 23:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 09:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays, Monday 1 through Sunday 7, without repetitions.

cron.description: Five-field Vixie cron expression in a time zone.

expression.description: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, for example "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5". When both day fields are restricted, a date matches if either one matches.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

at.description: Absolute target: an RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a local date, time, and IANA time_zone.

tools.name: spawn_teammate
tools.description: Create one named, durable teammate. Only the Team Lead may call this tool.

description.description: Short description of the delegated responsibility.

prompt.description: Complete initial task for the teammate.

context.description: fresh starts without Lead history; fork inherits completed Lead turns. Defaults to fresh.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

tools.name: subagent_fork
tools.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

923: 	var roles = {"刺客": [], "法师": [], "射手": [], "战士": [], "辅助": [], "坦克": []}

929: 		elif r == "射手": roles["射手"].append(type)
930: 		elif r == "辅助": roles["辅助"].append(type)
931: 		elif r == "坦克": roles["坦克"].append(type)
932: 		else: roles["战士"].append(type)
933: 	var picks = []
934: 	# 指定英雄优先（BP 结果）：按数组顺序，跳过不存在/空值/重复

939: 		picks.append(fname)
940: 	var required = ["刺客", "法师", "射手", "战士", "辅助"]

954: 			picks.append(avail[randi() % avail.size()])
955: 	# 若所需英雄数 > 已选数，用剩余英雄补齐
956: 	var all_remaining = []
957: 	for r in roles:
958: 		for t in roles[r]:
959: 			if not picks.has(t): all_remaining.append(t)
960: 	all_remaining.shuffle()
961: 	var k := 0
962: 	while picks.size() < count and k < all_remaining.size():
963: 		picks.append(all_remaining[k])
964: 		k += 1
965: 	for type in picks:

{"command":"$p = (Resolve-Path 'scripts\core\BattleManager.gd'); $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$t = [regex]::Replace($t, 'var blue := Vector2\(-58\.0, 58\.0\)\r?\n\tvar red := Vector2\(58\.0, -58\.0\)\r?\n\tvar p := Vector2\(pos\.x, pos\.z\)\r?\n\tif p\.distance_to\(blue\) < 7\.0 or p\.distance_to\(red\) < 7\.0:', "var blue := Vector2(-62.0, 62.0)`n`tvar red := Vector2(62.0, -62.0)`n`tvar p := Vector2(pos.x, pos.z)`n`tif p.distance_to(blue) < 5.3 or p.distance_to(red) < 5.3:")
"skip_ok=" + $t.Contains("Vector2(-62.0, 62.0)")
# 泉水外周石环（基地角 270°）
$anchor = "## 外周城墙落点：避开泉水"
$ring = @'
	# 泉水外周城墙（基地角）：以泉水为圆心半径 4.35 的 270° 石环，
	# 朝地图内的 90° 留出入口；石环同时把外周城墙在基地角上的缺口补齐
	for corner in [Vector2(-62, 62), Vector2(62, -62)]:
		var c: Vector2 = corner
		var inward_ang: float = 315.0 if c.x < 0.0 else 135.0
		for i in range(30):
			var ang: float = 12.0 * float(i)
			var rel: float = fposmod(ang - inward_ang + 180.0, 360.0) - 180.0
			if absf(rel) <= 45.0:
				continue
			var a: float = deg_to_rad(ang)
			_add_wall(Vector3(c.x + cos(a) * 4.35, 0.0, c.y + sin(a) * 4.35), Vector3(cos(a), 0.0, sin(a)), true)

'@.Replace("`r`n", "`n").TrimEnd("`n") + "`n`n"
$idx = $t.IndexOf($anchor)
"anchor_at=$idx"
$t = $t.Substring(0, $idx) + $ring + $t.Substring($idx)
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t)
"ring_ok=" + $t.Contains("泉水外周城墙（基地角）")

$p = (Resolve-Path 'scripts\entities\Hero.gd'); $h = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$hp = @(
	@("var spring = Vector3(-58,0,58) if team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Vector3(58,0,-58)", "var spring = Vector3(-62,0,62) if team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Vector3(62,0,-62)"),
	@("var player_spring = Vector3(-58, 0, 58)", "var player_spring = Vector3(-62, 0, 62)"),
	@("var enemy_spring = Vector3(58, 0, -58)", "var enemy_spring = Vector3(62, 0, -62)"),
	@("var spring_radius = 5.0", "var spring_radius = 3.6"),
	@("var spring := Vector3(-58.0, 0.0, 58.0) if team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Vector3(58.0, 0.0, -58.0)", "var spring := Vector3(-62.0, 0.0, 62.0) if team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Vector3(62.0, 0.0, -62.0)"),
	@("return global_position.distance_to(spring) <= 5.0", "return global_position.distance_to(spring) <= 3.6"),
	@("wukong_cloud_target = Vector3(-58, 0, 58) if team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Vector3(58, 0, -58)", "wukong_cloud_target = Vector3(-60, 0, 60) if team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Vector3(60, 0, -60)"),
	@("global_position = Vector3(-58, 0, 58)", "global_position = Vector3(-60, 0, 60)"),
	@("global_position = Vector3(58, 0, -58)", "global_position = Vector3(60, 0, -60)"),
	@("global_position = Vector3(-58, 0, 58) if team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Vector3(58, 0, -58)", "global_position = Vector3(-60, 0, 60) if team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Vector3(60, 0, -60)")
)
$hmiss = @()
foreach ($pr in $hp) { if ($h.Contains($pr[0])) { $h = $h.Replace($pr[0], $pr[1]) } else { $hmiss += $pr[0] } }
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $h)
"HERO_MISS=" + $hmiss.Count
$hmiss
$p = (Resolve-Path 'scripts\entities\HeroAI.gd'); $a = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$a = $a.Replace("Vector3(-58, 0, 58) if hero.team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Vector3(58, 0, -58)", "Vector3(-60, 0, 60) if hero.team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Vector3(60, 0, -60)")
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $a)
"AI ok=" + $a.Contains("Vector3(-60, 0, 60)")
$p = (Resolve-Path 'scripts\core\MapVisuals.gd'); $m = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$m = $m.Replace("uniform float wave_strength = 0.055;", "uniform float wave_strength = 0.040;")
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $m)
"WAVE ok=" + $m.Contains("wave_strength = 0.040")","description":"Add fountain ring walls and move spring logic"}

content.text:
四项都改完，实测数据如下。

## 1. 泉水沿中路对角线外移，且不再与水晶攻击圈重合
- 泉水中心：`(-58,58)` → **`(-62,62)`**（红方镜像 `(62,-62)`），沿对角线外移 5.7m
- 池子整体缩到约 2/3：水盘 4.42→**2.95**，池底 5.25→**3.50**，石沿 5.05→**3.37**，符文环 5.55→**3.72**，光晕 5.3→**3.60**（石座/水柱/水花/灯光同比缩放）
- 回血圈半径 `spring_radius` 5.0 → **3.6**（Hero 两处判定同步）
- **实测**：泉水到水晶 **12.73m**；水晶攻击范围 **8.90m**；泉水最外符文环 12.73−3.72 = **9.01 > 8.90**，回血圈 12.73−3.6 = **9.13 > 8.90** → 零重合

## 2. 泉水外周城墙
以泉水为圆心、半径 **4.35** 的 **270° 石环**（每 12° 一堵，每方 22 堵；朝地图内侧的 90° 留出入口）：
- 实测环上城墙 24 堵，最近城墙距泉水中心 **4.35m**（不插进池子，池外沿 3.6）
- 同时兼任基地角的外周闭合墙

## 3. 地图外周补缝（无缺口）
- 石环与地图边界外墙之间加接缝墙：`(-63,57.5)`、`(-57.5,63)`（红方镜像），并把外墙避让半径按新泉水位置重算
- **实测**：边界最大空隙 **1.00m**（= 墙间距 2m 的正常中点），接缝点最近墙距 **0.27~0.50m** → 视觉与逻辑上都是连续城墙
- 城墙总数 592 → **640**（网格已做变体共享，6 堵共用一份 584 面网格，不额外吃内存）

## 4. 分路平面高于河道（分路上不能有水）
根因：水面 shader 顶点波动把水面最高抬到 `0.02 + 0.055 = 0.075`，而分路平面只有 `0.05` → 水从分路表面冒出来。修正：
- `_add_lane_plane` 平面 y：**0.05 → 0.14**
- 水面波动 `wave_strength`：0.055 → **0.040**（水面最高 `0.06`）
- 结果：分路面 0.14 > 水面 0.06，**分路平面上不会再出现水**

## 5. 出生点同步
英雄/AI 出生点 `(-58,58)` → **`(-60,60)`**（Hero 6 处、HeroAI 2 处、BattleManager 2 处），距泉水中心 2.83m，**在 3.6 回血圈内**，出生即享受泉水回血。

验证：`walls=640`、`fountain children=9`、`fountain→crystal=12.73`、`lane_plane_y=0.14 / 水面最高 0.06`，**0 条 SCRIPT/SHADER ERROR**，探针与 `.cache` 已清理。

> 可调项：英雄移动仍被钳制在 ±60（`Hero.gd` 的 `Config.MAP_SIZE/2`），所以出生点在地图边线上、泉水中心在边界外 2m —— 视觉上英雄站在泉水边。若想让人物能真正走进泉水中心，把钳制放宽到 ±63 即可（城墙已经围住，不会跑出去）。

1688: 	var bushes: Array = []
1689: 	var bush_arr = bm.get("_bush_positions")
1690: 	if bush_arr != null:
1691: 		for p in bush_arr:
1692: 			bushes.append([float(p.x), float(p.z)])
1693: 	var walls: Array = []
1694: 	for w in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("walls"):
1695: 		if is_instance_valid(w):
1696: 			walls.append([w.global_position.x, w.global_position.z, w.rotation.y])
1697: 	var packs: Array = []
1698: 	for hp in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("health_packs"):
1699: 		if is_instance_valid(hp) and hp.get("available") != null:
1700: 			packs.append([hp.global_position.x, hp.global_position.z, int(hp.team)])
1701: 	var camps: Array = []
1702: 	var camp_arr = bm.get("jungle_camp_positions")
1703: 	if camp_arr != null:
1704: 		for c in camp_arr:
1705: 			camps.append([float(c.x), float(c.z)])
1706: 	return { "bushes": bushes, "walls": walls, "camps": camps, "packs": packs }

三处都已改好。

## 1. 边路一塔、二塔外周补墙
实测原来塔到最近墙的距离是 **8.0~10.6m**（塔站在 16m 宽的分路正中，两侧墙离得远），所以看着像"没有墙"。

新增 `_generate_tower_pockets()`：对 **8 座边路一塔/二塔**（发育路、对抗路 × 红蓝），沿分路方向在塔两侧各铺一排石墙（垂直分路 **±4.6m**，沿路 −3/−1.5/0/+1.5/+3 共 5 段），塔口形成石头夹道；中路塔保持原样不铺。

- 实测：所有边路一塔/二塔 **最近墙距 = 4.60m**（原 8.0~10.6m）
- 城墙总数 640 → **720**

## 2. 水面与分路平面的接缝
分路平面抬到 y=0.14 后，边缘与水面（最高 0.06）之间是一条硬台阶。修法：给 **6 条分路的两侧长边各加一条石质路缘**（宽 0.6m、高 0.22m，向下压 0.04 卡住台阶，材质直接复用墙体的岩石着色器）：

- 路缘由分路平面继承旋转，自动对齐三条路的走向
- 视觉上分路变成"有石沿的道路"，水面止于路缘外，不再是一条悬空薄片的硬切边
- 实测每条分路 2 条路缘、位置 y=−0.04（贴地压边）

## 3. 高地外周墙换成更高规格墙体
`DecorMesh.wall_visual_hq()`（新增）——结构完全重做，不是放大普通墙：
- **双层外挑基座**（1.42 / 1.26 宽，压住地面）
- **8 层错缝方石**，每层 2~3 块、横向错位 + 尺寸微抖（凿石砌筑感）
- **两级檐口压顶** + **两侧竖向边柱**
- 基底碎石 + 苔藓土盘沿用
- 实测 616 面、高 2.93m（与 3.0 碰撞高度一致），4 种变体网格共享

高地外周 12 堵墙全部换用：
- 主机：`_add_wall(pos, facing, false, hq=true)` → `Wall.hq` → `_ready` 选 HQ 模型
- 联机：墙的 map payload 增加**第 4 位 `hq` 标记**（旧客户端忽略多余字段，兼容），客户端 `NetModels.wall(hq)` 用同一套 HQ 模型 → **两端完全一致**（不靠距离猜，避免误判）

验证：`walls=720 / hq=12`、8 座塔最近墙 4.60m、路缘 2 条/路、`NetSession/NetClientBattle/NetModels/Wall/DecorMesh/BattleManager` 6 个脚本 `load() -> true`、**0 条 SCRIPT/SHADER ERROR**，探针与 `.cache` 已清理。

{"content":"extends RefCounted
## 程序化防御塔模型（替换 model/turret/Turret.glb）：八角石塔 + 队伍色发光刻纹；
## 水晶为十二角基座 + 立柱 + 悬浮晶核。主机与联机客户端共用同一套构建函数。
## 尺寸对齐旧模型：普通塔 ≈2.2 宽 × 3.5 高，水晶 ≈3.0 宽 × 4.2 高（塔口 y≈2.0 / 3.0）。

const DecorMesh = preload("res://scripts/entities/DecorMesh.gd")

static var _accent_mats: Dictionary = {}
static var _crystal_mats: Dictionary = {}

static func team_color(team: int) -> Color:
	return Color(1.0, 0.32, 0.24) if team == 1 else Color(0.26, 0.58, 1.0)

static func accent_material(team: int) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	if _accent_mats.has(team):
		return _accent_mats[team]
	var c: Color = team_color(team)
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(c.r * 0.45, c.g * 0.45, c.b * 0.45, 1.0)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = c
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = 1.5
	m.roughness = 0.35
	m.metallic = 0.25
	_accent_mats[team] = m
	return m

static func crystal_material(team: int) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	if _crystal_mats.has(team):
		return _crystal_mats[team]
	var c: Color = team_color(team)
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(c.r * 0.55, c.g * 0.55, c.b * 0.55, 1.0)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = c
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.4
	m.roughness = 0.12
	m.metallic = 0.15
	_crystal_mats[team] = m
	return m

## 构建一座塔的视觉节点（root 自带 "_fx_team_tint" 标记，阻止 UnitVisuals 二次染色）
static func visual(tier: String, team: int) -> Node3D:
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "TurretVisual"
	root.set_meta("_fx_team_tint", true)
	var stone := MeshInstance3D.new()
	stone.name = "Stone"
	stone.mesh = _build_crystal_stone() if tier == "crystal" else _build_tower_stone()
	stone.material_override = DecorMesh.rock_material()
	stone.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON
	root.add_child(stone)
	if tier == "crystal":
		var pivot := Node3D.new()
		pivot.name = "CrystalPivot"
		pivot.position = Vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
		root.add_child(pivot)
		var body := MeshInstance3D.new()
		body.name = "Crystal"
		body.mesh = _octa(0.72, 2.30)
		body.position = Vector3(0.0, 3.05, 0.0)
		body.material_override = crystal_material(team)
		body.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON
		pivot.add_child(body)
		var core := MeshInstance3D.new()
		core.name = "Core"
		core.mesh = _octa(0.34, 1.10)
		core.position = Vector3(0.0, 3.05, 0.0)
		core.material_override = accent_material(team)
		pivot.add_child(core)
		var ring := MeshInstance3D.new()
		ring.name = "Ring"
		ring.mesh = _torus(1.10, 0.055, 24, 6)
		ring.position = Vector3(0.0, 2.05, 0.0)
		ring.material_override = accent_material(team)
		pivot.add_child(ring)
		var halo := MeshInstance3D.new()
		halo.name = "Halo"
		halo.mesh = _torus(1.02, 0.07, 24, 6)
		halo.position = Vector3(0.0, 1.32, 0.0)
		halo.material_override = accent_material(team)
		root.add_child(halo)
	else:
		var accent := MeshInstance3D.new()
		accent.name = "Accent"
		accent.mesh = _build_tower_accent()
		accent.material_override = accent_material(team)
		root.add_child(accent)
	return root

# ==================== 普通塔 ====================

static func _build_tower_stone() -> ArrayMesh:
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	# 八角基座（两级台阶）
	_put(st, _cyl(1.10, 1.20, 0.30, 8), Vector3(0.0, 0.15, 0.0))

# ==================== 水晶 ====================

static func _build_crystal_stone() -> ArrayMesh:
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	# 十二角基座（三级）
	_put(st, _cyl(1.36, 1.50, 0.40, 12), Vector3(0.0, 0.20, 0.0))
	_put(st, _cyl(1.16, 1.28, 0.26, 12), Vector3(0.0, 0.53, 0.0))
	_put(st, _cyl(1.04, 1.14, 0.55, 12), Vector3(0.0, 0.94, 0.0))
	# 六根立柱
	var pillar := BoxMesh.new()
	pillar.size = Vector3(0.20, 1.15, 0.20)
	for i: int in range(6):
		var a: float = TAU * float(i) / 6.0 + PI / 6.0
		var b := Basis(Vector3.UP, -a)
		st.append_from(pillar, 0, Transform3D(b, Vector3(cos(a) * 0.93, 1.78, sin(a) * 0.93)))
	# 中央石座
	_put(st, _cyl(0.40, 0.64, 0.45, 8), Vector3(0.0, 1.38, 0.0))
	# 基座碎石
	var rock := _rock()
	for i: int in range(6):
		var a2: float = TAU * float(i) / 6.0 + 0.4
		var rr: float = 0.12 + 0.05 * fmod(float(i) * 0.41, 1.0)
		st.append_from(rock, 0, Transform3D(Basis().scaled(Vector3(rr, rr * 0.7, rr)),
			Vector3(cos(a2) * 1.56, rr * 0.5, sin(a2) * 1.56)))
	st.append_from(_disc(1.66, 0.07, 12), 0, Transform3D(Basis(), Vector3(0.0, 0.035, 0.0)))
	return st.commit()

# ==================== 基础网格工具 ====================

static func _put(st: SurfaceTool, mesh: Mesh, pos: Vector3) -> void:
	st.append_from(mesh, 0, Transform3D(Basis(), pos))

static func _cyl(top_r: float, bottom_r: float, height: float, segs: int) -> CylinderMesh:
	var cm := CylinderMesh.new()
	cm.top_radius = top_r
	cm.bottom_radius = bottom_r
	cm.height = height
	cm.radial_segments = segs
	return cm

static func _disc(radius: float, height: float, segs: int) -> CylinderMesh:
	return _cyl(radius, radius * 1.06, height, segs)

static func _torus(inner_r: float, tube: float, rings: int, segs: int) -> TorusMesh:
	var tm := TorusMesh.new()
	tm.inner_radius = inner_r
	tm.outer_radius = inner_r + tube * 2.0
	tm.rings = rings
	tm.ring_segments = segs
	return tm

static func _sphere(radius: float) -> SphereMesh:
	var sm := SphereMesh.new()
	sm.radius = radius
	sm.height = radius * 2.0
	sm.radial_segments = 8
	sm.rings = 4
	return sm

static func _rock() -> SphereMesh:
	var rm := SphereMesh.new()
	rm.radius = 1.0
	rm.height = 2.0
	rm.radial_segments = 5
	rm.rings = 3
	return rm

## 八面体（晶核）：半径 r、总高 h，平面着色
static func _octa(r: float, h: float) -> ArrayMesh:
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	var top := Vector3(0.0, h * 0.5, 0.0)
	var bot := Vector3(0.0, -h * 0.5, 0.0)
	var ring: Array[Vector3] = [
		Vector3(r, 0.0, 0.0), Vector3(0.0, 0.0, r), Vector3(-r, 0.0, 0.0), Vector3(0.0, 0.0, -r)
	]
	for i: int in range(4):
		var p1: Vector3 = ring[i]
		var p2: Vector3 = ring[(i + 1) % 4]
		st.add_vertex(top)
		st.add_vertex(p1)
		st.add_vertex(p2)
		st.add_vertex(bot)
		st.add_vertex(p2)
		st.add_vertex(p1)
	st.generate_normals()
	return st.commit()

## 程序化防御塔模型（替换 model/turret/Turret.glb）：八角石塔 + 队伍色发光刻纹；
## 水晶为十二角基座 + 立柱 + 悬浮晶核。主机与联机客户端共用同一套构建函数。
## 尺寸对齐旧模型：普通塔 ≈2.2 宽 × 3.5 高，水晶 ≈3.0 宽 × 4.2 高（塔口 y≈2.0 / 3.0）。

const DecorMesh = preload("res://scripts/entities/DecorMesh.gd")

static var _accent_mats: Dictionary = {}
static var _crystal_mats: Dictionary = {}

static func team_color(team: int) -> Color:
	return Color(1.0, 0.32, 0.24) if team == 1 else Color(0.26, 0.58, 1.0)

static func accent_material(team: int) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	if _accent_mats.has(team):
		return _accent_mats[team]
	var c: Color = team_color(team)
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(c.r * 0.45, c.g * 0.45, c.b * 0.45, 1.0)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = c
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = 1.5
	m.roughness = 0.35
	m.metallic = 0.25
	_accent_mats[team] = m
	return m

static func crystal_material(team: int) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	if _crystal_mats.has(team):
		return _crystal_mats[team]
	var c: Color = team_color(team)
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(c.r * 0.55, c.g * 0.55, c.b * 0.55, 1.0)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = c
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.4
	m.roughness = 0.12
	m.metallic = 0.15
	_crystal_mats[team] = m
	return m

## 构建一座塔的视觉节点（root 自带 "_fx_team_tint" 标记，阻止 UnitVisuals 二次染色）
static func visual(tier: String, team: int) -> Node3D:
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "TurretVisual"
	root.set_meta("_fx_team_tint", true)
	var stone := MeshInstance3D.new()

	stone.material_override = DecorMesh.rock_material()
	stone.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON
	root.add_child(stone)
	if tier == "crystal":
		var pivot := Node3D.new()
		pivot.name = "CrystalPivot"
		pivot.position = Vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
		root.add_child(pivot)
		var body := MeshInstance3D.new()
		body.name = "Crystal"
		body.mesh = _octa(0.72, 2.30)
		body.position = Vector3(0.0, 3.05, 0.0)
		body.material_override = crystal_material(team)
		body.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON
		pivot.add_child(body)
		var core := MeshInstance3D.new()
		core.name = "Core"
		core.mesh = _octa(0.34, 1.10)
		core.position = Vector3(0.0, 3.05, 0.0)
		core.material_override = accent_material(team)
		pivot.add_child(core)
		var ring := MeshInstance3D.new()
		ring.name = "Ring"
		ring.mesh = _torus(1.10, 0.055, 24, 6)
		ring.position = Vector3(0.0, 2.05, 0.0)
		ring.material_override = accent_material(team)

		halo.material_override = accent_material(team)
		root.add_child(halo)
	else:

		accent.name = "Accent"

# ==================== 普通塔 ====================

static func _build_tower_stone() -> ArrayMesh:

		var a: float = TAU * float(i) / 4.0 + PI / 4.0
		var b := Basis(Vector3.UP, a)
		st.append_from(rib, 0, Transform3D(b, Vector3(cos(a) * 0.74, 1.42, sin(a) * 0.74)))

	var merlon := BoxMesh.new()
	merlon.size = Vector3(0.22, 0.26, 0.16)
	for i: int in range(8):

nm_turret=True
client_team=True
T L2: const TurretMesh = preload("res://scripts/entities/TurretMesh.gd")
T L12: var _crystal_pivot: Node3D = null          # 水晶晶核（悬浮动画用）
T L92: var vis := TurretMesh.visual(str(display_name), team)
T L94: _crystal_pivot = vis.get_node_or_null("CrystalPivot") as Node3D
T L226: if _crystal_pivot != null and is_instance_valid(_crystal_pivot):
T L228: _crystal_pivot.rotation.y += delta * 0.45
T L229: _crystal_pivot.position.y = sin(_crystal_t * 1.6) * 0.07

But wait: our builder sets meta `_fx_team_tint` on root; tint_team checks `root.has_meta("_fx_team_tint")` → returns early ✓.

Host: Turret._create_visual no longer calls tint_team ✓.

Also crystal pivot position: I set `pivot.position = Vector3.ZERO` then in _process set `position.y = sin(...)*0.07` → fine, and its children are positioned absolutely (crystal at y 3.05) so bob moves whole assembly ±0.07 ✓.

But note pivot.rotation.y rotating will rotate child positions (they're centered on Y axis: x=0,z=0 → only crystal & core spin in place ✓; ring is at y 2.05 centered ✓). Good.

Now also there may be other places using `TURRET_GLB` (e.g., minimap? turret ghost preview?). Check leftover references to Turret.glb. Also `_create_range_preview` unaffected.

Then verify: probe: create turret visuals for each tier & team, print tri counts + AABB heights; run battle scene smoke to catch errors; check hero bullet origin unaffected.
