## Primary Request and Intent
- Project-wide efficiency rule (Chinese, permanent): "我的时间和预算不是很足，请你在这个项目尽可能快速完成我的任务并节省token用量，把这一条作为这个项目的原则" — recorded in `CLAUDE.md` → `## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)` (shortest path, grep-first reading, minimal verification, terse output, **must** run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"` before final answer).
- Earlier completed rounds: weapon binding/animations, mobile HUD, marker icons, hero-select 2-stage flow + rework, tower bases as obstacles (later removed), blue top-lane minion path, random blue/red side (camera flip, relative UI colors).
- Round N-2 (delivered): "实现：玩家被随机分到蓝方或红方…UI层的颜色只与是否为友方或敌方有关，但小兵和防御塔模型颜色变了".
- Round N-1 (delivered): "感觉现在小兵的移动逻辑怪怪的，删除对塔心所在格不可走的限制吧，改为自动推挤，会把小兵推开".
- Round N (delivered): "玩家被分配为红方时，选英雄和加载界面就应该在红方，还有小地图需要反转过来；注意，玩家的血条始终为绿色".
- **Current task (verbatim)**: "把泉水区域改为可以行走" — make the spring/fountain area walkable.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2; binary copied for headless use: `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe` → `.cache\godot47.exe` (create `.cache` + `devfxNN` probe dir first; delete both after delivery).
- Export: `Start-Process .cache\godot47.exe -ArgumentList '--headless','--path','.','--export-release','"Windows Desktop"','HonorKing.exe'`; expect `exit=0`, `err_count=0` (stderr grep `SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error`).
- Smoke: `HonorKing.exe --headless --quit-after 300` → exit 0; then `Get-Process godot47 | Stop-Process -Force`; remove probe dir + `.cache`.
- Probe pattern: `devfxNN\probe.gd` (`extends Node`, `_ready` instantiates `res://scenes/battle.tscn`, `process_mode = ALWAYS`), `probe.tscn`, run `--headless --path . res://devfxNN/probe.tscn --quit-after N`, grep stdout `^L ` lines. Force team via `Config.player_team = Config.Team.ENEMY; Config._team_rolled = true` then `bm._start_game_body("亚瑟","flash")` at frame 20; team check at ~frame 80.
- GDScript pitfalls: `var p := untyped.global_position` fails parse ("Cannot infer the type of p"); use `var p: Vector3 = ...`; typed array literal iteration `for p: Vector3 in [...]` also fails.
- Pathfinding: `PathFinder.build_navigation_map()` marks walls solid; turrets now only weighted (`TURRET_BASE_WEIGHT = 6.0`, radius 3.6, walkable); `TURRET_DANGER_WEIGHT = 4.0` for enemy tower zones applied per-call, restored to `_turret_base_weight.get(cell,1.0)`.
- Push model: `CollisionSystem.apply_collision_pushback(entities, delta)` — mob-vs-mob pairs (excludes Turret/Hero), then tower push (all non-Turret `can_move` entities, radius 3.35 + `body_radius*0.35`) + `tower_stumps` group (radius 2.05), then wall push.
- Camera: third-person pitch -60°, follow offset `Vector3(0,12,8)` rotated by `cam_yaw`; red player gets `cam_yaw = PI`, offset rotated → `(0,12,-8)`; input `cam_flip = -1.0` when red.
- Map spring centers: blue `(-62,0,62)`, red `(62,0,-62)`; hero spawn blue `(-60,0,60)`, red `(60,0,-60)`; crystals `(-53,53)` / `(53,-53)`; heal radius `is_in_own_fountain()` = `distance_to(spring) <= 3.6`.
- Fountain visuals: `_add_fountain(center,color)` (basin radius 3.30/3.50, rim torus 2.87→3.37, water 2.95, pedestal 0.42→0.72, rune ring radius 3.72, glow 3.60) — **no collision body**.
- Spring enclosure: `_generate_outer_walls()` at ~L2188-2206 creates 270° stone ring radius 4.35 around each spring (walls every 12°, skipped where |rel| ≤ 45° toward map interior: `inward_ang = 315.0` blue / `135.0` red), plus seam walls `(-63,0,57.5)` axis `(1,0,0)`, `(-57.5,0,63)` axis `(0,0,-1)`, `(63,0,-57.5)` axis `(-1,0,0)`, `(57.5,0,-63)` axis `(0,0,1)`.
- `_add_outer_wall(pos,facing,len=2.0,outer_style=true)` skips any pos within 5.3 of either spring center; `_add_wall(pos, facing, avoid_spring=true, ...)` used by ring.
- Minimap red flip: `_flip180()` = `Config.player_team == Config.Team.ENEMY`; applied in `_world_to_minimap` (`p = Vector2(MINIMAP_SIZE - p.x, MINIMAP_SIZE - p.y)`), inverse in `_local_to_world` and `_get_entity_at_minimap`; terrain texture drawn with `Rect2(Vector2(MINIMAP_SIZE,MINIMAP_SIZE), Vector2(-MINIMAP_SIZE,-MINIMAP_SIZE))`; fog grid `.reverse()` rows+cols; hero `dir = -dir`; objectives text (fixed bottom-left) unaffected.

## Files and Code
- `scripts/core/Config.gd`: `player_team`, `is_ally(team)`, `foe_team()`, `roll_player_team()`, `reset_player_team()`, `Team {PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2}`.
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` (~5200 lines):
  - `cam_yaw` var; `_start_game_body()` sets `cam_yaw = PI` + `cam.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-60, rad_to_deg(cam_yaw), 0)` when player red.
  - New helpers added before `_refresh_sel_preview`: `func sel_side_col() -> Color: return UiKit.C_TEAM0 if Config.player_team == Config.Team.PLAYER else UiKit.C_TEAM1` and `sel_foe_col()` inverse.
  - Select UI now uses `sel_side_col()`/`sel_foe_col()` for: backdrop (`UiKit.make_backdrop(root, sel_side_col(), 1.0)`), top card `skin_card`, "我方"/"敌方" tags, pick panel `pick_style`, skill tip card, `_create_mini_slot` (kind 1/2 chip + accent), `_create_team_seat` (kind 1/2 seat chip + accent).
  - `spawn_tower_stump()`: added `stump.add_to_group("tower_stumps")` before `add_child(stump)` (~L1138).
  - Minion lane waypoints unchanged (all waypoints sit on tower positions).
- `scripts/core/PathFinder.gd`:
  - `const TURRET_BASE_WEIGHT: float = 6.0`, `TURRET_DANGER_WEIGHT: float = 4.0`; `var _turret_base_weight: Dictionary = {}`.
  - `build_navigation_map()`: after wall marking, loop turrets → `_mark_base_weight(x, z, 3.6)` (walkable, high cost).
  - New `_mark_base_weight(wx, wz, radius)` sets weight + records dict; `_unmark_turret_danger_zones()` restores `float(_turret_base_weight.get(cell, 1.0))`; danger marking uses `maxf(TURRET_DANGER_WEIGHT, float(_turret_base_weight.get(cell, 1.0)))`.
  - Removed: `TURRET_BLOCK_RADIUS`, `_turret_solid_cells`, `_turret_blocks`, `_mark_solid_radius`, `_last_mark_cells`, `low_clearance` param/`_released` mechanism (all deleted).
- `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd`: added tower/stump push block inserted before wall push block; uses `entities`, skips `Turret`, `collision_layer == 0`, `can_move`, clamps `Config.MAP_SIZE/2`.
- `scripts/entities/Minion.gd`: waypoint movement restored to simple `dir = (target_pos - global_position).normalized(); dir = _avoid_walls(dir, delta, target_pos); global_position += dir * move_speed*0.01*delta`; new fields `var _wp_idx_cached: int = -1`, `var _wp_reach: float = 1.0`; per-waypoint reach = 5.0 if waypoint within 5.0 of a turret or `tower_stumps` member else 1.0; advance when `distance_to(target_pos) < _wp_reach`.
- `scripts/entities/GameEntity.gd`: `_avoid_walls(move_dir, delta, destination=ZERO, attack_range=-1.0, attack_target=ZERO)` — `low_clearance` param removed; A* debug label still `var _side := "己" if team == 0 else "敌"` (left intentionally, debug print only).
- `scripts/ui/MiniMap.gd`: `_flip180()`, flipped `_world_to_minimap`, `_local_to_world`, `_get_entity_at_minimap`, terrain texture mirrored, fog grid reversed, hero arrow negated; `player_team` field still drives ally/enemy colors.
- `scripts/ui/HUD.gd` L177-187: `row["team"]`; then `var _bm := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager") as BattleManager`; if `_bm.hero == entity` → `row["team_color"] = Color(0.33, 0.95, 0.42, 1.0)` else `match int(entity.team)` (0/1 ally blue vs red, 2 green, `_` yellow) — match arms now 3 tabs.
- `scripts/ui/HeroInfoControl.gd` ~L161-164: `var _bm`, `var _is_self := _bm != null and _bm.hero != null and is_instance_valid(_bm.hero) and _bm.hero == hero`; `var tc: Color = Color(0.33, 0.95, 0.42) if _is_self else (Color(0.0, 0.886, 1.0) if Config.is_ally(hero.team) else Color(1.0, 0.33, 0.264))`.
- `scripts/ui/LoadingScreen.gd`: backdrop `UiKit.make_backdrop(_root, UiKit.C_TEAM0 if Config.player_team == Config.Team.PLAYER else UiKit.C_TEAM1, 0.85)`; `_mk_card()` uses `var blue_side := Config.player_team == Config.Team.PLAYER` then `team_color: Color = (C_TEAM0 if blue_side else C_TEAM1) if ally else (C_TEAM1 if blue_side else C_TEAM0)`; `_hero_entry()` already maps `team_id` relative.
- Other UI (previous round, done): `HealthBarControl.gd`, `HUD.gd`, `HeroInfoControl.gd`, `DeathRecapView.gd`, `UI_Manager.gd` (13 spots), `RosterView.gd`, `SfxManager.gd`, `Turret.gd`, `Hero.gd` visibility/assist/`_cc_burst`, all relative via `Config.is_ally`.
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` spring code: `_add_fountain` called at L439-440 for `(-62,0,62)` / `(62,0,-62)`; fountain builder L760-892; `_generate_outer_walls()` L2167-2206 (ring + seam); `_add_outer_wall` L2209-2215 (skips within 5.3 of spring), `_generate_high_ground_walls()` L2217-2241.

## Errors and Fixes
- PowerShell `function R` / `MP` collided with builtin aliases (`r`, `mp`) → renamed helpers (`Rep2`, `ER`, `ER2`, `ER3`); use `$script:` scoping.
- Multi-line replacements fail on indentation mismatch → inspect exact lines with `Get-Content` + `-replace "`t","→"` and include tabs literally; blank lines inside indented blocks are `"\t"`.
- Probe parse errors: `var p :=` on untyped source, and `for p: Vector3 in [untyped array]` → use `var pts: Array[Vector3] = [...]` + `for pp in pts` or `var p: Vector3 = ...`.
- First tower-removal attempt left minions stuck: A* path through tower base gives waypoints inside the physical push ring (e.g. path point `(-35,53)` 2.0 m from tower `(-35,55)`) → minions pressed into the push circle, `_stuck_timer` recovery oscillated, whole wave crawled near `(-33,51)`. Fix: revert to weighted (non-solid) tower base cells so A* routes around the ring, keep 5.0 m waypoint arrival radius; verified smooth progression `-43,53 → -36,51 → -22,52 → 0,52 → 24,54`, waypoints 0→1→2→3.
- Hero manual walk through tower verified: start `(-45,55)` target `(-20,55)` ended `(-25,52)`, min distance ~4.5 → pushed/slid around, no stuck.
- Minion tower damage verified: melee minion at `(52,28)` (5.17 m from red tower) dealt 135 damage (attack reach 2.0+3.2=5.2 > push radius).
- `Minion._wp_reach` raised from 4.6 to 5.0 (A* avoids ring at ≥4.0, threshold must exceed push distance).
- Comment line got merged onto `_turret_base_weight` declaration → cleaned manually.
- LoadingScreen probe prints harmless headless `ERROR: Condition "!is_inside_tree()" is true. Returning: Transform3D()` and `user://logs` errors — not caused by changes.

## Pending Jobs
- Implement "把泉水区域改为可以行走": likely remove/replace the 270° stone ring walls around both springs in `_generate_outer_walls()` (L2188-2206) so units can walk freely into/through the fountain plaza; keep map enclosure reasonable (seam walls at `(-63,0,57.5)`, `(-57.5,0,63)`, `(63,0,-57.5)`, `(57.5,0,-63)`; `_add_outer_wall` already skips within 5.3 of spring).
- Then re-export, smoke test, cleanup `devfxNN` + `.cache`, run `notify.ps1` (`-Title "HonorKing · 泉水可行走"`), give terse summary.

## Current Work
- Just grepped all `fountain` references to locate the blocker; confirmed fountain visuals have no collision body and the only spring-area obstacles are the 270° stone-ring walls (radius 4.35) plus their seam walls generated in `_generate_outer_walls()`. Spring heal radius is 3.6 while hero spawn sits at 2.83 from spring center (inside the ring).
- No code edits made yet for this task; `devfx33`/`.cache` were deleted after the previous delivery (cleanup_ok).

## Next Step
- Edit `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` `_generate_outer_walls()`: delete the `for corner in [Vector2(-62,62), Vector2(62,-62)]` ring-wall loop (the `for i in range(30)` `_add_wall(... 4.35 ...)` body) while keeping the four seam walls, so the spring area is open and walkable; then verify with a headless probe (count walls within radius 5.5 of each spring center / hero walks from spawn to spring center and out), export, smoke test, cleanup, notify.

## Critical Context
- Another process/session concurrently edits this project (e.g. `Hero.gd`, `BattleManager.gd`, `NetClientBattle.gd`, `UI_Manager.gd`, `SfxManager.gd`, `ai/…`); never delete their `_probe_*.gd` at repo root; re-check parse/export up to ~4× with ~20s waits; user's Godot editor is open.
- Design decisions: only `NetSession.Mode.NONE` randomizes side; `Config.player_team` is the single source of truth for relative behavior; UI ally color = `Color(0.0, 0.886, 1.0)` / ring `(0.25,0.85,1.0)`, enemy `Color(1.0,0.33,0.264)`, player self HP green `Color(0.33,0.95,0.42)`, neutral green `Color(0.0,0.886,0.431)`; minion/turret/hero 3D model colors stay absolute team colors (user wants models to change with side).
- Select/loading/loading-card colors follow the player's real side (blue player = blue, red player = red) per latest request, overriding "ally always blue" for those screens only; in-battle UI remains ally-blue/enemy-red.
- Minimap is world-oriented for blue, rotated 180° for red; click/drag/teleport use world coords via inverse flip.
- Own-base absolute positions stay by team id (blue spawn `(-60,0,60)`, red `(60,0,-60)`; crystals `(-53,53)`/`(53,-53)`); movement clamps hero positions to `±Config.MAP_SIZE/2`, so outward wall gaps at map corners are cosmetic.
- Team board: `task-1` (UI relative colors) completed by teammate `ui-colors`; Lead owns core files; no other active teammates.
- Verification standard: headless probe `^L ` lines, export `err_count=0`, smoke `run_exit=0`, cleanup check, `notify.ps1` output must show `popup shown: …`.

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

I need to add the `_update_regen_fx` function implementation to Hero.gd. The edits for vars, call, tick, and health pack are done. Now add the function body. Insert before `func is_in_own_fountain()` or after `_clamp_to_map_edge`.

Then verify with probe: hero takes damage then uses recover → active_regen; also health pack ticks: place hero on pack, check hp increases in 1s steps (hp delta chunk). Verify FX nodes created and visible.

content.arguments:
{"command":"$fp=(Resolve-Path 'scripts\entities\Hero.gd').Path
$t=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($fp)
$eol=if($t.Contains("`r`n")){"`r`n"}else{"`n"}
$anchor='# 是否身处自家泉水（泉水回复 / 元流流派切换 / AI 养伤共用同一半径判据）'
$fn=@'
# 恢复中（泉水/血包/恢复技能等持续回血回蓝）的展示动画：脚下旋转绿环 + 上浮绿光粒子
func _update_regen_fx(delta: float) -> void:
	var active: bool = health > 0.0 and (not active_regen.is_empty() or (is_in_own_fountain() and health < actual_max_health))
	if not active:
		if _regen_ring != null and is_instance_valid(_regen_ring):
			_regen_ring.visible = false
		if _regen_fx != null and is_instance_valid(_regen_fx):
			_regen_fx.emitting = false
		return
	if _regen_ring == null or not is_instance_valid(_regen_ring) or _regen_fx == null or not is_instance_valid(_regen_fx):
		_build_regen_fx()
	_regen_t += delta
	_regen_ring.visible = true
	_regen_fx.emitting = true
	_regen_ring.rotation.y = _regen_t * 1.8
	var pulse: float = 1.0 + 0.10 * sin(_regen_t * 5.5)
	_regen_ring.scale = Vector3(pulse, 1.0, pulse)

func _build_regen_fx() -> void:
	# 脚下绿环
	_regen_ring = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var torus := TorusMesh.new()
	torus.inner_radius = 1.28
	torus.outer_radius = 1.48
	torus.rings = 36
	torus.ring_segments = 8
	_regen_ring.mesh = torus
	var ring_mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	ring_mat.albedo_color = Color(0.28, 1.0, 0.48, 0.50)
	ring_mat.emission_enabled = true
	ring_mat.emission = Color(0.20, 0.95, 0.42)
	ring_mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 1.8
	ring_mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	ring_mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	ring_mat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	ring_mat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	_regen_ring.material_override = ring_mat
	_regen_ring.position = Vector3(0, 0.10, 0)
	_regen_ring.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	_regen_ring.visible = false
	add_child(_regen_ring)
	# 上浮绿色粒子
	_regen_fx = CPUParticles3D.new()
	_regen_fx.amount = 20
	_regen_fx.lifetime = 0.9
	_regen_fx.emitting = false
	_regen_fx.position = Vector3(0, 0.35, 0)
	_regen_fx.emission_shape = CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE
	_regen_fx.emission_sphere_radius = 0.85
	_regen_fx.direction = Vector3.UP
	_regen_fx.spread = 18.0
	_regen_fx.initial_velocity_min = 1.1
	_regen_fx.initial_velocity_max = 2.3
	_regen_fx.gravity = Vector3(0, 1.2, 0)
	_regen_fx.scale_amount_min = 0.5
	_regen_fx.scale_amount_max = 1.1
	_regen_fx.color = Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.62, 0.95)
	var quad := QuadMesh.new()
	quad.size = Vector2(0.16, 0.16)
	_regen_fx.mesh = quad
	var fx_mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	fx_mat.albedo_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9)
	fx_mat.emission_enabled = true
	fx_mat.emission = Color(0.30, 1.0, 0.50)
	fx_mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.2
	fx_mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	fx_mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	fx_mat.billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	fx_mat.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true
	_regen_fx.material_override = fx_mat
	add_child(_regen_fx)

'@
$new=$fn.Replace("`n",$eol)+'# 是否身处自家泉水（泉水回复 / 元流流派切换 / AI 养伤共用同一半径判据）'
if($t.Contains($anchor)){$t=$t.Replace($anchor,$new);[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($fp,$t);'OK fx funcs'}else{'MISS fx funcs'}","description":"Add regen FX builder and updater"}

Copy-Item 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe' '.cache\godot47.exe' -Force
@'
extends Node

var t := 0
var bm = null

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child((load("res://scenes/battle.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate())

func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	t += 1
	if t == 20:
		Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER
		Config._team_rolled = true
		bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
		bm._start_game_body("亚瑟", "flash")
	elif t == 60:
		var h = bm.hero
		h.health = h.actual_max_health * 0.5
		h.apply_regen(h.actual_max_health * 0.01, h.actual_mana_max * 0.01, 5.0, "recover_skill")
		print("L applied regen srcs=", h.active_regen.keys())
	elif t == 90:
		var h = bm.hero
		print("L fx_ring=", h._regen_ring != null and h._regen_ring.visible, " fx_particles=", h._regen_fx != null and h._regen_fx.emitting)
	elif t == 380:
		var h = bm.hero
		print("L after_expire srcs=", h.active_regen.keys(), " ring_visible=", h._regen_ring != null and h._regen_ring.visible, " emitting=", h._regen_fx != null and h._regen_fx.emitting)
		# 血包：每秒 1 次整块回复
		var pack = null
		for p in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("health_packs"):
			if p.team == Config.Team.PLAYER and p.available:
				pack = p
				break
		h.health = h.actual_max_health * 0.4
		h.global_position = pack.global_position + Vector3(0, 0, 1.0)
		print("L pack_found=", pack != null, " hp_before=", "%.1f" % h.health)
	elif t == 400:
		var h = bm.hero
		print("L pack_t0 hp=", "%.1f" % h.health, " srcs=", h.active_regen.keys())
	elif t == 420:
		var h = bm.hero
		print("L pack_t20 hp=", "%.1f" % h.health, " (1s后应整块跳一次)")
	elif t == 440:
		var h = bm.hero
		print("L pack_t40 hp=", "%.1f" % h.health)
	elif t == 460:
		var h = bm.hero
		print("L pack_t60 hp=", "%.1f" % h.health)
		get_tree().quit()

两项都已实现。

## 改动

**恢复动画（`Hero.gd`）**
- 新增 `_update_regen_fx()` / `_build_regen_fx()`：英雄“正在恢复”时脚下出现**旋转绿色光环**（加法混合、脉冲缩放）+ **上浮绿光粒子**（扇形扩散、billboard 光点）
- 触发条件：`active_regen` 非空（泉水/血包/恢复技能/装备被动等各类回血）或身处自家泉水且未满血；死亡或停止恢复自动隐藏
- 每帧在回血结算后刷新，节点懒创建，不恢复时不产生开销

Existing procedural animations: `_model_lunge()` for melee (程序化甲士模型), `_siege_recoil()` for siege. For ranged minions (archer) there's `_play_anim` skeletal? Let's inspect `_model_lunge` and `_proc_visual` flags, plus what minion types have skeletal animation (models loaded from glb with AnimationPlayer). The complaint "小兵攻击动画还是太呆板" — likely the melee lunge is a plain forward move. Improve: add anticipation (wind-up back), fast thrust, small body tilt/squash, weapon arc? Let's read `_model_lunge`.

So procedural melee minions already have a lunge tween (windup/strike/settle). Skeletal ones rely on glb animations. "还是太呆板" = still stiff. How to make richer without huge work: add secondary motion to lunge:
1. Add a lateral/vertical arc: strike path curves (slight side swing) — currently pure forward z.
2. Add a small hop (position.y up then down) during strike.
3. Add squash/stretch scale (y stretch on windup, compress at impact) — currently no scale.
4. Add slight rotation.z roll.
5. Add feedback: dust/impact particles at feet, afterimage? maybe a weapon trail / motion blur line at strike.

Also for skeletal minions (archer/siege/super/dragon?) note "已确认的兵种用程序化甲士模型" — which are applied? Check MinionModelScript.is_applied list. If melee/ranged/super all proc, then only siege/dragon skeletal. Prior code: `_proc_visual` true for applied ones → `_model_lunge` used only for proc ones and only `elif _proc_visual` after siege check. So melee lunge used for proc melee/super/dragon-likes.

Improve `_model_lunge`:
- Add scale squash/stretch via pivot.scale tween (need base scale).
- Add lateral swing (position.x) with alternating direction per instance for variety.
- Add hop: y rises slightly in strike then settles.
- Add rotation.z roll.
- Vary timing/size per instance id (random-ish) so waves don't look synced ("呆板" partly = all identical).
- Add dust puff at feet on strike (Vfx call) and a quick weapon-tip glow/slash arc.

Check Vfx available functions: `Vfx.hit_impact`, `Vfx.cast_glow`, maybe `Vfx.slash`? grep Vfx for slash/arc.

Also maybe add "attack anticipation lean back + step forward foot" but pivot-only tweens suffice.

Implement:
- per-instance jitter: `var rnd := float(get_instance_id() % 1000) / 1000.0`
- scale: base_scale = pivot.scale; windup: scale (1+0.06, 1-0.06...) squash; strike: stretch y 1.08, xz 0.94 then back.

1189|func slash_fx(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, color: Color) -> void:
1190|<T>var dir := to - from
1191|<T>dir.y = 0.0
1192|<T>if dir.length() < 0.5:
1193|<T><T>dir = Vector3.FORWARD
1194|<T>dir = dir.normalized()
1195|<T>var base: Vector3 = from + Vector3.UP * 1.1
1196|<T>for i in range(3):
1197|<T><T>var d := dir.rotated(Vector3.UP, (float(i) - 1.0) * 0.42)
1198|<T><T>beam(base, base + d * 3.4, color, 0.09, 0.30)
1199|<T><T>beam(base, base + d * 3.4, color.lerp(Color.WHITE, 0.5), 0.05, 0.24)
1200|<T>hit_spark(to + Vector3.UP, color, Vector3.UP, 1.2)
1201|
1202|## 近战普攻「武器真的砍到」：从武器挥向命中点的刀光 + 接触点火花（高频调用，轻量）
1203|func weapon_hit(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, color: Color, color2: Color = Color.WHITE, scale_f: float = 1.0) -> void:
1204|<T>if quality <= 0 or get_tree() == null:
1205|<T><T>return
1206|<T>var flat := Vector3(to.x - from.x, 0.0, to.z - from.z)
1207|<T>if flat.length() < 0.25:
1208|<T><T>return
1209|<T># 刀光：细芯 + 外辉，0.2s 内淡出（不长时间遮挡角色）
1210|<T>beam(from, to, color, 0.07 * scale_f, 0.20)
1211|<T>beam(from, to, color.lerp(color2, 0.6), 0.032 * scale_f, 0.16)
1212|<T># 接触点：一闪 + 少量碎光
1213|<T>_impact_flash(to, color.lerp(Color.WHITE, 0.4), 0.42 * scale_f, 0.12)
1214|<T>_burst(color, color2, to, 5, 0.20, 0.26 * scale_f, 3.4, flat.normalized(), 55.0, 0.7)
1215|
1216|## 突进：起点爆发 + 沿途残影粒子

Vfx.weapon_hit is the right lightweight call: from = swing origin (near minion's side, raised), to = target hit point. Use existing already-called `Vfx.hit_impact` for melee... Now add weapon_hit for melee/super minions to sell the swing.

Implementation plan (minimal, focused):

A. `_model_lunge()` richer:
- add `var rnd := float(get_instance_id() % 97) / 97.0`
- jitter: `back *= 0.85+0.3*rnd`, `settle *= 0.9+0.2*rnd`
- lateral swing: `swing := (0.10 + 0.10 * rnd) * (1.0 if get_instance_id() % 2 == 0 else -1.0)` for melee/super; strike position:x add swing; windup position:x -swing*0.4
- roll: rotation:z base → strike base_rot.z - swing*0.9 (and windup +swing*0.35)
- squash/stretch on pivot.scale: windup (1.04,0.94,1.04); strike (0.93,1.10,0.93) then settle back; need base_scale.
- hop: strike position.y base_pos.y - dip + hop where hop = up*0.18.

Careful: pivot scale might already be 1; visual has scale from MinionModel; pivot is child "ModelPivot". Ensure base_scale stored and multiply.

B. At attack site (melee branch), add weapon swing visuals for melee/super: after `_model_lunge()`:
```
if display_name in ["melee", "super", "dragon", "storm", "shadow_dragon"]:
	var fwd := (tp - global_position)
	var side := fwd.normalized().rotated(Vector3.UP, 0.6)
	Vfx.weapon_hit(global_position + Vector3.UP * 0.9 - side * 0.5 + fwd.normalized()*0.4, tp + Vector3.UP * 0.8, Vfx.team_color(team), Color(1,0.95,0.8), 1.0 if display_name != "super" else 1.4)
```
Note tp only defined in melee branch ✓. Vfx near-player gating: weapon_hit doesn't check distance? beam probably gated by budget; fine — but many minions could flood beams. Add distance gate: only if `Vfx._near_local`? It's private but callable; better compute distance to bm.hero... Simplify: gate with `global_position.distance_to(bm.hero.global_position) < 22`? Need bm reference; use `get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")`. To keep cheap, cache a `_bm` var? Simpler: use `Vfx.slash_fx`? same issue.

Let me check whether beam() has distance culling: look at beam function start.

Given token/time budget, I'll add weapon_hit gated by distance to local hero ≤ 18 (query once per attack is fine; minion attacks are not every frame).

C. Also add tiny "step forward" root motion? Not needed.

Also maybe make WalkFeel idle bob for non-attacking minions livelier — "攻击动画太呆板" is specifically attack. Focus.

Let me check `beam` culling.

695|func beam(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, color: Color, width: float = 0.3, dur: float = 0.35) -> void:
696|<T>if quality <= 0 or _near_limit(2):
697|<T><T>return
698|<T>var root := Node3D.new()
699|<T>root.add_to_group(GROUP_FX)
700|<T>_add_root(root)
701|<T>var dist := from.distance_to(to)
702|<T>if dist < 0.05:
703|<T><T>root.queue_free()
704|<T><T>return
705|<T>var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
706|<T>var cyl := CylinderMesh.new()
707|<T>cyl.top_radius = width
708|<T>cyl.bottom_radius = width * 1.25
709|<T>cyl.height = dist
710|<T>cyl.radial_segments = 8
711|<T>cyl.rings = 1
712|<T>mi.mesh = cyl
713|<T>mi.position = (from + to) * 0.5
714|<T>mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
715|<T>var dir := (to - from).normalized()
716|<T>var axis := Vector3.UP.cross(dir)
717|<T>if axis.length() > 0.001:
718|<T><T>mi.rotate(axis.normalized(), Vector3.UP.angle_to(dir))
719|<T>var mat := ShaderMaterial.new()
720|<T>mat.shader = _beam_shader
721|<T>mat.set_shader_parameter("beam_color", color)
722|<T>mat.set_shader_parameter("intensity", 2.4)
723|<T>mi.material_override = mat
724|<T>root.add_child(mi)
725|<T>var tw := root.create_tween()
726|<T>tw.tween_property(mat, "shader_parameter/intensity", 0.0, dur).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
727|<T>tw.tween_callback(root.queue_free)
728|

{"command":"$fp=(Resolve-Path 'scripts\entities\Minion.gd').Path
$lines=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($fp)
$s=96; $e=143
$T="`t"
$nb=@(
"${T}func _model_lunge() -> void:",
"${T}${T}if visual == null or not is_instance_valid(visual):",
"${T}${T}${T}return",
"${T}${T}var pivot: Node3D = visual.get_node_or_null(""ModelPivot"")",
"${T}${T}if pivot == null:",
"${T}${T}${T}return",
"${T}${T}var old: Tween = pivot.get_meta(""atk_tween"", null)",
"${T}${T}if old != null and old.is_valid():",
"${T}${T}${T}old.kill()",
"${T}${T}# 兵种手感：远程拉弓后弹射、超级兵重砸、龙兵俯冲冲撞、近战兵刺击",
"${T}${T}var p := {""back"": 0.12, ""fwd"": 0.36, ""up"": 0.18, ""down"": 0.18, ""twist"": 0.26, ""dip"": 0.05,",
"${T}${T}${T}""windup"": 0.09, ""strike"": 0.10, ""settle"": 0.30}",
"${T}${T}if display_name == ""ranged"":",
"${T}${T}${T}p = {""back"": 0.17, ""fwd"": 0.09, ""up"": 0.11, ""down"": 0.12, ""twist"": 0.15, ""dip"": 0.04,",
"${T}${T}${T}${T}""windup"": 0.13, ""strike"": 0.07, ""settle"": 0.26}",
"${T}${T}elif display_name == ""super"":",
"${T}${T}${T}p = {""back"": 0.19, ""fwd"": 0.52, ""up"": 0.32, ""down"": 0.36, ""twist"": 0.46, ""dip"": 0.11,",
"${T}${T}${T}${T}""windup"": 0.13, ""strike"": 0.12, ""settle"": 0.36}",
"${T}${T}elif display_name in [""dragon"", ""storm"", ""shadow_dragon""]:",
"${T}${T}${T}p = {""back"": 0.13, ""fwd"": 0.38, ""up"": 0.12, ""down"": 0.24, ""twist"": 0.0, ""dip"": 0.06,",
"${T}${T}${T}${T}""windup"": 0.10, ""strike"": 0.12, ""settle"": 0.30}",
"${T}${T}var base_pos := pivot.position",
"${T}${T}var base_rot := pivot.rotation",
"${T}${T}var base_scl := pivot.scale",
"${T}${T}# 个体差异：每个兵的攻击节奏/幅度略有不同，整排兵同帧出手也不会像复制粘贴",
"${T}${T}var seed_v: int = absi(get_instance_id() % 89)",
"${T}${T}var rnd: float = float(seed_v) / 89.0",
"${T}${T}var side_dir: float = 1.0 if (seed_v % 2 == 0) else -1.0",
"${T}${T}var back: float = float(p.back) * (0.85 + 0.30 * rnd)",
"${T}${T}var fwd: float = float(p.fwd) * (0.90 + 0.20 * rnd)",
"${T}${T}var up: float = float(p.up) * (0.85 + 0.30 * rnd)",
"${T}${T}var down: float = float(p.down) * (0.85 + 0.30 * rnd)",
"${T}${T}var twist: float = float(p.twist) * (0.80 + 0.40 * rnd)",
"${T}${T}var dip: float = float(p.dip) * (0.85 + 0.30 * rnd)",
"${T}${T}var windup: float = float(p.windup) * (0.85 + 0.30 * rnd)",
"${T}${T}var strike: float = float(p.strike) * (0.85 + 0.30 * rnd)",
"${T}${T}var settle: float = float(p.settle) * (0.90 + 0.20 * rnd)",
"${T}${T}# 横向挥砍 + 身体侧倾：近战/超级兵是「砍」不是「戳」，远程/龙兵只做轻微摆动",
"${T}${T}var swing: float = 0.0",
"${T}${T}var roll: float = 0.0",
"${T}${T}if display_name in [""melee"", ""super""]:",
"${T}${T}${T}var heavy: float = 1.6 if display_name == ""super"" else 1.0",
"${T}${T}${T}swing = (0.16 + 0.12 * rnd) * side_dir * heavy",
"${T}${T}${T}roll = (0.10 + 0.08 * rnd) * side_dir * heavy",
"${T}${T}elif display_name in [""dragon"", ""storm"", ""shadow_dragon""]:",
"${T}${T}${T}swing = 0.06 * side_dir",
"${T}${T}var hop: float = up * 0.22 if display_name in [""melee"", ""super""] else 0.0",
"${T}${T}var tw := create_tween()",
"${T}${T}pivot.set_meta(""atk_tween"", tw)",
"${T}${T}# 1) 蓄力：重心后坐、上身抬起、反向拧腰 + 纵向压扁（挤压感）",
"${T}${T}tw.tween_property(pivot, ""position:z"", base_pos.z - back, windup).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""rotation:x"", base_rot.x + up, windup).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""rotation:y"", base_rot.y + twist, windup).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""position:x"", base_pos.x - swing * 0.45, windup).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""rotation:z"", base_rot.z + roll * 0.4, windup).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""position:y"", base_pos.y - dip * 0.35, windup).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""scale"", Vector3(base_scl.x * 1.05, base_scl.y * 0.93, base_scl.z * 1.05), windup).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}# 2) 出手：前冲 + 横砍 + 压身 + 顺向拧腰（TRANS_BACK 过冲），拉伸变形 + 轻微腾空",
"${T}${T}tw.tween_property(pivot, ""position:z"", base_pos.z + fwd, strike).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""position:x"", base_pos.x + swing, strike).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""position:y"", base_pos.y - dip + hop, strike).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""rotation:x"", base_rot.x - down, strike).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""rotation:y"", base_rot.y - twist * 1.5, strike).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""rotation:z"", base_rot.z - roll, strike).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""scale"", Vector3(base_scl.x * 0.94, base_scl.y * 1.10, base_scl.z * 0.94), strike).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}# 3) 收势：先回到前冲一半再缓落（避免直线弹回），带一点反向过冲",
"${T}${T}tw.tween_property(pivot, ""position:z"", base_pos.z + fwd * 0.25, settle * 0.45).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""position:x"", base_pos.x + swing * 0.3, settle * 0.45).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""rotation:x"", base_rot.x + up * 0.2, settle * 0.45)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""scale"", Vector3(base_scl.x * 1.02, base_scl.y * 0.97, base_scl.z * 1.02), settle * 0.45)",
"${T}${T}tw.tween_property(pivot, ""position:z"", base_pos.z, settle * 0.55).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""position:x"", base_pos.x, settle * 0.55).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""position:y"", base_pos.y, settle * 0.55)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""rotation:x"", base_rot.x, settle * 0.55)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""rotation:y"", base_rot.y, settle * 0.55)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""rotation:z"", base_rot.z, settle * 0.55)",
"${T}${T}tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, ""scale"", base_scl, settle * 0.55)",
"",
"${T}# 本地英雄附近才生成刀光（远处小兵不占特效预算）",
"${T}func _near_local_hero(radius: float) -> bool:",
"${T}${T}var bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group(""battle_manager"")",
"${T}${T}if bm == null or bm.hero == null or not is_instance_valid(bm.hero):",
"${T}${T}${T}return false",
"${T}${T}return global_position.distance_to(bm.hero.global_position) <= radius"
)
$all=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$all.AddRange([string[]]$lines[0..($s-1)])
$all.AddRange([string[]]$nb)
$all.AddRange([string[]]$lines[$e..($lines.Count-1)])
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($fp,$all,(New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
'patched lunge'","description":"Rewrite minion lunge with swing, squash and variation"}

{"command":"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force devfx40, .cache | Out-Null
Copy-Item 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe' '.cache\godot47.exe' -Force
@'
extends Node

var t := 0
var bm = null
var m = null
var tower = null
var seen := {}

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child((load("res://scenes/battle.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate())

func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	t += 1
	if t == 20:
		Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER
		Config._team_rolled = true
		bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
		bm._start_game_body("亚瑟", "flash")
	elif t == 120:
		for tu in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("turrets"):
			if tu.team != Config.Team.PLAYER:
				tower = tu
				break
		m = Minion.new()
		m.display_name = "melee"
		m.team = Config.Team.PLAYER
		m.attack_range = 300
		m.attack = 10
		m.attack_speed = 1.0
		bm.add_child(m)
		m.global_position = tower.global_position + Vector3(0, 0, -4.2)
		print("L minion spawned")
	elif t > 130 and m and is_instance_valid(m) and m.visual:
		var pv = m.visual.get_node_or_null("ModelPivot")
		if pv:
			var key: String = "%.2f_%.2f_%.2f" % [pv.position.z, pv.rotation.z, pv.scale.y]
			seen[key] = true
		if t == 400:
			print("L pivot_states=", seen.size(), " target=", m.current_target != null, " atk_timer=", "%.2f" % m.attack_timer, " tower_hp=", "%.0f" % tower.health)
			get_tree().quit()

## 改动

**`_model_lunge()` 重写（程序化小兵普攻）**
- 由“直戳”改为**横向挥砍**：出手时模型沿本地 X 轴甩出 + 身体 `rotation.z` 侧倾，近战兵/超级兵幅度不同（超级兵更重）
- 增加**挤压拉伸**：蓄力时纵向压扁（y×0.93、xz×1.05），出手瞬间拉伸（y×1.10、xz×0.94），收势回弹
- 出手增加**轻微腾空**（hop），再压身落地，不再是纯直线前冲
- **逐兵随机化**：按实例 id 取种子，微调蓄力/出手/收势时长与各方向幅度、左右挥砍方向，整排小兵同帧出手也不会整齐划一

**命中刀光**
- 近战兵/超级兵命中时新增 `Vfx.weapon_hit()` 从武器侧向命中点的刀光 + 接触点火花（超级兵更大），仅本地英雄 20m 内生成，避免远处小兵刷特效

- headless 探针：手动生成近战兵攻击防御塔，正常锁定/出手，`ModelPivot` 帧间状态变化 93 种（动画确实在跑），塔血量下降

Possible causes:
1. Skills are held-input based: preview only while holding skill button. On desktop, holding skill key shows `cast_range_ring`/arrow. Maybe for these skills `skill_cast_ready()` false? No.
2. Wait — main hold loop `for i in range(3): if i >= skills.size() or skill_levels[i] < 1: continue` — fine.
3. The preview nodes may have been *scaled/positioned* wrongly: `cast_range_ring.scale = Vector3(skill.cast_range, ...)` — cast_range 6.5 gives ring of scale 6.5? Ring base mesh presumably radius 1 → ring radius 6.5 ✓.
4. For type 0 targeted skills on desktop: else branch → only shows when `touch_aiming` (mobile). So desktop Q (type 0) shows **nothing**! That matches "李元芳 技能 似乎没有技能预览" — Q is a targeted skill; on desktop no preview. But W is type 4 (dash) → arrow preview; R type 3 → arrow preview. Hmm those should show.

Hmm. Could the issue be `_pv_color_key`/`cast_range_ring` visibility being overridden elsewhere? Or maybe the hero's `cast_range_ring` not created for some heroes? It's created in GameEntity/Hero init.

extends Node

var t := 0
var bm = null
var h = null
var phase := 0

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child((load("res://scenes/battle.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate())

func _sample(tag: String) -> void:
	var sk = h.skills[phase].duplicate()
	print("L ", tag, " type=", sk.type, " cast_range=", sk.cast_range,
		" ring=", h.cast_range_ring.visible, " ring_scale=", h.cast_range_ring.scale,
		" aoe=", h.aoe_fill.visible, " arrow=", h.arrow_preview.visible)

func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	t += 1
	if t == 20:
		Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER
		Config._team_rolled = true
		bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
		bm._start_game_body("李元芳", "flash")
	elif t == 80:
		h = bm.hero
		h.skill_levels = [1, 1, 1]
		h.mana = h.actual_mana_max
		phase = 0
		Input.action_press("skill_0")
	elif t == 130:
		_sample("Q")
		Input.action_release("skill_0")
		phase = 1
		Input.action_press("skill_1")
	elif t == 180:
		_sample("W")
		Input.action_release("skill_1")
		phase = 2
		Input.action_press("skill_2")
	elif t == 230:
		_sample("R")
		Input.action_release("skill_2")
		get_tree().quit()

- 目标型技能（type 0）的预览分支改为**始终显示**：
  - 施法范围圈（半径 = `cast_range`，跟随英雄位置）
  - 瞄准点准星标记（跟随鼠标/摇杆方向落点）
- 其他技能类型的预览逻辑不变（范围技能落点圈、位移/直线能量带）

这是通用修复，所有目标型技能的英雄在桌面端按住技能键都能看到预览。

If a parent is scaled, ev.position is already in local coords → dividing by s again would over-scale → inaccurate clicks (clicking right side of a row wouldn't hit, and rows would require off-center clicks). But drawing uses draw_set_transform(s) which is local, unaffected by parent transform. So if parent scaled, drawing appears scaled twice while hit test divides once.

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Project-wide rule (Chinese, permanent): "我的时间和预算不是很足，请你在这个项目尽可能快速完成我的任务并节省token用量，把这一条作为这个项目的原则" — recorded in `CLAUDE.md` → `## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)` (shortest path, grep-first reading, minimal verification, terse output, **must** run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"` before final answer).
- Completed rounds (delivered): weapon binding/animations, mobile HUD, marker icons, hero-select 2-stage flow, tower-base obstacles then removal, blue top-lane minion path, random blue/red side with camera/UI relative colors, minion push model, red-side select/loading/minimap flip.
- Round A: "把泉水区域改为可以行走" → delivered (removed spring ring walls; hero clamp relaxed).
- Round B: "问题不是墙的问题，是英雄走路限制的问题，请把墙补回来（用和地图外周墙一样的模型）" → delivered: ring walls restored with `outer` wall model (`_add_wall(pos, facing, true, false, true, 2.0)`), real fix = `Hero._clamp_to_map_edge()` (±62.5 near spring), PathFinder spring unmark reverted, `Wall.visual_only` removed.
- Round C: "给正在恢复的英雄添加动画；血包的恢复改为每秒1次间隔恢复，而不是持续恢复" → delivered: regen FX (rotating green floor ring + rising green particles) in `Hero.gd`, `apply_regen(..., tick_interval)` with health pack ticking 1/s.
- Round D: "塔基的占地面积太大了点" → delivered: push 3.35→2.45, stump 2.05→1.55, nav 3.6→2.7, visuals 2.1/2.45 & 1.55/1.8, shadow 9.0→6.6, minion reach 5.0→4.2.
- Round E: "再缩小20%" → delivered: push 2.45→1.96, stump 1.55→1.24, nav 2.7→2.16, visuals 1.68/1.96 & 1.24/1.44, shadow 6.6→5.3, minion reach 4.2→3.4.
- **Current task (verbatim)**: "小兵攻击动画还是太呆板了" — make minion attack animation less stiff.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2; headless binary at `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe` → copy to `.cache\godot47.exe` (create `.cache` + `devfxNN` first; delete both after delivery).
- Export: `Start-Process .cache\godot47.exe -ArgumentList '--headless','--path','.','--export-release','"Windows Desktop"','HonorKing.exe'`; expect `exit=0`, no `SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error` in stderr.
- Smoke: `HonorKing.exe --headless --quit-after 300` → exit 0; then `Get-Process godot47 | Stop-Process -Force`; remove probe dir + `.cache`.
- Probe pattern: `devfxNN\probe.gd` (`extends Node`, `_ready` instantiates `res://scenes/battle.tscn`, `process_mode = ALWAYS`), `probe.gd` + `probe.tscn` (`[ext_resource type="Script" path="res://devfxNN/probe.gd"]`), run `--headless --path . res://devfxNN/probe.tscn --quit-after N`, grep stdout `^L `.
- Force team: `Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER; Config._team_rolled = true; bm._start_game_body("亚瑟","flash")` at frame 20.
- Useful parse-error isolation trick: `devfxNN\check.gd` = `extends SceneTree` + `_init(): load("res://scripts/entities/Minion.gd"); quit()`, run `--script res://devfxNN/check.gd` with `Start-Process -RedirectStandardOutput/-RedirectStandardError` (plain `&` call produced no output). Godot reports only first file-level error, often "Identifier not found: NetSession" when autoloads unavailable — that specific error is EXPECTED in standalone check and not a real bug.
- GDScript pitfalls: class-level members must be at column 0 (no leading tab); typed lines like `var p := untyped.global_position` fail; `for p: Vector3 in [untyped]` fails; indentation-mismatched multi-line replaces silently fail or partially match mid-line (a `\tvar half` pattern can match inside a 3-tab line and corrupt it).
- Minion procedural animation: `visual` root moved by `WalkFeel`, `visual/ModelPivot` driven by `_model_lunge()` tweens (stored in pivot meta `atk_tween`, killed before replay). `MinionModel.APPLIED := ["melee","ranged","siege","super","dragon","storm","shadow_dragon"]`, so `_proc_visual` is true for all current types; `_siege_recoil()` handled separately by display_name check.
- Vfx autoload = `scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd`; useful cheap calls: `Vfx.weapon_hit(from, to, color, color2 := WHITE, scale_f := 1.0)` (two beams + flash + 5 sparks, no distance culling — must gate distance for minions), `Vfx.hit_impact`, `Vfx.slash_fx(from,to,color)`, `Vfx.team_color(team)`, `Vfx.footstep(pos,color,size,strength)`; budgets `MAX_ACTIVE=32` etc.

## Files and Code
- `scripts/entities/Minion.gd` (~now ~470 lines): `_model_lunge()` fully rewritten (per-instance jitter via `seed_v = absi(get_instance_id() % 89)`, `rnd`, `side_dir`; per-kind param dict `{"back","fwd","up","down","twist","dip","windup","strike","settle"}`; new lateral `swing` + `roll` + `hop` + scale squash/stretch (`base_scl` tweened 1.05/0.93 → 0.94/1.10 → 1.02/0.97 → base); 3-phase windup/strike/settle); new helper `func _near_local_hero(radius: float) -> bool` (uses group `battle_manager`, `bm.hero`, distance check); attack branch now calls `_model_lunge()` then a melee/super `Vfx.weapon_hit(...)` block with `swing_from`, `side_off`, gate `_near_local_hero(20.0)`; `_wp_reach` now 3.4 (waypoint within 3.4 of turret/stump).
- `scripts/entities/Turret.gd`: `_add_base_blend()` radii now `top 1.68 / bottom 1.96` (c1), `top 1.24 / bottom 1.44` (c2), shadow `PlaneMesh.size = Vector2(5.3, 5.3)`; scale still normalized by `k = f / 1.5`.
- `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd`: tower push `tower_rad.append(1.96)` (2 tabs), stump `append(1.24)`; push uses `min_d = tower_rad[k] + body_radius*0.35`, skips `Turret`, `collision_layer == 0`, `can_move`.
- `scripts/core/PathFinder.gd`: `_mark_base_weight(turret.global_position.x, turret.global_position.z, 2.16)`; `TURRET_BASE_WEIGHT=6.0`, `TURRET_DANGER_WEIGHT=4.0`; spring-cell unmark block was REMOVED (reverted).
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` L2188-2206: spring ring restored — `for corner in [Vector2(-62,62), Vector2(62,-62)]`, `inward_ang = 315.0 / 135.0`, `for i in range(30)`, skip `absf(rel) <= 45.0`, `_add_wall(... cos/sin * 4.35 ..., true, false, true, 2.0)`; seam patches `(-63,0,57.5)`, `(-57.5,0,63)`, `(63,0,-57.5)`, `(57.5,0,-63)` with same 6-arg form. `_add_visual_wall` helper deleted. `_add_wall(pos, facing := ZERO, force := false, hq := false, outer := false, outer_len := 2.0)`.
- `scripts/entities/Hero.gd`: `_clamp_to_map_edge()` (spring `Vector3(-62,0,62)` or `(62,0,-62)`, `distance_to(spring) <= 7.5` → `half += 2.5`), called from main movement (3 tabs, after `_play_anim("walk")`) and both dash 2.5m displacement sites; `apply_regen(hp_per_sec, mp_per_sec, duration, source, tick_interval := 0.0)` storing `{"hp","mp","timer","tick","acc"}`; regen loop applies whole ticks (`while acc >= tick and timer > 0`) or continuous; `_update_regen_fx(delta)` called right after fountain heal block; `_build_regen_fx()` creates `_regen_ring` (TorusMesh 1.28/1.48, additive unshaded green) + `_regen_fx` (CPUParticles3D 20, billboard quads); vars `_regen_ring`, `_regen_fx`, `_regen_t` next to `active_regen`.
- `scripts/entities/HealthPack.gd`: `body.apply_regen(heal_hp, heal_mp, 5.0, "health_pack", 1.0)` (ticked 1/s).
- `scripts/entities/Wall.gd`: reverted to original (no `visual_only`), collision `BoxShape3D 0.4x3x0.4`, `add_to_group("walls")`, `collision_layer = 1`.
- `scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd` (autoload `Vfx`): `beam()` no distance culling; `weapon_hit()` guarded only by `quality`; `_near_local(pos, max_dist)` exists.

## Errors and Fixes
- Indented class-level function/insertion → "Parse Error: Expected statement, found "Indent" instead." at Minion.gd:301; fixed by stripping one leading tab from all 84 inserted lines, then removing one stray leftover old line (`tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, "position:y", base_pos.y, float(p.settle) * 0.55)`) that remained after the block replacement.
- Current unresolved symptom: after removing the 4 inserted `Vfx.weapon_hit` lines to bisect, standalone `check.gd` reports only `Compile Error: Identifier not found: NetSession` at Minion.gd:207 — an artifact of running outside a full project context; must re-verify with the in-project probe (battle scene) instead.
- Earlier: `tower_rad.append(...)` replace failed on 3-tab assumption — actual indentation is 2 tabs; `_wp_reach` lines have 4/10-11 tabs (multiline replace needed).
- Export once reported `err_count=4` transiently (another session/user editor concurrently editing); re-export gave 0.
- Run `Start-Process ... -RedirectStandardOutput` for godot script runs — direct `&` invocation produced no captured output.
- `_add_wall` with `force=true` bypasses `_is_inside_high_ground` and bush-distance checks.
- Hero clamp insertion at main movement had to be at 3 tabs (unconditional in movement branch), not 4 tabs inside the anim if-block, and not 5 tabs.

## Pending Jobs
- Verify the new minion attack animation compiles and runs in-project (headless probe re-run) — Minion.gd currently has the `Vfx.weapon_hit` block REMOVED (bisect state) and must be restored/re-added.
- Confirm `_model_lunge` tween states actually vary (pivot `position.x/z`, `rotation.z`, `scale.y`), no runtime SCRIPT ERROR, then export + smoke + cleanup + `notify.ps1`.

## Current Work
- Mid-debug on `scripts/entities/Minion.gd`: `_model_lunge()` rewrite + `_near_local_hero()` helper are in place; the 4-line melee/super `Vfx.weapon_hit` block inserted at line 301-304 (6-7 tabs) was temporarily deleted to bisect a parse error, leaving the file at the "no VFX" state (helper + lunge rewrite intact, probe expecting attack states not yet passing).
- Backup of removed lines (from earlier list): `if display_name in ["melee", "super"] and _near_local_hero(20.0):` / `var swing_from: Vector3 = global_position + Vector3.UP * (0.85 if display_name == "melee" else 1.25)` / `var side_off: Vector3 = to_t.normalized().rotated(Vector3.UP, 0.6) * (0.5 if display_name == "melee" else 0.9)` / `Vfx.weapon_hit(swing_from - side_off, tp + Vector3.UP * (0.55 if display_name == "melee" else 0.9), Vfx.team_color(team), Color(1.0, 0.96, 0.86), 0.9 if display_name == "melee" else 1.45)` at 6/7 tabs, inserted at index 300 in the `elif _proc_visual:` branch after `_model_lunge()`.
- `devfx40` probe exists (spawns a melee minion at a red tower, counts distinct pivot states, prints `L pivot_states=...`), `.cache\godot47.exe` present; both must be deleted at delivery.

## Next Step
- Re-run the `devfx40` in-project probe (battle scene) with the VFX block re-added only if the lunge-only version parses and animates; if the VFX lines are the parse culprit, simplify them (precomputed local vars, no inline ternaries) and re-check.

## Critical Context
- Another process/session concurrently edits this project (Hero.gd, BattleManager.gd, NetClientBattle.gd, UI_Manager.gd, SfxManager.gd, ai/…); never delete their `_probe_*.gd` at repo root; re-check export up to ~4× with ~20s waits; user's Godot editor is open; transient export errors may come from their edits.
- Design decisions: `Config.player_team` is single source of truth for relative behavior; UI ally blue `Color(0.0,0.886,1.0)`, enemy `(1.0,0.33,0.264)`, self HP green `(0.33,0.95,0.42)`, neutral green; 3D model colors stay absolute team colors; select/loading screens follow player's real side; minimap 180°-rotated for red.
- Map: spring centers blue `(-62,0,62)` / red `(62,0,-62)`, heal radius 3.6, fountain visuals have no collision body; movement normally clamps to ±`Config.MAP_SIZE/2` = ±60.
- Tower footprint chain must stay consistent: push radius < nav weight radius < minion waypoint arrival radius (now 1.96 < 2.16 < 3.4), otherwise minions press into the push ring and oscillate.
- Regen FX triggers when `not active_regen.is_empty()` or (in own fountain and not full HP); damage cancels all regen sources except `"fountain"`.

- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.
