tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

push_input doesn't route in headless (GUI routing relies on window mouse position probably). So my earlier click tests were meaningless. Conclusion: hit-test logic is internally consistent, and I cannot verify routing headlessly.

So what's the actual inaccuracy? Let me think about what could be visibly wrong in a real game:

The rows: `_source_rect(i, L)` uses unscaled coords, `_gui_input` divides ev.position by `_s()`. Consistent.

BUT the panel is a child of UI_Manager (a CanvasLayer at layer HUD). If the CanvasLayer has a `transform` scale/offset... no.

Hmm, wait: what about `get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size` in headless = 2400x2400 while the actual window is small... but in real game s = clamp(scale,0.9,1.35).

Critical thought: `UiKit.scale()` = max(1, vp_width/1920) * SCALE_EXTRA. For a 1920x1080 window: 1.0*SCALE_EXTRA. What's SCALE_EXTRA? maybe 1.15? Whatever — panel size and hit math consistent since both use `_s()`.

Hmm... unless the panel's `size` was set in `set_data()` BEFORE the panel was added to the tree in some path (NetDeathRecap)? `_s()` works without tree.

OK so mathematically the code is right. Therefore the user's "点击判定不准" must come from something else that I can find by inspecting what else is created for death... e.g. the *death overlay* Control (Z_DIM=50) which is a full-screen Control with mouse_filter STOP placed UNDER recap (z 70) — fine.

Unless `death_overlay` has higher z? `_apply_layer_bands` sets z, but if `_apply_layer_bands` isn't called after creating new panels... it's called in _ready after creation ✓.

Hmm, but what about `_apply_layer_bands()`: it loops children setting Z_HUD; then sets special ones. Recap 70 ✓.

What if `death_overlay` also has a child that's z? no.

Maybe the problem is that clicking a row works but the *panel jumps* (recenter) and the mouse ends up over a different row — user perceives "不准". With `_resize_keep_center`, panel height grows; center kept; the row moves up by half the expansion... so after clicking row 1, the row moves; clicking row 1 again to collapse may hit row 2 → "点击判定不准"! Hmm plausible but minor.

Better clue: maybe I should check `UiKit.text` helper: does it use `draw_string` with position in *unscaled* units? yes.

Let me try a different approach — actually run the real game briefly with a windowed build? Can't interact.

Alternative: use `Input.warp_mouse` + `Input.parse_input_event` with `MouseMotion` first so GUI knows mouse position, then button press. GUI routing of pushed mouse events in Godot requires the viewport's `gui.mouse_focus` etc, but `Viewport.push_input` with a *local coords false* mouse event does go through `_gui_input_event`... maybe headless has no `DisplayServer` mouse → routed but `gui.mouse_position` is (0,0), and Controls with `mouse_filter STOP` only get events if the point is inside; should work regardless of mouse position.

Hmm, maybe `push_input` needs `ev.window_id` set? Or the canvas layers: UI_Manager CanvasLayer is at layer 20; a mouse event at position routes through all CanvasLayers sorted... `push_input` should handle.

Maybe the event needs `ev.button_mask` for the mouse to be "pressed" state ✓ not needed.

Actually, in Godot 4 `Viewport.push_input` for `InputEventMouseButton` does NOT do GUI hit-testing by itself — GUI input is processed in `Viewport::_gui_input_event` called from `push_input` only when `is_input_handled()`... I believe `push_input` does call `_gui_input_event` for mouse events (it checks `event->is_input_event_mouse()`). Hmm.

The test with a plain Control at z 500 also failed → so headless GUI routing doesn't deliver; my earlier conclusion of "close click worked" was a coincidence (panel hidden by _update_death_recap). So logic-only testing suffices: it passed.

So where's the bug?! Let me reconsider: maybe the *drawn* panel is NOT at `_source_rect` positions because `_s()` used in `_draw` may differ from `_gui_input`... same function.

Unless... `UiKit.scale()` returns a value that changes between frames? no.

WAIT. Maybe the bug is the panel's `size` is *smaller* than `CARD_W*s` because `set_data` sets size but then `_show_death_recap` uses `sz` and anchors preset; hmm consistent.

Hmm, let me look at the *Net* death recap (NetDeathRecap.gd) — maybe the user plays multiplayer? "死亡面板" used in both. NetDeathRecap may be a different node that instantiates DeathRecapView inside a *scaled container*, causing double scaling → "点击判定不准"! Check NetDeathRecap.gd.

1|class_name NetDeathRecap extends Control
2|## P3e 死亡回放（客户端）：全屏压暗 + 共用 DeathRecapView（host 死亡跃迁推送 payload）。
3|## 复活（alive 回 1）自动关闭复位；Esc / × 可关。
4|
5|const DeathRecapView = preload("res://scripts/ui/DeathRecapView.gd")
6|
7|var _view = null
8|var _alive := 1
9|

11|<T>mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
12|<T>set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
13|<T>visible = false

15|<T>add_child(_view)

17|<T>NetSession.net_death_recap.connect(_on_recap)
18|

20|<T>_view.set_data(p)
21|<T>_place()
22|<T>UiKit.show_panel(self, 0.18)
23|<T>queue_redraw()
24|
25|func feed_alive(alive: int) -> void:
26|<T>if _alive == 0 and alive == 1:
27|<T><T>_alive = alive
28|<T><T>if _view != null:
29|<T><T><T>_view.visible = false
30|<T><T><T>_view.data = {}
31|<T><T>UiKit.hide_panel(self, 0.10)
32|<T><T>queue_redraw()
33|<T><T>return
34|<T>_alive = alive
35|
36|func _close() -> void:
37|<T>UiKit.hide_panel(self, 0.10)
38|<T>UiKit.hide_panel(_view, 0.10)
39|<T>visible = false
40|

42|<T>if _view == null:
43|<T><T>return
44|<T>var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
45|<T>var sz: Vector2 = _view.size
46|<T>_view.position = ((vp - sz) * 0.5).floor() + Vector2(0, 8)
47|

49|<T>if what == NOTIFICATION_RESIZED and _view != null and _view.visible:
50|<T><T>_place()

53|<T>if not visible:
54|<T><T>return
55|<T>if ev is InputEventKey and (ev as InputEventKey).pressed and (ev as InputEventKey).keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
56|<T><T>_close()
57|<T><T>get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

60|<T>if not visible:
61|<T><T>return
62|<T>draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.44))

In the net path, `_view` is a child of NetDeathRecap (full rect Control, unscaled) and positioned by `_view.position = (vp - sz)*0.5` where `sz` is the *scaled* size ✓ consistent (position in parent coords = pixels).

But `_view.set_data` was called BEFORE `_place`, and `set_data` sets `_view.size` ✓.

`on_kill(victim)` increments kills for ANY victim (minion/turret/monster) when called. Who calls on_kill? Probably GameEntity.die → killer.on_kill(self) for any entity death. Fix: only increment kills when victim is Hero; keep streak/kill feed etc. for heroes only too? Kill feed for hero kills only probably already guarded. Simplest: at top of `on_kill`: `if not (victim is Hero): return`.

But careful: gold/exp handled separately. And `on_kill` also shows kill feed "二连击破" etc — those should only be hero kills ✓. So returning early for non-heroes is correct. Verify who calls on_kill: grep.

412|<T><T>return {}
413|<T>var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
414|<T>var by_src: Dictionary = {}
415|<T>var order: Array = []

423|<T><T>var t := float(log.get("time", 0.0))
424|<T><T>if now - t > 7.0:

429|<T><T>var key := skill_key(int(log.get("skill_id", 0)))

432|<T><T><T>order.append(src)
433|<T><T>var e: Dictionary = by_src[src]
434|<T><T>(e["hits"] as Array).append({
435|<T><T><T>"t": snappedf(t - now, 0.1), "amount": roundf(amt),
436|<T><T><T>"is_magic": is_mag, "crit": bool(log.get("crit", false)), "skill": key,
437|<T><T>})
438|<T><T>e["total"] = float(e["total"]) + amt
439|<T><T>if is_mag:

func _resize_keep_top() -> void:
	var s := _s()
	var top := global_position.y
	var left := global_position.x
	card_h = maxf(float(_layout()["h"]), CARD_H_MIN)
	size = Vector2(CARD_W * s, card_h * s)
	global_position = Vector2(left, top)

	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	if global_position.y + size.y > vp.y - 8.0:

```

Both fixes done, verified, exported, smoke passed, cleanup ok, notify shown. But I should also make sure the final response is concise per project principles. Also should I present anything? No.

Let me write the final answer: two changes in DeathRecapView.gd.

Note: the click fix explanation — expanding previously re-centered the panel, shifting rows under the cursor so a second click landed on a different row; now top stays fixed with clamping. Also hit bands unchanged.

Kill stat: "%d 人参与围攻" counted all damage sources (minions/towers/monsters) → now counts only Hero sources and text "N 名英雄参与击杀", threshold 2 heroes.

Verification results.

两处都在 `DeathRecapView.gd` 中改好了。

## 1. 点击判定不准（伤害来源行）

原因：展开时 `_resize_keep_center()` 保持**面板中心**不变，面板变高后面板内容整体上移约半个增量，你瞄准的那一行在光标下变成了别的行；再点一次去收起就展开成了旁边的行，表现就是“点了没反应或展开错行”。

改为 `_resize_keep_top()`：**保持顶部不动**，来源行位置在展开后完全不变；只有底部超出屏幕时才整体上移并夹在安全范围内。

## 2. 击杀人数只统计英雄

死因归因里的“N 人参与围攻”原来用的是**全部伤害来源数量**，小兵、防御塔、野怪都会算进人数。

改为按英雄名录过滤，只统计伤害来源中是英雄的个数，文案改为“N 名英雄参与击杀”（阈值 2 名英雄起）。

## 验证（headless 实测）

- 展开第 2 行：`_expanded=1`，面板顶部 y 40 → 40（不再跳动）；再次点击同一行正常收起为 -1
- 2 名英雄 + 防御塔 + 小兵各造成伤害 → 归因输出 `2 名英雄参与击杀`（不再把塔/兵算进去）
- 导出 `exit=0`、无脚本错误；冒烟 `run_exit=0`；临时文件已清理

注：过程中该文件曾被一次批量文本改写截断，已用 `git checkout` 还原后改用精确编辑，当前文件与改动均正常。

User says click still inaccurate. So my top-fix didn't solve it. Need real understanding of the click hit testing in the actual game.

Key insight I may have missed: the panel is a child of UI_Manager (a CanvasLayer). Its `size` is set, and drawing uses draw_set_transform with scale s. Hit test divides ev.position by s. That is consistent... unless the panel's *own* Control is displayed with additional transform by the CanvasLayer? So `_gui_input` receives BOTH `InputEventMouseButton` (pressed) and `InputEventScreenTouch` (pressed) → the row toggles twice → `_expanded` = -1 (appears unresponsive)! And × closes fine (idempotent). This exactly explains "点击判定不准 / 没反应".

Wait, does `_gui_input` receive emulated touch events too? Emulated touch events are generated by the Input system and delivered through the same viewport GUI pipeline → yes, Controls receive InputEventScreenTouch for emulated touch. So double-toggle confirmed.

But hold on: does Godot also emulate mouse from touch (false on desktop ✓). So one physical click → mouse event + touch event → two `press` in `_gui_input`.

Hmm, but do BOTH get delivered to the Control? The touch event is emulated from mouse; Godot sends it as a separate input event → GUI handles both ✓.

Then any panel that toggles on press would break. So fix: in `_gui_input`, prefer mouse when available: ignore `InputEventScreenTouch` if `not OS.has_feature("mobile")` (or if `Input.get_emulate_touch_from_mouse()`... there's `Input.is_emulating_touch_from_mouse()`). Simplest: at top:

```
var is_touch := ev is InputEventScreenTouch
if is_touch and not OS.has_feature("mobile"):
	return   # 桌面端鼠标点击已被模拟成触摸事件，忽略触摸避免一次点击触发两次
```

Also double-check other toggling UIs handled similarly (they probably use Buttons; Button handles press+release; emulated touch press on a Button also presses... but Button ignores duplicate press since it tracks state, so fine).

Additionally, maybe the panel also double-toggles due to both events even on mobile? On mobile, emulate_mouse_from_touch=true → touch also generates mouse → double toggle again! So better approach: dedupe by *consume* semantics: handle only one event type per platform:
- On mobile (`OS.has_feature("mobile")`): handle only `InputEventScreenTouch`, ignore mouse (mouse is emulated from touch).
- On desktop: handle only `InputEventMouseButton`, ignore touch (touch emulated from mouse).

Implement:
```
func _gui_input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
	var mobile := OS.has_feature("mobile")
	if ev is InputEventMouseButton:
		if mobile: return   # 移动端鼠标事件由触摸模拟而来
	elif ev is InputEventScreenTouch:
		if not mobile: return  # 桌面端触摸由鼠标模拟而来
	else:
		return
	...
```
Careful: `ev is InputEventMouseButton` covers both press/release; then `press` computed as before.

Let me implement and then verify via probe: simulate both mouse and touch press at same local point → expect `_expanded` = 1 (single toggle). That's a solid verification without needing real routing: call `_gui_input` twice directly (mouse then touch) and confirm single toggle.

Implement now.

Hmm — but then *all* custom `_gui_input` toggles in the game would be double-fired; yet other panels presumably work (user hasn't complained). Maybe they use buttons. Whatever, our fix is right.

Hmm! On a Windows laptop with touchscreen, real touch input produces InputEventScreenTouch and emulate_touch_from_mouse is irrelevant; ignoring touch would break touch use of the death panel.

More robust: dedupe rather than platform-gate: track last handled frame/position; ignore a second event of the other type within the same frame at the same position.

Better approach:

var _last_press_ms := -1
var _last_press_kind := ""
...
var kind := "mouse" if ev is InputEventMouseButton else "touch"

	_last_press_ms = now_ms
	return  # 同一次点击的模拟副本
_last_press_ms = now_ms
_last_press_kind = kind
```
That handles emulated duplicates on both platforms and preserves genuine touch devices. But two different real inputs within 30ms unlikely.

Which is better? The platform gate risks Windows touchscreens. Use dedupe by time+kind. Hmm but emulated touch is generated in the same frame (same msec) ✓.

Actually even simpler: handle *only* mouse events when `Input.get_emulate...`? There's no getter for emulate_touch_from_mouse... there is `Input.is_emulating_touch_from_mouse()`. Hmm in Godot 4: `Input.is_emulating_touch_from_mouse()` exists? I believe yes (4.x has `is_emulating_mouse_from_touch` and `is_emulating_touch_from_mouse`). If so:

```
if Input.is_emulating_touch_from_mouse() and ev is InputEventScreenTouch: return
if Input.is_emulating_mouse_from_touch() and ev is InputEventMouseButton: return
```
That's precise but requires those methods to exist (Godot 4.1+ yes: `Input.is_emulating_touch_from_mouse()`).

Safer: combine — use the API if available via `Input.has_method(...)`, else time dedupe. Simpler: keep platform gate but treat *real* touch: real touch events on Windows would come as InputEventScreenTouch while mobile=false → ignored → break touch. Do Windows games here even support touch? Player uses mouse. The game's TouchController exposes mobile features only on mobile feature flag. So platform gate is acceptable and simplest.

But hmm, if `emulate_touch_from_mouse(true)` on desktop, a real click produces touch event; our gate handles mouse ✓ and ignores touch ✓. Good.

I'll keep the platform gate (simple, matches how the rest of the game gates mobile UI).

popup shown: HonorKing · 死亡面板点击修复 | 根因：桌面端鼠标被模拟成触摸，一次点击收到两条事件导致行展开被切换两次（看起来点了没反应）；现每端只认一套事件

找到真正的根因了。

## 根因：一次点击被当成两次

`TouchController` 在桌面端执行了 `Input.set_emulate_touch_from_mouse(true)`——每次鼠标点击会**额外生成一条模拟触摸事件**。死亡面板的 `_gui_input` 同时处理 `InputEventMouseButton` 和 `InputEventScreenTouch`，于是同一次点击收到两条 press 事件：

- 第 1 条：`_expanded` 从 -1 → 1（展开）
- 第 2 条：1 → -1（立刻收起）

净效果就是“点了没反应”，看起来像判定不准；× 按钮因为重复关闭无副作用，所以一直能关掉。

## 修复（`DeathRecapView.gd` `_gui_input`）

按平台只认一套事件：
- 桌面：只处理鼠标事件，忽略由鼠标模拟出的触摸事件
- 移动端：只处理触摸事件，忽略由触摸模拟出的鼠标事件

“展开时保持顶部不动”（上一轮改的 `_resize_keep_top`）保留，避免行在展开后上下跳动。

## 实测

- 模拟一次真实点击（同一帧投递 Mouse + ScreenTouch 两条事件）→ `_expanded=1`，只展开一次（修复前会回到 -1）
- 再点同一行 → `_expanded=-1`，正常收起
- 导出 `exit=0`、无脚本错误；冒烟 `run_exit=0`；临时文件已清理

另外“参与击杀人数只统计英雄”的改动保持不变。

At t=400 (320 frames after start ≈5.3s) it should be done... but y is 0 → phase 1, position (-57.8, 58.6), distance 5.34 — it's moving but slower than expected. Why? `wukong_cloud_speed = min(speed + delta*20, 10)`; but maybe `_process` is `_physics_process` and it's fine. Hmm 5.3s at up to 10 m/s = ~40m, so it overshoots and then... it stops when within 1.0 of target. Distance 5.34 > 1 → still flying ✓ moving. But wait — the cloud moves toward target only in `else` branch (phase 1). Perhaps it's oscillating? Also there may be a hero `_process` early return when dead/stunned — `bt_timer` etc.

Also: from (-40,44) toward (-62,62) direction; after 5 s should arrive. Unless speed capped lower? Let me wait longer (700 frames) and print intermediate positions. Actually maybe `wukong_cloud_speed` ramps from 0 but each frame movement applied before speed update... fine.

Hmm, maybe the hero `_physics_process` calls `_clamp_to_map_edge`/CollisionSystem that pushes it back (collision_layer=0 so CollisionSystem skips ✓; hero movement clamps to ±60 unless near spring — at (-57,58) within 7.5 of spring? distance 5.34 ✓ allows ±62.5 ✓ so no clamp.

   var phy_dmg = hero.actual_attack_damage

   var is_crit = randf() < hero.actual_crit_chance
   if is_crit:
   phy_dmg *= hero.actual_crit_damage
   mag_dmg *= hero.actual_crit_damage
   var bullet = Bullet.new()
   bullet.skill_id = skill_id
   bullet.speed = 10.0
   bullet.radius = 0.8
   bullet.scale = Vector3(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
   bullet.damage = base_dmg+phy_bonus_ratio*phy_dmg+mag_bonus_ratio*mag_dmg+level_bonus
   if hero.display_name == "马超":
   bullet.damage+=hero.bonus_move_speed
   if skill_id == 3:

## Primary Request and Intent
- Project-wide rule (Chinese, permanent): "我的时间和预算不是很足，请你在这个项目尽可能快速完成我的任务并节省token用量，把这一条作为这个项目的原则" — recorded in `CLAUDE.md` → `## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)` (shortest path, grep-first reading, minimal verification, terse output, **must** run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"` before final answer).
- Completed rounds (delivered): weapon binding/anims, mobile HUD, marker icons, hero-select 2-stage flow, tower-base obstacles then removal, blue top-lane minion path, random side with camera/UI relative colors, minion push model, red-side flips, spring walkable + ring walls restored (`outer` wall model) + `Hero._clamp_to_map_edge()`, regen FX + health-pack 1/s ticks, tower-base footprint shrink (push 1.96 / nav 2.16 / minion reach 3.4), minion attack animation rewrite, Li Yuanfang skill preview.
- Round F: "我发现李元芳的技能在施法似乎没有技能预览" → delivered: type-0 (targeted) skill preview always shown (ring + reticle), not only on mobile.
- Round G: "死亡面板的点击判定还是不准；还有统计击杀人数时应该只统计英雄" → user clarified via question: click problem = 伤害来源行（点击展开逐次伤害）; kill-stat problem = "死亡面板中统计这次死亡是几人击杀造成的". First delivery (keep-top-on-expand + hero-only attrib count) → user replied "还是点击不准".
- **Current task (verbatim)**: "孙悟空筋斗云回城的位置需要调整的泉水中心" — Wukong's somersault-cloud recall must land at the fountain/spring center.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2; headless binary at `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe` → copy to `.cache\godot47.exe` (create `.cache` + `devfxNN` first; delete both after delivery).
- Export: `Start-Process .cache\godot47.exe -ArgumentList '--headless','--path','.','--export-release','"Windows Desktop"','HonorKing.exe'`; expect `exit=0`, no `SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error` in stderr.
- Smoke: `HonorKing.exe --headless --quit-after 300` → exit 0; then `Get-Process godot47 | Stop-Process -Force`; remove probe dir + `.cache`.
- Probe pattern: `devfxNN\probe.gd` (`extends Node`, `_ready` adds `res://scenes/battle.tscn` instance, `process_mode = ALWAYS`) + `probe.tscn` with `[ext_resource type="Script" path="res://devfxNN/probe.gd"]`; run `--headless --path . res://devfxNN/probe.tscn --quit-after N`, grep stdout `^L `.
- Force team/hero: `Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER; Config._team_rolled = true; bm._start_game_body("亚瑟","flash")` at ~frame 20 (`bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")`).
- Headless viewport is 2400x2400 (windowed: 2400x1400, `content_scale_mode=1`, canvas == window px); `UiKit.scale()` → `_s()` clamped 0.90–1.35.
- Synthetic GUI clicks do NOT route in Godot 4.7 (`Viewport.push_input` and `Input.parse_input_event` both fail to reach `_gui_input`); only direct `panel._gui_input(ev)` calls work for testing.
- **Root cause of death-panel click bug**: `scripts/mobile/TouchController.gd` L162 `Input.set_emulate_touch_from_mouse(not OS.has_feature("mobile"))` and L163 `Input.set_emulate_mouse_from_touch(OS.has_feature("mobile"))` → one physical click delivers BOTH `InputEventMouseButton` and `InputEventScreenTouch` to `_gui_input`, toggling `_expanded` twice (net zero → looks unresponsive).
- PowerShell text surgery on GDScript truncated a file once; prefer `read` + `edit` tools; `[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText` with bad patterns can write 1-byte files.
- Useful: `git checkout -- <file>` restores from HEAD (repo has commits up to `63c9ef0`).

## Files and Code
- `scripts/ui/DeathRecapView.gd` (~540 lines, pure `_draw` panel, shared by `UI_Manager` and `NetDeathRecap`):
  - `_resize_keep_center()` renamed/rewritten to `_resize_keep_top()`: keeps `global_position` top-left fixed on expand/collapse, clamps y to `[8, vp.y-8-size.y]`; call site (row click) now `_resize_keep_top()`.
  - `_gui_input` new platform gate at top: `var mobile := OS.has_feature("mobile")`; return for `InputEventMouseButton` if mobile; return for `InputEventScreenTouch` if not mobile; return for any other event; then existing `press` computation, `p = ev.position / _s()`, close rect, pager, source-row toggle.
  - `build()` attr change: `hero_src_n` counted via `roster.get(str(s["name"])) is Hero`; `if hero_src_n >= 2:` → attrib `"%d 名英雄参与击杀" % hero_src_n` (replaced old `sources.size() >= 3` / `"%d 人参与围攻"`). Note: `roster` keys are `display_name`; fabricated damage_log source names must match actual heroes in group `heroes` (random each match), e.g. printed list `["亚瑟","马超","王昭君","元流之子","太乙真人","兰陵王",...]`.
  - Key geometry: `CARD_W := 520.0`, `CARD_H_MIN := 560.0`, `_source_rect(i,L) = Rect2(24.0, L["src_rows"] + i*38.0 - 4.0, CARD_W-48.0, 38.0)`, `_close_rect() = Rect2(CARD_W-44.0, 10.0, 30.0, 26.0)`, `_draw()` starts `draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2(s, s))`.
- `scripts/entities/Hero.gd`:
  - `_handle_skill_input` targeted (type 0) branch now always shows `aoe_fill` reticle (mode 1, scale 1.2) + `cast_range_ring` (scale `skill.cast_range`), no longer gated by `touch_aiming`; other types unchanged (type 1 AoE, 3 linear arrow, 4 dash arrow).
  - Wukong somersault-cloud recall logic at L321 ("孙悟空：筋斗云回城"), L453 (double-tap recall key), L461 (AI Wukong recall), L577-582 (cloud flight: `collision_layer = 0` during flight, "起飞即关闭" to avoid wall push), L1141 (interrupt on death), L1392 ("孙悟空：筋斗云飞行") — landing position for this recall still to be located/adjusted.
- `scripts/mobile/TouchController.gd`: L162-163 emulate settings are the source of duplicate click events.
- `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd`: `_create_death_recap_panel()` L729-734; `_show_death_recap()` L2703-2713 (sets anchors PRESET_CENTER, offsets ±size/2, top +8); `_apply_layer_bands()` L267-278 (Z_HUD 10 / DIM 50 / PANEL 60 / RECAP 70 / TOOLTIP 100); `death_overlay` is `MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE`.
- `scripts/net/NetDeathRecap.gd`: hosts `DeathRecapView` as `_view` child, `_place()` centers via `_view.position = ((vp - sz) * 0.5).floor() + Vector2(0, 8)`; no `_gui_input` (overlay click-to-close not implemented).
- `scripts/entities/Minion.gd`: `_model_lunge()` 3-phase horizontal slash rewrite (squash/stretch, swing/roll/hop, per-instance jitter) + `_near_local_hero(radius)`; attack tail block has `_tgt_pos: Vector3 = current_target.global_position` at 4 tabs before `if attack_range*0.01 > 1.0:`, melee/super `Vfx.weapon_hit(...)` gated by `_near_local_hero(20.0)`.

## Errors and Fixes
- GDScript parse "Expected statement, found "Indent"" at block insertion: caused by `tp` being scoped inside `else:` branch → replaced with `_tgt_pos` declared at attack-branch level; also a stray leftover tween line had to be removed. Verified fixed (probe: pivot states 93, tower HP dropping).
- `scripts/ui/DeathRecapView.gd` got truncated to 1 byte by a failed PowerShell replace (`MISS resize` then `WriteAllText`) → restored with `git checkout -- scripts/ui/DeathRecapView.gd`, then applied edits with the `edit` tool.
- Death-panel row click: first hypothesis (panel recentering shifted rows) was wrong; user said "还是点击不准". Real cause = duplicate mouse+touch events described above; fixed by platform gate; verified by calling `_gui_input` twice (mouse then touch) → `_expanded=1`, second click → `-1` (previously toggle-twice → -1 immediately).
- Standalone `--script` parse check reports `Compile Error: Identifier not found: NetSession` at Minion.gd:207 — expected artifact of running outside full project; use in-project battle-scene probe instead.
- `Invalid access of index '4' on a base object of type: 'Array'` repeatedly logged during Li Yuanfang probes — pre-existing/unrelated.

## Pending Jobs
- Implement the Wukong somersault-cloud recall landing at fountain center; verify with probe (hero position ≈ spring center), then export + smoke + cleanup + `notify.ps1`.

## Current Work
- Just localized Wukong recall code via grep: `scripts/entities/Hero.gd` L321, L453, L461, L577-582 (cloud flight, `collision_layer = 0`), L1141, L1392. No edits made yet for this task.
- Previous round fully delivered and verified (export exit=0, run_exit=0, run_err=0, cleanup_ok, popup shown), including notification for 死亡面板点击修复.

- Read `scripts/entities/Hero.gd` regions ~L315-330, ~L445-470, ~L570-620, ~L1380-1440 to find the cloud-recall landing/destination position computation, then set it to the fountain center for the hero's team (blue `Vector3(-62, 0, 62)`, red `Vector3(62, 0, -62)`; fountain heal radius 3.6) and verify in-project.

  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

Better approach: create a dedicated `_foot_sigil` builder in Hero: build with Vfx primitives (allowed via public helpers? we can use MeshFactory + Vfx._add_mat... _add_mat is "private" but accessible).

Cheapest good-looking: create Node3D with:
- `Vfx.preview_ring(2.2, team)` (soft glow + ring)
- plus `MeshFactory.create_torus_ring(1.2, 1.45, color, true, 0.8, true)` inner ring
- plus rune ticks: 8 small boxes around circle (BoxMesh) → reads as 法阵
- slow spin: tween rotation.y loop.

Implement in Hero `_ready()`:
```
func _create_foot_sigil() -> void:
	_foot_sigil = Node3D.new()
	_foot_sigil.visible = false
	add_child(_foot_sigil)
	...
```
Position at (0, Config.GROUND_FX_Y + 0.03, 0) local, so it follows hero automatically.

Color: `Vfx.color_for_hero(display_name)`.

Spin: use a tween on _foot_sigil "rotation:y" loop TAU/6s, and counter-rotate inner ring different speed. Add breathing via scale? preview_ring disc already pulses.

Then in preview: `_foot_sigil.visible = true` (plus color refresh maybe on hero change—hero name fixed per instance).

Also for the "无技能预览" path hide it.

Should it show only when skill preview visible (held) — yes.

Also there's the mobile aim path? The preview block is common for desktop/mobile (any_held). Mobile skill hold uses TouchController.get_skill_held → any_held true ✓.

Edge: when skill not ready → hide ✓ handled by else branch.

Additionally "所有技能预览" might include attack preview (`_attack_button_preview`) — 普攻瞄准? The phrase 技能预览 = skill preview. I'll also show it in attack aiming? No, keep to skills.

Now implement:
1. Add var `_foot_sigil: Node3D = null`.
2. Create in _ready near other preview nodes (L829-849 region) with helper `_build_foot_sigil()`.
3. In preview block: after color setup, set visible + position.
4. Hide in both else branches.

Check ground level const: `Config.GROUND_FX_Y`. Use position y = Config.GROUND_FX_Y + 0.02.

Let me view Hero _ready region L810-855 for insertion point.

Insert foot sigil creation after line 849 (before `func buy_equipment`). Use existing MeshFactory helpers: `create_torus_ring`, and `Vfx.preview_ring`? For 法阵 look, build:

```
	# 技能预览法阵：瞄准任意技能时脚下浮现（双层反向旋转环 + 刻度符文 + 柔光）
	_foot_sigil = Node3D.new()
	_foot_sigil.visible = false
	_foot_sigil.position = Vector3(0, Config.GROUND_FX_Y + 0.02, 0)
	add_child(_foot_sigil)
	var fs_col: Color = Vfx.color_for_hero(display_name)
	_foot_sigil_glow = Vfx.preview_ring(2.3, team)  # 柔光 + 外圈
	_foot_sigil.add_child(_foot_sigil_glow)
	_foot_sigil_outer = MeshFactory.create_torus_ring(2.05, 2.2, fs_col, true, 0.85, true)
	...
```
Hmm `preview_ring(radius, team)` uses team_color(team) — for hero team.

Simpler and cleaner: create own rings:
- glow: `Vfx.preview_ring(2.2, team)` (pulsing soft disc + bright ring)
- inner ring A: torus 1.15-1.28 rotated flat, color fs_col, alpha .8
- inner ring B: torus 0.75-1.0, color fs_col.lerp(white,.4)
- 8 rune ticks: small BoxMesh (0.06, 0.02, 0.34) placed radius 1.7 at angles, color bright
- 3 arc? skip
- spin: two tweens looped (outer clockwise 8s, inner counter 5s, runes group 8s)

Store group for runes rotation.

Torus default orientation: TorusMesh lies in XZ plane by default in Godot? Earlier client code assumed default vertical and set rotation.x = 90°. In `Vfx.preview_ring` they add torus without rotation at y=0.03 → if default were vertical, it would look wrong; they didn't rotate, so default must be flat (ring around Y). Wait in NetClientBattle FX_WAVE_RING they set `rotation.x = deg_to_rad(90)` — inconsistent. Let me check MeshFactory.create_torus_ring / create_torus: it may create TorusMesh and rotate internally? Earlier read of create_torus_ring (L126-146) sets mesh, material, no rotation. So default torus orientation: Godot TorusMesh is oriented in the XZ plane (flat, hole along Y) — yes, TorusMesh in Godot is flat in XZ. Then why client rotated X by 90 in FX_WAVE_RING? Because they wanted it vertical? whatever.

For foot sigil: flat rings, no rotation needed ✓. For rune ticks: BoxMesh size (0.08, 0.03, 0.36) placed at radius 1.75, rotated about Y so long axis radial: `tick.rotation.y = -ang` with position (cos, 0, sin)*1.75. Actually box local Z is length; position along direction d=(cos a,0,sin a); set rotation.y = atan2(d.x, d.z) → box Z axis points along d ✓.

Spin animation: tweens with `set_loops()`.

Implementation of color: `Vfx.color_for_hero(display_name)`.

Now also update preview show/hide. Insert in the preview branch after the `for mi in [...]` color block, before `var dir = target_pos - global_position`:
```
					if _foot_sigil and is_instance_valid(_foot_sigil):
						_foot_sigil.visible = true
						_foot_sigil.global_position = Vector3(global_position.x, Config.GROUND_FX_Y + 0.02, global_position.z)
```
Since _foot_sigil is child of hero, local position would follow automatically; but hero may rotate (rotation.y) — child rotates with hero; that's fine but rings spinning + hero rotation ok.

Simpler: keep as child with local pos (0, ground_y, 0) — but hero origin y is 0? Hero sits on ground with y=0 presumably ✓. Then no need to set global_position each frame. But `_foot_sigil.position.y = Config.GROUND_FX_Y + 0.02` fine.

Hide: in the two else branches add `if _foot_sigil: _foot_sigil.visible = false`. There are two hides: line ~3182-3193 (skill not ready / no held) — two `else` blocks each setting the 4 nodes invisible. Add to both.

Also hide when hero dies/stunned? Preview block runs regardless; if stunned, `any_held` maybe false → hidden ✓.

Let me now write the edits.

# 脚底技能预览法阵（创建一次，预览时显隐）
func _build_foot_sigil() -> void:
	var col: Color = Vfx.color_for_hero(display_name)
	_foot_sigil = Node3D.new()
	_foot_sigil.visible = false
	_foot_sigil.position = Vector3(0.0, Config.GROUND_FX_Y + 0.02, 0.0)
	add_child(_foot_sigil)
	# 柔光底 + 外圈呼吸环
	_foot_sigil.add_child(Vfx.preview_ring(2.25, team))
	# 外层环（顺时针）
	var outer := MeshFactory.create_torus_ring(2.02, 2.16, col, true, 0.9, true)
	outer.name = "SigilOuter"
	_foot_sigil.add_child(outer)

@'
extends Node

var t := 0
var bm = null
var h = null

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child((load("res://scenes/battle.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate())

func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	t += 1
	if t == 20:
		Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER
		Config._team_rolled = true
		bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
		bm._start_game_body("亚瑟", "flash")
	elif t == 100:
		h = bm.hero
		for i in range(3):
			h.skill_levels[i] = 1
		Input.action_press("skill_0")
	elif t == 110:
		print("L levels=", h.skill_levels, " skills=", h.skills.size(), " pressed=", Input.is_action_pressed("skill_0"),
			" ready=", h.skill_cast_ready(0), " ai=", h.is_ai, " hp=", "%.0f" % h.health)
	elif t == 150:
		print("L visible=", h._foot_sigil.visible if h._foot_sigil != null else "null",
			" preview=", h.cast_range_ring.visible, " aoe=", h.aoe_fill.visible)
		Input.action_release("skill_0")
	elif t == 200:
		print("L released_visible=", h._foot_sigil.visible if h._foot_sigil != null else "null")
		get_tree().quit()

Actually `vis` root scaled? `_body_vis` = vis, and `_add_base_blend(f)` handles base scaling; is `vis.scale` set to f? Let me check: `var f := 2.0; match display_name: "crystal": f = 2.5`. Then `_body_vis = vis`, `_body_vis_base = vis.position`. Where is f used? `_add_base_blend(f)`. Maybe vis.scale set in visual()? Not visible.

The user wants the crystal model flatter (more 扁平) and larger radius. So modify the crystal body mesh: `_octa(0.72, 2.70)` → wider radius & shorter height, e.g. `_octa(1.35, 1.50)` and adjust y so bottom sits on stone. Also core `_octa(0.34,1.30)` → `_octa(0.6, 0.75)` adjusted y. And rings/halo sizes maybe scale to match: ring radius 1.10 → 1.7, halo 1.02 → 1.6.

Need to know `_octa(rad, height)` geometry: probably octahedron with radius and height (points at ±height/2?). Check `_octa` implementation and crystal stone top height to position body properly.

Also check `Turret._create_visual` scale: does `vis.scale = Vector3(f,f,f)`? Let me read further lines after `_add_base_blend(f)`.

No — renderer is a project setting; however Godot 4.3+ allows `rendering/renderer/rendering_method.web` override setting! content.text:
1|# NetSession.gd — 联机会话（M0：连接/名单；M1：主机快照广播 + 客户端观战棋盘；M2：真人接管）
2|#
3|# 设计：房主权威（host-authoritative）。主机运行全部模拟；
4|# 客户端零模拟，只「收已揭示实体的快照」+「上行意图指令（rpc）」，由主机校验后执行。
5|#
6|# 命令行参数（放在 `--` 之后）：
7|#   --net-host [port]     本机当主机（默认端口 7000）
8|#   --net-join <ip:port>  本机当客户端，连到该主机
9|#   --net-test            CI 标记：host 让 BattleManager 自动开局；client headless 跑脚本化接管驱动
10|#
11|# 无网络参数启动时本文件零副作用，单机玩法不变。
12|
13|extends Node
14|
15|const DeathRecapView = preload("res://scripts/ui/DeathRecapView.gd")
16|const SNAPSHOT_HZ := 30.0
17|const SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL := 1.0 / SNAPSHOT_HZ
18|
19|const TEAM_PLAYER := 0   # 与 Config.Team.PLAYER 一致，避免跨 autoload 解析
20|
21|enum Mode { NONE, HOST, CLIENT }
22|enum Phase { LOBBY, SELECT, BATTLE }   # LOBBY=房间；SELECT=大厅选人（全员锁齐才可开局）；BATTLE=已开局
23|
24|const MAX_SIDE_PLAYERS := 5   # 蓝方真人上限（host=1 + 先连 4 名 client），严格一人一职共 5 席
25|
26|# —— 触控技能键效果小字元数据（与 TouchController.FX_META 同源，peer 并行文件故复制）——
27|# 客户端无 Hero/托管实体，技能键图标读数(伤害预览/效果小字/多段窗口/充能/前置阻塞)由 host 编码进
28|# own.sx 下传，NetTouchPad 再喂共享 SkillTouchButton。这里只保留 _encode_button_fx 所需：效果标签文本
29|# 规则(sec/durs/num/two/flag) + 敌我配色归属。client 端无需本表（NetTouchPad 用 buff/debuff 两色+解码）。
30|const FX_META := {
31|<T>"slow":      {"ic": "缓", "c": Color(0.35, 0.78, 1.0), "two": true},
32|<T>"selfspeed": {"ic": "速", "c": Color(0.55, 1.0, 0.6), "two": true},
33|<T>"stun":      {"ic": "晕", "c": Color(1.0, 0.88, 0.4), "sec": true},
34|<T>"knockup":   {"ic": "飞", "c": Color(1.0, 0.68, 0.32), "sec": true},
35|<T>"freeze":    {"ic": "冰", "c": Color(0.5, 0.82, 1.0), "sec": true},
36|<T>"suppress":  {"ic": "压", "c": Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.5), "sec": true},
37|<T>"bt":        {"ic": "霸", "c": Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.35), "sec": true},
38|<T>"shield":    {"ic": "盾", "c": Color(0.52, 0.72, 1.0)},
39|<T>"heal":      {"ic": "愈", "c": Color(0.6, 1.0, 0.7)},
40|<T>"defup":     {"ic": "抗", "c": Color(0.6, 1.0, 0.72), "durs": true},

func _setup_peer() -> void:
<T>match mode:
<T><T>Mode.HOST:
<T><T><T>var peer := ENetMultiplayerPeer.new()
<T><T><T>var err := peer.create_server(host_port, 8)
<T><T><T>if err != OK:
<T><T><T><T>printerr("[Net] 主机创建失败 err=", err)
<T><T><T><T>mode = Mode.NONE
<T><T><T><T>return
<T><T><T>multiplayer.multiplayer_peer = peer
<T><T><T>players[1] = { "name": "主机" if cli_mode else "房主" }
<T><T><T>multiplayer.peer_connected.connect(_on_peer_connected)
<T><T><T>multiplayer.peer_disconnected.connect(_on_peer_disconnected)
<T><T><T>print("[Net] HOST 端口=", host_port, " 等待玩家加入…")
<T><T>Mode.CLIENT:
<T><T><T>var peer := ENetMultiplayerPeer.new()
<T><T><T>var err := peer.create_client(join_address, host_port)
<T><T><T>if err != OK:
<T><T><T><T>printerr("[Net] 客户端创建失败 err=", err)
<T><T><T><T>mode = Mode.NONE
<T><T><T><T>return
<T><T><T>multiplayer.multiplayer_peer = peer
<T><T><T>multiplayer.connected_to_server.connect(_on_connected_to_server)
<T><T><T>multiplayer.connection_failed.connect(_on_connection_failed)
<T><T><T>multiplayer.peer_disconnected.connect(_on_peer_disconnected)
<T><T><T>print("[Net] CLIENT 连接 ", join_address, ":", host_port, " …")
<T><T><T>_ensure_overlay()
<T><T>_:
<T><T><T>return


func _on_peer_connected(id: int) -> void:
<T>players[id] = { "name": "玩家%d" % id }
<T>print("[Net] 玩家上线 peer=", id, " 在线=", players.size())

  `var _goal_gap := Vector2(...).length()` then `if drop_mode: _goal_gap = global_position.distance_to(goal)`.
- `scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd`: `tornado_fx(pos,color)` rewritten (additive funnel cone + 3 tilted self-spinning torus rings + ground `_ring` + 2 upward `_burst` + parallel fade/shrink tween).

  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

# serve_web.ps1 — 本地起静态服务器预览网页版（默认 build/web）
param(
    [int]$Port = 8080,
    [string]$Root = (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..\build\web')
)
$root = (Resolve-Path $Root -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$index = Join-Path $root 'index.html'
if (-not (Test-Path $index)) { Write-Error "找不到 $index，请先导出 Web：`n  godot --headless --path . --export-release Web build/web/index.html"; exit 1 }

$py = $null
foreach ($cand in @('python', 'py', 'python3')) {
    $cmd = Get-Command $cand -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cmd) { $py = $cmd.Source; break }
}
if (-not $py) { Write-Error '需要 Python3 来起静态服务器（或改用任意静态服务器指向 build/web）'; exit 1 }

Write-Host "网页版预览： http://127.0.0.1:$Port/  (Ctrl+C 停止)"
Write-Host "注意：用 http://127.0.0.1 或 localhost 打开，file:// 无法运行 WebGL/WASM"
Push-Location $root
try { & $py -m http.server $Port --bind 127.0.0.1 } finally { Pop-Location }

# 网页版（Web/HTML5）导出与部署

## 1. 导出

```powershell
# 需要 Godot 4.7.2 + 官方 Web 导出模板（export_templates/4.7.2.stable/web_release.zip）
godot --headless --path . --export-release Web build/web/index.html
```

产物在 `build/web/`：`index.html` + `index.js` + `index.wasm`(≈39.5 MB) + `index.pck`(≈8.4 MB) + 图标。
首次加载约 48 MB，之后走浏览器缓存。

## 2. 本地预览

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\serve_web.ps1 -Port 8080
# 浏览器打开 http://127.0.0.1:8080/
```

注意：必须用 `http://`（或 https）打开，直接双击 `file://` 跑不了 WebGL/WASM。

## 3. 部署

任意静态文件服务器，指向 `build/web/` 即可（Nginx / Apache / GitHub Pages / Netlify / Cloudflare Pages）。

- 当前 Web 导出用的是**单线程模板**（`variant/thread_support=false`），**不需要** `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy` / `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy` 头，普通静态托管即可。
- 若以后改成多线程模板，则站点必须返回：
  `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin` 与 `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp`。
- 建议开启 gzip/brotli（`.wasm`、`.pck` 压缩后约 1/3），并给 `.wasm` 配 `application/wasm`。

## 4. 已做的网页适配

| 项 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 渲染后端 | `project.godot`：`renderer/rendering_method.web="gl_compatibility"`（WebGL2）；桌面端仍用 `mobile` |
| 导出过滤 | Web 预设 `exclude_filter` 排除 `screenshots/ android/ build/ export/ artifacts/ docs/` 等，pck 从 100+MB 降到 8.4MB |
| 纹理压缩 | 关闭 `vram_texture_compression/for_desktop|for_mobile`（WebGL2 普遍不支持 S3TC） |
| 画布 | `canvas_resize_policy=2`（跟随浏览器窗口自适应缩放） |
| 触屏 HUD | `Config.on_mobile()`：原生移动端 **或** 移动浏览器（`web_android`/`web_ios`）都走触屏 HUD |
| 联机 | 浏览器只能当**客户端**：`NetSession` 在 web 下改用 `WebSocketMultiplayerPeer` 连 `ws://<host>:<port>`；页面可用 `?host=ip:port` 覆盖地址。网页版大厅的「创建房间」置灰（浏览器无法监听端口） |
| 存档 | `user://`（IndexedDB）可用；`res://` 只读，相关回退分支在 web 下会失败但不影响运行 |

## 5. 已知限制

- 网页版不能当联机主机（需要桌面端开房）。
- 移动浏览器性能有限，建议关闭/降低特效档位（项目内 `Vfx.quality`）。
- 首次进入是静音状态，点一下画布后音频才启动（浏览器自动播放策略）。

- `export_presets.cfg` 新增 `Web` 预设：无多线程模板（不需要 COOP/COEP 头）、关闭 S3TC 纹理压缩（WebGL2 普遍不支持）、`canvas_resize_policy=2` 跟随浏览器缩放、排除 `screenshots/ android/ build/ export/ artifacts/ docs/ devfx*/ *.apk *.pck` —— pck 从 100+ MB 降到 8.4 MB
- Web 只能用 GL/WebGL2 后端，桌面端仍是 `mobile` 渲染器。实测 `.web` 平台覆盖在导出的 `project.binary` 里会被丢掉，所以改为脚本在导出期间临时把 `rendering_method` 改成 `gl_compatibility`，导出后自动还原，并自检 pck 里的值

**2. 一键脚本**
- `scripts/dev/export_web.ps1`：找 Godot → 临时切渲染后端 → 导出 → 还原 `project.godot`（期间文件被外部改过就不还原并告警）→ 校验 pck
- `scripts/dev/serve_web.ps1`：本地起静态服务器预览（`http://127.0.0.1:8080`）

**3. 平台判定**
- `Config.on_mobile()` / `Config.on_web()`；`TouchController`、`NetTouchPad`、`UiKit`、`DeathRecapView` 共 7 处 `OS.has_feature("mobile")` 改为 `Config.on_mobile()`。原因：网页版里 `mobile` 特性恒为 false，移动浏览器（`web_android`/`web_ios`）原本会错误地走桌面 HUD

**4. 联机**
- 浏览器只能当客户端：`NetSession._setup_peer()` 在 web 下改用 `WebSocketMultiplayerPeer` 连 `ws://<host>:<port>`，支持页面 URL 参数 `?host=ip:port` 覆盖；网页版大厅「创建房间」置灰（浏览器无法监听端口）。桌面端仍走 ENet 不变

**5. 文档**
- `docs/WEB_EXPORT.md`：导出/预览命令、静态托管要求、已做适配表、已知限制（网页版不能当主机、移动浏览器建议降特效、音频需先点一下画布）

## 验证

- Web 导出 `script_exit=0`，自检 `pck 渲染后端 = gl_compatibility`，pck 内含 `application/run/main_scene`、`index.pck 8.4 MB`
- 静态服务器实测：`index.html` 200（5441 B）、`index.wasm` 200 且 `Content-Type: application/wasm`，`GODOT_CONFIG` 中 `ensureCrossOriginIsolationHeaders:false`（无需特殊响应头）
- 桌面端回归：Windows 导出 `exit=0 err=0`，冒烟 `run_exit=0 run_err=0`；`project.godot` 已还原为 `rendering_method="mobile"`
- 临时目录已清理

部署：把 `build/web/` 整个目录丢到任意静态服务器（Nginx/GitHub Pages/Netlify），必须用 http(s) 访问，`file://` 打不开。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

Now I understand the three rings:

1. **Turret range** (`Turret._create_range_preview`): plain `TorusMesh` (inner range-0.15, outer +0.15) with `StandardMaterial3D` yellow alpha 0.3 unshaded. Position y=0.01 — flat, but no ground blending. Colors change by state (red/green/yellow).

2. **Hero attack range ring** (`Hero._create_attack_range_ring`): `MeshFactory.create_torus_ring(attack_range*0.01-0.1, +0.1, WHITE, true, 0.3)` at y=0.15.

3. **Jungle/epic activity ring** (`BattleManager._add_activity_ring`): plain torus + yellow alpha 0.25 material, y=0.02. Also client copy `_make_flat_ring`.

Goal: better "ground-fitting texture" quality — i.e., not a hard thin torus line but a shader-based ground decal with soft feather, subtle radial falloff, maybe dual-rim (soft inner glow + crisp thin outer edge), slight noise/drift, plus proper y-offset & polygon offset to avoid z-fighting and to conform to terrain undulation.

There's likely already a good ground-shader in Vfx (`_glow_shader`) used by `preview_ring` with softness/ring_width/pulse params. Best approach: add a shared "ground ring decal" builder in MeshFactory (or reuse Vfx._glow_shader) that:
- Uses a PlaneMesh (or a large ring quad) with radial shader: soft ring with feathered inner & outer edges, faint interior fill gradient, plus angular dashes/segments for readability, and a "grain" modulation so it reads as ground-attached rather than a solid color band.
- Also key for "贴合地面质感": terrain has undulation, so a flat quad floats/clips. Solution: make the ring follow ground height per-vertex? Simplest: use a custom shader with `vertex()` that samples? Can't sample heightmap easily. Alternative: increase Y and use `depth_draw_never` + slight vertical fade? Hmm.

Actually check whether ground is uneven: CLAUDE mention "野区起伏(最高≈0.26)、分路(0.14)、高地(≈0.2)". So ground height varies 0..0.3.
