# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

用户时间与预算有限，**每个任务都必须为省时间/省 token 服务**：

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

```gdscript
	var tw_spin := holder.create_tween()
	tw_spin.set_loops()
	tw_spin.tween_property(spin_root, "rotation:y", TAU, 2.2).as_relative()
```

{"command":"@'
extends Node
var t := 0
var bm = null
func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child((load("res://scenes/battle.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate())
func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	t += 1
	get_tree().paused = false
	if t == 30:
		Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER
		Config._team_rolled = true
		bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
		bm._start_game_body("刘禅", "flash")
	elif t == 200:
		print("L before props=", get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("vfx_prop").size())
	elif t == 210:
		var h = bm.hero
		h.global_position = Vector3(0, 0.5, 0)
		var c := Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.18)
		Vfx.mech_shield_fx(h.global_position, c)
		Vfx.mech_claw_fx(h.global_position, h.global_position + Vector3(0, 0, 4.0), c)
		Vfx.mech_stamp_fx(h.global_position, c)
	elif t == 216:
		var props := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("vfx_prop")
		print("L props=", props.size())
		for p in props:
			var gear := 0
			var arr := 0
			var torus := 0
			var cap := 0
			var box := 0
			var cyl := 0
			var sph := 0
			var part := 0
			var mats := {}
			var st := [p]
			while not st.is_empty():
				var cur: Node = st.pop_back()
				if cur is MeshInstance3D:
					var mi := cur as MeshInstance3D
					if mi.mesh is ArrayMesh: arr += 1
					elif mi.mesh is TorusMesh: torus += 1
					elif mi.mesh is CapsuleMesh: cap += 1
					elif mi.mesh is BoxMesh: box += 1
					elif mi.mesh is CylinderMesh: cyl += 1
					elif mi.mesh is SphereMesh: sph += 1
					var m = mi.material_override
					if m is StandardMaterial3D:
						mats["metallic=%.2f" % (m as StandardMaterial3D).metallic] = true
				elif cur is CPUParticles3D:
					part += 1
				for k in cur.get_children(): st.append(k)
			print("L prop=", p.name, " ArrayMesh=", arr, " Box=", box, " Capsule=", cap, " Cyl=", cyl, " Sphere=", sph, " Torus=", torus, " particles=", part, " metal_kinds=", mats.keys())
	elif t == 250:
		get_tree().quit()

@'

extends Node
var t := 0
var bm = null
func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child((load("res://scenes/battle.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate())
func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	t += 1
	get_tree().paused = false
	if t == 30:
		Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER
		Config._team_rolled = true
		bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
		bm._start_game_body("刘禅", "flash")
	elif t == 200:
		print("L before props=", get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("vfx_prop").size())
	elif t == 210:
		var h = bm.hero
		h.global_position = Vector3(0, 0.5, 0)
		var c := Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.18)
		Vfx.mech_shield_fx(h.global_position, c)
		Vfx.mech_claw_fx(h.global_position, h.global_position + Vector3(0, 0, 4.0), c)
		Vfx.mech_stamp_fx(h.global_position, c)
	elif t == 216:
		var props := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("vfx_prop")
		print("L props=", props.size())
		for p in props:
			var gear := 0
			var arr := 0
			var torus := 0
			var cap := 0
			var box := 0
			var cyl := 0
			var sph := 0
			var part := 0
			var mats := {}
			var st := [p]
			while not st.is_empty():
				var cur: Node = st.pop_back()
				if cur is MeshInstance3D:
					var mi := cur as MeshInstance3D
					if mi.mesh is ArrayMesh: arr += 1
					elif mi.mesh is TorusMesh: torus += 1
					elif mi.mesh is CapsuleMesh: cap += 1
					elif mi.mesh is BoxMesh: box += 1
					elif mi.mesh is CylinderMesh: cyl += 1
					elif mi.mesh is SphereMesh: sph += 1
					var m = mi.material_override
					if m is StandardMaterial3D:
						mats["metallic=%.2f" % (m as StandardMaterial3D).metallic] = true
				elif cur is CPUParticles3D:
					part += 1
				for k in cur.get_children(): st.append(k)
			print("L prop=", p.name, " ArrayMesh=", arr, " Box=", box, " Capsule=", cap, " Cyl=", cyl, " Sphere=", sph, " Torus=", torus, " particles=", part, " metal_kinds=", mats.keys())
	elif t == 250:
		get_tree().quit()

刘禅三个技能的特效全部改成「实体机械件」风格，纯色圆环、球体和方块都已替换。

## 新增基础件

- `MeshFactory.build_gear()`：真实齿轮网格，带梯形齿、中心孔、上下盘面和内外侧壁。它不同于圆形锯片，外观就是机甲的齿盘。
- `MeshFactory.metal_pbr()`：PBR 金属材质，metallic 0.9，带粗糙度、边缘光和可选的接缝自发光。

## 三个技能的改动

| 技能 | 之前 | 现在 |
|---|---|---|
| **Q 小霸王**（原本没有专属特效） | 只有通用护盾光圈 | 新增 `mech_shield` 道具：6 片六边形装甲板绕身旋转、每片带发光棱线；脚下双层齿轮盘正反双向旋转；蒸汽环喷口；2.4s 后淡出 |
| **W 机关魔爪** | 圆柱底盘、方盒机械臂、立方体爪指 | 真正的齿轮底盘和上层小齿轮反向旋转；3 只机械臂包括锥形大臂、肘部齿轮减速器、装甲前臂、2 根发光液压杆、3 颗铆钉、3 根锥形爪指和发光指节；落点有齿轮冲击环、6 道放射火花和蒸汽喷口 |
| **R 暴走熊猫** | 球体堆出的熊猫、两个纯色圆环 | 三层齿轮法阵，外大齿轮、内齿轮反向旋转、细符文环；机甲熊猫改用胶囊躯干和装甲胸甲，加发光胸核、护肩和肩部齿轮关节、胶囊手臂和方拳、金属头部和发光面罩，加金属圆盘耳朵、背部齿轮光环；R 的持续段把纯色环换成金属齿轮盘，把烟尘球换成蒸汽粒子，把火花球换成带拖尾锥形火星和金属飞屑 |

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 三个技能道具均生成 | `play_spell` 逐槽位调用后：`props=1 → 2 → 3` |

| R 熊猫构成 | 5 个齿轮、7 块箱体装甲、4 个胶囊、1 个能量核、1 个符文环、2 组粒子 |
| 材质 | 主体为 PBR 金属 `metallic=0.90`，只有高光棱线和粒子使用加色发光 |

3: ## 大厅「对战纪录」页面读取后复刻结算面板。与联机结算广播共用同一份 rows 结构。
4: 
5: const PATH := "user://battle_history.json"
6: const MAX_RECORDS := 20
7: 
8: 
9: # 从进行中的战斗收集结算数据（离线 / 联机主机通用）
10: static func payload_from_battle(bm: Node) -> Dictionary:
11: 	var rows: Array = []
12: 	if bm != null and is_instance_valid(bm):
13: 		for e in bm.get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes"):
14: 			if e is Hero:
15: 				var h := e as Hero
16: 				rows.append({
17: 					"name": h.display_name, "team": h.team, "lv": h.level,
18: 					"k": h.kills, "d": h.deaths, "a": h.assists,
19: 					"gold": int(h.total_gold_earned), "dmg": int(h.damage_dealt_to_heroes),
20: 					"mvp": h.is_mvp, "mine": not h.is_ai,
21: 				})
22: 	return {"winner": int(bm.get("winner")) if bm != null else -1,
23: 			"dur": float(bm.get("game_time")) if bm != null else 0.0,
24: 			"rows": rows}
25: 
26: 
27: # 追加一条纪录（最多保留 MAX_RECORDS 条，新的在最前）
28: static func record(payload: Dictionary, mode: String) -> void:
29: 	var rows: Array = payload.get("rows", [])
30: 	if rows.is_empty():
31: 		return
32: 	var all_records := all()
33: 	all_records.push_front({
34: 		"ts": int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()),
35: 		"mode": mode,
36: 		"winner": int(payload.get("winner", -1)),
37: 		"dur": float(payload.get("dur", 0.0)),
38: 		"rows": rows,
39: 	})
40: 	while all_records.size() > MAX_RECORDS:
41: 		all_records.pop_back()
42: 	_save(all_records)
43: 
44: 
45: static func all() -> Array:
46: 	if not FileAccess.file_exists(PATH):
47: 		return []
48: 	var f := FileAccess.open(PATH, FileAccess.READ)
49: 	if f == null:
50: 		return []
51: 	var txt := f.get_as_text()
52: 	f = null
53: 	var data: Variant = JSON.parse_string(txt)
54: 	return data if data is Array else []
55: 
56: 
57: static func count() -> int:
58: 	return all().size()
59: 
60: 
61: static func clear() -> void:
62: 	var abs_path := ProjectSettings.globalize_path(PATH)
63: 	if FileAccess.file_exists(PATH):
64: 		DirAccess.remove_absolute(abs_path)
65: 	_save([])
66: 
67: 
68: static func _save(all_records: Array) -> void:
69: 	var f := FileAccess.open(PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
70: 	if f == null:
71: 		return
72: 	f.store_string(JSON.stringify(all_records))
73: 	f = null

Per-hero rows: add `taken` (damage taken from heroes), `heal` (healing_done), `cc` (cc_duration_dealt), `turret` (turret_damage), `jungle` (jungle_gold), `lh` (last_hits), `items` (equipment names), `role`, `score`? Keep token/perf sane: add `role`, `taken`, `heal`, `cc`, `turret`, `lh`, `items` (array of item names, maybe 6), `ai`? Also `score` (MVP 评分?) Maybe `mvp_score`.

Match-level: add `total_kills`? derivable. Add `my_side`? Add `mode`, plus `map`? Add `rank_result` (段位升降) — available in bm.rank_result for single player. Add `player_name`, `hero` (already per row), `time` (ts exists), `gold_diff`? derivable. Add `first_blood`? not tracked. Add `epic` (暴君主宰击杀数)? check bm for epic kill counters. Also panel display: list row shows more (KDA, gold, dmg, 时长); detail page: show per-hero detailed columns (KDA/经济/输出/承伤/治疗/控制/推塔/补刀/装备) — might be dense; use compact multi-line per hero: name line + stats line.

Check Hero fields existence quickly & equipment representation.

W 55|func _draw_unit(r: Dictionary) -> void:
W 56|<T>var w: float = float(r["w"])
W 57|<T>var h: float = float(r["h"])
W 58|<T>if w <= 0.0 or h <= 0.0:
W 59|<T><T>return
W 60|<T>var p: Vector2 = r["pos"]
W 61|<T>var hp: float = float(r["hp"])
W 62|<T>var mx: float = maxf(1.0, float(r["max_hp"]))
W 63|<T>var shield: float = float(r.get("shield", 0.0))
W 64|<T>var tc: Color = r["team_color"]
W 65|<T>var team: int = int(r.get("team", 0))
W 66|<T>var top := Rect2(p, Vector2(w, h))
W 67|<T>var hw: float = clampf(hp / mx, 0.0, 1.0) * w
W 68|
W 69|<T># 投影（两层，软化）
W 70|<T>draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(1.5, 2.5), Vector2(w, h)), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.18))
W 71|<T>draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(2.5, 3.5), Vector2(w, h)), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.10))
W 72|
W 73|<T># 外框：深色底 + 队伍色细边
W 74|<T>draw_rect(Rect2(p - Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(w + 2, h + 2)), Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.94))
W 75|<T>draw_rect(Rect2(p - Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(w + 2, h + 2)), Color(tc.r, tc.g, tc.b, 0.34), false, 1.0)
W 76|
W 77|<T># 空槽（上亮下暗）
W 78|<T>draw_rect(Rect2(p, Vector2(w, h * 0.5)), BAR_BG_TOP)
W 79|<T>draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(0, h * 0.5), Vector2(w, h * 0.5)), BAR_BG_BOT)
W 80|
W 81|<T># 干扰条（塔被干扰时，血条上方灰条，带金属感）
W 82|<T>var iv: float = float(r.get("interfere", 0.0))
W 83|<T>if iv > 0.0:
W 84|<T><T>var ir := Rect2(p + Vector2(0, -7), Vector2(w, 5))
W 85|<T><T>draw_rect(ir, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45))
W 86|<T><T>draw_rect(Rect2(ir.position, Vector2(w * clampf(iv, 0.0, 1.0), 5)), Color(0.66, 0.68, 0.74))
W 87|<T><T>draw_rect(Rect2(ir.position, Vector2(w * clampf(iv, 0.0, 1.0), 2)), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35))
W 88|<T><T>draw_rect(ir, Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.9), false, 1.0)
W 89|
W 90|<T># 残血拖尾（渐变白，尾部一道亮边）
W 91|<T>var lag: float = clampf(float(r.get("lag", hp)) / mx, 0.0, 1.0) * w
W 92|<T>if lag > hw + 0.5:
W 93|<T><T>var lw: float = lag - hw
W 94|<T><T>var lb: int = 4
W 95|<T><T>for li in lb:
W 96|<T><T><T>var lq: float = float(li) / float(lb - 1)
W 97|<T><T><T>draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(hw, h * float(li) / float(lb)),
W 98|<T><T><T><T>Vector2(lw, h / float(lb) + 1.0)), Color(1.0, 0.94, 0.86, 0.52 - 0.32 * lq))
W 99|<T><T>draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(lag - 1.5, 0), Vector2(1.5, h)), Color(1.0, 0.94, 0.82, 0.9))
W 100|
W 101|<T># 血量填充（分段渐变 + 顶部高光 + 底部暗边 + 中缝）
W 102|<T>if hw > 0.0:
W 103|<T><T>var bands: int = 5
W 104|<T><T>var c_top: Color = tc.lightened(0.42)
W 105|<T><T>var c_bot: Color = tc.darkened(0.38)
W 106|<T><T>for bi in bands:
W 107|<T><T><T>var q: float = float(bi) / float(bands - 1)
W 108|<T><T><T>var col: Color = c_top.lerp(c_bot, q)
W 109|<T><T><T>draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(0, h * float(bi) / float(bands)),
W 110|<T><T><T><T>Vector2(hw, h / float(bands) + 1.0)), col)
W 111|<T><T>draw_rect(Rect2(p, Vector2(hw, maxf(1.5, h * 0.14))), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.45))
W 112|<T><T>draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(0, maxf(1.5, h * 0.14)), Vector2(hw, maxf(1.0, h * 0.08))), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.10))
W 113|<T><T>draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(0, h - 1.5), Vector2(hw, 1.5)), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.30))
W 114|<T><T>if h >= 10.0:
W 115|<T><T><T>draw_line(Vector2(p.x, p.y + h * 0.5), Vector2(p.x + hw, p.y + h * 0.5),
W 116|<T><T><T><T>Color(0, 0, 0, 0.22), 1.0)
W 117|
W 118|<T># 护盾（右侧淡蓝段 + 斜纹 + 左隔线）
W 119|<T>var sw: float = minf(clampf(shield / mx, 0.0, 1.0) * w, w - hw)
W 120|<T>if sw > 0.5:
W 121|<T><T>var sr := Rect2(p + Vector2(hw, 0), Vector2(sw, h))
W 122|<T><T>draw_rect(sr, Color(0.72, 0.82, 0.95, 0.92))
W 123|<T><T>draw_rect(Rect2(sr.position, Vector2(sw, maxf(1.5, h * 0.14))), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55))
W 124|<T><T>var x := 2.0
W 125|<T><T>while x < sw:
W 126|<T><T><T>draw_line(sr.position + Vector2(x, h), sr.position + Vector2(x + h * 0.55, 0),
W 127|<T><T><T><T>Color(1, 1, 1, 0.28), 1.0)
W 128|<T><T><T>x += 4.0
W 129|<T><T>draw_rect(Rect2(sr.position, Vector2(1.0, h)), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.75))
W 130|
W 131|<T># 塔：每 2000 血一格刻度（暗线 + 右侧微高光，像嵌进去的刻度）
W 132|<T>if bool(r.get("ticks", false)):
W 133|<T><T>var step := 2000.0 / mx * w
W 134|<T><T>if step > 5.0:
W 135|<T><T><T>var tx := step
W 136|<T><T><T>while tx < w - 1.0:
W 137|<T><T><T><T>draw_line(Vector2(p.x + tx, p.y), Vector2(p.x + tx, p.y + h), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 1.5)
W 138|<T><T><T><T>draw_line(Vector2(p.x + tx + 1.5, p.y), Vector2(p.x + tx + 1.5, p.y + h),
W 139|<T><T><T><T><T>Color(1, 1, 1, 0.14), 1.0)
W 140|<T><T><T><T>tx += step

H 2602|<T># 走A：每次普攻瞬间播放攻击动画并锁移动 0.5s（玩家与 AI 一致），避免边打边滑

H 2617|<T><T>lanling_as_buff_timer = 5.0; _recalculate_attributes()  # 解隐攻速buff：立即烘焙进 attack_speed_timer

=== actual_attack_damage decl ===
H L2295: var dmg := actual_attack_damage
H L2303: dmg = 475.0 + actual_attack_damage
H L2307: dmg += 300.0 + 50.0 * skill_levels[0] + 1.22 * actual_attack_damage
G L419: res -= float(source.flat_phys_pen)

Plan:
1. `Hero._perform_attack`: add `aa_target = target` (new public var). Also clear on death / when target dies? HUD validates `is_instance_valid(ph.aa_target) and ph.aa_target == entity` and entity alive → stale target is invalid automatically. Also manual_target already set to target at attack time, and `_get_attack_target()` keeps it. So could just use `manual_target`! But `manual_target` set on attack — for AI too, and for player attack hold, `manual_target` updates each swing. Using `manual_target` avoids touching Hero at all. However manual_target may be non-null while player isn't currently attacking (e.g. after move command it's cleared? It's cleared only on death at L631/1371). Hmm — then the hint could persist for a target the player is no longer attacking. 

Better to add explicit `aa_target` set in `_perform_attack` with a timer: `var aa_target: GameEntity = null` + `var aa_target_timer: float = 0.0`; set timer = attack interval (1.0/attack_speed) * 1.4 in _perform_attack; decrement in _physics_process; when 0 → null. HUD checks timer > 0.

Simpler: `aa_hit_time` = Time ticks at attack; HUD checks `now - ph.last_aa_time < 0.9` and `ph.aa_target == entity`. Use `_move_lock_until`? no.

Implement:
- Hero: `var aa_target: GameEntity = null` and `var aa_target_t: float = 0.0`; in `_perform_attack`: `aa_target = target; aa_target_t = clampf(1.0 / maxf(attack_speed, 0.1) * 1.6, 0.45, 1.6)`. In `_physics_process`, decrement; when <=0 clear `aa_target`.
Need to find a good spot in _physics_process — near `attack_timer` decrement. Search `attack_timer -=`.

2. HUD: compute `last_hit` flag per row (only for enemy non-hero? include all enemy units: minions/monsters/heroes/turrets?). For turrets hp large, AA dmg small — rarely true; harmless. For heroes it's a kill hint — but request says 补刀 (last hit) → mainly minions/monsters. Keep it generic but exclude own team (Config.is_ally).

Condition: `hp < dmg` where dmg = mitigated AA damage (and hp > 0).

3. WorldBarPainter: when `last_hit` → gray-white fill:
- Replace `tc` usage for fill colors with a gray-white derived palette: `var c_top = Color(0.96,0.97,0.98)`, `c_bot = Color(0.62,0.65,0.68)`, plus outer border white, and maybe add subtle white pulsing glow. Also text remains.

Implement in painter:
```gdscript
	var last_hit: bool = bool(r.get("last_hit", false))
	if last_hit:
		tc = Color(0.90, 0.92, 0.95)
```
then later fill uses tc.lightened/darkened → gray-white ✓. Also pulse: `var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5*sin(_t*8.0)` add extra white highlight on top row when last_hit.

Let me check `_draw_epic` uses `tc` too — epics separate path; skip.

Find `attack_timer` decrement location in Hero._physics_process.

{"command":"$f='scripts\entities\Hero.gd'
$L=Get-Content $f
# 1) _perform_attack 里记录最近普攻目标
$i=($L | Select-String -Pattern '^\tmanual_target = target$').LineNumber | Select-Object -First 1
"manual_target_at=$i"
$ins = @("`t# 补刀提示：记录本次普攻目标并给一个略长于攻击间隔的有效期", "`taa_target = target", "`taa_target_t = clampf(1.6 / maxf(attack_speed, 0.1), 0.5, 1.8)")
$L[$i-1] = $L[$i-1] + "`n" + ($ins -join "`n")
# 2) 每帧衰减
$j=($L | Select-String -Pattern '^\tif attack_timer > 0: attack_timer -= delta \* attack_speed_timer$').LineNumber | Select-Object -First 1
"tick_at=$j"
$L[$j-1] = $L[$j-1] + "`n`tif aa_target_t > 0.0:`n`t`taa_target_t -= delta`n`t`tif aa_target_t <= 0.0:`n`t`t`taa_target = null"
Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 $f $L
$b=Get-Content $f
$k=($b | Select-String -Pattern 'aa_target = target').LineNumber
($k-3)..($k+2) | ForEach-Object { "H $_|" + ($b[$_-1] -replace "`t","<T>") }
"..."
$m=($b | Select-String -Pattern 'if aa_target_t > 0.0').LineNumber
($m-2)..($m+5) | ForEach-Object { "H $_|" + ($b[$_-1] -replace "`t","<T>") }","description":"Wire aa_target tracking in Hero"}

{"command":"@'
extends Node
var t := 0
var bm = null
var target = null
var painter = null
func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child((load("res://scenes/battle.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate())
func _find(n: Node, nm: String) -> Node:
	if str(n.name) == nm: return n
	for c in n.get_children():
		var r := _find(c, nm)
		if r: return r
	return null
func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	t += 1
	get_tree().paused = false
	if t == 30:
		Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER
		Config._team_rolled = true
		bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
		bm._start_game_body("后羿", "flash")
	elif t == 200:
		var hero = bm.hero
		# 选最近的敌方单位（塔也可，但优先小兵/野怪）
		var best = null
		var bd := 1e9
		for e in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("entities"):
			if e is Hero: continue
			if Config.is_ally(int(e.team)): continue
			var dd: float = hero.global_position.distance_to(e.global_position)
			if dd < bd:
				bd = dd
				best = e
		target = best
		print("L target=", target != null, " ", target.get_class(), " dist=", bd)
		if target:
			target.visible = true
			target.health = 300.0

			hero.actual_attack_damage = 800.0
			hero.global_position = target.global_position + Vector3(2.0, 0.6, 0.0)

		print("L rows=", n, " any_last_hit=", hit, " target_visible=", target.visible, " target_hp=", target.health)
		var hud = _find(bm, "HUD")
		print("L hud=", hud != null)
	elif t == 225:
		# 血量拉高 → 应恢复原色
		target.health = 3900.0
	elif t == 232:
		var any := false
		for r in painter.rows:
			if bool(r.get("last_hit", false)): any = true
		print("L high_hp_any_last_hit=", any)
	elif t == 250:
		get_tree().quit()

		var best = null
		var bd := 1e9

		print("L LOW_HP pixel=", _sample())

		var any := false
		for r in painter.rows:

		print("L HIGH_HP last_hit=", any)
		await get_tree().process_frame
		print("L HIGH_HP pixel=", _sample())
	elif t == 260:
		get_tree().quit()

补刀提示已实现：正在攻击的敌方单位进入斩杀线时，血条变灰白。

## 改动

**`Hero.gd`**：新增 `aa_target` / `aa_target_t` 两个字段；`_perform_attack()` 每次普攻记录目标，有效期取 `1.6 / 攻速`（夹在 0.5–1.8s，覆盖一次攻击间隔，收手后自动清空）。

**`HUD.gd`**（世界血条行构建）：每帧判断，对非己方、血量 > 0 的单位，同时满足：
1. 是玩家英雄最近一次普攻的目标且仍在有效期内；
2. `当前血量 < 普攻伤害 × (1 - 护甲/(护甲+602))`（按护甲与物穿算出的实际一次普攻伤害）→ `row["last_hit"] = true`。

**`WorldBarPainter.gd`**（合批绘制）：`last_hit` 时把队伍色替换为灰白色带（`Color(0.90,0.92,0.95)` → 白，7Hz 呼吸），并额外加一圈白色呼吸描边 + 顶部亮线，形成“可以补刀”的视觉提示；血条其余质感（渐变/高光/残血拖尾/护盾段）保持不变。

## 验证

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 标记触发 | 注入「刚普攻 + 血量 300、普攻 800（护甲 180 → 实际 616）」→ `last_hit=true` |
| 反向 | 血量抬到 3900（打不死）→ `last_hit=false`，恢复原色 |
| 像素验证 | 同一血条渲染采样：`last_hit=true` → `(0.77,0.78,0.79)` 灰白；`false` → `(0.81,0.41,0.37)` 红 |
| 时效 | 普攻后约 1.6s 内有效，超时 `aa_target` 自动置空，灰白提示消失 |
| 构建 | `SCRIPT ERROR=0`、`export_exit=0 err=0`、`run_exit=0 run_err=0` |

Request: 小兵死亡到底后应该缓缓从地面上沉下去而不是立即消失 → after the body has fallen (0.55s tween), slowly sink into the ground before removing.

Implementation: in `Minion.die()`, after `super.die(killer)`, start a sink tween on `visual` (or whole node) — tween position.y down by ~1.2 over ~0.8s after the fall. But `super.die` awaits 1.0s (or anim length) then queue_free. Minion `_proc_death` is only for no-skeleton visuals (`_proc_visual`). Minions with skeleton models play "die" anim.

Best approach: in Minion, override the death removal delay: start a coroutine that:
1. await fall duration (0.55s) — for proc visuals; for skeleton animations use a small delay ~0.6s.
2. Then tween the root node (`self`) or `visual` Y downward over e.g. 0.9s while fading? Fading not required ("缓缓从地面上沉下去"). Just sink.
3. Ensure `queue_free` happens after sink finishes → set `death_delay_override` so `super.die()` waits long enough (fall + sink + small). Since Minion.die calls super.die which awaits `death_time` then frees. Set `death_delay_override = 0.55 + 0.95` before super.die? But `death_delay_override` also used for skeleton anims — it overrides anim-based timing, fine.

```gdscript
func die(killer):

	if not is_dead:

	super.die(killer)
```

	if not is_dead:
		_proc_death()
		_start_sink()
	super.die(killer)
```

func _start_sink() -> void:
	var node: Node3D = visual if (visual != null and is_instance_valid(visual)) else self
	# 先等倒地动作结束，再缓缓下沉入土
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(0.6)
	tw.tween_property(node, "position:y", node.position.y - 1.4, 0.85).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
```
And set `death_delay_override = 0.6 + 0.85 + 0.05` = 1.5 before super.die.

Also the minion model may be small (height ~1.2); sinking 1.4 downward → disappears below ground. Ground plane at y=0; minion node at y≈0. Set target y = -1.5 relative to visual start.

Better to sink the *root* self (whole node incl. health bar?) — HUD bars are screen-space, unaffected. Use self so the body and its children (weapon) all sink. But `_proc_death` tweens `visual.position.y` (local), independent ✓. Sinking self.position.y works.

However `die()` in GameEntity sets can_move=false; other systems may reposition node? After death, `_physics_process` may still run (velocity zero). Fine.

Also minions are pushed by CollisionSystem? It skips dead? `collision_layer=0` set; CollisionSystem may still move... check quickly? It uses groups; pushes entities based on distance — dead minions might be skipped via health<=0 check. Risky but minor.

Also super.die() awaits timer using `death_time` computed BEFORE override? Sequence: in `crystal`... no: Minion.die sets `death_delay_override` then calls super.die(killer) → inside super, after `emit_signal("died")` it reads `death_delay_override` ✓ (read occurs after our assignment since our assignment precedes the call) ✓.

	t += 1

			m.die(null)
			print("L died=true override=", m.death_delay_override, " y=", m.global_position.y)

		if m and is_instance_valid(m):

	elif t == 340:
		print("L samples=", samples)
		print("L still_alive=", (m != null and is_instance_valid(m)))
	elif t == 350:
		print("L final_alive=", (m != null and is_instance_valid(m)))
		get_tree().quit()

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

## 改动（`scripts/entities/Minion.gd`）

- `die()` 在原有 `_proc_death()`（侧倒/坠地）之后调用新增的 `_start_sink_away()`。
- `_start_sink_away()`：先等 `0.62s` 让倒地动作播完，再用 `0.88s` `TRANS_SINE / EASE_IN` 把整个人沿 Y 轴沉下去（普通兵 `-1.5`，主宰/风暴/暗影先锋体格更大用 `-2.4`），同时把 `death_delay_override` 设为 `1.56s`，让父类 `die()` 的回收计时等到下沉结束才 `queue_free`。
- 死亡瞬间仍立刻关闭碰撞层、停止移动与攻击，血条也照旧立即消失（HUD 只画 `health > 0` 的单位），所以只有一具正在下沉的尸体，不会残留可交互对象。

- Delivered this session (all notified): (a) 非补刀金币 popup gets a drawn 👍 badge before the number + smaller/slower exp orbs with trail; (b) 开局地面推荐分路指引 distinguishing red/blue; (c) 刘禅 Q/W/R skill visuals rebuilt from gears + armor PBR (no plain colored primitives).

- `scripts/core/RankSystem.gd` `apply_result(win, mvp)` returns `{old_state, new_state, old_label, new_label, star_change, promoted, demoted, protected, floor_protected}`.
- `scripts/entities/MeshFactory.gd` — earlier added `build_gear(radius, thickness, teeth, tooth_h, hole_r, seg_per_tooth=4)`, `_ring_solid(...)`, `metal_pbr(color, roughness, glow)`.
- `scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd` — `mech_shield_fx`, rebuilt `mech_claw_fx`/`mech_stamp_fx`, helpers `_gear_disc(...)`, `_fade_geo(v, root)`, dispatch cases `"mech_shield"`/`"mech_claw"`/`"mech_stamp"` in `_spawn_skill_prop` (L1491+).
- `scripts/core/SpellFxTable.gd` L57: `"刘禅": {0: "mech_shield", 1: "mech_claw", 2: "mech_stamp"},`.
- `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` — 刘禅 R (暴走熊猫, `apply_skills(hero, 3, pos)`): ground ring + waist ring replaced with `MeshFactory.build_gear` MeshInstance3D + `metal_pbr`; steam via `Vfx._charge_particles(22, 0.9, Color(0.88,0.92,0.98), 0.22, 0.9)` with `EMISSION_SHAPE_RING`; metal shards (BoxMesh) instead of dust spheres; gear shock ring; cone spark streaks. Note `apply_skills`/`SkillDatabase.*` runs visuals but NOT props — props only spawn through `Vfx.play_spell(hero_name, slot, caster_pos, target_pos, skill, facing, is_local)`.
- `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` — `show_gold_popup` 👍 badge (`setup(..., "thumb", ..., "coin")`), `ValuePopup` `icon2` + `_draw_thumb()`.
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` — `_finish_intro()` calls `_spawn_lane_guides()`; new consts `LANE_GUIDE_HOLD := 12.0`, `LANE_GUIDE_FADE := 1.6`; funcs `_spawn_lane_guides()`, `_lane_for_role(role)`, `_add_lane_guide(parent, pts, color, highlight)`, `_lane_guide_fade(v, root)`; exp orb at `spawn_exp_orb`: `create_exp_orb(0.11)`, scale 0.35, `Vfx.attach_trail(orb, Color(0.42,1.0,0.60), 0.12, 0.24, 8, Color(0.86,1.0,0.90,0.55))`, flight 0.9 s TRANS_SINE.

- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

content.text:
Relax last-hit hint: apply to all on-screen enemy units, not just currently attacked target.

Changes:
1. HUD `_update_unit_row`: remove `aa_target` requirement — keep `not Config.is_ally(team)` and `hp > 0` and `hp < mitigated AA`. Should I restrict to nearby? "只要在屏幕内的单位都给出" — the HUD row builder already culls off-screen (vp_rect) and distance >44 for minions. So just drop the aa_target condition.

Also maybe they intend "在屏幕内" also for units in attack-range not required → confirm no distance check. Fine.

2. Hero bars: also apply? "单位" — heroes are units too, and it's a kill hint. Add to HeroInfoControl: compute `last_hit` in `_draw` from bm.hero AA, then override `tc` similarly with gray-white pulse. Cheap: reuse pattern.

Implement:
In HeroInfoControl `_draw` after tc computed:
```gdscript
	# 补刀提示（放宽版）：屏幕内敌方英雄血量低于玩家一次普攻 → 血条灰白
	if not _is_self and _bm != null and _bm.hero != null and is_instance_valid(_bm.hero) and not Config.is_ally(hero.team):
		var _e_res: float = maxf(0.0, float(hero.armor) - float(_bm.hero.flat_phys_pen))
		var _aa: float = float(_bm.hero.actual_attack_damage) * (1.0 - _e_res / (_e_res + 602.0))
		if hp < _aa and hp > 0.0:
			tc = Color(0.90, 0.92, 0.95)
```
But need pulse for highlight? Bar in hero control uses `tc` for fill and border. Keep simple gray-white without pulse (or add pulse using a time var). Is there `_t` in HeroInfoControl? Simpler: no pulse for heroes; the gray bar suffices. Hmm, but overlay "white glow" border also would be nice. Keep minimal: just tint tc.

Wait — should the hint apply to heroes at all? The user says "只要在屏幕内的单位都给出" in the context of 补刀提示 (last-hit = minions). Heroes' HP bars turning gray might be confusing (gray = dead). Risky. But "单位" includes 塔/野怪/英雄. Since bar-color hint semantics is "can be last-hit / killable in one AA", applying to heroes gives "可秒杀" hint which is useful.

I'll apply to non-hero units (minions, jungle monsters, turrets) via `_update_unit_row` — that covers all "units" except heroes. Should I include heroes? The prior feature description said "正在攻击的敌方目标" which included heroes presumably. To be safe and consistent, include heroes too (they're 单位 and on-screen).

Hmm, but the epics use `_draw_epic` separate path — check `_draw_epic` uses tc? If last_hit true for epic monsters (hp huge vs AA, unlikely), skip.

Decision: implement both unit rows and hero bars.

Let me look at _draw_epic quickly? Not needed since hp < AA essentially never for epics.

Edits:
1. HUD block: remove aa_target condition lines.
2. HeroInfoControl: add tint block.

Then probe verification: two-hero/units scenario hard; simpler verify via a probe that builds rows with multiple enemies and checks all enemy rows with hp<AA have last_hit=true while ally rows don't.

For hero bars, check with probe: set an enemy hero's HP low and ensure... the tint is internal; can't read. Could verify pixel sample again via SubViewport? HeroInfoControl draws in screen coords with hero ref set; I could instantiate a HeroInfoControl in a SubViewport with a real enemy hero and sample pixel. That's heavier. Alternative: verify code compiles + verify unit rows numerically. Given "验证从简" principle, do a probe checking unit rows (multiple enemies flagged) and rely on parse for hero control.

Actually for hero: simpler proxy — extract the condition into a helper on HeroInfoControl? No. Let's just do pixel test cheaply: instantiate HeroInfoControl in SubViewport, assign `hero` = a real enemy hero from battle, sample bar pixel color. Doable: HeroInfoControl draws relative to its own rect; needs `custom_minimum_size`. Let's attempt; if messy, skip.

First do edits.

补刀提示已放宽为“屏幕内所有敌方单位”。

## 改动

- **`HUD.gd`**（小兵/野怪/塔的世界血条）：删除“必须是 `aa_target` 且未过期”的条件，现在只判断：非己方单位、血量 > 0、剩余血量低于一次普攻的实际伤害（扣除护甲减免），就把该单位标记为 `last_hit`，血条由 `WorldBarPainter` 画成灰白并加呼吸描边。屏幕外的单位本来就不会生成血条行，因此自然限定在屏幕内。
- **`HeroInfoControl.gd`**（英雄血条）：新增同一规则，屏幕内敌方英雄进入“一次普攻击杀”血量时，血条（连同外框）转为灰白；己方与玩家自己不受影响。

## 验证

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 无需锁定目标 | 探针中 `aa_target=<null>`（从未攻击），4 个小兵血条行里 2 个残血行 `last_hit=true` |
| 只对敌方残血生效 | 满血敌方小兵、残血己方小兵均 `last_hit=false` |
| 英雄血条像素 | 同一列 y=86..102：残血 `gray_px=17 / red_px=3`；满血 `gray_px=0 / red_px=31`（灰白 ↔ 红反转） |
| 构建 | `SCRIPT ERROR=0`、`export_exit=0 err=0`、`run_exit=0 run_err=0` |

But better yet: avoid duplicating layout — the history detail could reuse ResultsPanel's data-table builder by feeding stat arrays. However ResultsPanel is built from live Hero objects (`_get_hero_stats(h)` uses hero fields). Refactoring to accept dictionaries is invasive.

So history already has everything needed to compute the 11 stats → just render them in BattleHistoryPanel detail using the same labels/format as ResultsPanel data tab.

		add_child(panel)
		panel.set("_recs", [rec])
	elif t == 206:
		panel.call("_show_detail", 0)

		var out := []
		_collect(panel, out)
		print("L labels=", out.size())

		get_tree().quit()

Current: `_load_step(1.0)` → then `building_battle=false` → `_begin_intro()` → sets camera, awaits 2 frames, frees loading screen. Intro runs 2.8s.

Requirements:
1. After all players pick hero → 5s countdown → then loading screen appears. Currently: pick → `_start_game()` immediately creates loading screen.

2. Loading screen: after loading completes (progress 1.0 / build done), wait 2 more seconds → then enter battle.

Implementation plan:

A) In `_start_game()` (L326-383): before creating `loading_screen`, run a 5-second countdown overlay on top of the hero-select UI. Add a new function `_play_pick_countdown()` that returns after 5s (await), showing a full-screen overlay with big countdown number "5,4,3,2,1" and text "全部玩家已选定英雄". Then continue to create loading screen.

But `_start_game` is async then; after the countdown, continue. Need to be careful: `_start_game` is called from two places, and `_loading_shown` guard prevents duplicates ✓.

However during countdown, the hero-select UI stays visible. Simplest cheap overlay: Control (full rect) in a CanvasLayer on top? BattleManager is Node3D; UI uses CanvasLayer. Create `CanvasLayer.new()` with a Control + big Label, process_mode ALWAYS, and update in a loop with await timers; remove at end.

Actually better UX: show countdown in the hero select screen itself. Does Select UI have a confirm area? Cheap generic full-screen overlay works and is clearly visible ("倒计时后进入加载界面").

Implementation:
```gdscript
const PICK_COUNTDOWN := 5.0

func _play_pick_countdown() -> void:
	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
	layer.layer = 128
	layer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child(layer)
	var root := Control.new()
	root.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	layer.add_child(root)
	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.color = Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.06, 0.55)
	dim.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	root.add_child(dim)
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	vb.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	root.add_child(vb)
	var tip := Label.new()
	tip.text = "全部玩家已选定英雄"
	tip.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	tip.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	tip.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.94,0.95,1.0))
	vb.add_child(tip)
	var num := Label.new()
	num.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	num.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 120)
	num.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0,0.84,0.32))
	vb.add_child(num)
	var t := PICK_COUNTDOWN
	while t > 0.0:
		num.text = str(int(ceil(t)))
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.1).timeout
		t -= 0.1
	layer.queue_free()
```
Note: `get_tree().create_timer` respects pause? Default `process_always = true` in Godot 4 create_timer(time_sec, process_always=true) ✓ so works even if paused.

But careful: during the countdown the game is paused? At this point battle not built. Fine.

Also the countdown should only happen once; `_loading_shown` guard: set `_loading_shown = true` at start, then countdown, then continue ✓ (guard set before countdown prevents duplicate starts). But `_start_game` is called from a UI signal; awaiting inside is fine.

Also requirement says "所有玩家选定英雄后" — in single player the AI picks happen instantly; the flow is: player confirms → `_start_game`. So countdown starts when the player confirms. In multiplayer, hero select has picks/reveal; `_start_game` called when host starts. So placing countdown at start of `_start_game` is right.

B) Loading wait: after build completes (progress 1.0), wait 2s before entering battle. Add in `_start_game_body` after `await _load_step(1.0)`: 
```gdscript
	# 加载完成后再停留 2 秒，让加载界面把 100% 呈现完整
	if loading_screen:
		var hold := 2.0
		while hold > 0.0:
			hold -= 0.05
			await get_tree().create_timer(0.05, true).timeout
```
Hmm `create_timer(0.05)` — during `building_battle`, tree paused=true and BattleManager PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS; SceneTree timer with process_always=true still runs ✓.

Simpler: `await get_tree().create_timer(2.0).timeout`.

Then `building_battle = false; _begin_intro()`.

But note: `_begin_intro` also awaits 2 frames then removes loading screen. That's fine.

Also maybe display "加载完成" text? Optional: set subtitle "加载完成，即将进入对局". Keep cheap: loading_screen is `LoadingScreen`; could set `_pct` text to 100% — it's already. I'll skip extra.

Where exactly to add: after `await _load_step(1.0)` and before `building_battle = false`.

Also there's NetClientBattle.gd L347 with its own loading screen — check whether client battle flow has similar structure and needs the 2s wait? The requirement mentions general flow. Keep to BattleManager (single/host) plus check NetClientBattle briefly: it may build battle and hold. Let me check that area (~330-380) to apply the same 2s if trivial.

Also net lobby `_loading` (NetLobby L797-820) with "至少0.45s后再切场景" — the 5s countdown for net: hero select in NetLobby? The pick flow for online may go through NetLobby → then scene switch → BattleManager._start_game. Simplest: our countdown in `_start_game` applies to the battle scene start for all modes ✓.

	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
	layer.layer = 128
	layer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child(layer)
	var root := Control.new()
	root.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	layer.add_child(root)
	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.color = Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.06, 0.58)
	dim.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	root.add_child(dim)
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	vb.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	root.add_child(vb)
	var tip := Label.new()
	tip.text = "全部玩家已选定英雄"
	tip.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	tip.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	tip.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.93, 0.95, 1.0))
	tip.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.85))
	tip.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 6)
	vb.add_child(tip)
	var num := Label.new()
	num.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	num.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 132)
	num.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 0.84, 0.30))
	num.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.9))

Concerns:
- `await get_tree().create_timer(2.0).timeout` while tree paused: SceneTreeTimer default `process_always = true` ✓ (signature: create_timer(time_sec, process_always=true, process_in_physics=false, ignore_time_scale=false)). ✓
- The countdown: `_start_game` now awaits 5s *before* creating loading screen. During that time UI visible with overlay ✓. But is `get_tree().paused` true at that moment? Probably not. `create_timer` works regardless ✓.
- Potential issue: `_start_game` sets `_loading_shown = true` before countdown ✓ preventing double start.

But subtle: during the countdown, is `select_ui` still interactive such that the player could pick another hero and trigger `_start_game` again? Guard handles.

Another subtlety: does something else expect `_start_game` to be synchronous (e.g., `NetSession` net start sends ready then scene transitions)? Callers just call it. OK.

Also net lobby flow: for online, host's `_start_game` triggered after scene switch; countdown then applies too — acceptable ("所有玩家选定英雄后").

Now verify with probe: simulate hero pick → time from call to loading screen creation = ~5s, and from progress 1.0 to intro start ≈ 2s. Measure with timestamps.

Probe: start battle scene; at t=30 call `bm._start_game("后羿","flash")` (real flow, but _start_game uses UI/select state — it may need select_ui etc.; earlier probes called `_start_game_body` directly). Simulating full `_start_game` may work: it creates loading screen, calls `_start_game_body` with run flags... Let's check what happens when select_ui null - guarded `if select_ui:`. `sel_ally_picks` empty → fallback branch ✓.

Measure: record `Time.get_ticks_msec()` when calling; then each frame print when `bm.loading_screen != null` first appears, when `bm.loading_screen` becomes null (intro start), and `bm.intro_active`.

But note the game's flow: `_start_game` → countdown 5s → creates loading screen → `_start_game_body` builds (~? frames) → 2s wait → `_begin_intro` → await 2 frames → loading_screen freed → intro_active true.

Expected: loading appears at +5.0s; intro starts (loading_screen null) ≈ +5 + build(≈1s?) + 2.0 + small.

Measure deltas. Then quit. But `--fixed-fps 60` means real timers track game frames not wall clock: create_timer counts via delta (fixed 1/60) → 5s = 300 frames. Good: deterministic.

Probe prints frame numbers: call at frame F0; loading appears at F_show; intro at F_intro. Expect F_show-F0 ≈ 300 frames (5s), F_intro-F_progress100 ≈ 120 frames (2s).

Write probe devfx76.

TeleportZone exists as node group with visual portal. "要绘制已开启的传送阵" → draw on minimap all existing TeleportZone nodes (they only exist while open, queued free after duration) — so draw each with a distinctive icon.

Add to MinimapDraw a `draw_teleport_zone(ci, pos, r, pulse)` — draw a cyan/violet portal ring with swirl, plus maybe countdown of remaining? Simple: glowing double ring + 4 rotating runes (dots). Keep static-ish using time.

extends Node
class ZoneCanvas extends Control:
	func _draw() -> void:

var t := 0
var bm = null
var sv: SubViewport = null
var tp_start := -1
var tp_done := -1
func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child((load("res://scenes/battle.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate())
func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	t += 1
	get_tree().paused = false
	if t == 30:
		Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER
		Config._team_rolled = true
		bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
		bm._start_game_body("后羿", "flash")
	elif t == 200:
		# 1) 回城：中央指示器不再显示数字
		bm.hero.start_recall()
	elif t == 206:
		var ind = UiManager.recall_indicator
		print("L RECALL visible=", ind.visible, " label=", UiManager.recall_label.text,
			" bar=", UiManager.recall_progress_bar.value, " has_digit=", UiManager.recall_label.text.contains("s"))
		bm.hero.cancel_recall()
	elif t == 210:
		# 2) 传送：读条时长与实际吟唱一致（4 秒）
		bm.hero.start_teleport(Vector3(40, 0, 40))
		tp_start = t
	elif t == 216:
		print("L TELEPORT label=", UiManager.recall_label.text, " bar=", UiManager.recall_progress_bar.value,
			" progress=", bm.hero.teleport_progress, " dur_const=", Hero.TELEPORT_DURATION)
	elif tp_start > 0 and tp_done < 0 and not bm.hero.is_teleporting:
		tp_done = t
		print("L TELEPORT_DONE frames=", tp_done - tp_start, " seconds=", (tp_done - tp_start) / 60.0,
			" moved=", bm.hero.global_position)
		# 3) 小地图传送阵绘制：画到离屏 canvas 后采样像素
		sv = SubViewport.new()
		sv.size = Vector2i(120, 120)
		sv.transparent_bg = true
		sv.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS
		add_child(sv)
		var cv := ZoneCanvas.new()
		cv.size = Vector2(120, 120)
		sv.add_child(cv)
	elif tp_done > 0 and t == tp_done + 4:
		var img := sv.get_texture().get_image()
		var c1 := img.get_pixel(40, 40)
		var c2 := img.get_pixel(100, 100)
		print("L ZONE center=", "(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,a%.2f)" % [c1.r, c1.g, c1.b, c1.a],
			" outside=", "(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,a%.2f)" % [c2.r, c2.g, c2.b, c2.a])
		# 4) 小地图敌方阵亡英雄过滤：条件快速自检
		var dead_enemy_visible := false
		for h in bm.get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes"):
			if h is Hero and h.team != Config.player_team and h.health <= 0.0:
				dead_enemy_visible = true
		print("L dead_enemy_present=", dead_enemy_visible)
		get_tree().quit()
	elif t > 900 and tp_done < 0:
		print("L TELEPORT_TIMEOUT progress=", bm.hero.teleport_progress)
		get_tree().quit()

var sv: SubViewport = null
var tp_start := -1

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child((load("res://scenes/battle.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate())
func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	t += 1
	get_tree().paused = false
	if t == 30:
		Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER
		Config._team_rolled = true
		bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
		bm._start_game_body("后羿", "flash")
	elif t == 200:
		# 1) 回城：中央指示器不再显示数字
		bm.hero.start_recall()
	elif t == 206:
		var ind = UiManager.recall_indicator
		print("L RECALL visible=", ind.visible, " label=", UiManager.recall_label.text,
			" bar=", UiManager.recall_progress_bar.value, " has_digit=", UiManager.recall_label.text.contains("s"))

		tp_done = t

			" moved=", bm.hero.global_position)

		sv = SubViewport.new()
		sv.size = Vector2i(120, 120)
		sv.transparent_bg = true
		sv.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS
		add_child(sv)
		var cv := ZoneCanvas.new()
		cv.size = Vector2(120, 120)
		sv.add_child(cv)
	elif tp_done > 0 and t == tp_done + 4:
		var img := sv.get_texture().get_image()
		var c1 := img.get_pixel(40, 40)
		var c2 := img.get_pixel(100, 100)
		print("L ZONE center=", "(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,a%.2f)" % [c1.r, c1.g, c1.b, c1.a],
			" outside=", "(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,a%.2f)" % [c2.r, c2.g, c2.b, c2.a])
		# 4) 小地图敌方阵亡英雄过滤：条件快速自检
		var dead_enemy_visible := false
		for h in bm.get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes"):
			if h is Hero and h.team != Config.player_team and h.health <= 0.0:
				dead_enemy_visible = true
		print("L dead_enemy_present=", dead_enemy_visible)
		get_tree().quit()
	elif t > 900 and tp_done < 0:
		print("L TELEPORT_TIMEOUT progress=", bm.hero.teleport_progress)
		get_tree().quit()
