summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Project-wide permanent rule (Chinese, in `CLAUDE.md` → `## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)`): "我的时间和预算不是很足，请你在这个项目尽可能快速完成我的任务并节省token用量，把这一条作为这个项目的原则" — shortest path, grep-first reads with offset/limit, minimal verification, terse output, no refactoring beyond the task, and **before every final answer must run** `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`.
- Delivered this session (all notified): 对战记录 richer detail (role/lh/jungle/taken/heal/cc/turret/items + turrets + rank) and, in the record detail page, a "战后数据" table identical in caliber to the post-match 数据 tab (评分 + 11 stats, team-best in gold); 补刀提示 (enemy unit HP bar turns gray-white when remaining HP < player's armor-mitigated basic-attack damage), later relaxed to all on-screen enemies without needing a locked target; minions sink slowly into the ground (0.88 s) after falling instead of vanishing instantly.
- **Current/latest request, verbatim**: 「所有玩家选定英雄后，进入5秒倒计时再跳转加载界面；加载界面等加载完成后，再等2秒再进入战斗」 — after all players lock heroes, show a 5-second countdown before switching to the loading screen; and after loading finishes, wait 2 more seconds before entering battle.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 (`rendering_method="mobile"`). Headless binary: `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe` → must `New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .cache` then copy to `.cache\godot47.exe` (dir deleted each delivery; re-create before probes).
- Export: `Start-Process .cache\godot47.exe -ArgumentList '--headless','--path','.','--export-release','"Windows Desktop"','HonorKing.exe'` → expect `export_exit=0 export_err=0`; smoke `HonorKing.exe --headless --quit-after 300` → `run_exit=0 run_err=0`; then `Get-Process godot47 | Stop-Process -Force`; remove probe dir + `.cache`.
- Probe pattern: `devfxNN\probe.gd` (`extends Node`, `process_mode = ALWAYS`, add `res://scenes/battle.tscn`) + `.tscn`; run real render (`--resolution 1600x1000 --fixed-fps 60`), grep stdout `^L `, grep stderr `SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error`.
- Game start in probes: `Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER; Config._team_rolled = true; bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager"); bm._start_game_body("英雄名", "flash")`; set `get_tree().paused = false` each frame; intro lasts `INTRO_DURATION = 2.8`.
- Minion spawn helper: `bm.spawn_single_minion(type, team, pos, waypoints, line)` — waypoints array must be non-empty (empty array → "Out of bounds get index '0'").
- **`user://` is NOT writable from probe processes** (`FileAccess.get_open_error()` = 12 / ERR_FILE_CANT_OPEN; also `Failed to open 'user://logs/...'`) even though the same user can write from PowerShell — probe artifact only; verify file round-trips by temporarily pointing the const at `res://devfxNN/...`.
- GDScript 4 warnings-as-errors; `const X: Array = [...]` (not `:=`); duplicate local variable names in the same function body are a parse error (`There is already a variable named "pulse" declared in this scope`).
- PowerShell `$L[a..b]` slicing corrupts files; do large-file edits with `edit`/`read` or single-index assignment. Pixel verification is viable: `get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().get_pixel(x,y)` and SubViewport render targets.

## Files and Code
- `scripts/core/BattleHistory.gd` (~102 lines) — `const PATH := "user://battle_history.json"`, `MAX_RECORDS := 20`. `payload_from_battle(bm)` rows: `name, team, lv, k, d, a, gold, dmg, mvp, mine, role, lh, jungle, taken, heal, cc(×10 int), turret, items`; returns `{winner, dur, turrets[2] (我方被拆, 敌方被拆 via Turret.TOTAL_PER_SIDE=10), rows}`. `_item_names(h)`; `record(payload, mode)` push_front `{ts, mode, winner, dur, turrets, rank, rows}`; `all()`, `count()`, `clear()`, `_save()`.
- `scripts/ui/BattleHistoryPanel.gd` (~512 lines, untracked file) — list rows (96 px) + detail page. Detail: banner, `_summary_strip(rec, rows)`, two `_team_block`, then NEW `_data_table(rows, team, color)` × 2. Added this round: `const STAT_META: Array = [["伤","对英雄伤害"],["抗","承受伤害"],["金","总经济"],["团","参团率"],["转","伤害转化比"],["死","每死承伤"],["野","野怪经济"],["刀","补刀数"],["控","控制时长"],["疗","治疗量"],["塔","对塔伤害"]]`, `_team_ctx(rows, team)`, `_hero_stats(r, ctx)` (mirrors `ResultsPanel._get_hero_stats`), `_rating(r, ctx)` (mirrors `_calculate_rating` weights 0.15/0.10/0.05/0.15/0.25/0.10/0.20), `_grade(score)` (超神≥90/MVP≥80/优秀≥70/良好≥60/一般≥50/低迷), `_fmt_stat(sn, v)`, `_data_table()` renders GridContainer with header `"名字 · 评分 评级"` + 11 stat rows, gold for team max (`v >= best - 0.0001`). Helpers: `_fs`, `_lab`, `_btn`, `_clear_body`, `_close`, `_time_text`, `_dur_text`, `_gold_text`, `_signed_gold`, `_rank_text`.
- `scripts/entities/Hero.gd` — `var aa_target: GameEntity = null` / `var aa_target_t: float = 0.0` (near `manual_target`, L80); `_perform_attack` sets `aa_target = target; aa_target_t = clampf(1.6 / maxf(attack_speed, 0.1), 0.5, 1.8)` right after `manual_target = target`; `_physics_process` decays `aa_target_t`, clears `aa_target` at ≤0 (inserted after `if attack_timer > 0: attack_timer -= delta * attack_speed_timer`).
- `scripts/ui/HUD.gd` — in `_update_unit_row` after `row["interfere"] = 0.0`: `row["last_hit"] = false`; if player hero valid, `entity != _ph`, `not Config.is_ally(int(entity.team))`, `hp > 0.0` → `_res = maxf(0.0, float(entity.armor) - float(_ph.flat_phys_pen))`, `_aa = float(_ph.actual_attack_damage) * (1.0 - _res / (_res + 602.0))`, `if hp < _aa: row["last_hit"] = true` (no aa_target requirement any more).
- `scripts/ui/WorldBarPainter.gd` — `_draw_unit`: `var last_hit`, `var lh_pulse: float = 0.0`; when last_hit `lh_pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * 7.0)` and `tc = Color(0.90,0.92,0.95).lerp(Color(1,1,1), lh_pulse*0.35)`; after the team-color border adds a white breathing outline `Rect2(p - Vector2(1.5,1.5), Vector2(w+3,h+3))` alpha `0.35 + 0.45*lh_pulse` width 1.5 and a top bright line. NOTE there is a pre-existing `var pulse` at ~L184 in the low-HP pulse block — keep it.
- `scripts/ui/HeroInfoControl.gd` — after `var tc: Color = ...` (~L337): if not self, `_bm.hero` valid, not ally, `hp > 0.0` → `_e_res = maxf(0.0, float(hero.armor) - float(_bm.hero.flat_phys_pen))`, `_aa = float(_bm.hero.actual_attack_damage) * (1.0 - _e_res / (_e_res + 602.0))`, `if hp < _aa: tc = Color(0.90, 0.92, 0.95)`. Bar geometry: `_draw` starts `var y := 24.0`, `y_offset = y + 2.0`, `bar_width 280`, `bar_height 28`, `bx = center_x - 140`, `center_x = size.x / 2`.
- `scripts/entities/Minion.gd` — `die(killer)` now calls `_start_sink_away()` after `_proc_death()`; new:
  ```gdscript
  func _start_sink_away() -> void:
      var depth: float = 2.4 if display_name in ["dragon", "storm", "shadow_dragon"] else 1.5
      var fall: float = 0.62
      var sink: float = 0.88
      death_delay_override = fall + sink + 0.06
      var tw := create_tween()
      tw.tween_interval(fall)
      tw.tween_property(self, "position:y", global_position.y - depth, sink) \
          .set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
  ```
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` (6261 lines) — key flow for the CURRENT task: `_start_game(hero_type, summoner_id)` at **L326** (guard `_loading_shown`), builds `heroes` list, creates `loading_screen = LoadingScreen.new()` with `manual_progress = true`, `hold_full = true`, `setup(heroes, "对局加载中", "王者峡谷 · 5v5", 0.1)`, hides select_ui/ui/minimap, `building_battle = true`, `get_tree().paused = true`, then `_start_game_body()`. `_start_game_body` at **L430** awaits `_load_step(p)` stages 0.26→1.0 (L457–L481), sets `building_battle = false`, calls `_begin_intro()` (L485). `_begin_intro()` at **L5123** sets up camera, pauses tree, `await get_tree().process_frame` ×2 (L5147-5148), then `loading_screen.visible = false; loading_screen.queue_free(); loading_screen = null` (L5151-5154), `_intro_waiting = false`. Callers of `_start_game(...)`: **L4266** and **L4937** (hero-select confirm handlers). `_load_step(p)` at L426. Also `loading_screen` var at L3000, `_loading_shown` at L3001, `_on_loading_finished`/`_on_loading_progress_full` at L413-419.
- `scripts/ui/LoadingScreen.gd` — `signal finished`, `signal progress_full`; `var hold_full`, `manual_progress`, `_duration := 2.6`, `_fade := -1.0`; `setup(heroes, title, subtitle, duration)`, `set_progress(v)`, `set_progress_visual`; `_process` returns early when `manual_progress` (L381-382) — so a manually-driven screen never auto-fades; only `_begin_intro` removes it.
- `scripts/net/NetLobby.gd` L797-805 also creates a `LoadingScreen` for entering matches; `NetClientBattle.gd` L347 too.
- `scripts/ui/ResultsPanel.gd` — reference for identical stats: `STAT_META` (L701-713), `_get_hero_stats(hero)` (L911), `_fmt_stat(stat_name, value)` (L942), `_rating_grade` (L684), `_calculate_rating` (L1018), `_create_hero_card` (L507), `_create_data_tab` (L715), `_create_team_data_column` (L764).

## Errors and Fixes
- `FileAccess.open("user://...", WRITE)` in probes returns null with `err=12`; `user://logs/godot*.log` also fails → diagnosed as probe-environment artifact (PowerShell can write the same dir); worked around by temporarily setting `BattleHistory.PATH` to `res://devfx71/hist_test.json` to verify record→read round-trip, then reverting.
- `const STAT_META := [...]` → invalid for const; fixed to `const STAT_META: Array = [...]`.
- `There is already a variable named "pulse" declared in this scope` (WorldBarPainter had an existing `pulse` at L184) → renamed the new one to `lh_pulse`.
- `Out of bounds get index '0' (on base: 'Array')` from `spawn_single_minion(..., [], ...)` → pass two waypoints.
- Probe pitfalls fixed: calling `_perform_attack` killed the test minion so its bar vanished (inject `hero.aa_target` instead); `_find(bm, "HUD")` fails (HUD is a CanvasLayer found via script path `ends_with("scripts/ui/HUD.gd")` from `get_tree().root`); hero bar sampling must use `y_offset = 26` (`ctl.position.y + 26 + 14`) not `+2+14`.
- `git checkout --` is FORBIDDEN (prior deliveries are uncommitted); pre-existing diffs are legitimate work.

## Pending Jobs
1. Implement the 5-second countdown after all players have locked heroes, before the loading screen appears (single-player and any other `_start_game` entry path).
2. Implement the extra 2-second wait after loading completes before entering battle (before/around `_begin_intro()` / loading-screen removal).
3. Verify via probe (timestamps of countdown start → loading screen creation → intro start), then export + smoke, cleanup probe dirs + `.cache`, kill `godot47`.
4. Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`, then give the terse final answer (changes table + verification table).

  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

Implementation:
```gdscript
func _recommended_options(hero: Hero, best_id: String, list: Array) -> Array:
	var opts: Array = []
	if best_id == "": return opts
	# 目标大件：best 本身就是推荐大件时取其本身，否则取包含 best 的最小推荐大件
	var target_id := ""
	if best_id in list:
		target_id = best_id
	else:
		for id in list:
			if hero.equipment_slots.has(id): continue
			if _item_uses_component(id, best_id):
				target_id = id
				break
	if target_id == "": return opts
	var missing: Array = _missing_components(hero, target_id)   # 递归收集缺失的基础件（去重）
	var seen := {}
	for mid in missing:
		if seen.has(mid): continue
		seen[mid] = true
		if hero.gold < float(ItemDatabase.get_item(mid).get("cost", 0)): continue
		opts.append({"id": mid, "name": ..., "cost": ..., "tier": ...})
	if opts.size() < 2: return []
	return opts
```
`_item_uses_component(id, comp)` recursive check whether comp appears anywhere in id's requires tree.
`_missing_components(hero, target)` recursive leaves with counts (like `_find_missing_basic` but collects all).

# 目标大件缺失的各级素材（可一次买多件时让玩家自己挑）
func _recommended_options(hero: Hero, best_id: String, list: Array) -> Array:
	if best_id == "":
		return []
	# 找出 best 所属的推荐大件（best 本身是大件时就是它）
	var target_id := best_id if best_id in list else ""
	if target_id == "":
		for rid in list:
			if hero.equipment_slots.has(rid): continue
			if rid != best_id and _item_depends_on(rid, best_id):
				target_id = rid
				break
	if target_id == "":
		return []
	var missing: Array = []
	_collect_missing_leaves(hero, target_id, missing)
	var opts: Array = []
	var seen := {}
	for mid in missing:
		if seen.has(mid): continue
		seen[mid] = true
		var mi = ItemDatabase.get_item(mid)
		if mi.is_empty(): continue
		if hero.gold < float(mi.get("cost", 0)): continue
		opts.append({"id": mid, "name": str(mi.get("name", mid)), "cost": int(mi.get("cost", 0)), "tier": int(mi.get("tier", 1))})
	# 只有多件可选才弹出（单件就是普通推荐）
	if opts.size() < 2:
		return []
	return opts

func _item_depends_on(id: String, comp: String) -> bool:
	if id == comp:
		return true
	for req in ItemDatabase.get_item(id).get("requires", []):
		if _item_depends_on(str(req), comp):
			return true
	return false

func _collect_missing_leaves(hero: Hero, id: String, out: Array) -> void:
	var item = ItemDatabase.get_item(id)
	if item.is_empty():
		return
	var reqs: Array = item.get("requires", [])
	if reqs.is_empty():
		if not hero.equipment_slots.has(id):
			out.append(id)
		return
	for req in reqs:
		# 已拥有就直接扣掉（与合成消耗一致）

			continue
		_collect_missing_leaves(hero, str(req), out)

func _sync_rec_options(opts: Array, gold: int) -> void:
	if rec_option_row == null:
		return
	var sig := ""
	for o in opts:
		sig += str(o["id"]) + "|"
	if sig != rec_option_sig:
		rec_option_sig = sig
		for c in rec_option_row.get_children():
			rec_option_row.remove_child(c)
			c.queue_free()
		rec_option_btns.clear()
		for o in opts:
			var tc: Color = _shop_tier_color(int(o.get("tier", 1)))
			var btn := Button.new()
			btn.text = "%s  %d金" % [str(o["name"]), int(o["cost"])]
			btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(112, 46)
			btn.add_theme_font_override("font", UiKit.font())
			btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
			btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", UiKit.C_TEXT)
			btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", tc.lightened(0.4))
			btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", UiKit.skin_button("normal", tc, true))
			btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", UiKit.skin_button("hover", tc, true))
			btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", UiKit.skin_button("pressed", tc, true))
			btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", UiKit.skin_button("disabled", tc, true))
			btn.pressed.connect(_shop_quick_buy.bind(str(o["id"])))
			rec_option_row.add_child(btn)
			rec_option_btns.append({"btn": btn, "cost": int(o["cost"])})
	rec_option_row.visible = not opts.is_empty()
	for e in rec_option_btns:
		var b2: Button = e["btn"]
		b2.disabled = gold < int(e["cost"])
		b2.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 1) if gold >= int(e["cost"]) else Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55)

Also hide option row while rec card maxed/slot full? If maxed (no recommendation) options empty → hidden ✓.

Also `_shop_quick_buy` calls `_refresh_shop_all()` + toast; recommendation refresh happens每帧 via update() ✓.

Potential issue: `_shop_tier_color(tier)` defined at L38; ensure mapping handles tier 1..4 ✓.

Another: `Button` inside HBox in HUD; scale? HUD uses ui scale via CanvasLayer transform presumably fine.

Also need: when options exist, does the recommendation still pick one `best` (the card shows only one)? Yes, chips provide alternatives. Requirement satisfied: "这些装备都弹出，由玩家自己选择购买哪一件".

But should we also hide the `+` quick buy when options shown to avoid confusion? Keep; card's primary item is still valid.

Edge: `_recommended_options` might include items already owned partially: `_collect_missing_leaves` returns leaf not owned; if leaf owned once but required twice, it'd be missing — fine.

Edge: target big item could be current best that is a component chain (e.g., best = tier2 item that is itself a leaf? no). `_item_depends_on(rid, best_id)` — find recommended big item containing best.

Potential bug: `_recommended_options` when `best` is a mid-tier item (not in list) and the target big item is in list, we pass `best` and compute target; missing leaves may include `best` itself (since best not owned) → options include best + other leaves that are affordable. That's exactly desired: show all affordable components. ✓

But note: buying a leaf may be a leaf deeper than `best`. Fine.

Another consideration: `_compute_recommended_bundle` is also called from NetSession snapshot build (single source) — it adds "options" key with Array of Dictionaries; NetSession may serialize `b` into `own.rb` dict? Check NetSession line ~1095 area for `_compute_recommended_bundle` usage to ensure the extra key doesn't break snapshot size/serialization.

scripts\core\SfxManager.gd
S 38|# Announcer=播报语音单通道；SFX=世界短音池；UI=界面短音池；Music=大厅环境音乐
S 39|const BUS_ANNOUNCER := "Announcer"
S 40|const BUS_SFX := "SFX"
S 41|const BUS_UI := "UI"
S 42|const BUS_MUSIC := "Music"
S 43|const BUS_NAMES := [BUS_ANNOUNCER, BUS_SFX, BUS_UI, BUS_MUSIC]
S 44|const UI_SFX_KEYS := ["coin", "buy", "sell", "ui_click"]
S 45|
S 46|# 通道/音量常量（dB）；-40 当作淡出静音位

Buses: Announcer, SFX, UI, Music. Settings: master volume slider could set Master bus? SfxManager has set_channel_volume per bus. Simplest: a settings panel with a volume slider controlling all four buses via SfxManager.set_channel_volume (or Master bus volume_db directly). Better: use AudioServer Master bus volume — affects everything: `AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(0, db)`.

Surrender: not implemented anywhere. Need to implement for single-player (and possibly online). Requirement: "发起投降（需要本队4人以上通过才能成功，且6分钟后才能发起投降）". In single player, team = player + 4 AI. So initiate surrender → AI teammates vote; need ≥4 of own team to approve (including self? "本队4人以上通过" likely 4 of 5 votes). So simulate votes: player counts as 1 yes; AI vote randomly-ish... For playability: AI teammates vote based on whether the team is losing? Simpler deterministic: AI all vote yes if game is going badly? Hmm, "需要本队4人以上通过才能成功" implies voting UI where team members vote. In single-player, we can have AI vote automatically (maybe with delay) — but to keep the feature usable, let AI vote yes if team is behind (e.g., team kills/gold behind or player's KDA bad), else no. That's design decision; simplest predictable: AI teammates each vote yes with probability based on being behind; but "4人以上通过" then often fails and player gets frustrated.

For the net/multiplayer: implement voting over NetSession? That's a bigger task — check if net mode uses host BattleManager with player team AI heroes and remote clients (NetSession takeover). Surrender vote would need network plumbing. Given budget (project principle: fastest), implement for local battle (single-player and host): a surrender vote panel where the 5 team members' votes fill in over 3s (AI votes) and result determined; ≥4 yes → defeat immediately (like crystal destroyed). For net clients: only host sees? Hmm; user just asks feature. I'll implement in host/single-player path via `BattleManager`, and hide the settings button on net client (or allow volume only). Let's check how game end is triggered: `BattleManager.` game over function e.g. `_game_over`, `end_battle`, `game_over`, `show_result`. Grep.

Then UI: settings button placed below recommendation (y ~256?). But rec_option_row occupies y196..250. Settings button below → y 256..306. Keep small round gear button, opens panel with volume slider + 投降 button.

# ==================== 设置面板（音量 / 投降） ====================
func _master_volume_pct() -> float:
	var idx := AudioServer.get_bus_index("Master")
	if idx < 0:
		return 100.0
	return clampf(db_to_linear(AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db(idx)) * 100.0, 0.0, 100.0)

func _apply_master_volume(pct: float) -> void:
	var idx := AudioServer.get_bus_index("Master")
	if idx < 0:
		return
	AudioServer.set_bus_mute(idx, pct <= 0.5)
	AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(idx, linear_to_db(clampf(pct, 0.0, 100.0) / 100.0))

func _settings_label(txt: String, size: int, col: Color) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = txt
	l.add_theme_font_override("font", UiKit.font())
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", size)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col)
	return l

func _open_settings() -> void:
	if settings_panel != null and is_instance_valid(settings_panel):
		settings_panel.visible = true
		return
	var battle = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager") as BattleManager
	settings_panel = Control.new()
	settings_panel.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	settings_panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	add_child(settings_panel)
	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55)
	dim.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	settings_panel.add_child(dim)
	var card := Panel.new()
	card.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER)
	card.offset_left = -250.0; card.offset_right = 250.0
	card.offset_top = -170.0; card.offset_bottom = 170.0
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", UiKit.panel_style(0.98, 18.0))
	settings_panel.add_child(card)
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	vb.offset_left = 26.0; vb.offset_top = 20.0
	vb.offset_right = -26.0; vb.offset_bottom = -20.0
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	card.add_child(vb)
	var title := _settings_label("设置", 26, UiKit.C_GOLD)
	title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.add_child(title)
	# 音量
	var vol_row := HBoxContainer.new()
	vol_row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	vol_row.add_child(_settings_label("音量", 18, UiKit.C_TEXT))
	var slider := HSlider.new()
	slider.min_value = 0.0; slider.max_value = 100.0; slider.step = 1.0
	slider.value = _master_volume_pct()
	slider.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(270.0, 30.0)
	slider.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	vol_row.add_child(slider)
	var vol_val := _settings_label("%d%%" % int(slider.value), 18, UiKit.C_EXP)
	vol_val.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(56.0, 0.0)
	vol_row.add_child(vol_val)
	vb.add_child(vol_row)
	slider.value_changed.connect(func(v: float) -> void:
		vol_val.text = "%d%%" % int(v)
		_apply_master_volume(v))
	# 投降
	var sur := Button.new()
	sur.text = "发起投降"
	sur.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0.0, 44.0)
	sur.add_theme_font_override("font", UiKit.font())
	sur.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
	sur.add_theme_color_override("font_color", UiKit.C_TEXT)
	sur.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", UiKit.skin_button("normal", UiKit.C_DANGER, true))
	sur.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", UiKit.skin_button("hover", UiKit.C_DANGER, true))
	sur.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", UiKit.skin_button("pressed", UiKit.C_DANGER, true))
	sur.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", UiKit.skin_button("disabled", UiKit.C_DANGER, true))
	sur.pressed.connect(_start_surrender_vote)
	var sur_hint := _settings_label("", 15, UiKit.C_TEXT_DIM)
	if battle != null:
		if battle.game_time < SURRENDER_MIN_TIME:
			sur.disabled = true
			sur_hint.text = "对局满 6:00 后才可发起投降"
		else:
			sur_hint.text = "需本队 5 人中至少 4 人同意"
	vb.add_child(sur)
	vb.add_child(sur_hint)
	surrender_status_label = _settings_label("", 16, UiKit.C_GOLD)
	surrender_status_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.add_child(surrender_status_label)
	# 关闭
	var close := Button.new()

# ==================== 设置面板（音量 / 投降） ====================
func _master_volume_pct() -> float:
	var idx := AudioServer.get_bus_index("Master")
	if idx < 0:
		return 100.0
	return clampf(db_to_linear(AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db(idx)) * 100.0, 0.0, 100.0)

func _apply_master_volume(pct: float) -> void:
	var idx := AudioServer.get_bus_index("Master")
	if idx < 0:
		return
	AudioServer.set_bus_mute(idx, pct <= 0.5)
	AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(idx, linear_to_db(clampf(pct, 0.0, 100.0) / 100.0))

## 发起投降：满 6 分钟 + 本队 5 人中 4 票同意才结束对局（单人/联机 host 的 AI 队友按局势表态）
func _start_surrender_vote() -> void:
	if surrender_vote_running:
		return
	var battle = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager") as BattleManager
	if battle == null or battle.game_over:
		return
	if battle.game_time < SURRENDER_MIN_TIME:
		_hud_toast("对局满 6:00 后才可发起投降", true)
		return
	surrender_vote_running = true
	var total := 1
	var yes := 1
	for e in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes"):
		if e is Hero and e.team == Config.player_team and e != battle.hero:
			total += 1
	var losing: bool = battle.team_player_gold < battle.team_enemy_gold or battle.team_player_kills < battle.team_enemy_kills
	_update_surrender_status(yes, total)
	for e2 in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes"):
		if not (e2 is Hero) or e2.team != Config.player_team or e2 == battle.hero:
			continue
		await get_tree().create_timer(randf_range(0.5, 1.0)).timeout
		if not is_instance_valid(self) or battle.game_over:
			surrender_vote_running = false
			return
		if losing or randf() < 0.3:
			yes += 1
		_update_surrender_status(yes, total)
	surrender_vote_running = false
	if yes >= SURRENDER_MIN_YES:
		_update_surrender_status(yes, total, "投降通过（%d/%d），对局结束" % [yes, total])
		_hud_toast("投降通过（%d/%d）" % [yes, total])
		_close_settings()
		battle.crystal_destroyed(Config.player_team)
	else:
		_update_surrender_status(yes, total, "投降未通过（%d/%d，需 4 票）" % [yes, total])
		_hud_toast("投降未通过（%d/%d 票）" % [yes, total], true)

func _update_surrender_status(yes: int, total: int, txt: String = "") -> void:
	if surrender_status_label == null or not is_instance_valid(surrender_status_label):
		return
	surrender_status_label.text = txt if txt != "" else "投降投票中… %d/%d" % [yes, total]

Semantics: `dragon_minion_budget` = number of **lane-spawns** (3 lanes per wave). For 先知主宰 budget 6 = 2 waves × 3 lanes; 暗影主宰 9 = 3 waves × 3 lanes. `dragon_count` increments per lane spawn; each wave of 3 lanes consumes 3. Total waves = budget/3. Remaining waves = (budget - dragon_count)/3 (approx; dragon_count resets when budget exhausted).

For the panel: show per-team vanguard waves remaining:
- If `dominant_buff_team == my_team`: "主宰先锋: 我方 X 波（剩余）" where X = ceil((budget - dragon_count)/3).
- Else if enemy owns: "敌方 X 波".
Display both always: "主宰先锋 我方 X 波 / 敌方 Y 波" + type name (风暴先锋 if storm).

Need waves from kill event: attacker's waves are `budget/3` at kill; after completion → 0.

Also track for both teams? Only one team can hold at a time (`dominant_buff_team` single var). So panel shows:
- 我方 X 波；敌方 Y 波 where X/Y derived from dominant_buff_team & remaining.

Implement via helper in BattleManager: `func vanguard_waves_left(team: int) -> int`:
```gdscript
func vanguard_waves_left(team: int) -> int:
	if dominant_buff_team != team: return 0
	var left := dragon_minion_budget - dragon_count
	return int(ceil(float(left) / 3.0)) if left > 0 else 0
```

Turret.gd L510: func take_damage(amount: float, source: GameEntity = null, is_magic: bool = false,skill_id:int=0,pen: float = 0.0, is_crit_forced: int = -1):

Overrides exist in Hero, JungleMonster, Minion, Tripod, Turret — adding a param to base and Hero (the only ones where true damage matters: Hero) while others ignore it is fine (they call super?). Simpler: avoid changing signatures! Instead use a *transient flag* approach:

Option: add a module-level mechanism — e.g., `GameEntity.true_damage_pending` static? Ugly.

Better: minimal signature change only in GameEntity + Hero:
- GameEntity.take_damage gains `is_true_damage: bool = false`.
- Hero.take_damage gains it and forwards to `super.take_damage(..., is_true_damage)`.
Other overrides (Minion etc.) don't accept it; but true damage targets heroes anyway (thornmail reflect on source, storm aura on heroes). Callers use `take_damage(...)` with 7th positional arg — GDScript will error at runtime if the target's override lacks that param? GDScript dynamic dispatch: calling `entity.take_damage(a, b, c, d, e, f, true)` on Minion → "too many arguments" runtime error. Storm aura targets any entity: `for entity in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("entities")` — includes minions/jungle. So passing 7th arg would break there.

Safe approach: use a keyword-ish helper: add method `take_true_damage(amount, source, is_magic, skill_id, pen_percent)` on GameEntity that sets an internal one-shot flag `_next_damage_true = true` then calls `take_damage(...)` (no extra param). Base take_damage reads/clears `_next_damage_true`. Since overrides call super, flag persists through (Hero's take_damage calls super at end, but might early-return before super e.g. famous_blade). Manage: flag set before call; cleared at start of base take_damage. If override returns early without calling super → stale flag; minor. Also Hero's take_damage may do pre-processing and early return (famous blade) — then damage doesn't apply anyway.

Implement:
```gdscript
var _next_damage_is_true: bool = false

## 真伤（无视护盾）：打一个一次性标记，随后常规 take_damage 会跳过护盾并弹红字
func take_true_damage(amount: float, source: GameEntity = null, is_magic: bool = false, skill_id: int = 0, pen_percent: float = 0.0) -> void:
	_next_damage_is_true = true
	take_damage(amount, source, is_magic, skill_id, pen_percent)
	_next_damage_is_true = false
```
And in base `take_damage`: `var is_true_damage := _next_damage_is_true; _next_damage_is_true = false` right after early return check? Place at top after health check.

Then change 3 call sites to `take_true_damage(...)`:
- thornmail: `source.take_true_damage(amount * 0.35, self, false, -42, 1.0)`
- storm aura: `entity.take_true_damage(entity.max_health * 0.04, self, true, -54, 1.0)`
- 夏侯惇 W: `target.take_true_damage(int(w_true_dmg), self, false, -50, 1.0)`

Careful: call sites on entities that may be Turret (turret take_damage override doesn't call super, ignores flag) — flag stale on that entity? Flag is instance var set on target then take_damage called; if override ignores, flag remains true → next damage on that entity is treated true. For turret storm aura excluded (`if entity is Turret: continue`). Thornmail reflect targets attacker which could be minion/turret (source.team != team) — minion override calls super? Let me check Minion.take_damage to see if it calls super; if not, flag may leak. Mitigate: reset flag after call in take_true_damage (`_next_damage_is_true = false` after) ✓ ALREADY planned — so leak avoided regardless.

But Hero.take_damage early return (famous blade) leaves flag; then reset after call ✓.

content.arguments:
{"command":"$f='scripts\ui\UI_Manager.gd'
$L=Get-Content $f
$i=($L | Select-String -Pattern '^func show_damage_number').LineNumber
$L[$i-1] = 'func show_damage_number(world_pos: Vector3, damage: float, is_crit: bool, is_magic: bool, shielded: bool = false, true_dmg: bool = false):'
$L[$i+15] = "`t# 数字配色：真伤红 / 护盾吸收白 / 法术品紫 / 物理暖橙 / 暴击亮金（描边跟着换深色）"
$L[$i+16] = "`tvar col: Color = Color(1.0, 0.30, 0.26) if true_dmg else (Color(0.96, 0.97, 1.0) if shielded else (Color(1.0, 0.90, 0.45) if is_crit else (Color(0.74, 0.53, 1.0) if is_magic else Color(1.0, 0.76, 0.34))))"
$L[$i+17] = "`tvar edge: Color = Color(0.30, 0.02, 0.02, 1.0) if true_dmg else (Color(0.10, 0.10, 0.14, 0.96) if shielded else (Color(0.40, 0.24, 0.02, 1.0) if is_crit else Color(0.12, 0.05, 0.02, 0.96)))"
Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 $f $L
$b=Get-Content $f
$b[$i-1] -replace "`t","<T>"
($i+14)..($i+18) | ForEach-Object { "U $_|" + ($b[$_-1] -replace "`t","<T>") }","description":"Update damage popup colors"}

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

extends Node
var t := 0
var bm = null
var ui = null
func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child((load("res://scenes/battle.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate())
func _last_label_col(prev: int) -> String:
	var ch := ui.get_children()
	var i := ch.size() - 1
	while i >= 0:
		if ch[i] is Label:
			var l: Label = ch[i]
			if l.get_parent() == ui and ui.get_child_count() > prev:
				var c := l.get_theme_color("font_color")
				return "rgb(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f) txt=%s" % [c.r, c.g, c.b, l.text]
		i -= 1
	return "none"
func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	t += 1
	get_tree().paused = false
	if t == 30:
		Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER
		Config._team_rolled = true
		bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
		bm._start_game_body("后羿", "flash")
	elif t == 200:
		ui = UiManager
		var hp0: float = bm.hero.health
		bm.hero.shield_remaining = 500.0
		var n0 := ui.get_child_count()
		bm.hero.take_damage(100.0, null, false, 0)
		print("L SHIELD hp_delta=", "%.0f" % (bm.hero.health - hp0), " shield_left=", "%.0f" % bm.hero.shield_remaining)
		print("L SHIELD_POPUP ", _last_label_col(n0))
	elif t == 204:
		var hp1: float = bm.hero.health
		var sh1: float = bm.hero.shield_remaining
		var n1 := ui.get_child_count()
		bm.hero.take_true_damage(100.0, null, false, -54)
		print("L TRUE hp_delta=", "%.0f" % (bm.hero.health - hp1), " shield_delta=", "%.0f" % (bm.hero.shield_remaining - sh1))
		print("L TRUE_POPUP ", _last_label_col(n1))
	elif t == 208:
		print("L NO_DRAGON ", ui._vanguard_info(bm))
	elif t == 212:
		bm.dragon_minion_type = "dragon"
		bm.dragon_minion_budget = 6
		bm.dragon_count = 0
		bm.dominant_buff_team = Config.player_team
		bm.vanguard_ever = true
		print("L OUR_DRAGON ", ui._vanguard_info(bm), " waves=", bm.vanguard_waves_left(Config.player_team), "/", bm.vanguard_waves_left(Config.Team.ENEMY))
	elif t == 216:
		bm.dominant_buff_team = Config.Team.ENEMY
		bm.dragon_count = 3
		print("L ENEMY_DRAGON ", ui._vanguard_info(bm))
		ui.toggle_hero_detail()
		print("L ROSTER_INFO ", ui.hero_detail_panel.hud_info, " visible=", ui.hero_detail_panel.visible)
		get_tree().quit()

I'll add a "操作设置" button next to 备战/对战纪录 row, opening a full-page settings screen (`_open_controls` similar to `_open_loadout`/`_open_history`). Need to look at `_open_loadout` page pattern to replicate a scrollable multi-section page.

Given the scale (9 settings), implement:
- PlayerPrefs new keys + getters/setters (persisted).
- Settings page with 9 rows, each as cycle button or toggle chip.
- Wire to gameplay:
  1. 小兵/推塔键 显示开关 → TouchController buttons visibility. Find buttons: 推塔键 "推塔", 补兵键 "补刀"/"小兵".
  2. 优先攻击目标 → attack target selection logic in Hero/TouchController (percent HP / absolute HP / nearest).
  3. 自动追击距离 → auto chase logic.
  4. 锁敌头像显示 → lock-on enemy portrait display (maybe exists in UI_Manager: "锁敌"/portrait).
  5. 轻点闪现方向 → flash cast direction (movement dir / nearest enemy).
  6. 技能轮盘灵敏度 → skill wheel drag sensitivity (TouchController wheel).
  7. 镜头灵敏度 → camera sensitivity.
  8. 位移预览显示 → dash preview marker with wall check (raycast to clamp endpoint).
  9. 自动普攻 → auto attack when target exists & not moving, interrupted by movement.

This is very large. Budget: must be efficient but complete and working. Let me assess what exists for each feature to wire minimal but functional behavior.

H 2700|<T>_aa_anim_until = now_s + 0.5

Now modify `_get_attack_target` player branch to respect `target_prio` setting for the general selection: currently hero-first then lowest absolute HP. New semantics per setting:
- 0 百分比血量: among same-class candidates pick lowest health/max_health ratio.
- 1 绝对血量: current behavior (lowest health).
- 2 距离最近: pick nearest.
Class priority stays hero-first.

Simplest: refactor the player block's selection loop to compute score based on setting. Implement helper:
```gdscript
func _target_prior_key(ent: GameEntity) -> float:
	var mode := PlayerPrefs.opt_int("target_prio", 0)
	if mode == 2:
		return global_position.distance_to(ent.global_position)
	if mode == 0:
		return ent.health / maxf(ent.actual_max_health if "actual_max_health" in ent else ent.max_health, 1.0)  # hmm
	return ent.health
```
Careful: GameEntity has `max_health`; Hero has `actual_max_health`. Use `ent.max_health` for all (percent of max). For heroes actual_max_health differs; use `(ent as Hero).actual_max_health` if Hero.

Simpler: score = health / max_health (percent), hero uses actual_max_health via has method? Use `ent.get("actual_max_health")` — dictionary-ish? For properties, `ent.get("actual_max_health")` works (Object.get) returning null if missing. So:
```gdscript
var mx := float(ent.get("actual_max_health")) if ent.get("actual_max_health") != null else maxf(ent.max_health, 1.0)
```

Implement `_priority_score` and use in both player and net branches (replace `ent.health < best_hero_hp` comparisons with score comparisons). To minimize edits: rewrite the player block loop using scores.

Now the auto chase & auto attack. Read Hero physics player branch around L1980-2200 to see where manual_target lock, auto attack when 站定, movement.

func clamp_dash_landing(dir: Vector3, dist: float) -> Vector3:
	var from := global_position
	var to := from + dir.normalized() * dist
	var space := get_world_3d().direct_space_state
	var q := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(from + Vector3.UP * 0.6, to + Vector3.UP * 0.6)
	q.collision_mask = 1
	q.collide_with_bodies = true
	var hit := space.intersect_ray(q)
	if hit.is_empty():
		return to
	var c = hit["collider"]
	if c is Wall:
		var p: Vector3 = hit["position"] + (hit["normal"]) * 0.35
		p.y = 0.5
		return p
	return to

content.arguments:
{"command":"$f='scripts\entities\Hero.gd'
$L=Get-Content $f
$new = @(
 "`t`tvar best_hero: GameEntity = null",
 "`t`tvar best_hero_s := 999999.0",
 "`t`tvar best_other: GameEntity = null",
 "`t`tvar best_other_s := 999999.0",
 "`t`tvar best_pot: GameEntity = null",
 "`t`tvar best_pot_s := 999999.0",
 "`t`tfor ent in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group(`"entities`"):",
 "`t`t`tif ent == self or not (ent is GameEntity) or ent.health <= 0 or ent.team == team:",
 "`t`t`t`tcontinue",
 "`t`t`tif not (ent is Hero or ent is Minion or ent is Turret or ent is JungleMonster or ent is Tripod):",
 "`t`t`t`tcontinue  # 排除墙体/草丛/治疗包等非战斗实体",
 "`t`t`tif global_position.distance_to(ent.global_position) > range:",
 "`t`t`t`tcontinue",
 "`t`t`tvar sc: float = _target_prio_score(ent)",
 "`t`t`tif ent is Hero:",
 "`t`t`t`tif (ent as Hero).is_invisible_to_enemy() or (ent as Hero).is_untargetable_by_enemies():",
 "`t`t`t`t`tcontinue  # 隐身中的敌方英雄不可被自动索敌（AoE 仍可波及）",
 "`t`t`t`tif sc < best_hero_s:",
 "`t`t`t`t`tbest_hero_s = sc",
 "`t`t`t`t`tbest_hero = ent",
 "`t`t`telif ent is Tripod:",
 "`t`t`t`t# 大禹治疗鼎优先级最低：不抢英雄/兵线/塔的自动索敌",
 "`t`t`t`tif sc < best_pot_s:",
 "`t`t`t`t`tbest_pot_s = sc",
 "`t`t`t`t`tbest_pot = ent",
 "`t`t`telse:",
 "`t`t`t`tif sc < best_other_s:",
 "`t`t`t`t`tbest_other_s = sc",
 "`t`t`t`t`tbest_other = ent",
 "`t`tif best_hero:",
 "`t`t`treturn best_hero",
 "`t`tif best_other:",
 "`t`t`treturn best_other",

content.name: pwsh
content.arguments:
{"command":"$f='scripts\entities\Hero.gd'
$L=Get-Content $f
$i=($L | Select-String -Pattern '^func _pick_priority_target').LineNumber
"i=$i"
$helpers = @(
 "# 自动索敌排序分：0=百分比血量最低 1=绝对血量最低 2=距离最近",
 "func _target_prio_score(ent: GameEntity) -> float:",
 "`tvar mode: int = PlayerPrefs.opt_int(`"target_prio`", 0)",
 "`tif mode == 2:",
 "`t`treturn global_position.distance_to(ent.global_position)",
 "`tif mode == 0:",
 "`t`tvar mx: float = float(ent.get(`"actual_max_health`")) if ent.get(`"actual_max_health`") != null else ent.max_health",
 "`t`treturn ent.health / maxf(mx, 1.0)",
 "`treturn ent.health",
 "",
 "# 自动追击距离余量（米）：0=标准+3 1=近+1 2=关",
 "func _auto_chase_margin() -> float:",
 "`tvar m: int = PlayerPrefs.opt_int(`"auto_chase`", 0)",
 "`tif m == 1:",
 "`t`treturn 1.0",
 "`tif m == 2:",
 "`t`treturn 0.0",
 "`treturn 3.0",
 "",
 "# 位移落点（考虑墙体）：沿 dir 前进 dist，撞墙则停在墙前 0.4m",
 "func clamp_dash_landing(dir: Vector3, dist: float) -> Vector3:",
 "`tvar flat := Vector3(dir.x, 0.0, dir.z)",
 "`tif flat.length() < 0.01:",
 "`t`treturn global_position",
 "`tvar from := global_position + flat.normalized() * 0.4",
 "`tvar to := from + flat.normalized() * dist",
 "`tvar space := get_world_3d().direct_space_state",
 "`tvar q := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(from + Vector3.UP * 0.7, to + Vector3.UP * 0.7)",
 "`tq.collision_mask = 1",
 "`tq.collide_with_bodies = true",
 "`tvar hit: Dictionary = space.intersect_ray(q)",
 "`tvar out := to",
 "`tif not hit.is_empty() and hit.get(`"collider`") is Wall:",
 "`t`tvar p: Vector3 = hit[`"position`"] + (hit[`"normal`"] as Vector3) * 0.45",
 "`t`tout = Vector3(p.x, global_position.y, p.z)",
 "`treturn out",
 "",
 "# 位移预览环：拖动闪现/位移技能时在落点画圈（含墙体修正），关=不显示",
 "func _update_dash_preview() -> void:",
 "`tif is_ai or health <= 0:",
 "`t`tif _dash_preview != null and is_instance_valid(_dash_preview):",
 "`t`t`t_dash_preview.visible = false",
 "`t`treturn",
 "`tif not PlayerPrefs.opt_bool(`"move_preview`", true):",
 "`t`tif _dash_preview != null and is_instance_valid(_dash_preview):",
 "`t`t`t_dash_preview.visible = false",
 "`t`treturn",
 "`tvar dir := Vector3.ZERO",
 "`tvar dist := 0.0",
 "`tvar sum_drag := TouchController.get_summoner_drag()",
 "`tif sum_drag.length() > 20.0 and summoner_skill != null and str(summoner_skill.skill_name) == `"闪现`":",
 "`t`tdir = _resolve_flash_dir(sum_drag)",
 "`t`tdist = 5.0",
 "`telse:",
 "`t`tfor i in range(mini(skills.size(), 3)):",
 "`t`t`tif TouchController.get_skill_held(i) and skills[i] != null and int(skills[i].type) == 4:",
 "`t`t`t`tvar drag := TouchController.get_skill_drag(i)",
 "`t`t`t`tif drag.length() > 20.0:",
 "`t`t`t`t`tdir = Vector3(drag.x, 0.0, drag.y).normalized()",
 "`t`t`t`t`tdist = clampf(float(skills[i].cast_range), 2.0, 12.0)",
 "`t`t`t`t`tbreak",
 "`tif dist <= 0.0:",
 "`t`tif _dash_preview != null and is_instance_valid(_dash_preview):",
 "`t`t`t_dash_preview.visible = false",
 "`t`treturn",
 "`tvar endp := clamp_dash_landing(dir, dist)",
 "`tif _dash_preview == null or not is_instance_valid(_dash_preview):",
 "`t`t_dash_preview = MeshInstance3D.new()",
 "`t`tvar tm := TorusMesh.new()",
 "`t`ttm.inner_radius = 0.42",
 "`t`ttm.outer_radius = 0.55",
 "`t`t_dash_preview.mesh = tm",
 "`t`tvar mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()",
 "`t`tmat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED",
 "`t`tmat.albedo_color = Color(0.55, 0.85, 1.0, 0.9)",
 "`t`tmat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA",
 "`t`tmat.no_depth_test = false",
 "`t`t_dash_preview.material_override = mat",
 "`t`tget_tree().current_scene.add_child(_dash_preview) if get_tree().current_scene != null else get_parent().add_child(_dash_preview)",
 "`t_dash_preview.global_position = endp + Vector3.UP * 0.12",
 "`t_dash_preview.visible = true",
 "",
)
$L = $L[0..($i-2)] + $helpers + $L[($i-1)..($L.Count-1)]
Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 $f $L
$b=Get-Content $f
$k=($b | Select-String -Pattern '^func _target_prio_score').LineNumber
"k=$k"
$k..($k+8) | ForEach-Object { "H|" + $b[$_-1] }","description":"Insert priority/chase/preview helpers"}

data.arguments:
{"command":"$f='scripts\entities\Hero.gd'
$L=Get-Content $f
$i=($L | Select-String -Pattern '^func _pick_priority_target').LineNumber
"i=$i"
$helpers = @(
 "# 自动索敌排序分：0=百分比血量最低 1=绝对血量最低 2=距离最近",
 "func _target_prio_score(ent: GameEntity) -> float:",
 "`tvar mode: int = PlayerPrefs.opt_int(`"target_prio`", 0)",
 "`tif mode == 2:",
 "`t`treturn global_position.distance_to(ent.global_position)",
 "`tif mode == 0:",
 "`t`tvar mx: float = float(ent.get(`"actual_max_health`")) if ent.get(`"actual_max_health`") != null else ent.max_health",
 "`t`treturn ent.health / maxf(mx, 1.0)",
 "`treturn ent.health",
 "",
 "# 自动追击距离余量（米）：0=标准+3 1=近+1 2=关",
 "func _auto_chase_margin() -> float:",
 "`tvar m: int = PlayerPrefs.opt_int(`"auto_chase`", 0)",
 "`tif m == 1:",
 "`t`treturn 1.0",
 "`tif m == 2:",
 "`t`treturn 0.0",
 "`treturn 3.0",
 "",
 "# 位移落点（考虑墙体）：沿 dir 前进 dist，撞墙则停在墙前 0.4m",
 "func clamp_dash_landing(dir: Vector3, dist: float) -> Vector3:",
 "`tvar flat := Vector3(dir.x, 0.0, dir.z)",
 "`tif flat.length() < 0.01:",
 "`t`treturn global_position",
 "`tvar from := global_position + flat.normalized() * 0.4",
 "`tvar to := from + flat.normalized() * dist",
 "`tvar space := get_world_3d().direct_space_state",
 "`tvar q := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(from + Vector3.UP * 0.7, to + Vector3.UP * 0.7)",
 "`tq.collision_mask = 1",
 "`tq.collide_with_bodies = true",
 "`tvar hit: Dictionary = space.intersect_ray(q)",
 "`tvar out := to",
 "`tif not hit.is_empty() and hit.get(`"collider`") is Wall:",
 "`t`tvar p: Vector3 = hit[`"position`"] + (hit[`"normal`"] as Vector3) * 0.45",
 "`t`tout = Vector3(p.x, global_position.y, p.z)",
 "`treturn out",
 "",
 "# 位移预览环：拖动闪现/位移技能时在落点画圈（含墙体修正），关=不显示",
 "func _update_dash_preview() -> void:",
 "`tif is_ai or health <= 0:",
 "`t`tif _dash_preview != null and is_instance_valid(_dash_preview):",
 "`t`t`t_dash_preview.visible = false",
 "`t`treturn",
 "`tif not PlayerPrefs.opt_bool(`"move_preview`", true):",
 "`t`tif _dash_preview != null and is_instance_valid(_dash_preview):",
 "`t`t`t_dash_preview.visible = false",
 "`t`treturn",
 "`tvar dir := Vector3.ZERO",
 "`tvar dist := 0.0",
 "`tvar sum_drag := TouchController.get_summoner_drag()",
 "`tif sum_drag.length() > 20.0 and summoner_skill != null and str(summoner_skill.skill_name) == `"闪现`":",
 "`t`tdir = _resolve_flash_dir(sum_drag)",
 "`t`tdist = 5.0",
 "`telse:",
 "`t`tfor i in range(mini(skills.size(), 3)):",
 "`t`t`tif TouchController.get_skill_held(i) and skills[i] != null and int(skills[i].type) == 4:",
 "`t`t`t`tvar drag := TouchController.get_skill_drag(i)",
 "`t`t`t`tif drag.length() > 20.0:",
 "`t`t`t`t`tdir = Vector3(drag.x, 0.0, drag.y).normalized()",
 "`t`t`t`t`tdist = clampf(float(skills[i].cast_range), 2.0, 12.0)",
 "`t`t`t`t`tbreak",
 "`tif dist <= 0.0:",
 "`t`tif _dash_preview != null and is_instance_valid(_dash_preview):",
 "`t`t`t_dash_preview.visible = false",
 "`t`treturn",
 "`tvar endp := clamp_dash_landing(dir, dist)",
 "`tif _dash_preview == null or not is_instance_valid(_dash_preview):",
 "`t`t_dash_preview = MeshInstance3D.new()",
 "`t`tvar tm := TorusMesh.new()",
 "`t`ttm.inner_radius = 0.42",
 "`t`ttm.outer_radius = 0.55",
 "`t`t_dash_preview.mesh = tm",
 "`t`tvar mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()",
 "`t`tmat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED",
 "`t`tmat.albedo_color = Color(0.55, 0.85, 1.0, 0.9)",
 "`t`tmat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA",
 "`t`tmat.no_depth_test = false",
 "`t`t_dash_preview.material_override = mat",
 "`t`tget_tree().current_scene.add_child(_dash_preview) if get_tree().current_scene != null else get_parent().add_child(_dash_preview)",
 "`t_dash_preview.global_position = endp + Vector3.UP * 0.12",
 "`t_dash_preview.visible = true",
 "",
)

@'
extends Node
var t := 0
var bm = null
func _foes() -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	for e in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes"):
		if e is Hero and e.team != Config.player_team:
			out.append(e)
	return out
func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	t += 1
	get_tree().paused = false
	if t == 30:
		Config.player_team = Config.Team.PLAYER
		Config._team_rolled = true
		bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
		bm._start_game_body("后羿", "flash")
	elif t == 200:
		var s = load("res://scripts/net/NetLobby.gd")
		print("L LOBBY_SCRIPT parsed=", s != null)
		PlayerPrefs.set_opt("target_prio", 2)
		PlayerPrefs.set_opt("siege_keys", false)
		PlayerPrefs.set_opt("lock_portrait", false)
		PlayerPrefs.set_opt("flash_dir", 1)
		PlayerPrefs.set_opt("skill_sens", 1.4)
		PlayerPrefs.set_opt("cam_sens", 0.8)
		print("L PREFS prio=", PlayerPrefs.opt_int("target_prio", 0), " siege=", PlayerPrefs.opt_bool("siege_keys", true), " sens=", PlayerPrefs.opt_float("skill_sens", 1.0))
		print("L UI siege_tower_visible=", TouchController._tower_button.visible if TouchController._tower_button else "none", " minion_visible=", TouchController._minion_button.visible if TouchController._minion_button else "none")
		var foes := _foes()
		if foes.size() >= 2:
			var near: Hero = foes[0]
			var far: Hero = foes[1]
			near.global_position = bm.hero.global_position + Vector3(4, 0, 0)
			far.global_position = bm.hero.global_position + Vector3(9, 0, 0)
			near.health = 900.0
			far.health = 60.0
			var tg = bm.hero._get_attack_target(20.0)
			print("L PRIO_NEAREST -> ", tg.display_name if tg else "null", " (expect ", near.display_name, ")")
			PlayerPrefs.set_opt("target_prio", 1)
			var tg2 = bm.hero._get_attack_target(20.0)
			print("L PRIO_LOWHP -> ", tg2.display_name if tg2 else "null", " (expect ", far.display_name, ")")
			print("L FLASH_DIR ", bm.hero._resolve_flash_dir(Vector2.ZERO))
			bm.hero.manual_target = far
			var d0: float = bm.hero.global_position.distance_to(far.global_position)
			print("L CHASE_D0 ", "%.2f" % d0, " margin=", bm.hero._auto_chase_margin())
	elif t == 230:
